qa: Vragen van de leden Aasted Madsen-van Stiphout en Jan de Vries (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Justitie over het mentoraat (ingezonden 4 mei 2010).

MPs from the CDA asked whether the government is ending the temporary subsidy for regional mentorship foundations, what the consequences would be for vulnerable adults, whether a structural financing arrangement exists in the draft legislation, and why the government is winding down support it had built up. The minister answered that no decision has been taken yet but no new subsidies are currently granted pending budget decisions, that the draft law does not provide central government financing, and that the subsidies were always explicitly temporary with no guaranteed continuity.
That this appreciation has been given concrete form in temporary stimulation and bridging subsidies does not mean I guarantee the continuity of this funding.
Dat die waardering is geconcretiseerd in tijdelijke stimulerings- en overbruggingssubsidies betekent niet dat ik continuïteit van deze financiering garandeer.

The Minister replied that education has not been cut since 2015, that 4 hours weekly are available for education, re-integration and meaning-making, that no data is kept on hours per activity, and that Dutch practice complies with the European Prison Rules and Mandela Rules.
No data is kept on how many hours are spent on education within the 4 hours available for education, re-integration and meaning-making.

The minister cited VU research linking discrimination to fewer credits, said broader research is not necessary now, expressed confidence in the Action Plan, and answered the remaining questions mostly with general references, noting no national research on assessment subjectivity and an unclear effect of binding study advice, while committing to ongoing talks on an internship approach.
For that reason I do not consider broader research, in addition to what is already being done, necessary at this time.
Daarom acht ik een breder onderzoek – in aanvulling op wat er al gedaan wordt – op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van den Berge over de vaccinatiestrategie

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Health how homeless people, undocumented residents, unmanaged-budget recipients, informal carers and children of undocumented parents will be reached, informed, registered and vaccinated under the COVID-19 vaccination strategy. The Minister answered all 13 questions one by one, giving timing based on expected supply and Health Council risk groups, outlining outreach through organisations like the Leger des Heils, and stating that children under 18 are not yet being vaccinated.
We will soon discuss with the organisations where these groups are known (including the Salvation Army) how this harder-to-reach target group can best be informed.
We gaan binnenkort met de organisaties waar deze groepen bekend zijn (o.a. het Leger des Heils) in gesprek over de vraag hoe deze moeilijker bereikbare doelgroep het beste geïnformeerd kan worden.

The number of COVID-19 infections in sex work is not registered.

The minister answered that ex-partners should first agree between themselves, that courts remain available, that LBIO should not gain a review power, that periodic accounting is undesirable, and that the Belastingdienst is raising awareness, while rejecting a binding dispute committee.
I therefore see little added value in establishing a dispute committee for maintenance cases, certainly not given the downward trend in the number of court cases.
Ik zie dan ook weinig toegevoegde waarde in het instellen van een geschillencommissie voor alimentatiezaken, zeker niet gezien de dalende trend van het aantal rechtszaken.

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the Zeeland child-protection provider Intervence is being closed by 1 January 2021, whether children and families can be safely transferred, and whether the government is responsible. The government answers that municipalities chose the scenario, that no irreversible steps will be taken until an inspectorate-approved transition plan exists, and that tariff and personnel issues are being addressed.
The proposed decision by the municipalities has a far-reaching impact on the children and their relatives, the Intervence staff and all parties involved in Zeeland.

Arrests have since been made in this case and the criminal investigation is ongoing.

MPs asked the ministers why COVID-19 exemptions for cultural institutions differ between regions, why safety regions were unprepared, and whether a uniform rule set and RIVM-tested pilots are possible. The government answered that exemptions lapsed after the tougher measures of 13 October, that a uniform 30-visitor cap now applies and a routekaart improves predictability, and that a Fieldlab programme and RIVM advice will inform test events.

Met deze stevigere maatregelen is de mogelijkheid tot het verlenen van vrijstellingen door de Veiligheidsregio’s komen te vervallen.

MPs Van den Berge, Asscher and Kwint asked the ministers whether the culture sector's 62 percent turnover loss at UWV, the delay in support, the adequacy of the second support package, the talent drain, the link with the April motion, sector robustness and events-sector compensation were acceptable. The minister responds that substantial support (about 1.3 billion euros in total) has been provided in stages, that the second package covers January to June 2021, and that further measures are under discussion with the sector and the Raad voor Cultuur.
I regret that institutions and businesses in the cultural and creative sector have to decide to dismiss staff because of this crisis.
Ik betreur het dat instellingen en ondernemingen in de culturele en creatieve sector door deze crisis moeten besluiten tot het ontslaan van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Smals en Van den Berge over het bericht  “Ik ga waarschijnlijk niet over naar het volgende jaar” op 14 september 2020

MPs Smals and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education about the shortage of internship places for MBO students during the coronavirus crisis, including government and municipal placement numbers, how places will be expanded, and whether diploma requirements can be relaxed. The minister answered that central government internship places fell in 2020, that interdepartmental efforts and an action plan through SBB are underway, and that schools have flexibility on internship hours, while municipal data is not collected.
Inquiries with the VNG, IPO and Union of Water Boards show that no data is collected on the number of internship places at decentralised governments.
Uit navraag bij de VNG, IPO en Unie van Waterschappen blijkt dat er geen gegevens worden verzameld over het aantal stageplekken bij de decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over de rol, taken en verantwoordelijkheden van de Landelijke Expertisegroep Bijzondere Zedenzaken

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about the role, tasks and responsibilities of the LEBZ expert group on sexual offence cases, the removal of a website sentence about it, and calls for an independent investigation into ritual abuse networks. The minister explained that the LEBZ advises the public prosecutor non-bindingly, that the website change did not alter its role, and that he sees no reason for a new investigation while offering to contact German counterparts.
The advice of the LEBZ is not binding.
De adviezen van de LEBZ zijn niet bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de impact van coronabeperkingen op visumverlening aan buitenlandse geliefden van Nederlanders

MPs asked the government about the impact of COVID-19 restrictions on visa processing for foreign partners of Dutch nationals, including closed embassies, cancelled civic integration exams abroad, and whether alternative routes such as online exams or post-arrival testing are possible. The minister answered that most posts now offer the basic integration exam, that online testing is ruled out to prevent fraud, that post-arrival testing is incompatible with the MVV process, and that the government will keep working with posts and EU partners but cannot quantify affected families.
There is no insight into figures on the number of Dutch nationals currently forced to live apart because their partner cannot take the basic civic integration exam abroad.
Er is geen inzicht in cijfers van het aantal Nederlandse staatsburgers dat op dit moment gescheiden moet leven vanwege het niet kunnen afleggen van een basisexamen inburgering buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Van den Berge over het bericht ‘Ook kunstenaars in Oost-Nederland hekelen scheve verdeling kunstsubsidies’

MPs Ellemeet and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the regional imbalance in performing arts subsidies (54% to Amsterdam, almost none to the eastern and northern regions) and what will be done to prevent cultural decline in Oost-Nederland. The Minister replied that extra funding of EUR 15 million per year will go to 71 institutions with positive advice but insufficient budget, and that infrastructure in Flevoland, Friesland, Drenthe, Zeeland, Limburg and Overijssel will be strengthened, with more regional spread than before.
I am adding the province of Overijssel to that.
Daar voeg ik de provincie Overijssel aan toe.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van den Berge over de miljardenkorting op Europese onderzoeksgelden

An MP asks the minister why the European Parliament's proposed EUR 120 billion for Horizon Europe was not adopted, whether this cut harms Dutch researchers, and what compensation is planned. The minister answers that the agreed Horizon Europe budget rises from EUR 66 to EUR 76 billion (plus EUR 5 billion from Next Generation EU), that Dutch researchers are expected to benefit, and that the MFK agreement is not yet final.
The budget for Horizon Europe from the MFF 2021–2027 and the recovery instrument combined therefore rises by 22%.
Het budget voor Horizon Europe uit het MFK 2021–2027 en het herstelinstrument tezamen stijgt dus met 22%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Ellemeet en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Minister Van Engelshoven eindigt subsidie op de MBO card’

Three GroenLinks and PvdA MPs asked the education minister why she ended the MBO Card culture subsidy despite the Berenschot evaluation recommending strengthening it, and how this fits her culture policy ambitions. The minister answered that the subsidy goal was not met, so continuing state funding is not appropriate, and she will instead provide 500,000 euro yearly to a general cultural education scheme, while stating she remains committed to integrated culture education.
If the subsidy objectives of the MBO Card have not been achieved, I do not think it makes sense to then continue the MBO Card with government subsidies.
Als de subsidiedoelstellingen van de MBO Card niet zijn behaald, vind ik het niet geheel in de rede liggen om vervolgens met overheidssubsidies het voortbestaan van de MBO Card te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over inburgering van mensen met een beperking

MP Van den Berge asks whether inburgeraars with disabilities, especially blind newcomers, can access Dutch language learning and why medical exemption is the main route, and asks about pilots and monitoring. The minister answers that 499 people were exempted on medical grounds in 2019, that no breakdown by disability type is kept for privacy reasons, that a VISIO pilot started in April 2020, and that partial exemptions will be made possible in the new inburgering law.
No overviews are kept of the type of disability due to privacy legislation.
Er worden geen overzichten bijgehouden van het type beperking vanwege privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van den Berge over de strafrechtspleging in Coronatijd

MPs Buitenweg and Van den Berge asked about the state of criminal justice during the COVID-19 period, including police capacity, legal aid, backlogs, courtroom access, detainee participation and tbs (forensic psychiatric) leave. The minister replied that physical hearings were gradually resumed from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, backlogs are being addressed through an integrated approach, and various measures on legal aid, video hearings and probation were described, mostly without concrete new commitments beyond promised letters.
Your House will be informed in writing about the approach once it is ready.
Uw Kamer wordt schriftelijk geïnformeerd over de aanpak zodra deze gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Bruins over religie en seksualiteit in een online lesmethode voor burgerschapsonderwijs in het mbo

MPs Van den Berge and Bruins asked the Minister of Education about stereotyping questions on religion and sexuality in an online civic education method for MBO, and about oversight and development of such materials. The Minister said civic education should foster critical thinking, that schools choose their own methods within legal requirements, that the Inspectorate checks quality of civic education but not materials in general, and that no ministry role in developing materials is planned.
It is up to the school itself to decide how civic education is shaped and which teaching method is used.
Het is daarnaast aan de school zelf om te beslissen hoe het burgerschapsonderwijs wordt vormgegeven en welke lesmethode hierbij wordt gebruikt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Van den Berge over de berichtgeving dat de politie en het OM steken laten vallen bij het afdwingen van het nakomen van door de rechter vastgestelde omgangsregelinge

MPs asked whether police and prosecutors neglect enforcement of court-ordered child contact arrangements, including reluctance to take complaints and the scope of criminal versus civil remedies. The Minister acknowledges the concern, says current reports are insufficient for firm conclusions, and points to an expert team reporting in October, with no concrete enforcement change committed yet.
I am awaiting their report before drawing further conclusions.
Ik wacht hun rapport af alvorens verdere conclusies te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Berge over het voornemen de aangenomen motie over Afghaanse misbruikslachtoffers niet uit te voeren

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why the State Secretary will not implement an adopted motion granting protection to Afghan bacha bazi abuse victims, and why the response took nearly four months. The State Secretary replies that literal implementation conflicts with the EU Qualification Directive, that existing asylum assessment already protects such victims where needed, and that she is nonetheless willing to designate them as a risk group in the Vreemdelingencirculaire.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over streamingsdiensten

An MP asked whether streaming services profit from lockdown-driven demand while creative workers lose income, and whether the minister would push at EU level for a solidarity levy or a moral appeal on streamers. The minister noted Netflix subscriber growth in the Netherlands but said overall streaming revenue is unclear, described voluntary Netflix relief funds, and declined a general moral appeal while expressing concern for the sector.
I therefore do not consider a moral appeal to all streaming services in general desirable.
Ik vind een moreel appèl op alle streamingsdiensten in het algemeen derhalve niet wenselijk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van den Berge over het bericht 'Transgender eist excuses overheid: ‘Om vrouw te worden, moest ik me laten steriliseren’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government acknowledges the harm caused by the pre-2014 sterilisation requirement for legal gender change, whether it will apologise, how other countries handled redress, and whether it will meet the complainants. The minister acknowledged the harm and the requirement's damage, said a response to the Transgender Collective's letter requesting apology and compensation talks is still under consideration, described Sweden's compensation and noted no other countries have apologised, and declined to commit to a meeting for now.
I am aware that this condition for sterilisation caused suffering and I also acknowledge this suffering.
Ik ben er mee bekend dat deze voorwaarde tot sterilisatie leed heeft veroorzaakt en erken dit leed ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over gevolgen van het opschorten van Staatsexamens Nt2 voor statushouders en andere nieuwkomers

An MP asked whether suspending the Nt2 state exams, due to COVID-19, would block asylum holders and other newcomers from starting education in September, and whether the government would talk with education institutions about solutions. The minister agreed the situation is undesirable and reported agreements with the VH, VSNU and MBO Raad allowing conditional admission for students who cannot yet show the required Dutch language level, subject to proof of level before 1 January.
I have already spoken with VH, VSNU and the MBO Raad.
Ik ben reeds in gesprek gegaan met VH, VSNU en de MBO Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Van den Berge en Kwint over een noodfonds voor de culturele sector

Three opposition MPs asked whether the government will provide extra funds to compensate the cultural sector for lost income during the COVID-19 crisis and whether they support an emergency fund. The minister answered that an additional 300 million euros is being added for key cultural infrastructure, while pointing to general COVID-19 support measures and repeating the same reply to most follow-up questions.
The cabinet is adding 300 million euros in additional funds to the existing instruments to maintain the vital parts of the cultural infrastructure.
Het kabinet voegt € 300 miljoen additionele middelen toe aan het bestaande instrumentarium om de vitale onderdelen in de culturele infrastructuur in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Renkema over maatregelen tegen het Coronavirus in mbo-instellingen

MPs Van den Berge and Renkema asked why mbo vocational schools were not advised to move all non-essential activities online or cancel them, given student work in care settings and the approach taken for higher education. The minister replied that from 15 March until 6 April no on-site teaching occurs in mbo and other schools, that online teaching is used where possible, and that schools were asked to prioritise final-year students and the Cabinet is assessing consequences for individual students.
Currently the cabinet is inventorying the further consequences of COVID-19, including the consequences for individual students.
Momenteel inventariseert het kabinet de verdere gevolgen van COVID-19, waaronder de gevolgen voor individuele studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Nispen, Kuiken en Van der Graaf over het onderzoekverloop naar de dood van Dascha Graafsma

MPs asked how the second opinion on the cause of Dascha Graafsma's death was set up, how bias was prevented, whether lessons would lead to rule changes, and what the government would do about the family's complaints. The minister answered that a separate police unit runs the forensic second opinion, reviewed by uninvolved prosecutors, that no rule changes are planned, and that the OM apologised and will keep communicating openly.
The OM and police have apologised for earlier communication that too firmly concluded this case was a suicide.
Het OM en politie hebben excuses gemaakt voor eerdere communicatie waarin te stellig werd geconcludeerd dat in deze zaak sprake was van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Groothuizen en Van den Berge over de werkwijze van de meervoudige kamers van de Hoge Raad

MPs Van Nispen, Groothuizen and Van den Berge asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Supreme Court's practice of 'reservists' taking part in deliberations conflicts with articles 75 and 5 of the Wet RO. The Minister answered that reservists only give legal input in deliberations, do not decide cases or join the final vote, so no conflict with the law arises and no amendment is needed.
In my view there is therefore no reason to amend the law.
Mijns inziens bestaat er dan ook geen aanleiding om de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het personeelstekort in jeugdgevangenissen

MPs Van den Berge, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff shortages in youth detention centres, including juveniles being temporarily placed in a women's prison, closures, turnover, sick leave and the Juvaid incident. The Minister answered that the problem is staff shortage rather than a lack of beds, detailed staffing and absence figures, and described the Ter Peel arrangement and measures taken at Juvaid.
I am aware of that. Should there be cause to inform you, I will do so.
Ik ben daarvan op de hoogte. Mocht er aanleiding zijn u te informeren, dan zal ik dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over kinderen die seksueel zijn misbruikt en onvoldoende hulp krijgen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health and justice ministers about child sexual abuse victims who receive insufficient care, including misdiagnosis, referrals between services, use of isolation, and funding problems at Centres for Sexual Violence. The minister acknowledged difficulties in recognising trauma and referral delays, outlined programmes and pilots, and said the exact numbers are not known while committing to further research and a study with the Dutch Rapporteur.
The requested figures are not known.
De gevraagde cijfers zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Dam, Groothuizen, Helder, Kuiken, Van Wijngaarden en Van den Berge over het boek ‘Moordsporen, op zoek naar de waarheid achter cold cases’

MPs from several parties asked the Justice Minister about the book 'Moordsporen' on unresolved cold cases, including the Larissa Dumont case, and whether an independent second-opinion facility should be set up. The minister acknowledged the importance of resolving doubts for relatives, pointed to police learning and ombudsman initiatives, defended the prosecutor's earlier conclusions, and described an ongoing second-opinion pilot and existing complaint routes.
If relatives have doubts about the conclusions of the death investigation after it has concluded, they can raise them with the public prosecutor.
Indien nabestaanden na het overlijdensonderzoek twijfels hebben over de conclusies daarvan, kunnen zij deze kenbaar maken aan de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Paternotte en Van den Hul over het manifest van de beurspromovendi

MPs Van den Berge, Paternotte and Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the manifesto of PhD candidates on scholarships, who lack employee rights, face pressure to teach, and receive weaker protections than employed PhD students. The minister largely defended the experiment, saying promotion students have no teaching duty and that the RUG has been urged to better inform supervisors, while promising an independent review and an evaluation in 2021.
In the policy response to the interim evaluation I have therefore already called on the RUG to continue focusing on informing the supervisors.
In de beleidsreactie op de tussenevaluatie heb ik daarom de RUG reeds opgeroepen om onverminderd in te zetten op het informeren van de supervisors.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Groothuizen, Van den Berge en Özütok over geweld tegen de actiegroep Kick Out Zwarte Piet

MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister and the Justice and Interior ministers how violence against the Kick Out Zwarte Piet congress was allowed, whether local authorities knew in advance, and how demonstrations and the Sinterklaas processions will be protected. The ministers condemned intimidation and violence, said police and prosecutors are investigating, and said local authorities (mayor, police, prosecutor) decide within legal limits, with a handreiking offered to municipalities; several answers were evasive about advance knowledge.
In our constitutional state it is unacceptable that (groups of) individual citizens disrupt a gathering of other citizens with violence and intimidation.
Het is in onze rechtsstaat ontoelaatbaar dat (groepen van) individuele burgers een bijeenkomst van andere burgers verstoren met geweld en intimidatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over de MEOS-app Proactief Controleren

MP Van den Berge asks whether the police academy's evaluation of the MEOS app for proactive checks is ready, why the summer 2019 deadline was missed, and whether the pilot reduces ethnic profiling. The minister says the research is still being processed and will be sent to parliament when complete, that the pilots justify wider rollout in 2020, and that the app is expected to counter ethnic profiling alongside awareness training.
As soon as the research is completed, I will inform your House of this.
Zodra het onderzoek gereed is zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Den Boer over de laatste stand van zaken rondom de aanschaf van tweeduizend bodycams

Three MPs asked the Justice Minister about the status of the purchase of 2,000 police bodycams, including procurement progress, evidence on effects, privacy safeguards, ethnic profiling and the Ombudsman's role. The minister answered that procurement is underway with operational use expected by end 2020, that privacy rules and a 28-day review regime exist, and that bodycams are not used to combat ethnic profiling.
We are currently having that examined and will inform your House in the second police half-yearly report of 2019 about the outcome of that study.
Ik laat dat op dit moment onderzoeken en zal uw Kamer in het tweede halfjaarbericht politie van 2019 informeren over de uitkomst van dat onderzoek.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Den Boer, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘Politiechef die racisme aankaartte weggestuurd’

MPs Den Boer, Van den Berge and Buitenweg asked whether the Leiden team chief who raised racism and bullying in the police was sidelined by the police leadership, and how the force handles such reports. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the team chief was not placed on non-active duty, that the force says all reports of misconduct are taken seriously, and that he will discuss police culture with the chief commissioner but will not comment on individual personnel cases.
Like your House, I believe we should exercise great restraint in commenting on individual cases.
Met uw Kamer ben ik van mening dat ons grote terughoudendheid past in te gaan op individuele casussen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van den Berge over de berichten ‘Ik walg van politieagenten die zich Marokkanenverdelgers noemen’ en ‘Burgemeesters regio Den Haag: geen verziekte cultuur bij politie’

MPs Buitenweg and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that eleven Hague-region mayors concluded there is no 'rotten culture' in the Hague police regarding discrimination and racism, while an internal investigation into the Hoefkade unit was still running, and about dismissals, a letter from police leadership on an 'undesirable culture', and the treatment of a former team chief who spoke out. The Minister declined to comment on the ongoing case and individual personnel matters, said the police chief takes reports seriously, pointed to an ombudsman post and existing reporting channels, and saw no need for further structural measures for now.
In view of the ongoing investigation at the Hoefkade team, I will not go further into this case.
Gelet op het lopende onderzoek bij het team Hoefkade ga ik verder niet op deze casuïstiek in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over het bericht dat sommige jongeren niet kunnen studeren omdat zij dakloos zijn

GroenLinks MPs asked whether homeless young people are excluded from education, how many cannot study or lack a startkwalificatie, where they can get help, and about schuldsanering and student loan barriers. The government replied that lack of a registered address is no bar to enrolment, that no national figures exist on homeless youth without qualifications, that municipalities coordinate support, and pointed to existing action programmes and schuldhulp measures.
DUO does not register who has no fixed residential or residence address.
DUO registreert niet wie er geen vaste woon- of verblijfsplaats heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht Gedwongen uitgehuwelijkte Fatima: ‘Meisjes zoals ik worden verkocht als golden tickets’ van Hart van Nederland

MPs asked the ministers how forced marriage of young women with a non-Western migrant background is measured, what protection and legal tools exist, and how the vrouwenopvang shortage affects victims. The government answered that reliable figures are lacking, pointed to existing reporting channels, laws and an action agenda due end 2019, and said it would evaluate the Wet tegengaan huwelijksdwang and study the shelter capacity problem.
Precise and reliable figures on the scale of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van den Berge en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Minister Dekker kan teloorgang sociale advocatuur niets schelen; NOvA blijft weg uit topberaad’

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how to react to the Dutch Bar Association (NOvA) withdrawing from the top-level consultation on legal aid reform, which it called pointless, and why trust had collapsed. The minister regrets the NOvA's decision, says the door stays open, explains that no extra budget was provided in line with the coalition agreement, and points to a governance review by Bureau Gateway, inviting the NOvA back to talks.
I have invited the NOvA to resume talks in the short term.
Ik heb de NOvA uitgenodigd om op korte termijn weer in gesprek te gaan.
Vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Van Gent (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de inzet van schoolbussen als antwoord op krimp (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about school buses as a response to population decline, including how many schools use them, who bears the costs, and the expected role in shrinking regions. The minister answered that pupil transport is the responsibility of municipalities and school boards or parents, that the ministry has no overview of demand or costs, and that longer transport distances will likely play a larger role after school closures.
Pupil transport is the responsibility of the municipality.
Het leerlingvervoer is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.

Vragen van de leden El Fassed en Van den Berge (beiden GroenLinks) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het rapport «Vrij Verkeer: Nederlandse wapendoorvoer onder de Algemene Douanewet» (inge

Two MPs asked the minister about a report claiming Dutch arms transit under the Customs Act is largely unchecked, including a 2008 Czech arms shipment to Sri Lanka and the treatment of transit to Suriname and Ecuador. The government answered that transit to allies is checked via licence or notification rules, that over 90% of transit runs under an ally's export licence and is not re-tested by the Netherlands, and that no ad hoc licence requirement was imposed in the period.
In practice, the vast majority of transit transactions take place under an export licence from an ally, so more than 90% of military goods transit is not subject to a separate Dutch review.

Wel is het zo dat in de praktijk de overgrote meerderheid van de doorvoertransacties onder een uitvoervergunning van een bondgenoot plaatsvindt en dat dus meer dan 90% van de doorvoer van militaire goederen niet aan een eigen Nederlandse toetsing wordt onderworpen.

m: Amendement van het lid Kooiman over het handhaven van de huidige publieke taken van Sanquin, en het afstoten van de commerciële taken
Amendment to the Sanquin law to keep Sanquin's statutory public blood-supply tasks in the foundation and spin off commercial activities, including the plasma products subsidiary.
Therefore the submitter proposes to maintain Sanquin's public tasks as now laid down in law and to divest the commercial tasks
Daarom stelt de indiener voor om de publieke taken van Sanquin, zoals die nu in de wet zijn vastgelegd, te handhaven en de commerciële taken af te stoten
Motie van het lid Kooiman over een meldplicht voor alle jeugdzorgaanbieders
Asks the government to introduce a notification duty for all youth care providers, new and existing, so municipalities and the inspectorate know who operates.
requests the government to ensure that a notification duty comes for both new and existing youth care providers
verzoekt de regering, ervoor te zorgen dat er een meldplicht komt voor zowel nieuwe als bestaande jeugdzorgaanbieders
Motie van het lid Kooiman c.s. over lokaal draagvlak meewegen in de zorgspecifieke fusietoets
Asks that the competition regulator be allowed to weigh local population and political support in the hospital merger test.
to give the Autoriteit Consument & Markt the possibility to weigh local population and local political support
de Autoriteit Consument & Markt de mogelijkheid te geven om het draagvlak van de lokale bevolking en de lokale politiek mee te wegen
Motie van het lid Sazias c.s. over de medicatiebeoordeling buiten het eigen risico plaatsen
Asks the government to encourage insurers to place medication review outside the deductible.
requests the government to encourage health insurers to place the medication review outside the deductible
verzoekt de regering, te stimuleren dat zorgverzekeraars de medicatiebeoordeling buiten het eigen risico plaatsen
Motie van het lid Arissen c.s. over huisdieren meenemen naar zorginstellingen
Asks the government to consult the care sector body ActiZ on how care institutions can more broadly allow pets to visit and report back to parliament.
requests the government to consult with the sector organisation ActiZ on how care institutions can make it broader possible to bring a pet
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te gaan met brancheorganisatie ActiZ over hoe zorginstellingen het meenemen van een huisdier breder mogelijk kunnen maken
Motie van de leden Kooiman en Arissen over de premies substantieel verlagen
Asks the government to force health insurers to use their reserves to substantially lower premiums.
requests the government to force health insurers to use this money
verzoekt de regering, zorgverzekeraars te dwingen dit geld in te zetten
Motie van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over kleinschalige opvang in de wijk
Asks the government to inventory rules that hinder small-scale neighbourhood care homes for the elderly and propose how to remove them.
asks the government, in response to the initiative note on the Zorgbuurthuis, to inventory obstructive rules
verzoekt de regering om, in reactie op de ingediende initiatiefnota over het Zorgbuurthuis ( 34 849 ), belemmerende regels te inventariseren
Motie van het lid Sazias c.s. over ondervoeding in de zorg
Asks the government to examine with relevant parties how malnutrition care can be further improved and which care provider is primarily accountable.
requests the government, with relevant parties, to examine how the approach to malnutrition in care can be further improved
verzoekt de regering, met relevante partijen te onderzoeken op welke manier de aanpak van ondervoeding binnen de zorg verder verbeterd kan worden
Motie van het lid Dijksma c.s. over de extra middelen voor huisartsen
Asks the government to inform the House before 1 March 2018 how much money is made available to relieve GP workload, how it is distributed, and what it means for GPs in deprived areas.
requests the government to inform the House before 1 March 2018 how much money is made available to relieve workload
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer vóór 1 maart 2018 te berichten hoeveel geld beschikbaar wordt gesteld om de werkdruk te verlichten
Motie van de leden Kooiman en Ellemeet over de ova-ruimte uitzonderen van de hoofdlijnenakkoorden
Asks the government to exempt the care sector's labour cost development from the framework agreements that cut spending by 1.9 billion euro.
requests the government to exempt the OVA room, the government contribution to labour cost development, from the framework agreements
verzoekt de regering om, de ova-ruimte, de overheidsbijdrage in de arbeidskostenontwikkeling, uit te zonderen van de hoofdlijnenakkoorden
Motie van het lid Dijksma c.s. over verbieden van kloonpolissen

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘Jeugdpsychiaters slaan alarm over het isoleren van kinderen in de Jeugdzorg’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that youth psychiatrists warn of isolation of children in youth care, including how often and how long it happens, a national registration system, the 24-hour notification term, legal safeguards, staff shortages and a staffing norm. The minister acknowledged the issue, backed a sector plan to cut temporary isolation with a baseline measurement, promised to agree a national registration system and a timeline on legal position rules, and declined to set a staffing norm, pointing to the existing quality framework.
I will make agreements about this with the institutions and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate.
Ik ga daar met de instellingen en de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd i.o. afspraken over maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over bacteriofagen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care what steps are needed to allow magistral preparation of bacteriophages in hospitals, whether the Belgian model is applicable in the Netherlands, and whether the minister will consult the Belgian counterpart. The minister replied that individual use is in principle possible but clinical research is the preferred route, that applicability in the Netherlands cannot yet be judged, and that contact with Belgian colleagues has been made.
I therefore cannot yet make definitive statements about the applicability of this approach in the Netherlands.
Ik kan daarom nu geen definitieve uitspraken doen over de toepasbaarheid van deze werkwijze in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat ggz instelling Parnassia Groep ROM gegevens deelt met Stichting Benchmark GGZ.

An MP asked the State Secretary about Parnassia Group sharing routine outcome monitoring (ROM) data with Stichting Benchmark GGZ without patient consent, and whether this required action against the provider, other providers, or insurers. The State Secretary answered that it is unclear whether ROM data are personal data under the Dutch data protection law pending the Data Protection Authority's ruling, that consent is being used as a precaution, that the AP rather than the minister supervises the provider, and that patients are informed and can opt out.
It is not for me to call Parnassia to order. The AP is the supervisory authority in this area.
Het is niet aan mij om Parnassia tot de orde te roepen. De AP is toezichthouder op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht van Radar ‘Waar rook is: de macht van de tabaksindustrie’

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about a Radar broadcast on tobacco industry influence, covering smoking prevalence, cigarette measurement methods, illegal trade, industry-dominated standards committees and industry-funded research. The State Secretary answered most questions in substance, pointing to EU rules that prevent unilateral changes to cigarette measurement methods and promising further steps and reports.
The Netherlands is obliged to use the maximum permitted values and the testing method prescribed by the European Tobacco Products Directive.
Nederland is verplicht de maximum toegestane waarden en de onderzoeksmethode te gebruiken die wordt voorgeschreven door de Europese Tabaksproductenrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘Ministeries verzwijgen nog altijd gevoelige contacten met de tabaksindustrie’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Health why ministries still withheld sensitive contacts with the tobacco industry, why some documents carried earlier publication dates, why Finance reported only one meeting a year when the register showed about 70 contacts, and whether the transparency register was incomplete and open to manipulation. The government admitted some contacts had not been published, said the missing documents were now posted or would be updated, explained the publication-date and contact-count discrepancies as technical and definitional, and committed to publishing the remaining documents.
I acknowledge that part of the contacts between ministries and the tobacco industry had not yet been disclosed.
Ik erken dat een deel van de contacten tussen ministeries en de tabaksindustrie nog niet was geopenbaard.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat ggz-instelling Parnassia ondanks kritiek nog groter mag worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether he supports the proposed merger of mental health provider Parnassia with Virenze, whether it serves patients, and how fusion oversight by the NZa and ACM works, among other questions. The State Secretary answered that he takes no position on mergers, that the independent regulators NZa and ACM assess them, and that he sees no reason to commission research on mental health merger price effects.
It is not for me but for the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) and the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM), as independent regulators, to assess merger proposals under the statutory frameworks.

Het is niet aan mij maar aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) en aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om, als onafhankelijk toezichthouders, fusievoornemens te beoordelen op grond van de wettelijke kaders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de opkomst van privéklinieken in Twente en de bezuinigingen in de Twentse ziekenhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a private clinic opening near the Hengelo hospital, budget cuts at ZGT and MST in Twente, insurer Menzis and the NZa welcoming private clinics, and planned job cuts at MST. The Minister answered that the private clinic is a private matter, that he was not informed in advance, that he leaves insurer and hospital decisions to the parties concerned, and that the IGJ will monitor patient safety risks during the reorganisation.
However, I am not responsible for this either; this is a private matter.
Ik ga hier echter ook niet over; dit is een private aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kooiman over het bericht 'Gemeente harkt te veel persoonsgegevens binnen' (Herdruk)

MPs Hijink and Kooiman asked the health minister about reports that municipalities collect too much personal data via self-reliance matrices, and whether privacy oversight and municipal guidance are adequate. The minister acknowledged limited violations in Nijmegen and Zaanstad, said the Dutch data protection authority is responsible for enforcement, and listed support measures for municipalities while declining to undertake new specific activities.
I do not intend to undertake specific activities aimed at ensuring that municipalities using self-reliance matrices handle them properly from a privacy law perspective.
Ik ben niet van plan om specifieke activiteiten te ondernemen die erop zijn gericht dat gemeenten die met zelfredzaamheidmatrices werken, daar vanuit het privacyrecht bezien goed mee omgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat medicatie voor botontkalking van de markt is gehaald terwijl het PXE-patiënten nieuwe hoop geeft

An SP MP asks why the bone-softening drug etidronate, which reportedly helped patients with PXE, was withdrawn from the Dutch market and whether it can be made available again quickly. The Minister explains that the CBG did not know of the off-label PXE use when withdrawing the licences, that doctors can still prescribe it via import, and that a faster registration route is possible but timing and feasibility cannot be estimated.
The CBG was unable to include the off-label use in patients with PXE in its weighing of patient interests.
Het CBG heeft het off-label gebruik in patiënten met PXE niet kunnen meenemen in de afweging van het patiëntenbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat ziekenhuisapothekers kampen met een chronisch tekort aan geneesmiddelen

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about reports of chronic drug shortages in hospital pharmacies, their causes, and whether the preferential reimbursement policy is harming supply. The minister acknowledged the problems, described the Werkgroep Geneesmiddelentekorten's 20 measures and the reporting point, and argued that 2017 figures show fewer shortages for preferred drugs and that the policy cannot be evaluated in isolation yet.
I endorse the intention of the Drug Shortage and Defect Reporting Point to publish figures on reports periodically, so that comparisons will be possible in the future.
Ik onderschrijf het voornemen van het Meldpunt Geneesmiddeltekorten en -defecten om periodiek cijfers over de meldingen te publiceren, zodat in de toekomst vergelijkingen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Hijink over de brandbrief van de KNGF aan zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kooiman and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the KNGF's open letter to health insurers complaining of unequal power, stalled negotiations, unprofitable physiotherapy tariffs, rising non-contracted practice and administrative burden. The Minister answered that the Hoofdlijnenakkoord Paramedische Zorg is making progress, that tariffs are a matter for individual negotiations with the NZa planning a study, that the cabinet favours multi-year contracts and will report in April 2018, and that power balances vary by sector and are monitored by the NZa and ACM.
I am not aware of any recent NZa study on physiotherapy tariffs. As for the KPMG study, I do not have it at my disposal.
Mij is geen recent uitgevoerd onderzoek van de NZa naar tarieven binnen de fysiotherapie bekend. Wat betreft het KPMG-onderzoek; dit heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Sazias over de inzet van magistrale apotheekbereidingen in taperingstrips als middel om medicatie op verantwoorde wijze af te bouwen

MPs Kooiman and Sazias ask the minister why insurers refuse to reimburse magistral taper strips for withdrawing psychiatric medication, and how the Zorginstituut and insurers reached their positions. The minister replies that insurers and the Zorginstituut decide reimbursement under the rational pharmacotherapy criterion, that the minister has no formal role, and that a consensus document on antidepressant tapering is being prepared by the professional bodies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de uitzending van Hart van Nederland over bacteriofagen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Hart van Nederland broadcast on bacteriophage therapy in Georgia, whether it is acceptable that only the wealthy can access it, whether Dutch doctors should encourage it without evidence, when Dutch patients could be treated, what research is planned, and how subsidies could be directed to phage research. The minister answered that doctors must inform patients of risks and alternatives, that no Dutch timeline can yet be given because phages may require registration as medicines, that more clinical research is needed by researchers and companies, that ZonMw and NWO funding exists but no phage proposals were submitted, and that the RIVM literature study is expected in the second quarter of 2018.
I expect to receive the outcome of the literature study, which will also include the findings of the visit to Georgia, in the second quarter of this year.
Ik verwacht de uitkomst van de literatuurstudie, waarin ook de bevindingen van het bezoek aan Georgië opgenomen worden, in het tweede kwartaal van dit jaar te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Rotterdam van plan is het tekort aan verpleegkundig ambulancezorg op te vangen door verpleegkundigen uit het buitenland te halen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about Rotterdam's plan to recruit foreign ambulance nurses to fill shortages, and about rising emergency calls and related staffing and triage problems. The Minister acknowledged the concerns, explained the recognition rules for foreign-trained nurses, and pointed to ongoing NZa and IGJ monitoring, triage studies and planned measures, while declining to intervene in pay negotiations.
I call on the sector to take action on this.
Ik roep het veld op hier werk van te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma,  Ellemeet en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Megawinst farmaceut zet medicijndebat op scherp’

Three MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of high profits by pharmaceutical firms, whether profits factor into drug price negotiations, how firms fulfil their social responsibility, and whether EU joint procurement could be expanded. The minister said firms should justify high prices and be transparent, called their social responsibility insufficient, declined to comment on negotiations, and pointed to ongoing BeNeLux and EU cooperation.
I do not make substantive statements about the negotiation process.
Ik doe geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over het onderhandelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat kortingsacties voor cosmetische ingrepen op grote schaal worden ingezet om mensen over te halen een cosmetische ingreep te ondergaan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about time-limited discount campaigns for cosmetic procedures and whether these should be banned. The minister said misleading or time-pressured advertising is prohibited under a self-regulatory advertising norm being implemented via the advertising code body, but declined to introduce a statutory advertising ban.
I do not intend to legally regulate an advertising ban.
Ik ben niet voornemens een reclameverbod wettelijk te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over nieuwe bezuinigingen die bestuurders van Ziekenhuisgroep Twente (ZGT) doorvoeren

An MP asked the minister about ZGT hospital board cuts, including closing outpatient clinics in Nijverdal and Goor, raising parking tariffs, and possible closure of the Hengelo emergency department, and asked about insurers' role and cost savings. The minister said the closure decisions lie with the hospital board, declined to disclose savings figures as commercially sensitive, said the inspectorate sees no patient safety risk, and referred to a forthcoming letter on the emergency department and location profiles.
This is commercially sensitive information that I do not have.
Dit is bedrijfsgevoelige informatie waar ik niet over beschik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over het bericht dat de aardbevingen in Groningen de gezondheid van Groningers aantasten

Two SP MPs asked whether the government accepts that earthquakes in Groningen harm residents' health, including a reported PTSD-like picture, and whether the state is responsible and will act. The minister acknowledges the health impact, says removing the causes of stress is the top priority, promises gas production reduction options and a public-law damage protocol, and commits to a health action plan from the RIVM and GGD by end of April.
Removing the causes of stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over de berichtgeving dat stress in bevingsgebied Groningen tot sterfgevallen leidt

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman (SP) asked ministers whether reports that earthquake-related stress in Groningen leads to deaths were known, and how affected people would be supported. Minister Wiebes replied that the government finds this worrying, prioritises removing the causes of stress, wants gas extraction reduced further this term, and wants damage settlement accelerated, referring to an earlier answer.
Removing the causes of the stress and uncertainty has the highest priority.
Het wegnemen van de oorzaken van de stress en onzekerheid heeft de hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kooiman over doorstroming en drukte bij maatschappelijke opvang

MPs Beckerman and Kooiman asked about shortages and slow move-on in women's shelters and emergency homelessness shelters, including Groningen's reduced capacity and the lack of affordable housing for shelter residents. The minister responded that a working group with several ministries and municipal follow-up will address bottlenecks from the Ombudsman's report, municipalities will carry local responsibility for housing and capacity agreements, and a multi-year agenda on sheltered housing is being developed.
Currently, work is underway to set up this working group.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan het opzetten van deze werkgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Dijksma over hoge parkeertarieven bij ziekenhuizen

MPs Kooiman and Dijksma asked the minister whether high hospital parking charges, and the lack of local say over them, were acceptable and what was being done about transparency and patient support. The minister answered that he has no role or competence over parking tariffs, which lie with hospitals and municipalities, and declined to add parking costs to transport schemes or require a specific accounting duty.
I have no role or competence regarding parking tariffs and consider this the responsibility of hospitals and municipalities.
Ik heb geen rol of bevoegdheid ten aanzien van parkeertarieven en vind ik dit de verantwoordelijkheid van ziekenhuizen en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de uitzending van Radar over Sint-janskruid

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Medical Care about a Radar broadcast showing St John's wort sold freely in drugstores without warnings about interactions with medicines, and pressed for stricter rules such as sales only via pharmacies and questioned why action had not been taken earlier. The minister acknowledged the interaction risk, announced a legally mandatory warning text on all St John's wort products by year-end, and rejected restricting sales to pharmacies as going too far, while pointing to a pilot and to monitoring by Lareb and the NVWA.
I therefore want to make a warning text on all products with St John's wort legally mandatory.
Ik wil daarom een waarschuwingstekst op alle producten met Sint-janskruid wettelijk verplicht stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat farmaceut Pfizer stopt met onderzoek naar medicatie voor Parkinson en Alzheimer

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care about Pfizer ending its neuroscience research on Parkinson's and Alzheimer's drugs, its reasons, consequences, and whether the Netherlands should fund an independent national drug research fund. The Minister says Pfizer decides its own portfolio, other firms and research groups remain active, and he will not create a national fund, though he will address alternative development models in a later response.
As I indicated above, I do not share your view that priorities for drug development are set solely by industry.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven deel ik uw mening niet dat de prioriteiten voor medicijnontwikkeling uitsluitend door de industrie worden vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Achmea met een fusie van dochtermaatschappijen orde op zake probeert te stellen

An SP MP asked the health minister about Achmea's merger of Zilveren Kruis and De Friesland amid financial strain at subsidiary FBTO, including whether DNB supervision and capital transfers within the group protect premium payers. The minister answered that DNB was informed and approved FBTO's recovery plan, that intra-group capital transfers are permitted and sound, and that the merger is a commercial decision whose legality is pending before the Ondernemingskamer.
I am awaiting the judgment of the Enterprise Chamber.
Ik wacht het oordeel van de Ondernemingskamer af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat psychische hulp aan kwetsbare jongeren ernstig in gevaar is

An MP asks the minister how to respond to reports that youth mental health care is delayed or unavailable because municipal budgets are exhausted, and about waiting lists, bureaucracy, staffing and trust. The minister acknowledges the concern, says children must never be denied timely care, points to regional agreements, expert teams, an admin-burden bill and a labour market study, though much responsibility is placed on municipalities and providers.
I have agreed with municipalities and youth care providers to make waiting times transparent at regional level and to incorporate agreements on this into the 2018 purchasing contracts.
Ik heb met gemeenten en jeugdhulpaanbieders de afspraak gemaakt wachttijden op regionaal niveau inzichtelijk te maken en afspraken hierover in de inkoopcontracten van 2018 te verwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat afhaalpunten voor pakketjes worden misbruikt door de tabaksbranche

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether tobacco shops used as parcel pick-up points expose customers to visible tobacco products, whether the display ban is consistent, and whether the tobacco industry's lobbying via trade groups will be investigated. The State Secretary answered that a planned display ban from 2022 will cover parcel pick-up shops, that no further investigation of indirect lobbying is deemed necessary, and that ministries and local bodies were informed of the WHO treaty's lobbying prohibition.
I am aware that the tobacco industry lobbies through other organisations. I do not consider it necessary to investigate this further.
Ik ben op de hoogte dat de tabakindustrie via andere organisaties lobbyt. Ik acht het niet noodzakelijk dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de kindergeneeskunde afdeling en verloskunde afdeling van het Scheper ziekenhuis tijdelijk sluiten

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister for Medical Care about the temporary closure of paediatrics and acute obstetrics at Scheper hospital in Emmen due to a shortage of paediatricians, including ambulance travel times, staff complaints, board decisions, inspectorate involvement and measures to reopen. The Minister answered that the wards could stay open until 18 December, that responsibility for regional care lies with providers and insurers, and that the NZa and Inspectorate are monitoring, while noting ambulance impacts will be analysed and no commitment beyond monitoring was given.
The organisation of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De organisatie van de zorg in de regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat duizenden kwetsbare patiënten slechtziend zullen worden door onverantwoorde bezuiniging van zorgverzekeraars

Kooiman (SP) asks whether insurers forcing ophthalmologists to use only cheap injections, which may leave vulnerable patients blind, is acceptable, and what the minister will do about insurers limiting expensive injections. Minister Bruins replies that the three drugs are broadly equivalent, that insurers may lawfully steer to the cheapest effective option while leaving room for the dearer drug, that no evidence yet shows the alternatives work for bevacizumab non-responders, and that manufacturers should submit a dossier to the Zorginstituut.
Based on the information I have now, I cannot say that health insurers are evading their duty of care.
Op basis van de informatie die ik nu heb, kan ik niet stellen dat zorgverzekeraars hun zorgplicht ontduiken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de beschikbaarheid van bacteriofagen als alternatief voor antibiotica

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the unavailability of bacteriophage therapy in the Netherlands, commercial trips to Georgia, and research funding. The minister said clinical evidence is limited, outlined ongoing Dutch phage research and funding programmes, and promised a RIVM literature study and a visit to the Eliava institute.
I also indicate that treatment with bacteriophages or products based on them is possible under conditions and has also been practically used in the Netherlands.
Ook geef ik aan dat een behandeling met bacteriofagen of producten die daarop gebaseerd zijn onder voorwaarden mogelijk en ook praktisch gebruikt is in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de lange wachtlijsten en de tekorten in de jeugdzorg

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about long waiting lists and shortages in youth care, rising bureaucracy since the 2015 Youth Act, a petition on local quality differences, and municipal deficits of about 300 million euro. The minister acknowledged concerns, pointed to regional expert teams, standardisation of information systems, a pending bill to reduce administrative burdens, and said the deficit question requires clarifying the causes before any solution, and that answers for the GGZ debate could not be provided in time.
Due to the necessary coordination with third parties, it unfortunately did not prove possible to answer these questions before the GGZ committee meeting of 29 November.
Het is – vanwege de noodzakelijke afstemming met derden – helaas niet gelukt om deze vragen te beantwoorden voor het AO GGZ van 29 november.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht in de NRC dat de zorg aan kwetsbare gezinnen onder druk staat

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether municipalities may buy youth protection and probation care below cost, whether a realistic tariff will be ensured, and how continuity of care for about 420 families will be guaranteed after a tariff dispute. The government answered that municipalities bear responsibility under the decentralised system, that a cost-price study with VNG is planned for April 2018, and that continuity in the Zuid-Holland Zuid region has been arranged, while referring many detailed questions to municipalities or lacking the data.
It is up to municipalities and institutions themselves to conduct research into the cost price where necessary.
Het is dan ook aan gemeenten en instellingen zelf om zo nodig onderzoek te doen naar de kostprijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het voornemen van Zilveren Kruis om geneesmiddelen voor een jaar te verstrekken in plaats van maximaal drie maanden

An MP asked the Minister whether Zilveren Kruis's policy of dispensing cheap chronic medicines for up to a year, instead of three months, breaches the national prescription agreement and what the effects would be. The Minister answered that the insurer's policy does not breach the agreement, which covers only new, expensive and palliative medicines, and that prescribers and patients will set appropriate durations, with the government deferring the details to contract negotiations.
Zilveren Kruis does not deviate from the prescription arrangement with its purchasing policy.
Zilveren Kruis wijkt met haar inkoopbeleid niet af van de prescriptieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraars hun afspraken met huisartsen niet nakomen

An SP MP asked the minister whether health insurers are failing to honour the 2018 GP agreement on investment in vulnerable groups, and what safeguards will prevent this. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the parties must resolve it locally and regionally, and noted a shared commitment to the agreement without committing to a concrete step.
I expect the parties to keep talking with each other and to reach agreement.
Ik ga er van uit dat de partijen goed met elkaar in gesprek blijven en dat ze er uit komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de financiële problemen van Ziekenhuis Groep Twente (ZGT)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about financial trouble at Ziekenhuis Groep Twente (ZGT), including the board's cost cuts, the loss of 9.7 million, and whether the hospital supervisory bodies and the IGJ had acted. The minister answered that hospitals are responsible for their own finances, that ZGT has been transparent, and that the IGJ monitors quality and safety rather than financial management, while stating he cannot judge the internal supervisor's conduct.
From my position I cannot judge the conduct of ZGT's internal supervisor.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie niet oordelen over de handelwijze van de interne toezichthouder van ZGT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aangekondigde ontslagen bij Ziekenhuis Groep Twente

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about ZGT hospital's plan to cut 150 jobs, the reasons, union involvement, the role of banks, the future of the Hengelo emergency department, and whether the recovery plan would be shared. The minister said the cuts are needed, ZGT is negotiating a new social plan with unions, the Inspectorate monitors quality risks, and the banks are reviewing the plan, but declined to share the internal recovery plan and said it is not for the minister to intervene in hospital management.
ZGT has informed me that the recovery plan is an internal plan that is only shared with the banks and health insurers.
ZGT heeft mij laten weten dat het herstelplan een intern plan is dat alleen met de banken en zorgverzekeraars wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over verloskundigen die massaal hun contract opzeggen bij de zorgverzekeraars

An MP asked the Minister of Health why midwives are terminating contracts with insurers over tariffs and why insurers have objected to the NZa's 2018 tariff increase, and what will guarantee basic care. The minister answered that contracting is a matter between insurers and providers, that the NZa's objection procedure timing is set by law, and that insurers must ensure sufficient care, with the NZa supervising and able to intervene.
The NZa supervises this and will also intervene if that is not the case.
De NZa ziet daarop toe en zal ook ingrijpen als niet geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kooiman over het conflict tussen verloskundigen en zorgverzekeraars inzake tarieven

MPs Ellemeet and Kooiman asked whether insurers pay midwife practices in integrated care experiments the maximum NZa tariff, thereby pushing them toward integrated funding contrary to the Leijten motion, and how a level playing field and voluntariness are ensured. Minister Bruins answers that switching to integrated funding is voluntary for regions, that insurers may set their own tariffs and merely incentivise integrated contracts, and that the NZa is monitoring the contracts.
Midwives state that insurers are willing to reimburse the childbirth care agreed under integrated contracts more generously than under monodisciplinary contracts. I have no insight into this.

Verloskundigen geven aan dat zorgverzekeraars bereid te zijn om de geboortezorg die binnen de integrale contracten wordt overeengekomen ruimer te vergoeden dan binnen monodisciplinaire contracten. Ik heb hier geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de noodzakelijke toestemming voor het vergoed krijgen van langdurige psychoanalytische psychotherapie

An MP asks why insurer OHRA requires written prior consent for long-term psychoanalytic psychotherapy that the Zorginstituut has classified as insured care, and questions the legal basis and the administrative burden. The Minister answers that insurers may require procedural prior consent as an administrative condition, that this serves appropriate use of care, and that the Zorginstituut's standpoint does not remove each insurer's duty to verify indication, while stating that consent requirements for long-term psychotherapy are not common among other insurers.
Health insurers are jointly responsible for the correctness of claims charged to the Zvw.
Zorgverzekeraars zijn medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid van declaraties ten laste van de Zvw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de bezuinigingen die bestuurders van ZGT Hengelo en Almelo willen doordrukken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether ZGT hospital board's cost-cutting and possible patient stops in Hengelo and Almelo are acceptable, and whether the minister would intervene and inform parliament. The minister answered that contracting is a matter between hospital and insurers, that ZGT denies patient stops are planned, and that the minister will not intervene but expects good communication and will not inform parliament beyond the information already given.
However, I am not interfering in this.
Ik meng mij hier echter niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over jongeren met psychische problemen die soms wel 40 weken moeten wachten op hulp

MP Kooiman asked whether the government shared alarm that youth with psychological problems in the Utrecht region sometimes wait up to 40 weeks for care, why waiting times vary so widely, and what is being done about the low share of providers publishing waiting times. Minister De Jonge acknowledged the long waits and the low publication rate, pointed to regional agreements on transparent waiting-time reporting from 2018, and said gemeenten and providers must make every effort to provide timely care, but did not commit to a broader national investigation.
I also find that percentage too low.
Ik vind dat percentage ook te laag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Diertens over de noodzaak van een onderzoek naar de dwang bij patiënten om ROM-lijsten in te vullen

MPs Kooiman and Diertens asked the health minister whether patients are being coerced into filling in ROM questionnaires and whether insurers' budget cuts for under-delivery of ROM data should be banned. The minister answered that ROM is voluntary, insurers and providers must settle delivery targets between themselves, she has no signals of coercion, and the Data Protection Authority is still investigating.
As I indicated in the answers to your earlier parliamentary questions on ROM, I have no signals of coercion to complete ROM.
Antwoord 9 Zoals ik aangaf in de antwoorden op uw eerdere Kamervragen over ROM 5 heb ik geen signalen over dwang tot het invullen van ROM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de blijvende chaos binnen Treant

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the ongoing governance turmoil at hospital group Treant, including the inspectorate's oversight, its review of the proposed experimental board model, the €15 million savings target, the works council's treatment and whether advisory councils should have consent rights. The Minister replied that the inspectorate applies intensive supervision and the governance framework, that hospitals are responsible for their own organisation and are not pre-approved, that she cannot judge Treant's financial trade-offs or the works council dispute, and that the Cliëntenraden law will strengthen patient councils' rights.
Good governance is an important part of this intensive supervision trajectory, and the Good Governance supervision framework is of course applied.
Goed bestuur is een belangrijk onderdeel van dit intensieve toezichttraject en uiteraard wordt het kader Toezicht op Goed Bestuur daarbij toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over het bericht dat ziekenhuisfusie tussen het AMC en VUmc niet in het belang is van patiënten

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the NZa's warning that the AMC-VUmc merger harms patients (higher prices, lower quality, 'too big to fail') and whether oversight by ACM, NZa and IGJ is adequate. The minister replied that fusion oversight is legally split between NZa and ACM, that the ACM cleared the merger on competition grounds, and that she wanted stronger fusion rules via a bill which the Tweede Kamer declared controversial.
I find it highly undesirable if mergers lead to such market power that the price of care rises and/or quality and accessibility decline.
Ik vind het zeer onwenselijk als fusies leiden tot een zodanige mate van marktmacht dat daardoor de prijs van zorg stijgt en of de kwaliteit en toegankelijkheid dalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat huisartsenposten overbelast zijn

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Health about reports that GP out-of-hours posts are overloaded, rising complex caseloads, referrals to ambulances, budget and bed-reduction policy. Minister Schippers answered that the problem is real, gave causes and planned joint action across the acute care chain, but declined to reverse bed reductions or raise the GP budget beyond the agreed indexation.
There is certainly a problem; I have also shared this in several debates and letters with your House.
Er is zeker sprake van een probleem, ik heb dat ook in meerdere debatten en kamerbrieven met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over de ontslagen bij ziekenhuis Medisch Spectrum Twente (MST) Enschede

MPs Kooiman and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Health about MST Enschede's cost-cutting plan of 30 million euros, which eliminates about 155 jobs, its effects on patient safety, regional referrals, and executive salaries and bonuses. The Minister answered that MST cites rising care demand, new building costs and the need to fund a new EPD, that the IGZ monitors risks, and that executive pay falls under the WNT and supervisory board responsibility, declining to intervene.
That is not my responsibility as Minister.
Dat is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid als Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat psychologen nog steeds niet positief zijn over de financiering van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

MP Kooiman asks the Health Minister about survey findings that psychologists remain dissatisfied with mental health (GGZ) financing, including the DBC system, and whether this shows market-based care has failed. The minister acknowledges the criticism, says a new payment model is being developed with the NZa and sector organisations and piloted for introduction around 2020, and rejects the claim of market failure while noting improvements to the current system are wanted.

At present the Netherlands Healthcare Authority (NZa), on the proposal of and together with provider organisations (including the NIP), insurers and patients in mental health care, is working on a new funding model for basic, specialised and forensic mental health care.

Op dit moment werkt de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) dan ook op voorstel van en samen met organisaties van aanbieders (waaronder het NIP, het Nederlands Instituut van Psychologen), verzekeraars en patiënten in de ggz aan een nieuw bekostigingsmodel voor de basis-ggz, gespecialiseerde ggz en forensische zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kooiman over ‘de toename van het aantal dakloze jongeren’

MPs Van Dijk and Kooiman asked why homeless young people rose from 8,000 to 12,000 in 2016, and whether the cost-sharing norm, psychiatric cuts, briefadres access and benefit rules contribute. The government acknowledges the rise, points to a pending Federatie Opvang report and a research project, defers responsibility to municipalities, and largely declines to commit to new legislative change.
Municipalities are responsible for tackling this target group and for making good policy to prevent people from becoming homeless.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de aanpak van deze doelgroep en het maken van goed beleid om te voorkomen dat mensen dakloos raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Beckerman over het bericht dat er een sterke groei is van het aantal gezinnen dat bij de noodopvang belandde

MPs Kooiman and Beckerman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of the Interior about a sharp rise in families ending up in emergency shelter in 2016, its causes, and possible structural fixes. The government answered that it is improving monitoring, that data on homeless families are incomplete, that debt rules are not a legal barrier to renting, and that it supports a Amsterdam-style approach while leaving most solutions to municipalities.
I do not know whether, and if so how often, this happens with homeless families.
Het is mij niet bekend of en zo ja, hoe vaak dit gebeurt bij dakloze gezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de ontbrekende stukken uit het verslag van het Directeuren Overleg Alcohol (DOA)

An MP asked why the Auditdienst Rijk report on the missing second page of a 2008 Directeuren Overleg Alcohol minutes did not report former members' recollections, why the search stopped after finding an earlier version, and for the search file. The state secretary answered that there was no special reason, that recollections varied and were limited, that the search covered departmental drives without finding a second page, and that an anonymised file will be sent with a broader Wob request pending.
Yes, that can be done. Because of the large amount of documents to anonymise, this takes some time.
Ja, dat kan. Door de grote hoeveelheid te anonimiseren stukken vraagt dat enige tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marijnissen over het bericht dat door invoering van eigen bijdrage ggz de dwangopnames zijn verdubbeld en crisisopnamen zijn toegenomen

MPs Kooiman and Marijnissen asked whether the 2012 co-payment for mental health care, which a study linked to doubled involuntary admissions and more crisis care and a net cost increase, was sensible, and what the government would do about care avoidance and unequal effects by income.
