Minister Schippers acknowledged the findings, said the co-payment was abolished in 2013, stressed the Wvggz bill and ambulantisation as responses, and pointed to municipal compensation measures without committing to new research.
The co-payment in secondary mental health care was abolished in 2013, so I do not consider it necessary to conduct further research into it.
De eigen bijdrage in de tweedelijns ggz is in 2013 afgeschaft, waardoor ik het niet nodig acht daar verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de sluiting van de afdeling cardiologie in ZGT Hengelo

An MP asked the Minister of Health about the temporary closure of the cardiology department at ZGT Hengelo, including fears it foreshadows further cutbacks, the reasons, patient travel times, and the role of the Inspectorate. The Minister answered that the closure is temporary due to summer staff shortages, patients are redirected to Almelo, responsibility for regional access lies with providers and insurers, and the Inspectorate has pressed ZGT to manage the transition safely.
Accessibility and availability of care in the region is primarily the responsibility of care providers and health insurers.
De bereikbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van het zorgaanbod in de regio is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet toekennen van voldoende financiële middelen aan het ziekenhuis in Den Helder om de acute verloskundige zorg en spoedzorg in de lucht te houden

MP Kooiman asks whether the Minister will guarantee that acute obstetric and emergency care in Den Helder hospital remains available, given the Noordwest Ziekenhuisgroep threat to close them without €9m extra annual funding and the NZa's refusal. Minister Schippers says the hospital and insurers must agree the location profile, that she will consider using her powers under the Wtzi to ensure access to acute care, and that the NZa has invited VGZ and NWZ to talk.
I will therefore consider using the powers included in the Wtzi.
Ik zal mij daarom beraden op het inzetten van de bevoegdheden die in de Wtzi zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Inspectie Jeugdzorg geen onderzoek doet naar zelfdoding

An SP MP asked the state secretary why the Inspectie Jeugdzorg is not investigating the suicide of a youth in Venlo previously involved in youth care, and why Venlo, unlike Heerlen, did not report it. The secretary answered that no youth care was active in the past year so there was no inspection reason, that the municipality is investigating itself, and that reporting is voluntary for municipalities but obligatory for providers.

The municipality of Venlo will first conduct its own investigation. This will be monitored, and during and after completion TSD, in consultation with the municipality, will consider whether and what further action is needed.

De gemeente Venlo gaat nu eerst zelf onderzoek doen. Dit wordt gevolgd en tijdens en na afronding van het onderzoek zal door TSD in afstemming met de gemeente worden bekeken of en wat er nog extra nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de bestuurlijke instabiliteit van Treant en de dreigende teloorgang van volwaardige ziekenhuiszorg op de ziekenhuislocaties in Stadskanaal en Hoogeveen

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about governance instability at hospital group Treant, the threat to full hospital care in Stadskanaal and Hoogeveen, and whether an independent investigation or replacement of the board is warranted. The minister answered that the IGZ monitors quality and sees no reason for intervention, that hospitals are responsible for their own governance, and that she has no role beyond calling for dialogue.
Hospitals are private institutions and as such are themselves responsible for steering their organisation.
Ziekenhuizen zijn private instellingen en in dat kader zelf verantwoordelijk voor de besturing van hun organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de enorme bezuiniging die het bestuur van de Ziekenhuis Groep Twente (ZGT) in Hengelo en Almelo wil doordrukken

An SP MP asked the health minister about planned cuts of 10 to 15 million euros at the ZGT hospital group, including possible closures and concentration of care, and whether the Inspectorate was involved. The minister answered that financial management is the hospital board's responsibility, that the Inspectorate only acts if patient safety is at risk, and that decisions on emergency services and locations are for the hospital and insurers to make in consultation with stakeholders.
It is the responsibility of the institution's board to keep the organisation financially healthy and to adjust course where necessary. In that responsibility, I as Minister do not intervene.
Het is aan het instellingsbestuur om de organisatie financieel gezond te houden en zo nodig bij te sturen. In die verantwoordelijkheid treed ik als Minister niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de berichtgeving dat het UMC Utrecht weer in opspraak is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports of problems at the UMC Utrecht home-ventilation unit, including patient safety, working conditions, and dismissals of whistleblowers, and asked how the Inspectorate missed it. The Minister replied that the situation was already known and covered in the Inspectorate's report on the hospital board, that the board has taken measures after an independent investigation, and that the Inspectorate maintains intensive supervision, while declining to investigate the whistleblower dismissals beyond noting that protections exist.
Are you willing to look into this and inform the House about it? If not, why not?
Bent u bereid dit uit te zoeken en de Kamer hierover te informeren? Zo neen, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de zaadkwaliteit van de westerse man keldert door gebruik van hormoon verstorende stoffen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Western sperm quality is declining due to hormone-disrupting substances, and about concrete measures, hospital practice, pregnancy information and BPA regulation. The minister agreed the trend is undesirable, outlined EU and national steps (hospital awareness, RIVM work, EU medical device rules, a pending BPA norm decision), but stated the causal link to sperm quality is unclear and gave no firm national ban.
I am taking the following steps to break this impasse.
Ik onderneem de volgende stappen om deze impasse te doorbreken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het risico op een mazelen uitbraak toeneemt door een dalende vaccinatiegraad

An MP asks the Minister of Health why her letter on falling vaccination rates omitted the RIVM warning that measles herd immunity may be at risk, and asks about e-learning uptake, consultation time for vaccination counselling, municipal measures and research on late vaccination. The minister denies downplaying the issue, points to the RIVM warning and the 2017 measures, and answers each question, committing to inform parliament in autumn but declining further research on late vaccination.
I will inform your House in the autumn about participation in the e-learning.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het najaar over de deelname aan de e-learning informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de sluiting van de spoedeisende hulppost in Woerden

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Health Minister about the closure of the emergency department and GP post in Woerden and whether this was properly decided and communicated. The minister answered that the closure followed from the hospital merger and the GP post's relocation, that the 45-minute norm is met, that regulators NZa and ACM approved the plans, and that the hospital and GP post should engage residents in dialogue.
Healthcare providers and health insurers are responsible for good and accessible emergency care in the region.
Zorgaanbieders en zorgverzekeraars zijn verantwoordelijk voor goede en toegankelijke spoedzorg in de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het risico op een mazelen uitbraak toeneemt door een dalende vaccinatiegraad

An MP asked the health minister why her letter did not state that measles vaccination coverage had fallen so far that herd immunity might be at risk, and what she would do to restore coverage. The minister answered that the 95% WHO target was not linked to a hard threshold for outbreaks, that the cause of the decline was still unknown and was being researched, and listed measures such as an e-learning course, more consultation time in youth health care from 2018, and continued monitoring.
Failing to meet the 95% norm for the BMR vaccination was not mentioned in the letter because the risk of a measles outbreak is not linked to that 95%.
Het niet voldoen aan de norm van 95% voor de BMR-vaccinatie is in de brief niet vermeld omdat het risico op een mazelenuitbraak niet gekoppeld is aan die 95%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het Universitair Medich Centrum (UMC) Utrecht weer onder vergrootglas ligt na een dubieus sterfgeval

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the Inspectorate for Health Care should start independent investigation into a sudden death after a medical procedure at UMC Utrecht, and whether patient trust and safety are assured given earlier problems there. The Minister answered that the hospital was ordered to investigate under the Wkkgz, with an external independent expert, that the Inspectorate continues intensive supervision, and that it oversees the hospital's response.
The hospital must now work hard to carry out these measures and restore trust.
Het ziekenhuis moet nu hard aan het werk om deze maatregelen uit te voeren en het vertrouwen weer te herstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (Nza) waarschuwt voor de versnippering van ziekenhuiszorg

An SP MP asked the health minister to respond to a Nza market scan warning that hospital concentration may reduce access and quality, and whether she would halt hospital mergers. The minister agreed concentration can have drawbacks, said oversight by ACM and Nza is in place, denied that the scan shows fragmentation, and declined to halt mergers.
I attach importance to the supervisory authorities intervening where there is cause to do so.
Ik hecht eraan dat de toezichthouders ingrijpen indien daartoe aanleiding is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Kooiman over de schadelijke gevolgen van de HeatStick voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Dik-Faber and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about claims that the IQOS HeatStick is less harmful, its cancer-causing substances, its missing graphic warnings and its regulatory status abroad. The State Secretary said the product is still discouraged, that independent studies were short-term and did not assess long-term harm, and that RIVM research on the product is expected in autumn 2017 before deciding on notification to the European Commission.
I have asked the RIVM to conduct research into the IQOS and the HeatStick.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd onderzoek te doen naar de IQOS en de HeatStick.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over het bericht dat een zorgbestuurder de Wet Normering Topinkomens middels een riante vertrekpremie omzeilt

MPs Marijnissen and Kooiman asked the health minister whether a hospital board member's EUR 75,000 departure payment circumvents the Dutch top-income cap (WNT) and whether the law will be amended. The minister replied that the WNT caps severance at one year's salary up to EUR 75,000, does not regulate when such payments may be contracted, so the payment is not in breach, and the cabinet does not intend to amend the WNT on severance.
The WNT does not prescribe in which cases a severance payment may be included in the employment contract.
De WNT schrijft niet voor in welke gevallen een beëindigingsvergoeding in het arbeidscontract mag worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de hoge werklast van huisartsen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about rising GP workload linked to elderly care shifts, the need for more time per patient, VGZ pilot results, unused GP budget, and substitution capacity. The minister answered that research shows more GP time for elderly patients, pointed to existing budget room and pilots, and said the choice of sharing data and organising care lies with insurers and providers, while committing to a fixed number of GP training places and a conditional budget shift for substitution.
It is up to VGZ to choose whether it wants to share such research results.
Het is aan VGZ om te kiezen of zij dergelijke onderzoeksresultaten willen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de onderbezetting bij de KID-DNA databank

An SP MP asked the health minister about the Fiom KID-DNA databank being understaffed, forcing donor children toward commercial services, and whether budget cuts are to blame. The minister said donor children conceived after 2004 have a legal right to identity via the Sdkb, that she is discussing capacity expansion and support with Fiom and others, but gave no data on waiting times and denied a link to budget cuts.
I have no insight into this. The Fiom KID-DNA Databank was not initiated by VWS and is not subsidised by VWS.
Ik heb hier geen inzicht in. De Fiom KID-DNA Databank is niet geïnitieerd door VWS en wordt niet gesubsidieerd door VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet toelaten van geneesmiddel Orkambi tot het basispakket

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health why Orkambi was not added to the basic insurance package, given its high cost per patient and the treatment of cystic fibrosis patients. The minister answered that the Health Care Institute advised against unconditional reimbursement because of unfavourable cost-effectiveness and crowding-out of other care, that she considers the price unacceptable and wants pharmaceutical companies to be more transparent, and that negotiations with Vertex continue.
I do not make substantive statements about the negotiation.
Ik doe geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over de onderhandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat veel meer kinderen residentieel geplaatst worden, in plaats van in een (pleeg)gezin

MP Kooiman asked the State Secretary why CBS figures show youth care with residential placement rising from about 33,000 in 2015 to over 36,000 in 2016, alongside falling foster care and rising 'other residential placement', and what will be done to reverse this. The State Secretary answered that 2016 is too early to draw conclusions about the Jeugdwet, that the causes are unclear and require further research (due autumn 2017), and that the outcomes will feed into the Actieplan Pleegzorg if a link is found.
It is still too early to draw conclusions from the 2016 CBS figures, the second year of the Jeugdwet, about the success of the Jeugdwet.
Het is nog te vroeg om uit de CBS-cijfers 2016 – het tweede jaar van de Jeugdwet – conclusies te trekken over het slagen van de Jeugdwet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over de decentralisatie van de Kindertelefoon, AKJ en Sensoor

MPs Marijnissen and Kooiman asked the state secretary about the VNG's decision to stop centrally financing the Kindertelefoon, AKJ and Sensoor, and how continuity and bureaucracy concerns square with earlier motions and commitments. The state secretary answered that the government will take over responsibility for these services from 2018 via a fund deduction from the municipal fund and legislation, citing insufficient guarantees and the burden of the existing arrangement.
I will regulate this by law as soon as possible.
Ik zal dit zo snel als mogelijk wettelijk regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Kooiman over de tekorten aan ambulancepersoneel

Two SP MPs asked the government about shortages of ambulance staff, reliance on temporary agency workers, pay and workload, and whether market-based regulation of ambulance care is acceptable. The state secretary answered that an advisory study of ordering variants is underway, that staffing is the responsibility of providers and insurers supervised by the NZa and Inspectie, that AZN assured sufficient staff, and that pay is a matter for CAO negotiations; the government declined to address the desirability of market mechanisms given its caretaker status.
Because the cabinet is caretaker, I will not address questions on the desirability of market mechanisms in ambulance care.
Vanwege de demissionaire status van het kabinet zal ik niet ingaan op vragen over de wenselijkheid van marktwerking in de ambulancezorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de weeffout in de Jeugdwet

An SP MP asks why municipalities pay for residential youth care for children from other areas, why some cities bear costs for children placed by others, whether municipalities refer children for financial reasons, and why the compensation scheme is slow and partial, plus a question on innovation in residential care. The State Secretary says the woonplaats principle will be changed for care without residence now and that a feasibility study is underway for residential care, that the compensation scheme for 2017–2019 will stay as is, and refers back to answers 3–5 for question 8.
For youth care without residence, the woonplaats principle will be adjusted and I am initiating a legislative amendment for this.
Voor jeugdhulp zonder verblijf zal het woonplaatsbeginsel worden aangepast en daarvoor zet ik een wetswijziging in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat nietsvermoedende Nederlandse meisjes op Twitter worden aangeboden als prostituee

SP MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that girls' identities were used on social media to advertise them as prostitutes, and about police capacity, training, and the role of platforms. The minister confirmed awareness, said sextortion is not registered separately so no figures exist, defended police prioritisation and training, and placed responsibility for swift removal of content on social media providers.
Sextortion is registered as a form of extortion in police systems and not as a separate phenomenon.
Sextortion wordt als een vorm van afpersing geregistreerd in de politiesystemen en niet als apart fenomeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat scholen geen vertrouwen meer hebben in Veilig Thuis

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that schools have lost trust in Veilig Thuis, citing 40% of primary schools reporting no feedback on their notifications, and asked about registration systems, data and measures to raise reporting. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to the VNG programme 'Veilig Thuis – de basis op orde', the Beweging tegen Kindermishandeling, a protocol to improve statistics, and the meldcode revision, but gave no school-specific data and declined to create a single linked registration system.
No figures can be given on the number of advice requests and notifications from (primary) education.
Er zijn geen cijfers te geven over het aantal adviezen en meldingen vanuit het (basis)onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de voortdurende zorgelijke situatie bij Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid

An MP asked the government about continuing problems at Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid, including police reports not being handled properly and waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that inspectorates have kept the organisation under intensified supervision since April 2016, that waiting lists have fallen markedly since August 2016, and that the regional municipalities have taken steps, though the organisation is not yet fully in order.
The inspectorates are following developments at Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid within the framework of intensified supervision.
De inspecties volgen de ontwikkelingen bij Veilig Thuis Gelderland-Zuid in het kader van het verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen die slachtoffer worden van mensenhandel en uitbuiting

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked about the Save the Children report on unaccompanied minor victims of trafficking in Italy, the rise in Nigerian minors arriving via Italy, whether the Netherlands bears special responsibility, Albania's EU accession and anti-trafficking cooperation with Italy and the Balkans. The Minister described the figures as worrying, pointed to EMPACT THB cooperation, liaison officers and joint investigations, and said Albania is not yet ready to open accession negotiations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman en Van Tongeren over het bericht dat burgemeester van der Laan vasthoudt aan de sluiting van acht coffeeshops

MPs Bergkamp, Volp, Kooiman and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Amsterdam's mayor insisting on closing eight coffee shops near schools, including the legal basis of an earlier informal agreement with the minister's predecessor and whether it obliges the mayor to enforce a 250-metre distance criterion. The minister answered that the agreement was oral, concerns phased enforcement priorities, that enforcement of the residence and distance criteria lies with the mayor or municipality, and declined to judge local research or to answer on the shorter deadline.
My predecessor made an oral agreement with the mayor of Amsterdam on prioritisation in enforcement regarding local coffee shop policy.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft met de burgemeester van Amsterdam een mondelinge afspraak gemaakt over prioritering in de handhaving met betrekking tot het lokale coffeeshopbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de snelwegpolitie wordt afgeschaft

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the motorway police is being abolished and why, given good results, and how this fits the goal of reducing road deaths. The minister answered that the 20 motorway enforcement staff are moved into the Dienst Infrastructuur, that enforcement stays at current levels with results agreements to follow, and that enforcement will focus on priority offences.
In addition, results agreements on motorway traffic enforcement will be formulated between the CVOM parquet and the National Unit, in consultation with Rijkswaterstaat.

In aanvulling daarop zullen tussen het parket Centrale Verwerking Openbaar Ministerie (CVOM) en de Landelijke Eenheid, in samenspraak met Rijkswaterstaat, resultaatafspraken worden geformuleerd met betrekking tot de verkeershandhaving op de snelwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over grenscontroles door de douane in het binnenland

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Justice and Security about customs checks in the interior, including the end of BPM checks on foreign-plated cars, the revenue recovered, the armed status of customs officers during excise checks, and cooperation with police and the Marechaussee. The State Secretary answered that BPM checks moved to the Tax Administration in 2010, that repressive recovery yields about 1.5 million euro per year, that a study on arming excise checks is ongoing, and that the Customs service has a 24-hour contact point.
The investigation announced in this letter into whether there are situations in which excise checks can be carried out armed is ongoing.
Het in deze brief aangekondigde onderzoek of er situaties zijn waarin de accijnscontroles bewapend uitgevoerd kunnen worden, loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Recourt, Van Oosten, Kooiman en Van der Staaij over de documentaire ‘Grenzeloos misbruikt’

Five MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about the documentary on child sex tourism and webcam abuse, including police capacity, investigative powers, Philippine cooperation, liaison staffing and funding. The government answered in detail, describing existing measures, the Plan van Aanpak, the Manila liaison extension and the Down to Zero programme, while declining to commit additional funds or expertise for Philippine police training due to scarce specialised capacity.

Because these efforts require scarce specialised operational police capacity, which would then not be available for investigation in the Netherlands, I am unfortunately forced to be restrained in this regard.

Omdat deze inspanningen de inzet vereisen van schaarse gespecialiseerde operationele capaciteit van de politie, die daardoor niet voor de opsporing in Nederland beschikbaar is, ben ik helaas gedwongen hiermee terughoudend om te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over reclasseringsmedewerkers die de regels overtreden

MP Kooiman asked about reclassering staff allegedly selling furniture made by community-service offenders for cash in breach of rules, whether oversight existed, why earlier whistleblower complaints (2010-2014) were rejected, and whether rehabilitation or Huis voor Klokkenluiders involvement is warranted. The Secretary of State answered that Reclassering Nederland commissioned external investigations finding no evidence of informal sales, that cash payments breached rules and staff were re-instructed, that earlier complaints had been investigated and the Raad van Toezicht saw no reason for further inquiry, and that rehabilitation is not currently at issue.
RN has informed me that these recordings were not provided to RN despite repeated requests, and I too have been unable to view these recordings.
RN heeft mij laten weten dat deze beelden, ondanks herhaald verzoek hiertoe, niet aan RN zijn verstrekt, en ook ik heb geen kennis kunnen nemen van deze opnames.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg  en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Nabestaanden twijfelen aan zelfmoord gevangene Nieuwegein’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kooiman asked whether relatives doubting a prisoner's suicide in Nieuwegein prison should be able to halt the cremation, and whether the Rijksrecherche should investigate. The State Secretary replied that the cremation was not scheduled for 5 December and needed no postponement, and that the Public Prosecution Service is already investigating, with relatives to be informed of the outcome.
The Public Prosecution Service, the police and also DJI take the signals from relatives who doubt the cause of death of a family member very seriously.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), de politie en ook DJI nemen de signalen van nabestaanden die twijfelen over de doodsoorzaak van een familielid zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de budgetten en bureaucratie in de jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about municipal youth care budget shortfalls, rising intake, administrative burden and private practitioners withdrawing from youth care. The state secretary was cautious about shortfall reports, denied a clear rise in youth care use, pointed to ongoing data work and the Jeugdwet's choice rules, and promised to report back on administrative-burden measures in early 2017.
I followed the reporting by NOS and Binnenlands Bestuur with interest.
Ik heb de berichtgeving van de NOS en Binnenlands Bestuur met interesse gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Groningen later ter plekke is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about fire brigade arrival times in Groningen (met in only 39% of cases), regional differences, rising fire service costs, and safety in sparsely populated areas. The minister said the regional safety board is responsible for arrival times, pointed to an Inspectorate study due by summer 2017, and said police response-time issues require local tailoring.
It is up to the board of the Groningen safety region to ensure that when setting fire brigade arrival times, the provisions of the Safety Regions Decree (Bvr) are met.

Het is aan het bestuur van Veiligheidsregio Groningen om ervoor te zorgen dat bij het vaststellen van de opkomsttijden van de brandweer wordt voldaan aan de bepalingen van het Besluit veiligheidsregio’s (Bvr).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er alarm wordt geslagen over het geweld en corruptie in de cocaïnehandel

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about police and prosecution warnings over rising cocaine trade violence, port capacity and customs corruption. The state secretary answered that the signal is taken seriously, points to the integrated one-government approach and customs' smart supervision, says shootings may be indirectly linked to drug imports, and refers to earlier answers on anti-corruption measures at customs.
The regional triangle and Customs are examining which consultation model can best be given shape for this.
De regionale driehoek en de Douane onderzoeken in welk overlegmodel dit het beste vorm gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de onrust bij de douane

An MP asked the Finance Minister about unrest among customs staff over his working visit, including whether surveillance staff were deliberately skipped and whether he would inform parliament. The minister denied skipping surveillance, said he met staff and union representatives, committed to pursuing customs weapons and emergency-vehicle exemptions, and referred further detail to a separate letter.
It was my explicit wish to speak with those employees, and there was ample time for this during the visit.
Het was mijn uitdrukkelijke wens om met die medewerkers in gesprek te gaan en tijdens het bezoek was er ook ruim de tijd voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Van Nispen en Karabulut over de aanhouding van demonstranten wegens belediging

Three SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether arrests at a November 2016 demonstration for detained Kurdish parliamentarians were made for insult, how the decisions were taken, what the insults were, whether local authorities banned slogans, whether arrestees will be prosecuted, and whether protest rights are protected. The minister answered that one person was arrested for refusing to hand over a sign reading 'Erdogan Terrorista' with a Hitler-moustache image, which the Public Prosecution Service deemed insulting, that seven others were arrested for violence, that no slogan ban is known, that prosecution of the violence arrestees is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that freedom of expression is not absolute.
The Public Prosecution Service deemed this expression punishable as insult (article 266 of the Criminal Code).
Het Openbaar Ministerie oordeelde deze uiting als strafbaar (belediging, artikel 266 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Kooiman over de reactie van de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie op de plannen van de Woenselse Poort naar aanleiding van misstanden aldaar

MPs Van Toorenburg and Kooiman asked why the minister did not mention the Inspectorate's critical letter on the Woenselse Poort action plan during a November 2016 debate on TBS, and asked for the Inspectorate's concerns on drug use, vacancies and staffing. The Secretary of State confirmed receipt, said the letter was published and that the plan now addresses the Inspectorate's points, and promised to await the final report and a return visit in early 2017.
The inspectorate informed me that the action plan presented by the clinic De Woenselse Poort broadly addresses the identified shortcomings.
De inspectie heeft mij geïnformeerd dat het actieplan dat de kliniek De Woenselse Poort heeft gepresenteerd, op hoofdlijnen ingaat op de geconstateerde tekortkomingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over zorgorganisaties die steeds meer betalen aan accountants

Two SP MPs asked why healthcare organisations spent rising sums on accountants, with the big four firms taking most of it, and whether the Wmo 2015 and Jeugdwet caused extra bureaucracy. The state secretary answered that accountancy control is necessary, that costs fell on average, that the rise is due to more contracting parties under the new laws, and that standardisation tools and possible further regulation are being pursued.
I do not have the figures on the accountancy costs of these mental health providers and therefore cannot confirm whether this expectation is correct.
Ik beschik niet over de cijfers van de accountantskosten van deze ggz-aanbieders en kan dus niet staven of deze verwachting wel of niet terecht is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de leegstand en het personeelstekort bij de PI Haaglanden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice why PI Haaglanden Zoetermeer is concentrating vacancies, closing its prison wing and ISD unit, and relocating staff and detainees amid a staff shortage, and whether this undermines the parliamentary motion against prison closures. The State Secretary replied that these are temporary concentration measures, not closures, that the ZBBI regime is moved rather than abolished, and that staffing and external-hiring choices are driven by declining capacity needs.
There is no question of wholly or partially closing PIs.
Er is geen sprake van het geheel of gedeeltelijk sluiten van PI's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het beveiligingsteam van de Oranjes een bende is

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the security team protecting the royal family (Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen) was a clique, including unrest, a corruption probe, workload and training. The minister answered that an external culture study led to improvement measures, the head of the service stepped down, and the report would be shared confidentially with parliament.
The investigation report concerns an internal study aimed at addressing the underlying causes of the signals of unrest and dissatisfaction within the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen.
Het onderzoeksrapport betreft een intern onderzoek met als doel om de achterliggende oorzaken van de signalen van onrust en onvrede binnen de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorg in de regio Arnhem in de knel dreigt te komen

An SP MP asks whether it is acceptable that three youth-care providers in the Arnhem region may withdraw from a tender, possibly leaving families without their trusted helpers, and what the state will do to prevent underpayment and stalled procurement. The State Secretary answers that the procurement is not yet concluded, that municipalities must ensure adequate provision and continuity under the Jeugdwet, that the Transition Authority can mediate if needed, and that the region will not halt the tender but will seek clarification from the non-bidding parties.
At this moment the tender procedure in the Arnhem region has not yet been concluded and it is not appropriate for me to make statements about it.
Op dit moment is de aanbestedingsprocedure in de regio Arnhem nog niet afgerond en past het mij niet om hierover uitspraken te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het geld voor jeugd-ggz in Almere op is

MP Kooiman asked the state secretary how he responds to Almere's letter restricting youth mental health access due to budget shortfalls, whether this reflects broader budget and waiting-list problems, and whether he will verify that children are not left without care. The state secretary replied that the Youth Act obliges municipalities to provide care beyond acute cases, that he contacted the alderman, that the municipal council passed a motion reversing the intake stop, and that he will monitor implementation and report on waiting-time norms in a letter before 14 November.
The mere fact that the municipal budget for youth care threatens to be exceeded does not detract from municipalities' obligation to provide youth care.
Het enkele feit dat het gemeentelijk budget voor jeugdhulp overschreden dreigt te worden doet niet af aan de jeugdhulpplicht van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat door de lange wachttijd bellers van de politielijn massaal afhaken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why callers to the police non-emergency line are abandoning calls due to long waits and whether this is acceptable. The minister acknowledged the reports, said the police are working on short- and long-term measures to improve the line's availability, and described steps taken on staffing with temporary and permanent hires.
The number 0900 8844 is intended for non-urgent contacts.
Het nummer 0900 8844 is bedoeld voor niet spoedeisende contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter met betrekking tot de jeugdhulpaanbesteding in de gemeenten Alphen aan den Rijn en Kaag en Braassem

An MP asked the state secretary how the court ruling on the youth care tender in Alphen aan den Rijn and Kaag en Braassem is being followed up, whether other regions must redo similar tenders, and whether online auction-site tendering should be banned. The state secretary replied that the municipalities are appealing, that existing providers continue meanwhile, that the ruling concerns risk allocation and scope rather than the tender method, and that no other changes to policy follow.
If the appeal ruling is that a re-tender must nonetheless take place, the court's ruling will be taken into account when carrying out that re-tender.
Mocht de uitspraak in hoger beroep zijn dat alsnog moet worden overgegaan tot heraanbesteding, dan wordt bij de uitvoering van deze heraanbesteding de uitspraak van de rechter in acht genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over Wurg- en zwijgcontracten in de jeugdzorg

MP Kooiman asked whether the minister will investigate how many municipalities use gag and strangle clauses in youth care contracts and whether clients can effectively opt out, and how the minister will address privacy problems. The minister answered that municipal councils oversee municipal privacy compliance, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens supervises, no investigation into scale or opt-out is planned, and the issue will be placed on the agenda of the next consultation with municipalities and providers.
It is up to the municipal council to supervise the conduct of the municipal executive board.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om toe te zien op het handelen van het college van B&W.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat vanwege geldgebrek autistische kinderen op de wachtlijst komen

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether autistic children are being placed on waiting lists because of budget shortfalls at a youth mental health provider, and about cut-off dates, waiting-list data, and guarantees against children falling through the gap. The secretary replied that municipalities bear the duty of care and procurement responsibility, that national waiting-list data cannot be provided, and that he will report on waiting-time agreements with VNG and providers in the November progress letter.
In this case it is up to the municipality of Dordrecht to make agreements with providers on the care offer for children who need youth care directly.
Het is in dit geval aan de gemeente Dordrecht om afspraken te maken met aanbieders over het hulpaanbod voor kinderen die direct jeugdhulp nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat in veel gemeenten het geld voor de jeugdpsychiatrie al op is

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether youth psychiatry funding in many municipalities had run out, creating waiting lists, and how the government as system responsible would address budget ceilings and related issues. The State Secretary replied that youth care budgets are unearmarked municipal funds, that waiting-list cases are being checked individually and so far not linked to budget shortfalls, that talks with the VNG on referring children are under way, and that municipalities' budget outcomes vary for many reasons.
I am in talks with the VNG and sector bodies about the agreements they will make on this and will inform you of the outcomes before the budget consultation.
Ik ben met de VNG en branches in gesprek over de afspraken die zij hierover gaan maken en zal u voor het begrotingsoverleg informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er wederom een ernstige corruptiezaak binnen de Nationale Politie is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported corruption case involving a police commissioner, when the minister learned of it, and what action and measures would follow given it is a third such case this year. The minister confirmed being informed by the prosecution service, said the officer was suspended, stated no extra measures were currently needed beyond existing ones, and pointed to an Inspectorate report and a forthcoming WODC study due spring 2017.
This is a subject that continues to receive my attention. That is why I asked the WODC to carry out a phenomenon study
Het is een onderwerp wat blijvend mijn aandacht heeft. Daarom heb ik aan het WODC verzocht een fenomeenonderzoek uit te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over wurg- en zwijgcontracten in de jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the state secretary about gag and strangling clauses in youth care contracts that force independent providers to hand over confidential client data and impose penalties for breaching secrecy. The state secretary answered that contracts may not violate the law, that a ministerial regulation now clarifies privacy rules for data sharing, and that courts can review such clauses, but declined to make model contracts mandatory or to track how many municipalities use similar clauses.
What is certainly not possible is that municipalities include conditions that violate laws and regulations, or require a provider to violate them.
Wat zeker niet kan, is dat gemeenten voorwaarden opnemen die wet- en regelgeving overtreden, of die van een aanbieder verlangen dat ze deze overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat ouderen of instanties kinderen opzadelen met enorme pgb-schulden

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that children are left with large personal budget (pgb) debts incurred by parents or institutions while they were minors, and whether this breaches children's rights and whether the system should change. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem as undesirable, said he is discussing a solution with care offices and the NZa, and said that since 2015 pgb applications are examined more strictly, though he saw no reason to change application rules and could not yet give numbers of affected children.
That is why I am in discussion with the care offices and the NZa to find a solution for this AWBZ case.
Daarom ben ik met zorgkantoren en de NZa in gesprek om te komen tot een oplossing voor deze AWBZ-casuistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut over het bericht dat de vrouwenopvang onveilig is

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about reports that women's shelters are unsafe, with reports of fear cultures, volunteer and flex staffing, bureaucracy, debt, high contributions and weak housing pathways. The State Secretary answered that no further signals of a fear culture were received, that the matters are largely for municipalities and ongoing projects, and promised continued monitoring and talks with the Federatie Opvang.
This concerns a limited number of anonymous sources.
Het gaat hier om een beperkt aantal anonieme bronnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over fraude bij zorgorganisatie Boriz

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about suspected fraud at care organisation Boriz, its profits, whether it continues as subcontractor of Pluryn, and whether former owners can set up new care organisations. The state secretary said he awaits Menzis's fraud investigation, which he will not publish, declined to give a timeline, said excessive profits do not belong in care and that enforcement bodies are acting, and noted insurers must screen providers' integrity.
Health insurers and care offices never make fraud investigation reports public, both out of privacy interests and to prevent sensitive information about fraudsters' methods from becoming public.

Zorgverzekeraars en zorgkantoren maken de rapporten van fraudeonderzoeken nooit openbaar, zowel vanuit het belang van privacy als om te voorkomen dat gevoelige informatie over de werkwijze van fraudeurs naar buiten komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een modelagent gearresteerd is door eigen collega’s

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that a model police officer was arrested by his own colleagues and whether ethnic profiling by the police is only incidental. The minister said ethnic profiling is not systematic, that an internal investigation is underway and its results will be sent to parliament, and that a national working group on ethnic profiling exists.
An investigation into the facts and circumstances is being carried out by the Amsterdam and East Netherlands units.
Er wordt door de eenheden Amsterdam en Oost-Nederland een onderzoek ingesteld naar de feiten en de omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er kritiek is op de hulpverlening na drama Stieltjeskanaal

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criticism of emergency response after a car accident in the Stieltjeskanaal, including whether regions without dive teams slow rescue and whether a legal duty for dive teams should be introduced. The minister answered that regions decide their own rescue arrangements, that response times depend on the case, and that no change or new talks are planned.
For that reason, safety regions are not obliged to have a dive team.
Veiligheidsregio’s zijn om die reden niet verplicht te beschikken over een duikteam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanhoudende financiële problemen voor jeugdzorginstellingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about persistent payment delays and financial problems for youth care institutions, including the eligibility criteria for transition-cost subsidy, the size of the payment problem, and administrative burden. The State Secretary largely defended the existing escalation ladder and subsidy criteria, said no reliable data exist on administrative burden, and promised to report on standardisation by September.
No figures are available that offer solid insight into a decrease or increase in administrative burden and regulatory pressure since decentralisation.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar die een solide inzicht bieden in een daling of stijging van administratieve lasten en regeldruk sinds de decentralisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kooiman over “het bericht dat steeds meer ouderen door armoede in de cel belanden na een verkeersboete”

MP Kooiman asked whether older people are increasingly jailed for unpaid traffic fines due to poverty, and how CJIB and the prosecution account for financial hardship. The state secretary said the absolute number of older detainees rose slightly, that detentions for unpaid fines among over-50s fell from 72 in 2013 to 12 in mid-2016 after a person-focused assessment was introduced, and described the financial checks and debt-relief referral steps taken.
A request for detention for non-payment is in principle only filed against persons for whom, on the basis of the available information, there is no inability to pay.
Het indienen van een vordering gijzeling gebeurt in beginsel alleen bij personen voor wie geldt dat – op basis van de beschikbare informatie – geen sprake is van betalingsonmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Raad voor de Kinderbescherming 130 tijdelijke mensen aanneemt

MP Kooiman asked the Justice and Health ministers about long waiting times at the Child Protection Board (Raad voor de Kinderbescherming) and the temporary hiring of 130 staff, including whether waiting times will be reduced, what the effects are on the wider child protection chain, and whether extra funds will follow. The minister answered that the hiring is a temporary response to unexpected rising intake, that waiting times may rise further before easing by year-end, that the chain will be monitored and funding adjusted if the rise persists, and that other chain organisations are the responsibility of municipalities.
We see no need to take other measures in anticipation of this.
Wij zien geen noodzaak om vooruitlopend hierop andere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat relatie- en concurrentiebeding voor vrije zorgkeuze gaat

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a court ruling letting a care provider's non-compete and non-relocation clauses override young adults' free choice of care, along with related questions on child welfare, management pay and a profit-distribution holding structure. The State Secretary regretted the impact on clients, said the court's ruling must be respected, argued choice of care remains important, said the inspectorate is investigating the profit ban and the pay regulator will examine management pay, and deferred to contracting bodies to protect clients.

The CIBG will, as the responsible supervisory body under the Public and Semi-Public Sector Senior Officials (Remuneration) Act, launch an investigation into the remuneration of De Karmel's management.

Het CIBG zal, als de verantwoordelijke toezichthouder op grond van de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke – en semi-publieke sector, een onderzoek instellen naar de bezoldiging van het management van De Karmel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat agenten een spijkermat willen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether he would reconsider the police leadership's decision not to purchase spike mats for officers, who reportedly wanted them, and whether he would discuss the matter with the police chief. The minister replied that the police chief judged the spike mat not worth buying after a 2012-2013 pilot used it only ten times, mostly successfully, and that he sees no reason to reopen the discussion.
As I indicated in my letter of 13 June, the assessment of the need for a new weapons system involves external studies, tests and the experiences of staff.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 13 juni jl. heb aangegeven, worden bij de beoordeling van de behoefte aan een nieuw wapensysteem (externe) onderzoeken, testen en ervaringen van medewerkers betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie ontevreden is over de robuuste basisteams en het aanbieding van het rapport Basisteams in de Nationale Politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he agreed with a research report finding that the robust basic police teams do not function well, and whether he would revise them, publish the report and address concerns about reduced accessibility, the role of neighbourhood officers, reactive policing, and complex structures. The minister answers that the findings are an early signal from a six-team study, that the teams will be given time to become fully operational by end 2017, that the police will use the insights, and that the report will be sent to parliament with a fuller reaction before the budget debate.
The report was prepared by Radboud University Nijmegen, commissioned by the independent research programme Police and Science. I am sending you the report as an annex to these answers.

Het rapport is opgesteld door de Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen, in opdracht van het onafhankelijke onderzoeksprogramma Politie en Wetenschap. Ik zend het u het rapport als bijlage bij deze antwoorden toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politiebaas grif tekende

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the police chief signed off spending by the police works council (COR) that exceeded its budget of 1.6 million euro by about 226,000 euro, including alleged luxury boat expenses, and whether this reflected a quid pro quo. The minister confirmed an initial inquiry and an internal investigation by the police integrity unit, but withheld substantive findings and conclusions pending the investigation, promising to inform parliament after it concludes.
Pending the investigation, I cannot inform your House any further at this time.
Hangende het onderzoek kan ik uw Kamer op dit moment niet nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de rechterlijke uitspraken over Schakenbosch

MPs Bergkamp and Kooiman asked the state secretary about court rulings that minors stayed without a valid legal basis at the Schakenbosch closed youth facility, and why the government did not intervene earlier. The state secretary confirmed knowledge of the rulings since November 2015, said coercive care requires a legal basis, and reported that the Inspectorate is assessing all closed youth institutions, with a final report and consequences promised within weeks.

My starting point is that coercive care requires a legal basis, whether it takes place in a closed youth care institution under the Youth Act or involves compulsory mental health or disability care under the Bopz Act.

Mijn uitgangspunt is dat gedwongen zorg een juridische grondslag behoeft, of deze nu op grond van de Jeugdwet in een instelling voor gesloten jeugdhulp plaatsvindt of dat het gedwongen geestelijke gezondheidszorg of gehandicaptenzorg betreft op grond van de Wet bopz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de acties van de brandweer voor een betere cao

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the fire brigade's summer strike action over a better collective agreement, the heavy nature of firefighting work and the stalled negotiations between safety regions and unions. The minister answered that the parties must reach agreement themselves, that he is not a party to the negotiations and sees no reason to intervene for now, and that he raised the pension gap with the safety regions in 2015.
Responsibility for the staff's terms of employment lies with the boards of the 25 safety regions.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de arbeidsvoorwaarden van het personeel ligt bij de besturen van de 25 veiligheidsregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat ggz-patiënten (patiënten in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg) vaker in een tbs-kliniek zitten

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the ministers how BOPZ psychiatric patients can be transferred to a TBS clinic without a judge's involvement, why suitable GGZ places are lacking, and whether the bed reduction is to blame. The government answered that transfers are based on BOPZ article 55 with a copy to the judge, are rare (about 0.24% of BOPZ patients, 38 people), are made by the medical director on psychiatric indication, and that a broader study and IGZ talks will follow.
These are BOPZ patients whose judicial measure is converted into a BOPZ authorisation.
Het gaat hierbij om BOPZ-patiënten van wie de justitiële maatregel wordt omgezet in een BOPZ-machtiging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het onder verscherpt toezicht stellen van Veilig Thuis Drenthe

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about the placement of Veilig Thuis Drenthe under enhanced supervision, waiting lists, safety of children and families, and whether the budget should be increased. The State Secretary answers that the inspectorates are monitoring, that municipalities are responsible, that the national programme is working on waiting lists, and that the budget depends on local visions, while promising a further progress report.
Municipalities are responsible for Veilig Thuis. The Inspectorates supervise the Veilig Thuis organisations.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor Veilig Thuis. De Inspecties houden toezicht op de Veilig Thuis organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorginstellingen miljoenen euro's kwijt zijn aan bureaucratie

An SP MP asked the state secretary why youth care providers keep reporting millions of euros in extra bureaucratic costs since the transition, and what he would do if the reform takes too long. The secretary acknowledged administrative burden is too high, pointed to reduced product codes, uniform benchmark reports and a possible future power to set rules if municipalities and providers do not act.
I am considering setting further rules if providers and municipalities do not themselves take their responsibility.
Ik overweeg nadere regels te stellen als aanbieders en gemeenten niet zelf hun verantwoordelijkheid nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat men de afbraak van de beveiliging nu beu is

The MP Kooiman asks whether the minister is aware of staff complaints about high workload, declining quality and sick leave in the Den Haag police unit's Bewaken en Beveiligen team, and whether reduced police numbers should be reversed. The minister answers that the unit's leadership has held talks with staff, that extra capacity is drawn from other teams, that the quality claim is rejected, and that sick leave is being investigated generally, without committing to restore the planned reduction.
An operational strength of at least 49,500 FTE has been agreed with your House.
Met uw Kamer is een operationele sterkte afgesproken van tenminste 49.500 FTE.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de stand van zaken in de jeugdhulp

An MP from the SP asks the state secretary about the Rotterdam child-protection failure, the use of unqualified student helpers, a looming crisis-shelter admission freeze, the link between the youth-care transition, budget cuts and weak neighbourhood teams, and waiting-list monitoring. The secretary answers that the inspections' findings are being followed, that qualified staff must be used under the Jeugdwet, that waiting-list data cannot be collected uniformly in a decentralised system and that a study and Treek waiting norms will follow.
It is up to municipalities to purchase sufficient provision and the municipal council to supervise this.
Het is aan gemeenten om voldoende aanbod in te kopen en de gemeenteraad om hierop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Van Toorenburg en Swinkels over het in weerwil van een Kamermotie sluiten van gevangenissen

MPs Kooiman, Van Toorenburg and Swinkels asked whether preparations to close prisons after the March 2017 elections, and the concentration of vacant cells, conflict with a Chamber motion stating that closing prisons is not on the agenda. The Secretary of State replied that he is implementing the motion, closes no prisons, and that concentrating vacancies is internal operational management, with DJI mapping consequences in consultation with staff and promising to inform the Chamber later.
I am implementing this motion accordingly.
Ik voer deze motie dienovereenkomstig uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Enkhuizen regelmatig buiten dienst is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether fire brigade understaffing in Enkhuizen, and a variable-crew trial in Hellevoetsluis, were safe, and whether the Inspectorate would investigate. The Minister said the safety region is responsible for adequate fire services, the Inspectorate will examine repressive fire care in all safety regions this year, and no talks or further sending of the regional report were planned, referring questions to the regions and municipal councils.
The Inspectorate of Security and Justice will carry out an investigation into the quality of repressive fire brigade care in all safety regions this year.
De Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie zal dit jaar in alle veiligheidsregio’s een onderzoek uitvoeren naar de kwaliteit van de repressieve brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de rechtsbijstand aan slachtoffers van ernstige gewelds- en zedenmisdrijven

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Justice Minister about legal aid for victims of serious violent and sexual crimes, including the LANGZS black book, referrals by Slachtofferhulp Nederland, Raad voor Rechtsbijstand fee points and budget cuts. The minister answered that referrals have been stimulated and fee points are under review with stakeholders, but largely pointed to existing policy and promised further consultation without committing to new structural changes.
My ministry has asked the organisations concerned to respond to the cases mentioned in the black book.
Mijn ministerie heeft de betrokken organisaties gevraagd om een reactie op de in het Zwartboek genoemde casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanval op een cipier van de Penitentiaire Inrichting (PI) Vught

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a stabbing attack on a prison guard at PI Vught with a sharpened toothbrush, including whether the incident was concealed, whether the Inspectorate investigated, staffing levels, aftercare, and whether budget cuts endanger safety. The state secretary answered that the incident was reported under internal procedures, that the Inspectorate found the PI handled it correctly, that staffing was not short, and that the Masterplan cuts did not increase aggression.
There is no question of concealing this incident.
Er is geen sprake van stilhouden van dit incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bergkamp over legale wietteelt als positieve mensenrechtenverplichting

MPs Kooiman and Bergkamp asked whether international human rights law obliges the state to regulate legal cannabis cultivation, and about the budgetary and tax effects of regulation. The minister answered that the conditions for a human-rights-based space for regulation are not met, that regulation would not reduce enforcement costs or yield tax revenue as claimed, and that no change of course is warranted given the parliamentary majority against regulation.
Therefore I see no reason for a change of course.
Derhalve zie ik geen reden voor een koerswijziging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Zeeland de ideale plek is voor drugssmokkelaars

MP Kooiman asks the Minister of Security and Justice whether drug smuggling is shifting to Zeeland, whether inspection reports show too little police capacity there, and whether he will cut police staffing by about 2,000 FTE. The minister says enforcement is risk-based and integrated, points to inspection work that gave no verdict on Zeeland drug enforcement, notes agreed capacity measures and a port prosecutor, and states the operational strength will be reduced to the agreed 49,500 FTE.
Do the inspection reports indeed show that there is far too little capacity in Zeeland to tackle this problem? Are you willing to also send these reports to the House of Representatives?
Vraag 3 Blijkt uit de inspectierapporten inderdaad dat er veel te weinig capaciteit is in Zeeland om deze problematiek aan te pakken? Bent u bereid deze rapporten ook naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Smaling en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat er door een drugs-lab giftige stoffen zijn vrij gekomen in een woonwijk in Tilburg

MPs asked the government how harmful the toxic release from a Tilburg drug lab was, how residents are being informed and trained to spot drug labs, and how many labs are dismantled and what resources are assigned. The minister answered that methanol and sulphuric acid were present, residents were informed by letter, training and a smell map are being rolled out in the south, and labour conditions at the dismantling unit were investigated and improved.
In any case it is an undesirable situation when a drug laboratory is found in a residential area.
Het is hoe dan ook een onwenselijke situatie als een drugslaboratorium in een woonwijk wordt aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het bericht over een bedreigd Rotterdams gezin

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether honour-related violence against a Rotterdam family is being recognised and acted on in time, and whether knowledge should be strengthened at police units. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because a criminal investigation is ongoing, defended the existing police and LEC EGG structure, and agreed knowledge should be present in all regional units while saying existing arrangements already provide for it.
However, I cannot go into the details of an individual case, because of the privacy of those involved and in the interest of the criminal investigation that is still ongoing.
Ik kan echter niet ingaan op de details van een individuele casus, vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen en in het belang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat momenteel nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de jeugdzorgorganisaties op het randje van faillissement staan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that youth care organisations are near bankruptcy, asking for liquidity data, the role of late municipal payments, and whether the right to youth care should be reinstated. The State Secretary said the survey response was 36%, that about 40% of respondents reported at least 10% payment arrears from municipalities, and that the TAJ was asked to advise on liquidity support, with a progress report promised for spring.
This report is based on a survey by the Branches Specialised Care for Youth (BGZJ).
Dit bericht is gebaseerd op een enquête van de Branches Gespecialiseerde Zorg voor Jeugd (BGZJ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het inhuren van detentietoezichthouders via een extern beveiligingsbedrijf

MP Kooiman asked why the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen hires detention supervisors via an external security firm while staff are being dismissed under the Masterplan, and why this is cheaper than retaining or retraining own staff. The state secretary answered that shortages in the security job group trigger first internal mobility, then temporary external hiring under a framework agreement in force since 2013, that no reorganisation dismissals have occurred, that own staff have priority for structural vacancies, and that cost plays no decisive role.
External hiring takes place only if vacancies cannot be filled in time by qualified DJI staff.
Er wordt alleen extern ingehuurd indien de vacatures niet tijdig kunnen worden vervuld door gekwalificeerd DJI-personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie het vaakst te laat komt in Rijnwaarden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police response times differ widely between municipalities, such as Rijnwaarden, and whether vehicle cuts and station closures worsen policing there. The Minister said the police now measure response times, that national performance has improved to 85%, that more resources would be needed to meet the norm everywhere, and that vehicle cuts and station closures would not reduce service, while promising an analysis of lagging areas.
I will ask the chief of police to conduct a closer analysis of the specific areas, such as Rijnwaarden, where performance is substantially lower than the national average.
Ik zal de korpschef vragen een nadere analyse van de specifieke gebieden, zoals Rijnwaarden, waar de prestaties substantieel lager zijn dan het landelijk gemiddelde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de gemeentelijke BOA de rol van de agent overneemt

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether municipal enforcement officers (BOAs) are taking over police tasks, whether weapons and assaults on BOAs are a concern, and about neighbourhood watch groups. The minister replied that BOAs take over no police tasks, that the police remain primarily responsible for public order, and that the issues raised are local matters or outside the government's direct remit, while committing to further consultation and to answer questions before the police debate.
Municipal enforcement officers (BOAs) take over no tasks from the police.
Gemeentelijke Buitengewoon Opsporingsambtenaren (hierna: boa's) nemen geen taken over van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de overlast van verwarde personen de pan uit rijst

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Health about reports that nuisance from confused persons is rising sharply, the police figures behind it, and whether mental health care budget cuts, bed reductions, the FACT-team rollout and police capacity cuts are to blame. The minister answered that police registrations rose about 65% between 2011 and 2015 but are incident counts rather than unique persons, that no causal link to ggz cuts has been shown, and that the aanjaagteam, a regional study and a handle for insurers and municipalities are underway.
I make growth room available for curative mental health care every year and therefore do not cut.
Ik stel elk jaar groeiruimte beschikbaar voor de curatieve GGZ en bezuinig dus niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over bijzonder bijkomende kosten voor kinderen onder voogdij en residentiële instellingen

An SP MP asks the State Secretaries whether municipalities are refusing to pay special additional costs for children under guardianship or in residential care, whether this reflects procurement pressure and the costs dispute the Children's Ombudsman reported, and whether financial barriers prevent parental contact. The Minister replies that no concrete signals of municipal refusal are known, that a factsheet with the VNG and Jeugdzorg Nederland will clarify the scheme, that special assistance is not the right route, that travel costs can be reimbursed, and that parental contributions were abolished, but commits to no new structural measures beyond the factsheet.
I am not aware of any concrete signals that municipalities would no longer be willing to pay for special costs.
Er zijn mij geen concrete signalen bekend dat gemeenten niet meer bereid zouden zijn om te betalen voor bijzondere kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat 8 kinderen uit hun zorgvoorziening gezet dreigen te worden

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport to respond to reports that eight children might have to leave a care farm, and to intervene to prevent the closure or to keep it open. The secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for individual cases, that a solution was found with the current provider through in-kind care contracting, and that no national intervention is planned.
It is the task of municipalities to ensure an appropriate solution is provided in individual cases.
Het is de taak van gemeenten om in individuele casussen te zorgen dat er een passende oplossing wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘Ziekteverzuim onder politieagenten explodeert’

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he would respond to reports that sick leave among police officers is surging, what he would do to reduce it, and whether he agreed that uncertainty over reassignment drives absence and that the 2014 task force had not worked. The minister referred to a separate letter to parliament on sick leave and measures, acknowledged that workforce reorganisation may be one explanatory factor, and rejected the claim that the task force had failed, citing over 1,800 long-term absence cases closed.
Simultaneously with answering these parliamentary questions, I am informing your House by letter about the development of sick leave and the measures the police are taking to reduce it.
Gelijktijdig met de beantwoording van deze Kamervragen, informeer ik uw Kamer bij brief over de ontwikkeling van het ziekteverzuim en de maatregelen die de politie neemt om dit terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het sluiten van gevangenissen

MP Kooiman (SP) asks whether the government will close more prisons, whether further cuts at Justice are wise, what the scenarios discussed with prison directors involve, and what happens if the PMJ prison-capacity forecasts do not materialise. The State Secretary says the measures stem from aligning capacity with forecast need rather than a new budget cut, that DJI is preparing a plan with no final decisions yet, and that the 2017 budget implications will be presented on Prinsjesdag.
At this stage, however, no definitive decisions have yet been taken on this.
In dit stadium zijn hierover echter nog geen definitieve beslissingen genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Siderius over het bericht dat de werkgelegenheid in welzijn, jeugdzorg en kinderopvang fors afneemt

MPs Kooiman and Siderius asked the ministers about a projected fall in employment in youth care, welfare and childcare, its effects on care quality, waiting lists, costs of unemployment benefits and support for affected workers. The government answered that the outlook is uncertain, that waiting lists cannot be tracked nationally because municipalities organise access differently, that childcare employment is expected to recover, and that sector plans and extra funding support retraining.
It is not possible to establish nationally in a uniform way the size of the waiting lists because municipalities have organised access to youth care differently.
Het is niet mogelijk om landelijk op eenduidige wijze vast te stellen wat de omvang van de wachtlijsten is omdat gemeenten de toegang tot de jeugdhulp verschillend georganiseerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het proefschrift Troubled girls, troubled futures

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how the government responds to a dissertation finding serious shortcomings in the effectiveness of closed youth placement for adolescent girls, including multi-problem families, early detection, aggression diagnostics and continuity after age 18. The state secretary acknowledges the picture, points to effectiveness monitoring, professional guidelines, ZonMw research and municipal efforts, but gives largely general answers without committing to specific new measures.
I facilitate this scientific discussion in, among other things, the research programme Effective work in the youth sector.
Ik faciliteer deze wetenschappelijke discussie in onder meer het onderzoeksprogramma Effectief werken in de jeugdsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over jongeren die worden omgekocht in jeugdgevangenissen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how he views reports that detained youths' complaints are bought off with compensation such as phone credit, and whether the informal complaint procedure should be changed. The State Secretary says bribery is unacceptable and that a joint policy response to the Children's Ombudsman will be sent to parliament, deferring the detailed answers to that response.
Bribery is absolutely undesirable and does not belong in the practice of the complaints right for young people in closed custody.
Omkopen is volstrekt onwenselijk en behoort niet thuis in de praktijk van het klachtrecht voor jeugdigen in geslotenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het automatisch opleggen van boetes

Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the consequences of a Court of Appeal ruling that fully automated traffic fines conflict with the Wet administratiefrechtelijke handhaving verkeersvoorschriften because no room is left to assess special circumstances, and whether RDW's system should change. The Minister answered that the Supreme Court annulled that ruling on 16 February 2016 as based on a wrong legal view, so the existing policy will not be changed.
Since the Supreme Court has annulled the judgment of the court of appeal, I see no reason to change the existing policy.
Nu de Hoge Raad het arrest van het gerechtshof heeft vernietigd, zie ik geen reden tot wijziging van het bestaande beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over de dood van een Eritrese asielzoeker

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked whether police and prosecutors would investigate the disappearance and death of an Eritrean asylum seeker, why COA and police information was not shared with German authorities, and whether a conflict with a roommate was reported. The minister replied that the German authorities handled and closed the investigation, that the COA reported a roommate dispute but no threat, that the person was moved to another room, and that the COA's notice to the EMM was not passed on under standard procedure, while promising to inform relatives if new insight arises.
The investigation into the death of the Eritrean asylum seeker, Mr. Mekonen, falls under the competence of the German authorities.
Het onderzoek naar het overlijden van de Eritrese asielzoeker, de heer Mekonen, valt onder de bevoegdheid van de Duitse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Twee keer per dag vergeet justitie verdachte op te halen’

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that suspects are often not transported to court hearings, with hundreds of cases where transport was never requested. The Minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service, not DV&O, requests transport, that court-data figures cannot establish causes, that adjournment costs about 87,000 euro per year, and that DJI is exploring earlier notice of the right to waive attendance.
The figures show the number of cases the Council for the Judiciary reports as adjourned because a suspect did not appear on time for the hearing.
De cijfers geven het aantal zaken weer dat volgens uitvraag van de RvdR wordt aangehouden wegens het niet tijdig verschijnen van een verdachte op de zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over boeven die de baas zijn in de bajes

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that long-sentenced prisoners dominate prisons, including claims about cell inspections finding weapons and phones, integrity of guards, whistleblower channels, and police intelligence awareness. The State Secretary said staff did not recognise the criticism, asked the Inspectorate to bring forward an integrity and contraband investigation, described inspection and integrity procedures and whistleblower options, and declined to confirm or deny the intelligence question.

Nevertheless, given these different signals and the great importance of integrity in an organisation like DJI, I have asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to bring forward its announced investigation into contraband and integrity issues in the prison system.

Toch heb ik gelet op deze verschillende geluiden en het grote belang van integriteit in een organisatie als DJI, de Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) verzocht haar reeds in haar werkprogramma 2016 aangekondigde onderzoek in het gevangeniswezen naar contrabande en integriteitskwesties, naar voren te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over boeven die de baas zijn in de bajes
