MP Kooiman (SP) asked about reports that long-sentenced prisoners run the wing in PI Alphen aan den Rijn and PI De Schie, smuggling of phones and anabolics by staff, and integrity checks. The State Secretary denied the De Schie claims, reported cell inspections and an access ban for one staff member, described the VOG and integrity bureau system, and said the Inspectorate was already asked to examine contraband and integrity.

As I also indicated in the answers to the questions from MPs Helder (PVV) and Van Toorenburg (CDA), I have asked the Inspectorate of Security and Justice to examine contraband and integrity issues in the prison system.

Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in de antwoorden op de vragen die zijn gesteld door het lid Helder (PVV)(Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2015–2016, nr. 1782 ) en Van Toorenburg (CDA)(Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2015–2016, nr. 1784 ) heb ik de IVenJ verzocht haar onderzoek in het gevangeniswezen naar contrabande en integriteitskwesties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar moord in gedrang volgens hoofdofficier justitie Breda'

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Breda public prosecution service might stop investigating difficult murder cases due to capacity constraints and budget cuts. The Minister replied that no investigation is being stopped, that prioritisation is an ordinary part of operational decisions, and that budgets for the prosecution service are being increased.
The chief public prosecutor does not say in the interview that he is stopping difficult investigations into liquidations.
De hoofdofficier zegt in het interview niet dat hij stopt met lastige opsporingsonderzoeken naar liquidaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bergkamp over een uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam inzake coffeeshops

MPs Kooiman and Bergkamp asked the Justice Minister how to view a Amsterdam district court ruling that government policy keeps cannabis trade in criminal hands, and whether experiments with regulated cannabis supply to coffeeshops should be allowed. The minister declined to comment on the judgment, maintained that regulating cultivation would not solve crime and is blocked by international treaties, and refused experiments, while noting the coffeeshop policy has been repeatedly backed by parliament.
It is for the judge to rule on cases brought before him within the framework of the law.
Het is aan de rechter om binnen de kaders van de wet te oordelen over zaken die aan hem worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht mobiele flitsapparatuur politie is onbetrouwbaar

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that mobile police speed cameras give unreliable readings, including the causes, error rates, costs and prevention. The minister answered that errors occur only rarely in specific reflection situations, that images are reviewed by an officer, that costs are commercially confidential, and that software upgrades are planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er steeds meer brand is bij thuiswonende senioren

An MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about rising fire incidents among independently living seniors, brigade staffing and voertuigbezetting, veiligheidsregio governance, and fire-brigade keuring. The minister answers largely by referring responsibility to veiligheidsregio boards and municipalities, provides some inspection reports, and promises a letter from another minister and further inspection work.
The boards of the safety regions are responsible for organising fire brigade services.
De besturen van de veiligheidsregio's zijn verantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van de brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie zelf drugs gaat testen

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police will test drugs themselves, questioning the reasons, timelines, quality, training, capacity and future of the arrangement. The minister answered that pilots showed on-site police testing with NFI interpretation is quick (about 24 hours versus 19-21 days), equivalent in quality, needs only a two-day training for technical handling, and does not require extra police capacity, while noting extra NFI funding of 5 million euro from 2016.
The outcomes were in all cases the same.
De uitkomsten waren in alle gevallen gelijk.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Rotterdam dat een gesloten machtiging niet wordt beëindigd vanwege gebrek aan financiële mi

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport how the government views a Rotterdam court ruling that a closed youth care order was not ended for lack of funds to support reintegration, whether this conflicts with the Youth Act, and whether waiting lists for closed youth care exist. The state secretary answered that the court's decision rested mainly on the lack of a meaningful day-care arrangement rather than funding, that the Youth Act provision cited does not apply to minors, that financial considerations can never justify extending a closed order, that the case gives no reason for further investigation, and that no signals of a shortage of closed places are known.
Purely financial considerations cannot form a basis for extending (or not ending) an order for closed youth care.
Louter financiële overwegingen kunnen geen grond vormen voor het verlengen (of het niet beëindigen) van een machtiging gesloten jeugdhulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de toedracht van de moord in PI Zoetermeer

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the handling of prisoners with psychiatric disorders following a fatal prison incident in PI Zoetermeer, including placement in PPC and EZV units, transfers, and investigations. The State Secretary answered that existing care and placement arrangements are adequate, that investigations will reveal the circumstances, and that internal reports will not be published, though inspection reports are.
I do not consider it desirable to make these public, because these reports contain personal data and information on procedures within the institution.
Ik acht het niet wenselijk om deze openbaar te maken, omdat deze rapporten persoonsgegevens én informatie over handelwijzen binnen de inrichting bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat jeugd-GGZ instellingen wellicht miljoenen euro’s terug moeten betalen

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the state secretary about reports that youth mental health institutions may have to repay millions of euros over disputed billing rules, and whether the situation could threaten providers and clients. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said the NZa would be asked to clarify and retroactively adjust the rules so insurers and providers can reach fair agreements, and stated that the ministry has not assessed bankruptcy risks.
She has therefore decided to ask the NZa to adjust the relevant rules (on direct time of the main practitioner and residential performances) with retroactive effect and in consultation with parties.

Zij heeft daarom besloten de NZa te vragen om de betreffende regels (rond de directe tijd van de hoofdbehandelaar en verblijfsprestaties) met terugwerkende kracht en in afstemming met partijen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de stand van zaken omtrent het Onderzoeksrapport Vrouwenopvang locatie IJmond

MPs Volp and Kooiman asked the state secretary about the Haanstra report on women's shelter location IJmond, including criticism of its independence and whether further research is needed. The state secretary said the Haarlem alderman is responsible for oversight and has ordered a follow-up investigation, and proposed an expert meeting via VNG and FO to examine whether the shelter model matches client needs.
The alderman of Haarlem must supervise the quality of facilities in his (central) municipality and account for this to the municipal council.
De wethouder van Haarlem moet toezicht houden op de (kwaliteit van) voorzieningen in zijn (centrum)gemeente en daarover verantwoording afleggen in de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Veilig Thuis tekort schiet in haar taken

An MP asked whether Veilig Thuis (domestic violence reporting centres) falls short in its tasks, including long waiting lists that may include high-priority cases and whether acute cases get contact, and what is being done. The state secretary acknowledged inspection signals, said municipalities added funds and organisations are preparing improvement plans, and stated that not all centres meet legal requirements and that some high-priority cases are on waiting lists.
I expect the final inspection report at the end of February 2016. As soon as I have received this report, I will send it to you within the usual timeframes.
Het eindrapport van de inspecties verwacht ik eind februari 2016. Zodra ik dit rapport heb ontvangen, zal ik het binnen de gebruikelijke termijnen aan u sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de druk op de beveiliging in asielzoekerscentra groot is

SP MPs asked whether reports of high pressure on security at asylum reception centres were accurate, how many violent incidents occurred, whether training and police support were adequate, and how staff safety is ensured. The Secretary of State answered that incidents rose in number but are not disproportionate, that contracted security is certified, that a mantle agreement with the security firm covers staff safety, and that police support is available, while stating that incidents with weapons are not separately registered and that the COA could not split its figures by location type.
Incidents involving weapons are not registered separately.
Incidenten waarbij wapens betrokken zijn worden niet apart geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat een beveiligingsbedrijf zorgtaken en behandeling in het kader van de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning en jeugdzorg wil gaan leveren

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about reports that security company G4S would provide Wmo and youth care tasks in Hollandse Kroon, including its qualifications, staffing, use of remote care and transition impact on clients. The state secretary replied that the municipality had ended the tender talks with G4S, that it would not explain its reasons citing the Aanbestedingswet, and that continuity of care and legal safeguards would be ensured through the procurement process.
Referring to the Aanbestedingswet and the handling of talks between G4S Zorg en Welzijn and the municipality, the municipality makes no statements about the reasons for ending the talks.

De gemeente doet onder verwijzing naar het gestelde in de Aanbestedingswet en de afwikkeling van gesprekken tussen G4S Zorg en Welzijn en de gemeente, geen uitspraken over de beweegredenen voor het beëindigen van de gesprekken.
Vragen van de leden Oskam (CDA) en Kooiman (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over criminelen die shoppen bij spionagewinkels (ingezonden 11 november 2015).

MPs Oskam (CDA) and Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about criminals buying gadgets from spy shops to frustrate police investigations, asking for a product overview, enforcement practice, and a possible blacklist. The Minister said such devices are only punishable if illegal or knowingly used to facilitate crime, that enforcement is up to the OM and police, that no complete data exist, that a blacklist is not practical, and that Amsterdam is exploring a licensing scheme with which he will engage.
I do not have conclusive data on the range of products sold by spy shops.
Ik beschik niet over sluitende gegevens met betrekking tot het assortiment van spyshops.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de route tussen wietkweker en coffeeshophouders

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about ripdeals, the illegal intermediaries between cannabis growers and coffeeshops, the penalties for such trade, and the rules on joint-rolling and the 500-gram stock limit. The minister answered that no ripdeal statistics are kept, that the Opiumwet does not distinguish growers from intermediaries, that the 500-gram limit is a tolerance condition coffeeshops must meet, and that prosecution data lack case-specific details.
Figures on such offences are not kept separately.
Cijfers over dergelijke delicten worden niet apart bijgehouden.
Antwoord op van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie-pc’s brandhout zijn

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a report that police PCs were unusable, when the minister learned of the ICT funding shortfall, whether he would fund it before the Spring Memorandum, and whether an investigation into ICT project steering is needed. The minister says the report paints too bleak a picture, reports progress under the Aanvalsprogramma, admits the 2016 ICT portfolio cannot be funded and promises an external review of financial steering by the Commissie van toezicht, while rejecting a separate investigation.
I have asked the Commission for supervision of police management to take on the external investigation.
Ik heb de Commissie van toezicht op het beheer politie gevraagd om het externe onderzoek voor haar rekening te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over “het onderzoek naar het gijzelen van mensen die verkeersboetes niet betalen”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice how the government responds to the Ombudsman's report on imprisoning people who cannot pay traffic fines, including how the OM justifies unwillingness to pay, how it selects cases for detention, and whether instalment payments and a threshold amount will be examined. The State Secretary answered that the OM and CJIB now assess cases individually, will improve motivation of detention claims, introduce instalment payments and a contact step for possible inability to pay, and that the RDW notification process and the instalment threshold are being evaluated, with further measures set out in a separate letter.
In this way, evidently unreasonable situations should be prevented as much as possible.
Hiermee dienen evident onredelijke situaties zo veel mogelijk te worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over het gemak van inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen

MPs Kooiman and Bashir (SP) asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Housing about burglary risks in social rental housing, including the share of doors and windows with weak locks and whether the government will fund better protection. Minister Van der Steur answered that prevention is locally led and primarily the responsibility of residents and landlords, announced a 2 million euro co-financed fund for hotspot neighbourhoods, and said no national data on burglaries in social rental housing are kept.
No national figures are kept on the number of burglaries in social rental housing.
Over het aantal inbraken bij sociale huurwoningen worden landelijk geen cijfers bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over achterstand onderscheidingen politie

MP Kooiman asked whether police officers face multi-year delays receiving commemorative certificates and decorations, and what will be done. The minister (answering for the Interior/Justice portfolio) acknowledges backlogs in some units, says most have been cleared, and that national management of certificates is intended to prevent recurrence.
In a number of units there is indeed a backlog in issuing the certificates.
In een aantal eenheden is inderdaad sprake van achterstand bij het uitreiken van de oorkondes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Volp over het van binnenuit kunnen vergrendelen van celdeuren

MPs Kooiman and Volp asked whether prison staff at PI Sittard are instructed to force open cell doors blocked from inside, and whether cell locks should be changed after a fatal stabbing at PI Zoetermeer. The State Secretary confirmed the instruction was re-circulated but declined to explain the method for security reasons, and said a national inventory found no need to replace cell doors, only some bolts and lock housings.
For security reasons, however, the manner in which a (blocked) cell door can be opened from outside cannot be discussed.
Om veiligheidsredenen kan echter niet worden ingegaan op de wijze waarop een (geblokkeerde) celdeur van buitenaf kan worden geopend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Breskens veel te laat kwam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that fire services in Breskens arrived too late, whether safety is at risk, and whether the Zeeland safety region's 'Maatwerk in Brandweerzorg' plans were tested. The minister replied that the Zeeland safety region is primarily responsible, that the Inspectorate found the plans largely compliant with rules while uncertainties remain to be checked during implementation, and that the region acted in line with the motion on closing posts.
I trust that the board, in addition to the steps already taken, which the inspectorate judges positively, will take additional measures to prevent a situation like the one in Breskens.

Ik vertrouw erop dat het bestuur naast de reeds gezette stappen, waarover de inspectie positief oordeelt, aanvullende maatregelen neemt om een situatie zoals zich in Breskens heeft voorgedaan te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van loverboys op kosten van de belastingbetaler geholpen kunnen worden in Turkije

The MP Kooiman asks the State Secretary about a private youth care provider in Turkey (Turkijezorg) that reportedly treats Dutch children with psychological problems and loverboy victims at public expense, raising questions about inspection, quality standards, contracting by municipalities, and registration. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for youth care, that the Youth Inspectorate cannot supervise providers operating outside municipal responsibility, that no children are currently being treated, and that domestic care is preferred, while leaving some questions unknown.
These quality requirements cannot be checked or enforced by a Dutch inspectorate in another country.
Deze kwaliteitseisen kunnen niet door een Nederlandse inspectie in een ander land worden gecontroleerd of afgedwongen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over misstanden in de vrouwenopvang in Heemskerk

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about alleged abuses (exploitation, hygiene, intimidation, prostitution) at a women's shelter in Heemskerk, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should investigate and whether the problems extend to other regions. The State Secretary answered that the responsible alderman and the operator are handling the signals, the Inspectorate had no role since the signals did not concern working conditions, the operator being the commissioner of the inquiry does not per se undermine independence, and the ministry passed on signals it received while the responsible municipalities supervise the shelters.
It is not directly for me to judge whether the alleged abuses have been sufficiently investigated in this way.
Het is niet direct aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de vraag of de vermeende misstanden op deze wijze voldoende onderzocht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over Brabantse veroordeelden die vrij rondlopen

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked about reports that about 1,600 convicted persons in Brabant walk free, and about how many outstanding prison sentences are actively sought and why the 120-day threshold applies. The Staatssecretaris agreed the situation is undesirable, reported 2,843 outstanding sentences subject to active search and about 10,000 not pursued actively due to likely foreign residence, and outlined investment in information sharing and fast-track sentencing.
I agree with you that this is an undesirable situation.
Ik ben het met u eens dat dat een onwenselijke situatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de verkeersboetes in Nederland te hoog zijn

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether traffic fines raised in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were too high after a court ruling, why he did not intervene despite police criticism, and whether fines will only be raised to improve road safety and refunds given. The minister disagreed that the increases were excessive, said the Wahv sets only procedural requirements, argued fines deter offences, and stated the ruling has no consequences for fines or the 2016 budget.
I do not agree with the finding that the fine increases in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were too high.
Ik ben het niet eens met het oordeel dat er in 2008, 2011 en 2012 te hoge boeteverhogingen zijn doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie meer aandacht moet hebben voor stalkingszaken

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the police handle stalking cases, including capacity, expertise, the ZSM fast-track procedure, specialised prosecutors and central registration. The Minister answered that prioritisation and case-screening, cooperation with Veilig Thuis, a police work-process pilot in 2016 and existing specialised prosecutors are in place, while stalking is not always registered in a uniform way.
No new guideline is being developed. The police are, however, working on improving the stalking work process.
Er wordt niet gewerkt aan een nieuwe richtlijn. De politie werkt wel aan het verbeteren van het werkproces Stalking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat opsporingsdiensten witwasdossiers laten liggen

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that money-laundering case files are left unprocessed by investigative services, asking about FIU cooperation, reasons for not investigating signals, and capacity. The minister answered that FIU reports are not equal to case files, that signals are continuously weighed with the OM, that the FIU receives no feedback from the Belastingdienst, and that capacity is considered sufficient with time allocated to money laundering rising.
A suspicious transaction that FIU-Nederland passes on to an enforcement or investigative body cannot be equated with a money-laundering case file.
Een verdachte transactie die FIU-Nederland doorgeeft aan een handhavings- of opsporingsinstantie kan niet gelijk gesteld worden aan een witwasdossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat aangerande vrouwen vinden dat hulp politie tekort schiet

An MP asks the Justice Minister whether police response to sexual assault victims is too slow, including delays before contact by the sex crimes unit, the practice of not talking to suspects when no case is opened, and referral to sexual violence centres. The minister explains the 7-day target for the informative conversation, the criteria for talking to suspects, and that temporary funding will support a nationwide network of sexual violence centres.
The informative conversation is held within 7 days unless this is not possible for the reporter.
Het informatief gesprek wordt binnen 7 dagen gevoerd tenzij dit voor melder niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de pilots zelfredzaamheid gedetineerden

An MP asked the State Secretary about the evaluation of pilots giving prisoners more self-reliance and staff more self-direction, which projects are continuing or stopped, and whether successful projects like Dutch Celldogs and self-cooking will continue. The State Secretary responded that the pilots are promising, that projects are generally not stopped but considered for further development, that Bad Boys Brand is stopped for marketing reasons while self-cooking has a future where facilities allow.
These projects are in principle not stopped; it is being considered whether they can be further developed and rolled out, whether or not within other prison institutions.
Deze projecten worden in beginsel niet stopgezet, bezien wordt of deze verder kunnen worden ontwikkeld en uitgerold – al dan niet binnen andere PI’s.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen, Oskam, Swinkels en Van Der Staaij over de geruchten dat er extra geld vrijkomt om de gaten in de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie te dichten en de door de bezuin

MPs from SP, CDA, D66 and SGP asked whether extra money is available for the Justice and Security budget for 2016, how it would be allocated across police, prosecution, judiciary, forensics, probation and prisons, and whether it should be decoupled from the Eerste Kamer risk on fee and legal aid measures. The answer refers the MPs to the government's budget letter for the 2016 Justice and Security budget (Kamerstuk 34 300 VI, nr. 23) rather than answering each question directly.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (both SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) and Van Der Staaij (SGP) have been answered by way of the letter 'Draft budget 2016 Security and Justice'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen (beiden SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) en Van Der Staaij (SGP) Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z21968 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Ontwerpbegroting 2016 Veiligheid en Justitie»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over schiettraining van politieagenten

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice how many hours of shooting training police officers receive in initial and post-initial training, whether the four two-hour blocks per year are sufficient, and what will be done to expand laser-based training pilots. The minister answered that recruits get 38 shooting hours in year one and 14 in later years, that post-initial officers get eight live-fire hours per year, that this is considered sufficient, and that the Integrale Beroepsvaardigheidstraining review will examine on-the-job training options.
The eight hours of live-fire shooting training, supplemented by practice-oriented shooting exercises, have proven sufficient to maintain shooting proficiency.
De acht uren schiettraining met scherp, aangevuld met de praktijkgerichte (schiet)oefeningen blijken voldoende te zijn om de schietvaardigheid te onderhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over de steekpartij in PI Zoetermeer

MPs Volp and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about a fatal stabbing of an 82-year-old inmate in the Zoetermeer prison, including how the suspect obtained a weapon, prior inspections and staffing, and whether the incident was preventable. The State Secretary answered that investigations are ongoing and an internal security review has produced recommendations to be implemented, denied receiving signals of unsafe conditions, said staffing was fully on strength, and promised to inform parliament if structural shortcomings are found.
If the research results show that the incident is attributable to structural shortcomings at PI Haaglanden, location Zoetermeer, I will of course inform you about this.
Indien uit de onderzoeksresultaten blijkt dat het incident is toe te schrijven aan structurele tekortkomingen in PI Haaglanden, locatie Zoetermeer, zal ik u hierover uiteraard informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over de balans tussen veiligheid en rechtsstaat

Three SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the balance between security and the rule of law has tipped toward security, how he would restore it given budget cuts, and whether the police should return to the Ministry of the Interior. The minister denied any tipping, pointed to intensifications, and declined to change the police's ministerial placement, saying a future cabinet could decide that.
The cabinet sees no reason to anticipate this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hierop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het splitsen van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie om de rechtsstatelijke taak en de veiligheidstaak weer uit elkaar te halen

SP MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Interior whether he would support splitting the Ministry of Security and Justice into separate rule-of-law and security tasks, including moving the national police back to the Interior Ministry, and whether preparations should start now. The minister replied that the previous cabinet placed political responsibility for police management with the Justice and Security Minister, the current cabinet kept that choice, and any future change is a matter for the next cabinet formation, so it sees no reason to anticipate.
The cabinet sees no reason to anticipate this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hierop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Kooiman betreffende de problemen die kinderen ondervinden met het volgen van onderwijs na een plaatsing in een residentiële jeugdzorgvoorziening

MPs Siderius and Kooiman asked why pupils placed in residential youth care often cannot return to their home school, whether schools tied to nationally operating care institutions bear the school duty of care, and how onderwijs and care placements can be better aligned. The State Secretary says the receiving school has the duty of care, outlines transition rules and a Variawet exemption for short stays, rejects per-place funding, and promises a separate letter on education outside school premises.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘politie nam in 2,5 jaar 24.000 vuurwapens in beslag’

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police seized 24,000 firearms in 2.5 years, and whether illegal arms trafficking networks and police capacity are adequately tackled. The minister confirmed the correct figure is about 11,500 firearms, provided a breakdown of seizures by category, said he does not hold European seizure data, and described measures against illegal arms trafficking while denying that police capacity is insufficient.
I do not have these figures.
Ik beschik niet over deze cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de grote problemen in de (specialistische) jeugdpsychiatrie

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about problems in specialist youth psychiatry after the transfer of youth care to municipalities, covering costs, free choice of doctor, continuity at age 18, administration burden, unpaid invoices, waiting times in neighbourhood teams, privacy and access for children from less affluent families. The government answers that the transfer rules allow free choice via contracts or personal budgets, that municipalities are responsible for local problems, and that it will monitor and research them further.
It is a municipal responsibility to solve local problems in matching demand and supply.
Het is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid om lokale problemen in de aansluiting van vraag en aanbod op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van loverboys niet de noodzakelijke hulp krijgen

An SP MP asked whether loverboy victims in the Rotterdam region are not getting the specialist help they need, after Fier Fryslân reported falling referrals. The Secretary of State answered that financial arrangements under the Jeugdwet and Wmo 2015 designate specialist providers, that causes of the fall are unclear and under review with Rotterdam and the VNG, and that a quality framework and further talks with the VNG are planned.
To clarify what is going on, both the municipality of Rotterdam and Fier Fryslân are looking into this matter.
Om helder te krijgen wat er aan de hand is buigen zowel gemeente Rotterdam als Fier Fryslân zich over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Volp en Bergkamp over het bericht dat personeel monddood wordt gemaakt in de vrouwenopvang

MPs Kooiman, Volp and Bergkamp asked whether staff at a women's shelter in Heemskerk were being silenced, whether the shelter was unsafe for staff and clients, and whether fewer and lower-qualified staff now work there. The State Secretary replied that responsibility lies with the municipality of Haarlem and the operator, that a 2014 Labour Inspectorate visit found no violations, and that a GGD emergency inspection, an improvement plan and an independent investigation are underway, with results promised for November.
The personnel policy of the Heemskerk women's shelter is primarily a matter for the employer and the municipality of Haarlem.
Het personeelsbeleid van de vrouwenopvang Heemskerk is primair een zaak van de werkgever en de gemeente Haarlem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over benodigdheden voor hennepteelt door de overheid aangeboden op een veiling

MPs Volp and Kooiman asked whether the government offered hemp-cultivation equipment seized under the Opium Act on a public auction site, and whether it is wrong that businesses cannot sell the same goods. The minister answered that he disagrees the listing was a mistake, refers to earlier answers for the remaining questions, and says re-use cannot be excluded but the legal test is whether the seller knew or had serious reason to suspect professional cultivation use.
I refer you to my answers to the written questions from Member Berndsen-Jansen (D66) of your House.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het sluiten van tbs-klinieken voor agressie en frustratie zorgt

The SP MP Kooiman asks the State Secretary about lawyers' concerns that closing forensic psychiatric clinics and relocating about 370 TBS patients harms resocialisation, including lost leave permits, delayed treatment and differing judicial practice. The State Secretary answers that relocations are necessary to avoid empty capacity, that leave permits are reissued through an expedited procedure, that about 5% of patients are normally transferred, and that an evaluation will follow.
After the approximately 370 relocations, an evaluation will be carried out that also takes into account their effect on treatment and resocialisation.
Na afloop van de ongeveer 370 overplaatsingen wordt een evaluatie verricht, waarin ook het effect hiervan op de behandeling en resocialisatie wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorg zorgboerderij Hoge Aard in Molenschot ongemoeid laat

MPs Bergkamp and Kooiman asked the State Secretary about media reports that youth care authorities left care farm Hoge Aard in Molenschot alone despite allegations of poor care and mistreatment of residents. The State Secretary said he was seriously concerned, that the inspectorates have conducted several supervisory activities since 2014, that they will continue the investigation jointly and inform the House of the results, and referred the remaining questions to a separate letter to the House.
The IGZ and IJZ will jointly continue the investigation.
De IGZ en IJZ zullen gezamenlijk het onderzoek voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de slechte bereikbaarheid en gebrekkige kennis van de politie te water

MPs Kooiman and Bashir asked why water-police calls are poorly handled, why police officers without shipping expertise are deployed on water, and whether the abolished Deelorgaan Binnenvaart should be reinstated. The minister says the national service line is professional, the Landelijke Eenheid has invited shipping association ASV to discuss its complaints, the integrated Dienst Infrastructuur is designed to add capacity and knowledge, existing consultation forums exist, and no reinstatement is needed because the function is secured in current law.
The National Unit of the police has invited shipping association ASV to a meeting to gain more clarity about the problems it raised
De Landelijke Eenheid van de politie heeft de schippersverenging ASV uitgenodigd voor een gesprek om meer duidelijkheid te krijgen over de door haar genoemde problemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman en Ulenbelt over onveiligheid en beroepsziekten bij de brandweer

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on a broadcast reporting that about 130 fire stations fail safety requirements and that occupational cancer risks among firefighters are poorly monitored. The minister answered that the safety regions as employers are responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has given them six months to remedy shortcomings, and that a national 'clean work' guideline and further research are underway, while further action rests with the regions.
The Labour Inspectorate has given the safety regions 6 months to remedy the shortcomings.
De Inspectie SZW heeft de veiligheidsregio’s 6 maanden de tijd gegeven om de tekortkomingen op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de schiettraining van politieagenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police firearms training hours, comparing them unfavourably with civilian gun-permit requirements, and asked about laser-based training. The minister gave hours figures, said the comparison is not apt, pointed to CAO negotiations and IBT renewal, and said the laser pilot will be evaluated before any decision on expansion.
The pilot will be evaluated, after which the desirability of a possible follow-up will be considered.
De pilot wordt geëvalueerd waarna de wenselijkheid van een eventueel vervolg zal worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht “Politie die drugslabs ontruimde ‘onverantwoord’ ingezet”

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police dismantling drug labs were overworked and exposed to dangerous conditions, and whether leadership knew and why the Inspectorate's report was not published. The minister acknowledged high workload, cited doubled LFO capacity, tightened deployment criteria and stricter Arbeidstijdenwet compliance, and explained that individual inspection reports are not published, only aggregate factsheets.
Individual fine reports are not published by the Inspectorate.
Individuele boeterapporten worden door de Inspectie niet gepubliceerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat gemeenten in Gelderland 1,1 miljoen euro willen investeren in een ondersteuningsbureau dat de inkoop van jeugdzorg en uitvoering van de Wet maats

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the state secretary about seven Gelderland municipalities investing 1.1 million euro in a regional procurement support bureau for youth care and Wmo, questioning overhead costs and whether residents get the care they need. The state secretary replied that the investment is about 1% of the 108 million euro budget, that municipalities are responsible for organising execution, and that statutory safeguards and supervisory powers exist, though no national data on transaction costs are available.
The way municipalities organise the implementation of the Wmo 2015 and the Youth Act is the responsibility of the municipalities.
De wijze waarop gemeenten de uitvoering van de Wmo 2015 en de Jeugdwet organiseren, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er een aanmeldstop is bij een jeugd-GGZ praktijk

An MP asked the state secretaries about a reported intake stop at a youth mental health practice in Den Bosch, allegedly caused by budget cuts, and what would be done for affected children and whether other municipalities face similar stops. The government replied that the 20% cut claim is incorrect (3% macro cut for 2015), that municipalities are responsible for providing youth care and for dealing with budget exhaustion, that Den Bosch is in talks with the provider, and that national monitoring does not separately track such stops, while declining to answer before the scheduled debate.
It is up to municipalities to ensure that all children who need youth care receive it.
Het is aan gemeenten om ervoor te zorgen dat alle kinderen die jeugdhulp nodig hebben, deze krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de zorgelijke berichten over de zorg van “hulporganisatie” stichting Stoploverboys.nu

An SP MP asked whether the private foundation Stoploverboys.nu, which provides shelter and care to young loverboy victims with possibly unqualified staff, is acceptable and what oversight exists. The government answered that the foundation is not a legally recognised youth care provider, so the Inspectie Jeugdzorg has no supervisory power over it, and that the municipality has no subsidy relation with it, while a draft law on youth residences would bring such facilities under municipal supervision.
As we indicated above, the Inspectie Jeugdzorg currently cannot take any steps against private care providers such as the foundation Stoploverboys.nu.
Zoals wij hierboven reeds aangaven kan de Inspectie Jeugdzorg op dit moment geen stappen ondernemen tegen particuliere zorgaanbieders, zoals de stichting Stoploverboys.nu.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat oud-cliënten van Boriz BV onder druk worden gezet om hun klachten in te trekken

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked about reports that Boriz BV pressured former clients to withdraw complaints, whether housing tied to care is acceptable, what happens to clients' rights, and whether the board structure complies with the WNT pay law. The State Secretary condemned such pressure, pointed to a Menzis investigation, said clients can switch care providers, and asked the CIBG to investigate the missing WNT reporting in Boriz's 2014 accounts.
I have asked the CIBG, as the responsible supervisory body, to carry out further investigation.
Ik heb het CIBG, als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder, verzocht nader onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut over misstanden in de vrouwenopvang

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about reported abuses and poor living conditions in a women's shelter in Heemskerk, including hygiene problems, prostitution, intimidation, financial hardship and weak guidance, and asked for independent inquiry and permanent control. The State Secretary said a GGD emergency inspection found inadequate cleaning, Haarlem did not declare the location unfit, an improvement plan and an independent inquiry by J. Haanstra (results expected November) were launched, and that toezicht and shelter quality are the responsibility of centrumgemeenten, so no separate national investigation was ordered.
Before the results of this investigation are available, expected in November of this year, I refrain from giving a substantive judgment on this matter.
Voordat de resultaten van dit onderzoek beschikbaar zijn, naar verwachting in november van dit jaar, onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijk oordeel over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het artikel ‘De 7 plagen van het ministerie van Veiligheid & Justitie’

The SP MPs Van Nispen, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to react to a NRC article describing dysfunction at the ministry, including image management and weak business operations. The minister disputes the article's characterisations, says the ministry manages its operations well and is open and transparent, and promises separate answers and reference to the Oosting inquiry.
I do not recognise the claim in the article that problems are taboo or that we operate in a hostile environment.
Ik herken mij bijvoorbeeld niet in de bewering in het artikel dat problemen «taboe» zijn of dat we in een «vijandige omgeving» opereren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat er een opnamestop is voor dagbesteding en jeugd-ggz

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about reports of an admission stop for day care and youth mental health care, including at farm-based care providers in Leeuwarden. The secretary answered that no admission stop applies to Leeuwarden's municipalities, that a single provider (Bezinn) imposed one unilaterally, that municipalities are responsible for securing youth care and handling waiting lists, and that the wait-list figures are not separately monitored.
Waiting-time information is not a separate part of the national monitoring of youth care use.
Wachttijdinformatie maakt niet apart deel uit van de landelijke monitoring van het jeugdhulpgebruik.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het verzoek aan gemeenten om de pgb-herindicaties (persoonsgebonden budgetten) voor 1 oktober a.s. af te ronden, en aan te leveren bij de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked why municipalities were asked to deliver revised PGB re-assessment decisions to the SVB by 1 October 2015, whether this deadline was brought forward and whether it risks careless or erroneous re-assessments. The State Secretary answers that no deadline was advanced, that the request aimed at planning for the budget holder and SVB steps, that municipalities can extend budgets to 1 May 2016 if they need more time, and that the chain director will actively monitor progress.
There is no question of deadlines being brought forward.
Er is geen sprake van het vervroegen van deadlines.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat slachtoffers van geweld te lang moeten wachten op hulp in Gelderland

MPs Kooiman asked the State Secretaries about reports that victims of domestic violence in Gelderland face long waits before Veilig Thuis reports are handled, and about the rise in reports nationwide. The government answers that Gelderland Zuid has added temporary staff and that municipalities are responsible for addressing delays, with no extra budget planned and a review of the situation expected by end of year.
It is undesirable that victims of domestic violence have to wait too long before the Veilig Thuis organisation takes up the report.
Het is onwenselijk dat slachtoffers van geweld in huiselijke kring te lang moeten wachten voordat de Veilig Thuis-organisatie (VT-organisatie) de melding in behandeling neemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Kooiman over benodigdheden voor hennepteelt door de overheid aangeboden op een veiling

MPs Rebel and Kooiman asked whether the government was wrong to offer hemp-cultivation equipment seized from growers for sale on an auction site, whether such items could still be used for cultivation, and what criteria the Dienst Domeinen applies. The Minister refers to earlier answers to MP Berndsen-Jansen and does not answer the questions on substance, while confirming that the items were offered.
I refer to my answers to the written questions from MP Berndsen-Jansen (D66) of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen (D66) van uw Kamer
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en VanNispen (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «OM trekt verklaring over dode arrestant in» (ingezonden 1 juli 2015).

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service retracted its statement that a man who died after an arrest became unwell during transport, whether it had a basis for that claim, and whether video footage exists and is known to the OM and Rijksrecherche. The minister said the Rijksrecherche will investigate all events from the first report to the death, that he will await its results before commenting on the OM's statements, that the investigation will take months, and described police first-aid training.
The Rijksrecherche will investigate in this case all events from the first report up to and including the death.
De Rijksrecherche zal in deze zaak alle gebeurtenissen vanaf de eerste melding tot en met het overlijden onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het dragen van gevaarlijke laserpennen niet verboden is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether dangerous high-powered laser pointers should be banned or more actively enforced, including customs seizures, NVWA action against foreign web shops, police capacity and the risk of unknowing misuse. The minister answered that existing rules under the Warenwet, Wet wapens en munitie and Criminal Code are sufficient, gave seizure and enforcement figures, and declined further research.
I consider the current legal instruments adequate and see no reason to conduct research.
Ik acht het huidig wettig instrumentarium afdoende en zie geen aanleiding voor het verrichten van onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de 10-jarige Sem niet bij de gemeente Stadskanaal en niet bij het Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg (CIZ) in aanmerking komt voor een indicatie voor zorg en onders

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked why 10-year-old Sem, who has epilepsy and autism, could not obtain care indication from either his municipality or the CIZ, and how many people fall into such gaps. The State Secretary admits the municipality should have taken over responsibility earlier, says it will now do so retroactively, and promises information sessions, but refuses to confirm any general figures or a systemic link between the Wmo and Wlz and offers only partial data.
It took too long before it became clear that the municipality is responsible under the Youth Act for Sem's care.
Het heeft te lang geduurd voordat duidelijk is geworden dat de gemeente op grond van de Jeugdwet verantwoordelijk is voor de zorg voor Sem
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de kritiek op de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about criticism that the Certificate of Conduct (VOG) is too strict, covering refusal statistics, appeal duration and costs, the four-year lookback period, the role of Justis and probation advice, and the promised vision on screening. The State Secretary rejects the claim of rigidity, gives statistics showing a low refusal rate, defends the four-year lookback period, and says the vision on screening will be sent to parliament this autumn.
I do not consider it appropriate to address individual cases in public, and therefore not the examples that came up in the Radio1 programme.
Ik vind het niet passend om in het openbaar in te gaan op individuele zaken, dus ook niet op de voorbeelden zoals die naar voren zijn gekomen in het programma van Radio1.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jeugdzorg een strop dreigt te worden voor Friese gemeenten

MP Kooiman asks whether youth care costs threaten to leave Frisian municipalities short of funds, what the consequences are for children and families, and whether shortfalls and waiting lists are being monitored. The State Secretary answers that municipalities hold the youth care duty since 2015, that Leeuwarden reports possible shortfalls for some Frisian municipalities but no signs the duty is not being met, and that waiting-time data are not part of national monitoring, with oversight left to municipal councils.
It is up to the municipal council to assess whether the municipal executive's conduct is correct.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om te beoordelen of de handelwijze van het gemeentebestuur juist is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat een dj zelf zijn gestolen apparatuur via Marktplaats terughaalt

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police advising a DJ to arrange with the seller himself the return of stolen equipment via Marktplaats was desirable given the victim's risks, and who is responsible for evidence gathering. The minister answered that police, with the victim's help, chose this route given the case situation, that three suspects were arrested, and declined to judge the desirability while the case is before court; evidence gathering lies with police and prosecution.
As long as this case is still before the court, I refrain from judging the desirability of the course of events.
Zolang deze zaak nog onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van een oordeel over de wenselijkheid van de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op penitentiaire bibliotheken

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the planned closure of physical prison libraries, including whether the works council was consulted, the state of the digital reading project, who will support digital reading, its costs, and the savings. The State Secretary answers that a works council advice request has been sent but no advice yet, that physical libraries will close only after the ZBJ digital system is implemented around 2016-2017, that costs are not yet known, and that the savings are EUR 2.4 million per year.
I cannot yet provide your House with information on the costs of digital reading, because no contracts have yet been concluded with suppliers.
Ik kan uw Kamer nog geen informatie verschaffen over de kosten van digitaal lezen, omdat er nog geen contracten zijn gesloten met leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over plankzaken bij de politie door drukte bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to reports that police cases are shelved because the Netherlands Forensic Institute is overloaded, and whether the service level agreement is exhausted. The minister answered that demand always exceeds NFI capacity, that the SLA is not exhausted over the year, that monthly overruns can be carried over, and that unexhausted SLA does not show the number of shelved cases; he will discuss the issue with the LFO.
No conclusions about the number of shelved cases can be drawn from whether the SLA is exhausted or not.
Uit het al dan niet uitputten van de SLA kunnen geen conclusies over het aantal plankzaken worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de voorgestelde Voetbalwet en de mogelijkheden Nederlandse relschoppers te weren bij uitwedstrijden in het buitenland

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked whether the proposed football law and existing powers can stop Dutch hooligans from travelling to away matches abroad, and whether mayors should be given power to ban such supporters from away games. The minister answered that the proposal is creative but not simple, that existing tools (stadium bans, reporting duties, area bans under the amended Penal Code) already reach abroad, and that the pending bill should proceed without waiting for the mayoral proposal.

I am of the opinion that the handling of the bill on tightening measures against football vandalism and serious nuisance should not wait for that; the powers contained therein must become available as soon as possible.

Ik ben van oordeel dat de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel Aanscherping maatregelen ter bestrijding van voetbalvandalisme en ernstige overlast daarop niet moet wachten; de bevoegdheden die daarin zijn opgenomen, moeten nu zo spoedig mogelijk beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de conclusie van wetenschappers dat Utrecht faalde met het sluiten van de prostitutieramen

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about research concluding that closing Utrecht's Zandpad brothel windows harmed sex workers, and what lessons, alternatives, monitoring and support should follow. The minister replied that the local authority is responsible for prostitution policy, pointed to the national prostitution programme and anti-trafficking tools for municipalities, and said monitoring individual sex workers is not a government task because it would seriously harm their privacy, while promising to study the full publication once released.
Monitoring and tracking prostitutes when there are no signals of human trafficking is not a government task and would seriously harm the privacy of prostitutes.
Het monitoren en volgen van prostituees als er geen signalen zijn van mensenhandel is geen taak van de overheid en zou de privacy van prostituees ernstig schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat drugsafval het riool overspoelt

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Environment ministers about drug waste dumped into sewers and on land, including incident counts, lab takedowns, enforcement capacity, prevention, BOA safety and who pays the cleanup costs. The government answered that no national dumping figures are kept, cited 24 lab takedowns and doubled LFO capacity, said the polluter should bear costs, and pointed to a one-million-euro amendment-funded contribution and a Brabant cleanup protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de jeugd-ggz in Almere geen behandeling meer kan bieden omdat het geld bij de gemeente op is

MP Kooiman asked the Minister about a youth mental health provider in Almere halting intake because the 2015 budget was spent, including parents' letters, data on waiting lists and other municipalities, and whether the municipality's one-month promise was realistic. The State Secretary replied that municipalities are legally responsible for youth care under the Jeugdwet, that the municipality is working with the provider, that national monitoring does not track waiting times, and that there is no reason to hold municipalities to account now.
It is up to municipalities to ensure that all children who need youth care receive it.
Het is aan gemeenten om ervoor te zorgen dat alle kinderen die jeugdhulp nodig hebben, deze krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over tbs’ers die langer op de kamer zitten wegens bezuinigingen bij de Pompekliniek

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about longer cell confinement of tbs patients at the Pompe clinic, attributed to budget cuts and staff shortages, and about leave arrangements, staffing, and the clinic's debt. The State Secretary answered that the clinic's measures are internal, comply with legal quality requirements, the Inspectorate oversees the clinic, and no ministerial budget cuts were imposed, while declining to reverse the measures.
This does not fall within my powers.
Dit hoort niet tot mijn bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de gemeentelijke plannen om wietteelt te reguleren en andere vragen ten aanzien van het Nederlands drugsbeleid

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about seizure and import figures for drugs, electricity theft by cannabis growers, coffeeshop turnover, drug harm rankings, illegal distilleries, public support for regulated cannabis cultivation, and a Groningen court ruling on home growers. The minister answered that most figures are not kept or are unavailable because the trade is illegal or the tax data cannot be broken down, gave harm rankings from RIVM and European research, and declined to comment on the pending appeal.
The import of soft and hard drugs concerns an illegal market that operates in secret. No overviews of this are available.
De import van soft- en harddrugs betreft een illegale markt, die zich in het verborgene afspeelt. Hiervan zijn geen overzichten beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Schouw over het bericht dat veel mensen in de problemen komen na zinloze gijzeling vanwege verkeersboetes

MPs Kooiman and Schouw asked the State Secretary about reports that people face serious problems after pointless imprisonment for traffic fines, including the legal basis for payment arrangements and for coercive detention. The State Secretary answered that a legal basis is needed for instalment payments, that an interim measure is planned from 1 July 2015, that a new model for detention requests is in use, and gave 2013 and 2014 figures on detention requests and orders.
The starting point is that a detention request is only submitted if there is no indication that the person concerned cannot pay the sanction.
Het uitgangspunt is dat alleen een vordering gijzeling wordt ingediend indien er geen indicatie is dat de betrokken persoon de sanctie niet kan betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Tongeren over de wachttijd tussen tbs met voorwaarden en tbs met dwangverpleging

MPs Kooiman and Van Tongeren asked whether tbs patients whose probation-based treatment is converted to compulsory treatment can be left without care during the pending conversion procedure, using the case of C.R. The State Secretary acknowledged the conversion procedure took undesirably long, said the four-month maximum waiting-period rule does not apply to it, and pointed to Penitentiary Psychiatric Centres and planned preparation measures.
The so-called procedure for subsequent detention took undesirably long in this case.
De zogenoemde procedure tot alsnog verpleging heeft in deze casus onwenselijk lang geduurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer in Noord-Holland Noord alarm slaat omdat bezuinigingen ten koste gaan van de veiligheid

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that firefighters in Noord-Holland Noord raised alarm over budget cuts, including the number of cuts, dive team suspension and director salaries. The minister said the regional board is responsible for budgets and operations, pointed to public budgets and annual accounts, saw no need for a separate inspection of cuts, and noted the inspectorates found shortcomings in the dive teams.
The board of a safety region adopts the (multi-year) budget of the region.
Het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio stelt de (meerjaren)begroting van de regio vast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een tekort aan brandweervrijwilligers leidt tot onveilige situaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that shortages of volunteer firefighters create unsafe situations, and about regionalisation, post closures, bureaucracy and budget cuts. The minister answered that responsibility lies with the safety regions' boards, that most regions report no unsafe situations, and that regions have consulted volunteers through works councils and other bodies, while giving detailed figures per region.
It is the responsibility of the boards of the safety regions to ensure an adequate organisation of fire brigade services.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de besturen van de veiligheidsregio’s om zorg te dragen voor een adequate organisatie van de brandweerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het weigeren van verzekeringen aan mensen met een strafblad

An SP MP asked whether refusing car insurance, or charging higher premiums, to people with a criminal record is legitimate and whether the government will discuss a solution with insurers' association Verbond van Verzekeraars. The minister defended the insurer's right to assess risk and asserted that few ex-offenders face problems, so no talks are planned.
The Verbond van Verzekeraars indicates that there are few or no complaints or reports on this issue.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars geeft aan dat er op het gebied van deze kwestie weinig tot geen klachten of meldingen binnenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over misdaadgeld en de werkelijkheid van voordeelsontneming

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a study claiming asset confiscation mainly targets petty offenders, and why reported confiscation figures differ from the study's data. The minister rejected the 'petty offenders' characterisation, explained the scope and data limits, and described the investment and capacity expansion in the enforcement chain.
The picture that mainly smaller cases are confiscated, I consider incomplete in light of the foregoing.
Het beeld dat voornamelijk in de kleinere zaken wordt afgepakt, vind ik gezien het voorgaande onvolledig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het dragen van gevaarlijk krachtige laserpennen niet verboden is

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a broadcast showing high-powered laser pointers causing eye injuries, whether police, prosecutors and the NVWA are acting and have enough tools, and whether the carrying of such pens should be banned. The minister said the existing legal framework is sufficient, that no national figures on laser-pen incidents exist, that the NVWA supervises sales within the Netherlands but not possession or online sales from abroad, and declined to extend the weapons research or add a ban.
Currently there is therefore no national overview available of the number of incidents involving laser pens.
Momenteel is er dan ook geen landelijk overzicht beschikbaar van het aantal incidenten met laserpennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie steeds vaker te maken krijgt met verwarde en overspannen mensen

Two MPs asked whether rising police contact with confused persons reflects cuts to psychiatric beds, and about notifications from ministries and municipalities. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, that no notifications from other ministries or municipalities were received, and that the bed reduction was not meant as savings and a misunderstanding about GGZ cuts exists.

As already announced, consultation will be held with the chain partners involved, focusing on relieving the police and identifying bottlenecks and improvements regarding confused persons on the street.

Zoals reeds aangekondigd zal overleg gevoerd worden met de bij het onderwerp betrokken ketenpartners, waarin zowel aandacht zal zijn voor het ontlasten van de politie als voor het inventariseren van knelpunten en het aandragen van verbeteringen met betrekking tot de verwarde personen op straat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over ongevallen met voorrangsvoertuigen van de politie, brandweer en ambulance

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about accidents involving emergency vehicles of police, fire and ambulance services, citing reports on accident rates, prevention, traffic-light priority and training. The Minister said a pilot allowing on-road training with sirens was evaluated positively and made permanent, explained differences in accident rates, pointed to prevention work, and stated there was insufficient Dutch data on traffic-light influence.
From 1 April 2015 a permanent exemption has been granted for giving driving instruction on public roads in operating an emergency vehicle with optical and audible signals.
Met ingang van 1 april 2015 is een permanente vrijstelling verleend voor het op de openbare weg geven van rijonderricht in het besturen van een voorrangsvoertuig met optische en geluidssignalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Wanbetalers niet meer de cel in'

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about reports that judges find the Public Prosecution Service too quick to seek imprisonment (gijzeling) of people who cannot pay fines. The state secretary responded that new procedures will require motivation of ability to pay, that data on requests and refusals are limited, and that the government will monitor the effects before deciding on further measures.
The Public Prosecution Service and the CJIB in some cases have a full picture of the debtor's financial situation, but in many cases they do not.
Het OM en het CJIB beschikken in sommige gevallen over een volledig beeld van de financiële situatie van betrokkene, maar in veel gevallen ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de minister de feiten over wietteelt verdraaide

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister whether he will act on reports that he distorted facts about cannabis cultivation (suppressing unwelcome research, selective conclusions, steering questions) and on the lack of clear export figures, and whether a new independent study on regulated cultivation will be commissioned. The minister denies the allegations, refers to an earlier letter, says export figures carry uncertainty but most Dutch cannabis is likely exported, and sees no reason for a new study since research is independent and fully shared with parliament.
I do not recognise myself in these signals.
Ik herken mij niet in deze signalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat vrijwilligers ingezet worden in gezinnen die een maatregel opgelegd hebben gekregen van de kinderrechter

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether volunteers deployed in families under a court-ordered child protection measure is responsible, whether they can replace professionals and be effective, and whether child safety is guaranteed. The state secretary replied that the youth-care law and quality framework allow municipalities to use volunteers as a supplement under the lead of the child protection worker, that the matter is a decentralised responsibility, and that the existing legal safeguards suffice.
I do not intend to intervene in this decentralised responsibility. The aforementioned legal safeguards are sufficient.
Ik ben niet voornemens in deze decentrale verantwoordelijkheid te treden. De eerdergenoemde wettelijke waarborgen volstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de rol van de ondernemingsraden bij de beslissing tot het sluiten van politieposten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the role of police works councils in closing police posts under the housing plan, including whether their agreement is needed before the plan is implemented. The minister replied that the plan is a political decision falling under the works council's exemption from advisory rights, that the works council only has advisory rights on personnel consequences, and that the central works council has requested an extension and has not yet advised.
The works council will also be involved in the further decision-making on implementing the housing plan.
De medezeggenschap zal ook betrokken worden bij de nadere besluitvorming in de uitvoering van het huisvestingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de aanwas van gespecialiseerde agenten stokt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reducing operational strength just means aligning police staffing with the formation plan, and asked for training and deployment figures for specialist police roles. The minister said formation and staffing are being balanced to a affordable operational strength of 49,500 fte, gave training reservation and enrolment figures for specialist courses, and promised to report on financial and cybercrime specialists through the Veiligheidsagenda.
On the realisation of the intake targets for specialists in financial and cybercrime, I will report to your House as agreed, within the framework of the Security Agenda.
Over de realisatie van de doelstellingen voor de instroom van specialisten op het gebied van finec en cybercrime zal ik uw Kamer conform afspraak rapporteren in het kader van de Veiligheidsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘CBP: doorbreking geheimhoudingsplicht Jeugdwet niet goed geregeld’ (CBP: College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens)

An MP asked whether the Youth Act lacks a clear basis for youth care providers to share client data with municipalities for financing and control, following a Dutch privacy regulator warning. The state secretary replied that the Act already provides a basis for such data sharing for access to youth care, that the rules will be further specified in a pending bill, and that privacy is adequately safeguarded with no actual risk.
The care for and privacy of individual clients is not endangered as a result of the legislation and the actions described above.
De zorg voor en de privacy van individuele cliënten loopt geen gevaar als gevolg van de wetgeving en de hiervoor beschreven acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht ‘De jeugdwet, het CBS en… privacy’

MP Kooiman asks the State Secretaries about reports that CBS will receive individual, potentially identifiable youth care data under the Jeugdwet, raising privacy, professional secrecy and administrative burden concerns. The government replies that CBS pseudonymises the BSN immediately, publishes only non-identifiable aggregates, that the data flow is legally mandated and reviewed in a PIA, and that professional secrecy is not breached, while declining to ask the CBP for a new opinion.
The system for policy information is organised so that no data traceable to individuals is published.
De systematiek van de beleidsinformatie is zodanig ingericht dat geen tot personen herleidbare gegevens worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat processen-verbaal het verdachtenverhoor niet goed weergeven

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister how to address research showing police interview reports (processen-verbaal) do not accurately reflect suspect interrogations, and whether judges and prosecutors are aware of these limits and can review recordings. The minister answered that legislation is being prepared to regulate interview reports, police and prosecution are improving report quality, audiovisual recordings remain a supplementary tool that judges can order played at trial, and the Inspectorate's ongoing study will determine whether further research is needed.
Audiovisual recording of interrogations cannot fully replace the written report and remains a tool that makes subsequent checking possible.
Audiovisuele vastlegging van verhoren kan daarvoor niet volledig in de plaats komen en blijft een hulpmiddel, waardoor controle achteraf mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de rellende Nederlanders in Rome

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Dutch fans rioting in Rome before the AS Roma-Feyenoord match, whether preventive measures and information exchange were sufficient, and whether fans with stadium bans could be prevented from travelling. The minister answered that European information channels were used, Dutch police spotters were present, the investigation is ongoing, and the pending bill on area bans is considered sufficient without additional measures.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover geen verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de onrust en onvrede onder de agenten die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de veiligheid op het spoor, de snelwegen en het water

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about unrest among police officers responsible for rail, motorway and water safety, including deployment of untrained staff and removal of 112 emergency calls from the national unit's control room. The Minister acknowledged the transition causes concern, defended cross-specialism deployment as more effective, and said the works council concerns will be discussed, without committing to restore old arrangements.
Supervised deployment fits my policy of promoting professional skill in and on the job.
Het begeleid optreden past in mijn beleid van het bevorderen van het vakmanschap in en op het werk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over de aanpak van synthetische drugs en georganiseerde misdaad

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the Minister of Security and Justice about tackling synthetic drugs and organised crime, including a generic ban on new precursor chemicals, extra investigative capacity in the south, RIEC case backlogs, NFI turnaround times, and protective clothing for police at drug labs. The minister answered that a generic ban would be too broad, that the Labour Inspectorate investigation is ongoing, and that protective gear is provided only to specialist LFO staff while Parliament will be informed by end of April.
The instrument of a generic criminalisation is therefore too coarse-meshed.
Het middel van een generieke strafbaarstelling is dus te grofmazig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de wens van forensisch rechercheurs om geen uniform te dragen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about forensic investigators' objections to wearing the new police uniform, including safety concerns about being unarmed and unable to act in emergencies, and asked why the duty to wear uniform was not dropped entirely. The minister acknowledged some concerns, said uniform wearing is not mandatory in situations where it hinders work, and stated the uniform is the standard for all police staff, with a final decision to follow after consultation with the corps leadership and works council.
Until that moment, wearing the uniform is not mandatory.
Tot dat moment is het dragen van het uniform niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het sluiten van politiebureaus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about closing police stations, including the number of new locations by type, maps, response times, mayors' views and opening hours. The minister answered that about 200 physical locations will no longer be needed by 2025, that changes will be gradual and agreed with local authorities, and that response times are not expected to be affected, though exact closure dates and opening hours are not yet fixed.
This situation will be worked towards gradually over the next ten years.
Naar deze situatie wordt de komende tien jaar geleidelijk toegewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de data van agenten niet goed beveiligd zijn

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the police handles reports that officers' personal data was insufficiently secured, including whether online login to systems holding such data was possible and why HR systems were outsourced to an external company. The minister replied that a second risk analysis led to two-factor authentication, that the system meets Wbp security requirements though no absolute guarantee exists, that no unauthorised access occurred, and that outsourcing does not change the korpschef's responsibility for data security.
It is in fact not correct that one could log in without security.
Het klopt overigens niet dat onbeveiligd kan worden ingelogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de inzetbare operationele sterkte bij de Nationale Politie

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice for yearly figures on national police funding, personnel costs, operational and non-operational strength, headcount and operational deployability (including and excluding trainees) for 2013 to 2021. The Minister answered with budget and annual-report figures for 2013 to 2019, noting that the police multi-year budget runs only to 2019, and gave the deployability percentages (trainees assumed 40% deployable).
Therefore, no data can currently be provided for the period after 2019.
Derhalve zijn er op dit moment nog geen gegevens te verstrekken voor de periode na 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de reflectoren op politieuniformen niet werken
