An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police uniform reflectors fail, whether officers must wear hi-vis vests in dangerous situations, and whether the uniform will be improved. The minister said the new uniform meets all design requirements, that the yellow stripes were never meant to be reflective, and that extra hi-vis gear is supplied for specific situations, so no change is planned.
The new uniform meets all the requirements set for the design.
Het nieuwe uniform voldoet aan alle bij het ontwerp gestelde eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Oskam en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Eerste stap naar vergunning voor gokbedrijven’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the Kansspelautoriteit's survey of interest in online gambling licences was justified, whether it should be halted before the bill passed, how many applications were expected, and how advertising violations by gambling firms were monitored and sanctioned. The State Secretary answered that the survey was the regulator's own decision to prepare for licensing, that he hoped licensing would be swift for consumer protection, that expected applications rested on a 2011 study and contacts with regulators, and that individual enforcement cases could not be disclosed to protect ongoing investigations.
Offering this possibility to interested parties for a licence was an independent decision of the gambling authority.
Het bieden van deze mogelijkheid aan geïnteresseerden voor een vergunning is een zelfstandige beslissing van de kansspelautoriteit geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat gevangenisbewaarders onder druk staan

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the State Secretary about a DJI staff satisfaction survey showing reduced feelings of safety, violence against staff, working-time law breaches, understaffing, sick leave, cell opening practice, management ratios and the 'stoplicht' promotion model. The State Secretary answered that the ISZW and staff survey reports would be responded to substantively in April, gave sick-leave and staffing figures and management ratios, and denied unrest about the stoplicht model.
At the General Consultation on the Prison Service of 22 January, the then State Secretary committed to giving Parliament a substantive response to both reports.

Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over het Gevangeniswezen van 22 januari jl. heeft de toenmalige Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie uw Kamer toegezegd een inhoudelijke reactie te geven op beide rapporten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de aanwas van gespecialiseerde agenten stokt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that recruitment of specialist police officers (sex crime investigators, marksmen, riot police, financial and cyber investigators) has stalled, and whether reducing operational strength is responsible. The minister answered that recruitment is deliberately restrained during the reorganisation to match the agreed formation, gave training numbers for 2011-2014, said no shortages were reported except in financial and cybercrime, and promised a progress report with a reorganisation completion date and a later update on postinitial training enrolment.
I will inform your House in the next progress report about the date on which the personnel reorganisation is expected to be completed.
Ik zal uw Kamer in de eerstkomende voortgangsrapportage informeren over de datum waarop de personele reorganisatie naar verwachting afgerond zal zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over reclame voor zware luchtdrukwapens

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about heavy air-pressure weapons being advertised, whether advertising should be discouraged, whether these weapons should move to a licensed category, and why they should not be banned in the meantime. The minister replied there is no specific advertising policy for such weapons, that a study of their classification and power limits is underway and will be reported to parliament, but that no ban is possible without changing the law first.
On 16 December 2014 I committed to conduct a study of (heavy) air-pressure weapons as soon as possible.
Op 16 december 2014 heb ik toegezegd zo snel mogelijk een onderzoek te zullen doen naar (zware) luchtdrukwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de recherche zo goed als stilligt door een stuwmeer aan overuren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether criminal investigations were being postponed to next year because detectives had to take leave hours, and whether budgets for overtime had run out. The minister replied that prioritisation is a continuous task of the prosecution service, that leave is granted subject to operational needs, that no unit had exhausted its overtime budget, and that the agreed police strength of 49,500 FTE is maintained, so no extra funds are needed.
Per unit a budget is available for overtime.
Per eenheid is er een budget beschikbaar voor overuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over criminele netwerken en hennepteelt in Zuid Nederland

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about municipalities stopping recovery of costs for clearing cannabis plantations, police and prosecution capacity for organised crime, financial investigators, and whether cannabis should be regulated. The minister answered that municipalities set their own policy, that cost recovery is a local matter, that cannabis regulation would not solve the problem, and that investigations and capacity are being strengthened, while stating that some data is not held centrally.
I am not aware whether, and if so how many municipalities for what reason have since 2012 stopped the administrative clearance of cannabis plantations and recovery of costs from the offender.
Het is mij niet bekend of, en zo ja hoeveel gemeenten om welke reden sinds 2012 zouden zijn gestopt met het bestuurlijk ruimen van hennepplantages en het verhalen van gemaakte kosten op de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de brandweer bezorgd is om veiligheid bij uitrukken in duo’s

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to union and volunteer-association criticism that the 'Uitruk op maat' framework for variable fire-brigade deployments endangers firefighter safety, and what he will do to secure workfloor support. The minister answered by referring to a letter sent to the House, noting the Security Council provided the framework for information, that he will discuss the safety concerns with the parties, and that he asked the Council to keep consulting them to build support.
Given the criticism from the unions and the VBV of the national framework regarding the safety aspect, I will enter into discussions with the parties concerned about this jointly.
Gezien de kritiek van de vakbonden en de VBV op het landelijk kader met betrekking tot het veiligheidsaspect, zal ik met de betrokken partijen hierover gezamenlijk in gesprek gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de problemen bij de uitvoering van de SBF-regelingen

An SP MP asked why the SSC sent wrong letters and wrong income data to former SBF-leave staff, whether 123 staff were paid the AOW-gap compensation too early, and who the contact points are. The minister acknowledges the errors, says all staff now have correct information, offers staff the choice to keep or repay the early payment, and reports new contact points and regular SSC-P Direkt coordination.
I deeply regret the course of events.
Ik betreur de gang van zaken zeer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Reorganisatie politie kost honderden miljoenen extra’

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Kooiman asked whether the police reorganisation would cost hundreds of millions more than budgeted, how extra costs would be covered, and whether the Court of Audit should check the costs. Minister Opstelten answered that the 230 million euro friction-cost budget is considered sufficient, that extra costs must fit within the budget, that the accounts are audited externally, and that he sees no reason for a separate Court of Audit review.
I see no reason to ask the Court of Audit, on top of the external accountant's audit, to look again specifically at the spending within the friction-cost budget.
Ik zie geen reden om bovenop de accountantscontrole de Algemene Rekenkamer te vragen nog eens extra specifiek naar de uitgaven binnen het frictiekostenbudget te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over resocialisatiepilots in het gevangeniswezen

MP Kooiman asked about the dyslexia pilot and the self-reliance (zelfredzaamheid) pilots in prisons, why funding was stopped, and whether ex-prisoner experts could be used more. The Secretary of State answered that the dyslexia pilot was evaluated and discontinued because the evidence did not justify it, that the self-reliance pilots are under WODC evaluation with a decision expected in spring 2015, and that volunteers are supported.
Based on this evaluation, I decided in September 2013 not to continue the pilot.
Ik heb op grond van deze evaluatie in september 2013 besloten geen vervolg aan de pilot te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Marcouch over misbruik van de introducéregeling bij schietsportverenigingen

MPs Kooiman and Marcouch asked the Minister of Security and Justice about misuse of the introducé rule at shooting clubs after a TV broadcast showed clubs still ignoring tightened rules, and about inspections, sanctions, certification and a national registration system. The Minister said he was disappointed, outlined sanctions (certificate withdrawal, police permit revocation), argued that additional inspections are unnecessary given the limited scale, and said a national registry lacks added value per the KNSA.
Given the limited scale of the problem and the measures already introduced, in my view there is no reason to deploy more quantitative supervision by the police and inspection visits by the KNSA.

Gelet op de beperkte omvang van de problematiek en de reeds ingevoerde maatregelen, is er naar mijn mening geen aanleiding méér kwantitatief toezicht door de politie en controlebezoeken door de KNSA in te zetten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Kooiman over problemen bij Fier Friesland met de budgetten specialistische functies

MPs Siderius and Kooiman asked why specialised national services of Fier Friesland still lack funding agreements for 2015 and whether budgets, shelter for foreign trafficking victims and their children, and the transfer of AWBZ and youth mental health funds to municipalities have been properly arranged. The State Secretary answered that agreements exist through the VNG framework, that municipalities decide on purchasing, that central shelter (COSM) is extended to 2017, and that the government will monitor the transition and revisit the 2015 budget in spring with the VNG, while declining several requests such as a pilot status, a transfer to the Ministry of Security and Justice, or a trust account.
It is up to the municipalities to make agreements on the design and financing of care provision for victims of trafficking in human beings and their children.
Het is aan de gemeenten om afspraken te maken over de vormgeving en financiering van het zorgaanbod voor slachtoffers van mensenhandel en hun kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over te weinig capaciteit bij politie en Openbaar Ministerie om mensenhandel aan te pakken

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and the Public Prosecution Service have enough capacity to tackle human trafficking, including forced prostitution, and whether planned budget cuts will affect specialist staff. The minister replied that the approach is working, that specialist human trafficking officers and teams exist, and that budget cuts will not undermine the ability to prosecute trafficking cases.
As a result, it is not possible to indicate how much capacity is deployed specifically for human trafficking.
Hierdoor is het niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel capaciteit specifiek alleen voor mensenhandel wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat de rechtbank Utrecht niet goed beveiligd is

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked about reports that fake weapons were smuggled into the Utrecht court through a back door and whether court security was tightened. The Minister answered that the incident at the Midden-Nederland court exposed a pass registration and authorisation problem, outlined the Rijkspas security framework, and listed measures such as replacing all passes and checking deactivation of departed staff's passes.
I find this a worrying incident to which the Midden-Nederland court responded adequately.
Ik vind dit een zorgwekkend incident waar de rechtbank Midden-Nederland adequaat op heeft gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Kooiman over de vroegtijdige plaatsing van een veroordeelde mensenhandelaar in een zeer beperkt beveiligde inrichting (zbbi)

MPs Segers and Kooiman asked why a convicted human trafficker was placed in a zbbi before serving half his sentence, why victims were informed only after his first leave, and what safeguards exist during weekly leave. The minister answered that placement follows the regime, victims were informed in time, a no-contact condition applies, and victims are not consulted on leave decisions.
There is no question of victims advising on the granting of freedoms during detention.
Van advisering door slachtoffers bij het toekennen van vrijheden tijdens detentie is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie dit jaar veel meer uitgeeft aan extern personeel dan begroot

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the National Police spends far more on external hired staff than budgeted, and whether a cap like the 'Roemernorm' should apply. The minister answered that external hiring is 4-5% of personnel costs, within the government norm, that hires are for a complex reorganisation and business continuity rather than replacing permanent staff, and that a diensthoofd HRM's arrangement does not circumvent the pay norm.
The total costs for external hiring by the police lie between 4 and 5% of total personnel costs and thus fall well within the government norm for external hiring.
De totale kosten voor externe inhuur van de politie liggen tussen de 4 en 5% van de totale personele lasten en vallen daarmee ruim binnen de Rijksoverheidsnorm voor externe inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het gebruik van de Quick Connect-koppeling

An MP asked whether the minister's letter wrongly implied that Quick Connect couplings had been replaced everywhere by screw couplings, whether reinforced variants can still fail, and which safety regions still use them, and whether the government will stop their use until proven safe. The minister answered that the weak combination was replaced everywhere by a robust one, that the reinforced-variant test lacked scientific basis, that no problems have been reported, and that the Veiligheidsberaad confirmed no further issues.
The letter of 7 October reported that the weak coupling combination has been replaced everywhere by a robust one.
In de brief van 7 oktober is gemeld dat de zwakke koppelingscombinatie overal is vervangen door een robuuste.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de politie geen betrouwbare cijfers heeft over hennepacties waarbij geen kwekerij wordt aangetroffen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police lack reliable figures on home entries where no cannabis grow is found, and about aftercare and damage compensation for residents. The minister agreed that reliable figures are important, noted that BVH was adjusted in September 2014 to generate such data, supported personal explanation to residents and prompt damage settlement, and said a national damage procedure is being developed.

In early September 2014 the police made an adjustment in the Basic Enforcement Facility (BVH) so that from that date figures can be generated on entries into premises where no cannabis grow was found.

Begin september 2014 heeft de politie een aanpassing gemaakt in de Basisvoorziening Handhaving (BVH), zodat met ingang van die datum cijfers kunnen worden gegenereerd over het binnentreden van plaatsen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat een paranoïde Pool alleen celstraf krijgt omdat geen kliniek hem wil behandelen

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the State Secretary why a paranoid Polish offender convicted of manslaughter received only a prison sentence because no clinic would treat him, and how this fits the TBS guidance for foreign nationals and the handling of repatriation and leave for TBS patients. The State Secretary replied that the prosecution declined TBS with conditions because the offender had no health insurance or income, that prison psychiatric care is available, and that leave and repatriation rules were adjusted from April 2014.

Because enforcing a TBS with conditions would encounter practical obstacles, as the person has no own income and no individual health insurance, the Public Prosecution Service refrained from it and sought only a prison sentence.

Omdat de tenuitvoerlegging van een tbs met voorwaarden echter op praktische bezwaren zou stuiten, omdat betrokkene geen eigen inkomen heeft en ook geen individuele ziektekostenverzekering, heeft het Openbaar Ministerie daarvan afgezien en alleen een gevangenisstraf geëist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de bezuinigingen op het reclasseringstoezicht

The MP asks whether the cut in reclassering supervision hours rests on a report by the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and Sexual Violence against Children, and whether the cut is representative given that it covers only a small share of advice. The state secretary answers that the cut is not based solely on that report, that merging supervision levels 1 and 2 with fewer hours allows more tailored supervision, that the high-impact-crime policy for robbers at level 3 will be maintained, and that the reclassering organisations were consulted in the 2015 framework letter.

The announced downward adjustment of the hours available within reclassering supervision is not based solely on the report of the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and Sexual Violence against Children.

De door mij aangekondigde neerwaartse bijstelling van het aantal uren dat beschikbaar is binnen het reclasseringstoezicht, is niet enkel gebaseerd op het rapport van de Nationaal Rapporteur Mensenhandel en Seksueel Geweld tegen Kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over diverse ontwikkelingen en reorganisaties in de strafrechtketen en de gevolgen hiervan voor de bestrijding van georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister about reorganisations in the criminal justice chain, including dissolving the interregional detective units in Brabant and Zeeland in favour of new undermining teams, reduced prosecutor availability, the practice of listing only a few offences on summons, and police detective attractiveness. The minister answered that the redistribution is deliberate, prosecutors' capacity will be increased, asset seizure remains a priority, and the ad informandum practice has long-standing procedural grounds.
There is no reorganisation. It concerns a deliberate redistribution of capacity.
Er is geen sprake van reorganisatie. Het betreft een weloverwogen herverdeling van capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over inzake het integriteitsbeleid bij het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responded to a report finding the ministry's integrity policy was not in order, why the review was commissioned, which recommendations were accepted or rejected, and why no separate integrity unit was created. The minister rejected the negative picture, said several units manage integrity well, adopted two of three recommendations, and declined a separate integrity department because integrity should remain a line responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman naar aanleiding van het bericht in de Gelderlander dat de gemeente Neder-Betuwe dumping van drugsafval hard gaat aanpakken

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked how many drug waste dumpings occur, how much police and inspection capacity is devoted to them, and who pays for clean-up. The government answered that no national figures exist, that Brabant recorded about 150 dumpings in 2013, and that dedicated police capacity and cost recovery from offenders are being pursued.
As I set out in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, I do not have national figures on drug waste dumpings.
Antwoord 1, 2 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 2 uiteen heb gezet beschik ik niet over landelijke cijfers over dumpingen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een student is beschoten met een luchtdrukwapen

The SP MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a student shot with an air-pressure weapon in Zeist, whether such incidents are tracked, whether buyers are warned, and whether stronger air weapons should require licensing and be reclassified under the Weapons and Ammunition Act. The Minister called the incident worrying, said there is no national registry for air-weapon incidents, described voluntary buyer information by dealers and clubs, and announced research into the firing power of air, spring and gas-pressure weapons.
I intend to commission research next year into the firing power of air, spring and gas-pressure weapons.
Ik ben voornemens komend jaar onderzoek te laten doen naar de schotkracht van lucht-, veer- en gasdrukwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Kooiman over het bericht “Tienduizenden zonder 112”

MPs Agnes Mulder and Kooiman asked whether tens of thousands of people cannot reach emergency number 112 by mobile phone, and what is being done about coverage gaps and cross-border cooperation. The minister replied that TNO and Agentschap Telecom are mapping outdoor mobile coverage for 112 (map due in December), that cost and technical options are excluded from that study, and that cross-border arrangements with Belgium and Germany already route emergency calls to the correct Dutch centre.
I am currently having research carried out into outdoor mobile coverage in relation to the accessibility of the emergency number 1-1-2.
Ik laat momenteel onderzoek uitvoeren naar de mobiele dekking buitenshuis in relatie tot de bereikbaarheid van het alarmnummer 1-1-2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat een brandweerman tijdens het bestrijden van een brand door een defecte ademluchtfles met Quick Connect-koppeling in acute ademnood kwam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that a firefighter fell into acute breathing distress from a defective breathing apparatus with a Quick Connect coupling, asking how many incidents occurred, whether testing is adequate, and whether use should stop everywhere. The minister reported five incidents across regions, a national inventory showing which regions still use the coupling, that the Inspectorate SZW is investigating, and that the choice of equipment is the employer's responsibility, promising no immediate nationwide halt.
This concerns an employer responsibility – in this case of the safety regions – to provide personnel with sound equipment
Het betreft een werkgeversverantwoordelijkheid – in casu van de veiligheidsregio’s – om personeel te voorzien van deugdelijke middelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Kooiman en Van Gerven over de publicatie ‘Verstand op veilig’

MPs Smaling, Kooiman and Van Gerven asked whether the government shares concerns from a Rathenau Instituut report that marketisation has strained the core tasks of national-security knowledge institutes, and whether it will convene stakeholders, examine horizontal cooperation and review inspectorates' reliance on these institutes. The minister denied that marketisation is a problem, cited existing funding and statutory safeguards, and declined new round-tables, new horizontal structures or a review, saying existing forums suffice.
The cabinet sees no reason in the report to sit down with the institutions concerned and other relevant parties outside existing forums where this already happens.
Het kabinet ziet in het rapport geen aanleiding om met de betrokken instellingen en andere relevante partijen om tafel te zitten buiten verbanden waarin dat al gebeurt.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat jonge criminelen in jeugdgevangenissen vaak niet worden behandeld (ingezonden 20 augustus 2014).

MP Kooiman asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice about press reports that young offenders in youth detention centres often receive no treatment, and about sick leave, daily programmes and the effects of closures and budget cuts. State Secretary Teeven rejects the one-sided picture, describes measures taken to improve care and states that daily programmes and quality have not changed materially despite cutbacks.
I find the article paints an unbalanced picture of what happens in the youth detention institutions (JJI's).
Ik vind het artikel een onevenwichtig beeld schetsen van hetgeen in de Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen (JJI's) gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat steeds meer agenten kampen met schulden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that more police officers are in debt, including whether debts are underreported, whether officers are dismissed after a second wage garnishment, and whether police pay should rise. The minister said such debts are undesirable, that no historical overview exists (about 600 wage garnishments), that a new debt-assistance framework applies, denied dismissals as a routine practice, and maintained that current pay is adequate.
Such an overview cannot be provided as these figures are not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht kan ik niet verstrekken aangezien deze cijfers niet beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over afhandeling van incidenten door penitentiaire en tbs-inrichtingen

An MP asked how penitentiary and TBS institutions handle drug finds and suspected criminal incidents, including reporting to police and recording of reports. The State Secretary explained the aangifte rules, sanctions, police cooperation, and a national handbook, but said national counts of reports and processen-verbaal are not kept for penitentiary institutions.
The number of reports, and therefore also the number of official records drawn up, is not kept nationally for penitentiary institutions.
Het aantal aangiftes en dus ook het aantal opgemaakte processen-verbaal wordt niet landelijk voor de penitentiaire inrichtingen bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat het 112 alarmnummer slecht bereikbaar is voor doven en slechthorenden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the 112 emergency number is hard to reach for deaf and hard-of-hearing people, including whether calls are often disrupted, whether location data can be detected, and whether harm has occurred. The minister said several channels exist (text phone, intermediary services, the Signcall app), that no police incidents of harm are recorded, and that a fix for disrupted conversations and location transmission is expected within months.
The solution is expected to be realised within a few months.
Naar verwachting is deze oplossing binnen enkele maanden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over gijzelingstrainingen in gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether crisis training for prison staff (hostage-taking, riots, fire drills) would be cut, how often trainings and drills occur per prison, and how crisis team sizes change after budget cuts. The State Secretary answered that no cuts apply to drills or crisis teams, that a new hostage-training approach using in-house instructors and e-learning is being prepared, and that staff councils will be consulted.
No cuts are being made to crisis teams.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Kooiman over de brief van de gemeente Alphen aan den Rijn over de fiscale consequenties van de inkoop van jeugdhulp

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries whether the municipality of Alphen aan den Rijn's warning about VAT charges on regional youth care purchasing, possibly cutting budgets by 21%, was accurate, and what would be done about the budget uncertainty. The government replied that VAT exemptions for youth care apply, that clarifying standard cooperation forms with umbrella organisations is underway, and that municipalities received budget certainty on 30 May 2014.
We are therefore in consultation with a number of umbrella organisations to produce a description of the tax consequences of the most common forms of cooperation, as expected.
Wij zijn daarom in overleg met een aantal koepelorganisaties om te komen tot een beschrijving van de fiscale consequenties van de – naar verwachting – meest voorkomende samenwerkingsvormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over de mishandeling van spoorwegpersoneel

MPs Smaling and Kooiman asked the government about the assault on rail staff, prevention measures, operator practices and court sentencing. The state secretary answered that the case is under investigation, outlined a Veilige Publieke Taak programme and existing measures, and said regional operators' cost and measure details would follow later.

I have asked the relevant subnational governments and PT authorities, as responsible concession grantors toward the regional rail operators, to provide insight into measures and costs regarding social safety.

Ik heb aan de betreffende decentrale overheden en OV- autoriteiten als verantwoordelijk concessieverlener richting de regionale spoorvervoerders (Arriva, Connexxion, Syntus en Veolia) gevraagd om inzicht te geven in maatregelen en kosten op het gebied van sociale veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over over de brandbrief van gemeenten in de regio Zuidoost-Utrecht over het tekort op het budget Jeugdzorg

An MP asks the state secretary how he views the Zuidoost-Utrecht municipalities' alarm over a 15 million euro youth-care budget shortfall and whether other municipalities face similar gaps. The state secretary says he is consulting the region, will run a difference analysis after the May circular, and sees no problem with the woonplaatsbeginsel allocation.
It is not exactly known to me which other municipalities expect to face financial shortfalls regarding the youth-care budget.
Het is mij niet exact bekend welke andere gemeenten verwachten te maken te krijgen met financiële tekorten met betrekking tot het budget voor de jeugdzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Toorenburg over de onrust onder het gevangenispersoneel

MPs Kooiman and Van Toorenburg asked the State Secretary about unrest among prison staff, including staffing shortages, intimidation, budget cuts and the pension gap for staff in substantially burdensome posts. The State Secretary disputed the staffing-shortage and intimidation claims, cited falling violent incidents, and deferred detailed answers on cuts and the Masterplan to a later letter.

In line with my earlier commitments during the General Consultation on the DJI Masterplan of 29 January and the General Consultation on prisons of 27 March, I will inform the House before the summer recess about progress on implementing the DJI Masterplan and the additional financial problems.

Conform mijn eerdere toezeggingen tijdens het Algemeen Overleg over het Masterplan DJI van 29 januari jl. en het Algemeen Overleg over het gevangeniswezen op 27 maart jl. zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces informeren over de voortgang van de implementatie van het Masterplan DJI en de aanvullende financiële problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de ontslaggolf in de jeugdzorg

The SP MP Kooiman asked the state secretaries about the reported loss of 140 jobs at Bureau Jeugdzorg Gelderland and an expected 5,100 to 8,700 job losses in youth care, asking how quality and continuity would be protected, whether dismissals and social plans could be reported by region, and what transition support exists. The government answered that job losses are plausible and depend on municipal contracting, that it is monitoring labour market effects, and that it has allocated funds for transition and retraining, but gave no regional dismissal figures because contracting is not yet complete.
Only once the contracting process between municipalities and providers has progressed further can it be stated to what extent, despite the efforts of these parties, forced dismissals occur and where.
Pas als het inkoopproces tussen gemeenten en aanbieders verder is gevorderd kan worden aangegeven in hoeverre er, ondanks de inspanningen van deze partijen, gedwongen ontslagen zijn en waar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Kooiman over het bericht dat transportbedrijven zwarte lijsten hanteren voor parkeerplaatsen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether they know transport firms keep blacklists of unsafe lorry parking places, whether the government will act on the rise in cargo theft, and for statistics and an action plan. The minister confirms ongoing talks with the sector, says the government lacks those blacklists, outlines public-private prevention efforts and cargo theft figures, and promises to inform parliament before summer.
I expect to be able to inform the House about this this summer.
Ik verwacht Uw Kamer hierover deze zomer te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over het gebruik van de stille sms door de politie ten behoeve van de opsporing

Four MPs asked the minister about police use of silent SMS (stealth SMS) to locate phones in criminal investigations, including whether repeated use amounts to systematic observation, what procedural tightening was announced, and whether frequency of use is registered and disclosed. The minister answered that privacy impact depends on the case and is judged by the public prosecutor, that procedure now requires recording duration and frequency in the case file, but that the number of uses will not be publicly disclosed to protect investigations and because the criminal judge reviews lawfulness.
For that reason I do not intend to make this information public.
Om die reden ben ik niet voornemens deze informatie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Nederland niet goed is voorbereid op een ramp

MP Kooiman asked whether Dutch safety regions and vital sectors have concrete agreements, whether mandatory system exercises are held, and whether the NL-Alert cooperation has stalled. Minister Opstelten answered that preparedness is improving, that convenants are being concretised, that 22 of 25 regions held a system exercise in 2013 while the rest were pressed to comply, and that a national uniform-agreement duty for the Veiligheidsberaad was rejected in line with the Hoekstra commission.
I will continue to press the safety regions to hold exercises on the main structure and with vital partners.
Ik blijf er bij de veiligheidsregio’s op aandringen oefeningen op de hoofdstructuur en met de vitale partners te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het idee om agenten vrij te maken die zich alleen bezig moeten houden met criminaliteitsbestrijding onder Tilburgers van Marokkaanse en Antilliaanse afkomst

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether the government endorses a Tilburg VVD proposal to assign police specifically to crime-fighting among residents of Moroccan and Antillean descent, and whether there is a police capacity problem in Tilburg. The minister says targeted youth policy was used in the past and is now part of regular policy, stresses effectiveness and warns against unjustified ethnic distinction, and says he has no signals of a capacity problem in Tilburg, with the mayor able to request more capacity.
We must of course guard against a targeted approach toward these groups leading to unjustified distinction.
We moeten er uiteraard voor waken dat een gerichte aanpak op deze groepen zou leiden tot het maken van ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over het stijgend aantal ladingdiefstallen

MPs Kooiman and Bashir asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the 42 percent rise in cargo thefts in 2013, its causes, and the claim that police and prosecutors had reduced attention to transport crime. The minister denied reduced attention, said the cause of the rise is not directly explained, described continuing public-private cooperation and the NPC priority, and promised continued monitoring without committing to a specific new measure.
I do not share the view that there would be reduced attention to transport crime.
Ik deel de opvatting dat sprake zou zijn van verminderde aandacht voor transportcriminaliteit niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat jongeren nog steeds geen passende zorg krijgen vanaf hun 18e levensjaar

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about reports that young adults with autism and severe behavioural problems, such as Jabko, still lack suitable care after turning 18, and why a year later no good follow-up places exist. The state secretary expressed understanding, said providers bear responsibility for suitable care, is consulting providers and the CCE on tailored care and its financing, and says the number of such cases is about 40 per year, with no concrete new preventive measures beyond the planned municipal role in youth care.
The CCE has indicated that it sees nationally around 40 (very) hard-to-place young people and (young) adults with autism spectrum disorder and severe behavioural problems each year.
Het CCE heeft aangegeven landelijk jaarlijks circa 40 (zeer) moeilijk plaatsbare jongeren en (jong)volwassenen met een autisme spectrum stoornis en ernstig probleemgedrag te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over "een groeiend aantal huisuitzettingen van gezinnen met kinderen".

SP MPs asked whether evictions of families with children and demand for emergency shelter are rising, whether this breaches the Convention on the Rights of the Child, and whether evictions involving children should be banned. The government confirmed 6,980 evictions from housing corporations in 2013 (up 8%) but said the rise is mainly single adults, not families, and that a ban is unnecessary because courts already weigh tenants' housing interests and a noodmoratorium exists.
A forced eviction will therefore only take place after judicial review; this is related to the special character of residential accommodation.
Een gedwongen ontruiming zal dus alleen plaatsvinden na een rechterlijke toets; dit heeft te maken met het bijzondere karakter van woonruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het nieuwe regime in gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports of unrest and criticism of the new prison promotion-and-demotion regime, including whether its introduction ahead of the pending penitentiary law amendment was justified, its treatment of life-sentence prisoners, its compatibility with European rules on restricting freedoms, and whether it is a cost-cutting measure. The State Secretary answered that no security incidents are known, that the regime is carefully monitored, that it does not depend on the pending legislation, that about two-thirds of prisoners qualify for the plus programme, and that the regime is not in itself a cost measure though the basic programme saves costs.
I have therefore asked the director-general of DJI to monitor the implementation carefully and adjust where necessary.
Ik heb de hoofddirecteur van DJI dan ook verzocht de implementatie zorgvuldig te monitoren en bij te sturen waar dit noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de zorg voor kinderen in gevaar is

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretaries whether the transfer of youth care to municipalities threatens continuity of care for children, citing gaps in contracts, budgets, frictional costs and regional cooperation ahead of 2015. The government replied only by referring to its letter on preparing the Youth Act (Kamerstuk 31 839, nr. 351), without answering the questions on substance.

The written questions from MP Kooiman (SP), question number 2014Z04148, have been answered by means of the letter on 'preparing the introduction of the Youth Act on 1 January 2015' (Kamerstuk 31 839, no. 351).
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP), vraagnummer 2014Z04148 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief over «voorbereiding invoering Jeugdwet op 1 januari 2015» (Kamerstuk 31 839, nr. 351 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over problemen in het gevangenisziekenhuis

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about a new death and continuing complaints at the prison hospital (JCvSZ), including harsh regime and isolation, and whether earlier claims that problems were resolved still hold. The State Secretary answers that the police investigation is closed with no need for further inquiry, a calamity commission is investigating, the Inspectorate has ended intensive supervision and judges care to be in order, and he will send the inspectorate's final report but does not commit to a new investigation of the complaints.
The police investigation into the death of the detainee in question has recently been concluded.
Het politieonderzoek naar het overlijden van de betreffende gedetineerde is recent afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het eerder sluiten van penitentiaire inrichtingen

An SP MP asked whether several prisons, including De Kruisberg, Haarlem and Wolvenplein, would close earlier than planned in the Masterplan DJI, and about staff impact and funding for reintegration. The Secretary of State answered that no facilities close earlier than the Masterplan dates, that vacancies are concentrated in several locations, and that staff are being supported through the Van Werk Naar Werk scheme with a reserved budget.
This means that no departments or institutions will be closed earlier than planned in the Masterplan DJI.
Dit betekent dat er geen afdelingen of inrichtingen eerder dan in het Masterplan DJI gepland worden gesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over de aanscherping van het toevoegbeleid bij gijzeling als dwangmiddel

MPs De Wit and Kooiman asked why legal aid (toevoeging) for imprisonment as a coercive measure (gijzeling) was tightened at a time of rising complaints about CJIB enforcement, and whether this would be reversed. The State Secretary defended the policy change as aligned with existing practice, promised to refine aid criteria with attention to hardship cases, and announced a letter on a more targeted approach for people who cannot pay, with further plans due in Q2 2014.
In view of the foregoing, there is no reason to reverse the policy set out above.
In het licht van het vorenstaande is geen aanleiding om het hiervoor uiteengezette beleid terug te draaien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet verlenen van toestemming aan bandleden van Pussy Riot om een Nederlandse gevangenis te bezoeken

Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why two Pussy Riot band members were denied permission to visit a Dutch prison and whether this was justified. Teeven answered that visits are weighed against order, security and detainee privacy, and that a director-level meeting and a video were arranged instead of a prison visit.
As long as the visit serves no functional purpose and is not initiated by a detainee, these interests prevail over the interest of visits by interested parties.
Zolang het bezoek geen functioneel doel dient of is geïnitieerd door een ingeslotene prevaleren deze belangen boven het belang van bezoek van belangstellenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de inzet van politiestudenten tijdens de jaarwisseling 2013-2014

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about deploying police trainees (aspirant-agenten) during New Year's Eve 2013-2014, including whether agreements with police unions on voluntariness, coaching, pay and course completion were kept. The minister confirmed deployment, said the agreements were made and largely followed, acknowledged one incident each of no coach present and one trainee deployed before completing the course, and promised clearer communication of agreements before future deployments.
For every special deployment, the agreements will be clearly communicated and repeated shortly before a deployment.
Bij iedere bijzondere inzet zullen de afspraken duidelijk worden gecommuniceerd en vlak voor een inzet worden herhaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht over een extra controle op het nieuwe dienstwapen van de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the extra inspection of the new police service pistol, after a missing trigger-bar catch notch was found, including when all weapons would be checked, whether any were affected, the risks to officers, the manufacturer's liability and the costs. The minister answered that 13,000 weapons were checked so far with completion due 15 February 2014, that only one weapon was found missing the part and repaired, that the manufacturer bears all extra costs of about 1,200 man-hours, and that more defects cannot be ruled out but sampling was increased.
On 15 February 2014 the inspection of all service weapons will have been completed.
Op 15 Februari 2014 zal de controle op alle dienstwapens zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het negeren van waarschuwingen over het binnensmokkelen van verboden goederen in een Penitentiaire Inrichting

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice why warnings about smuggling of prohibited goods into PI De Schie were ignored, what measures exist to keep such goods out, what risks were taken, and whether the prison management has been consulted. The State Secretary answered that DJI's Bureau Integriteit en Veiligheid launched its own investigation in February, leading to dismissal of two staff, that the media makers' footage yielded no new insights, and that cell inspections and mobile-phone detection are standard practice.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over integriteitsonderzoeken onder gevangenispersoneel

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about annual dismissals of prison staff for integrity violations, the differences between institutions, the independence of the Bureau Veiligheid & Integriteit, and whistleblower protection in prisons. The State Secretary answered that DJI addresses violations directly under a renewed code of conduct, that the Bureau is an internal body whose investigations meet due care standards, that the national whistleblower scheme is applied, and denied that whistleblowers are transferred or dismissed without the problem being solved.
The investigations meet the set requirements of due care, such as applying the principle of hearing both sides.
De onderzoeken voldoen aan de gestelde eisen van zorgvuldigheid, zoals het toepassen van hoor en wederhoor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over tekort wijkagenten

An MP asked whether Overijssel (Oost unit) falls short of the one-neighbourhood-officer-per-5,000-residents norm, why the shortfall persists nine months after the National Police was formed, and whether labour-union disagreement over the new job classification explains the delay. The minister confirmed Oost has 415 officers against a target of 629 after reorganisation, that the national total meets the norm, and that the norm should be reached by end 2014, with the union talks to be reported to parliament shortly.
Naturally, work must be done towards the statutory norm as quickly as possible.
Uiteraard dient zo snel mogelijk toegewerkt te worden naar de norm uit de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het verscherpt toezicht van de kansspelautoriteit op Holland Casino

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the Gambling Authority's decision to place Holland Casino under heightened supervision, including its prevention policy and whether its priorities are right given illegal online gambling. The state secretary answered that the rules are set out in law and that it is for the Gambling Authority, not the minister, to judge compliance and set enforcement priorities.
It is not for me to judge the extent to which individual license holders comply with the rules set, nor how the Gambling Authority supervises those rules.
Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te vellen over de mate waarin individuele vergunninghouders voldoen aan de gestelde regels, noch over de wijze waarop de kansspelautoriteit op die regels toeziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over medicijngebruik bij de politie

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about police officers taking sedatives and anti-depressants during work, and about PTSD in the force. The minister disputed the reported figures, said medication use falls under medical confidentiality, and described existing PTSD support and the PTSD complaints committee.
The medication use of every individual Dutch citizen falls under medical professional confidentiality.
Het medicijngebruik van iedere individuele Nederlander valt onder het medisch beroepsgeheim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat gemeenten massaal adviesbureaus inhuren voor hulp bij decentralisaties

MPs Kooiman and Leijten (SP) asked whether it is desirable that municipalities spend large sums on consultancy firms to prepare for the decentralisations and whether this should be stopped. The state secretary answered that municipalities bear their own responsibility and may hire commercial advisers, noted a non-commercial national transition bureau, and declined to commission a study of how much has been spent.

Given the municipalities' own responsibility for the decentralisation and my answers to the previous questions, I do not consider a study into the hiring of consultancy firms by municipalities necessary.
Gegeven de gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid bij de decentralisatie en mijn antwoorden op de vorige vragen acht ik een onderzoek naar de inhuur van adviesbureaus door gemeenten niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het vertonen van kansspelen op televisie door SBS

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that broadcaster SBS plans a gambling channel, whether this is desirable, and about the risks of addiction and youth access. The state secretary said television gambling is not yet permitted, that a future regulation will set conditions based on risks, that current advertising rules apply, and that he has not met SBS because the Kansspelautoriteit handles licensing and oversight.
The law currently offers no possibility to allow participation in gambling via television.
De wet biedt op dit moment geen mogelijkheid voor het gelegenheid geven tot deelname aan kansspelen via televisie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de mogelijkheid anoniem aangifte te doen bij zedenmisdrijven

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Justice Minister how anonymous reporting of sexual offences such as grooming works, whether this would lower the threshold for reporting, and why the Public Prosecution Service first said anonymity was not possible. The minister answered that anonymous reporting is possible in some cases but must be weighed against the defendant's right to test statements, that the Openbaar Ministerie policy is set out in an updated handbook, and that the earlier unclear communication reflects the need for careful weighing.
However, a careful weighing will always have to be made between the protection of victims and witnesses on the one hand and the procedural interests of suspects on the other.
Er zal echter steeds een zorgvuldige afweging moeten worden gemaakt tussen de bescherming van slachtoffers en getuigen enerzijds en de procesbelangen van verdachten anderzijds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over het toepassen van het dwangmiddel gijzeling

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary about a Bergen op Zoom judge's sharp criticism of the CJIB's automated practice of routinely seeking detention (gijzeling) for unpaid traffic fines, even where payment arrangements existed, and what would be done about it. The state secretary said detention is a last resort decided case by case by a judge, that over 40% of ordered detentions end in payment, and that the CJIB will broaden bundling of cases and earlier recognition of special circumstances, with the OM improving its use of detention.
The CJIB has set itself the goal of applying this bundled approach to cases more broadly in the future.
Het CJIB heeft zich ten doel gesteld deze gebundelde aanpak van zaken in de toekomst breder toe te passen.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen (beiden SP) aan de Minister en Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over achterblijvende resultaten van de Nationale politie (ingezonden 14 oktober 2013).

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the Minister and State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that the National Police is failing on crime, high tech crime clearance, burglary and street robbery clearance, and a possible unofficial quota for arresting illegal immigrants. The minister rejected the claim of failure, said high tech crime targets were behind schedule but being addressed, and maintained there is no quota, pointing to prioritised immigration enforcement and referring to the performance agreements and annual reports.
Of course I am and will remain in discussion with the police, mayors and the Public Prosecution Service to jointly look at how lagging results can be further improved.
Uiteraard ben en blijf ik met de politie, de burgemeesters en het Openbaar Ministerie in gesprek om gezamenlijk te kijken hoe achterblijvende resultaten verder verbeterd kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over agenten met een trauma

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police officers with PTSD still do not receive adequate care, whether the ministry's stated policy is being followed by managers, and what will happen to 25 dossiers at the PTSD complaints point. The minister regretted the media reports, said care is provided regardless of whether the problem is work-related, noted the HRM and care structure is still being set up, and said 7 of the 25 dossiers have been transferred to the complaints point with the rest not yet transferred.
Of course I will keep you informed about the progress of the work and results in this important dossier.
Vanzelfsprekend zal ik u op de hoogte houden over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden en resultaten in dit belangrijke dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Raak over het boek ‘naar één nationale politie’

MPs Kooiman and Van Raak asked whether the minister knew of a book on the creation of the national police, whether it was commissioned, what the police contributed and whether every officer received a copy at what cost. The minister confirmed knowledge of the book, said it was an initiative of the publisher and author, described the police's contribution as interviews and photo material, and stated the book was given to all permanent staff at a total cost of EUR 415,000.
This book is an initiative and publication of publisher Kerckebosch and author Louis Cornelisse.
Dit boek is een initiatief en uitgave van Uitgeverij Kerckebosch en auteur Louis Cornelisse.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en van Raak over de dreigende sluiting van de brandweerpost Diever

MPs Kooiman and Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the planned closure of the Diever fire station, its effects on response times, and whether the Drenthe safety region complies with the law and the Kooiman motion. The minister answered that responsibility lies with the municipality and then the safety region, that the regional coverage plan does not yet meet legal requirements, and that he has asked the region to fix it by end 2013.
I have asked the safety region to improve the coverage plan as quickly as possible so that it meets the legal requirements.
Ik heb de veiligheidsregio verzocht op zo kort mogelijke termijn het dekkingsplan zodanig te verbeteren dat het voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de dood van een 19-jarig meisje

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why a 19-year-old woman was killed despite a prior threat complaint lying in a police pile, and whether police capacity is too thin for serious cases. The minister regretted the death, described the prioritisation procedure, and said there is sufficient capacity and that improvements such as earlier case screening are underway.
Complaints of robbery with serious violence and grievous assault are always taken up by the police.
Aangiftes van overvallen met fors geweld en zware mishandelingen worden door de politie altijd opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Kooiman over uitbetaling van overuren bij de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether some police units had stopped paying overtime in cash from mid-2013, switching to time-off, and questioned the effects on workload, night-shift scheduling and uniform working conditions. The minister confirmed that units with exhausted overtime budgets now compensate in time-off, denied that workload or cost cutting was the motive, and stated that working conditions are uniform nationally.
The same working conditions apply to every police employee.
Voor iedere politiemedewerker gelden dezelfde arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Bommel over wanbetalende diplomaten

MPs Kooiman and Van Bommel asked whether diplomats unpaid traffic fines can be compelled to pay, given Article 41 of the Vienna Convention, and what the government is doing about it. The minister replies that quarterly reminders and talks with embassies have largely worked, some embassies have agreed to pay, and other coercive measures like withholding plates or parking permits are ruled out by the Vienna Convention.
The Netherlands is bound by the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations and must therefore act within the limits of that convention.
Nederland is gehouden aan het Verdrag van Wenen inzake diplomatiek verkeer en heeft daardoor te handelen binnen de grenzen van dit verdrag
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over angstcultuur bij de politie

MP Kooiman asked the minister whether he shares police union concerns about a culture of fear, disciplinary action and gagging of officers, and what he will do about it. The minister denies recognising that picture, points to internal complaint channels, the whistleblower procedure and union freedom, and says cultural change is being pursued through the new national police.
I do not recognise the picture painted by the union chairs.
Ik herken het geschetste beeld van de voorzitters van de vakbonden niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het sociaal beleid en de personele gevolgen van het sluiten van gevangenissen

An SP MP asked about social policy and staff consequences of prison closures under the DJI Masterplan, including unclear communication, uncertainty over the 'van-werk-naar-werk' scheme, early closures, placement numbers, the timing of plans and the SBF scheme. The government answered that closures follow planned dates, consultation with unions is ongoing, staff are being placed elsewhere, and a new offer on the SBF scheme is under discussion without details.
The content of that cannot be communicated while the consultation is ongoing.
Over de inhoud daarvan kan lopende het overleg geen mededeling worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de politieverklikker

An SP MP asks the Justice and Security minister how he reacts to reports that criminals use the Target Blu Eye alert device to evade police, whether it is legally sold, whether it is easily converted for misuse, whether sale should be made punishable, and whether the Flister system is a better alternative, with its results. The state secretary only sends a holding notice saying the answers cannot be given within the usual period because information is still outstanding.

I hereby inform you that the written questions from MP Kooiman (SP) to the Minister of Security and Justice about the police informer (submitted 16 September 2013) cannot be answered within the usual period, as not all necessary information has yet been received.

Hierbij deel ik u mede dat de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) van uw Kamer aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de politieverklikker (ingezonden 16 september 2013) niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn kunnen worden beantwoord, aangezien nog niet alle benodigde informatie is ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat bureaus jeugdzorg mogelijk failliet gaan als gevolg van de decentralisatie jeugdzorg

Two SP MPs asked whether Bureaus Jeugdzorg may go bankrupt and lose staff and continuity of youth care as provinces transfer youth care to municipalities, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that regional transition arrangements are due by 31 October 2013, that a support team and an independent commission (TSJ) will assess continuity and possible failures, and that the government may issue binding instructions to municipalities if continuity is not secured.

If this assessment shows that continuity of care is insufficiently secured, or that the required continuity of infrastructure or cooperation agreements between municipalities are inadequate, the national government will issue a binding instruction to the municipality or municipalities concerned under the Youth Act.

Als uit deze toetsing blijkt dat de continuïteit van zorg onvoldoende is geborgd of de daarvoor benodigde continuïteit van de infrastructuur of de samenwerkingsafspraken tussen gemeenten niet toereikend zijn, dan zal het rijk de desbetreffende gemeente(n) binnen de betreffende regio op basis van de Jeugdwet een aanwijzing geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat wethouders alarm slaan over de budgetten jeugdzorg

An SP MP asks the state secretary how he will respond to municipal alarms over shrinking youth care budgets, including reports that some South Holland municipalities face cuts above 10% and whether any will not submit their plans. The state secretary says he is in talks with the affected regions, is analysing the gap between indicative and calculated budgets, will send the transition committee's interim report, and promises definitive budgets in the 2014 circular.
At the beginning of October the Transition Committee Youth will come with an interim report on how the regional transition arrangements came about. I will send you this report.
Begin oktober zal de Transitiecommissie Jeugd met een tussenrapport komen over de totstandkoming van de regionale transitiearrangementen. Ik zal u dit rapport toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat kinderen steeds minder zwemvaardig zijn

An SP MP asked the health minister about reports that children are increasingly unable to swim, including questions on school swimming, municipal funding and the former safety-net scheme. The minister replied that swimming ability is primarily a parental responsibility supported by schools and municipalities, that no changes to this division are planned, and that she will not revert to the 2005 decision ending the safety-net scheme.
I endorse the answers to those parliamentary questions and see no reason to make changes to the current division of responsibilities.
Ik schaar me achter de beantwoording van die Kamervragen en zie geen aanleiding aanpassingen te doen in de huidige verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling.
Vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over herrie van politiehelicopters(ingezonden 5 juli 2013).

Two MPs asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Infrastructure and Environment about the legal rules for deploying police helicopters and whether night-time and urban use causing noise nuisance should be restricted to acute safety risks, quieter equipment, or flight instructions. The government replied that legal rules exist under the Police Act and aviation law, that deployments are tested for proportionality, subsidiarity and priority including nuisance, and that deployment is limited to lifesaving, complex arrests and high-impact crime, without committing to new restrictions.
Deployments are tested against the requirements of proportionality, subsidiarity and priority.
De inzetten worden getoetst aan de eisen van proportionaliteit, subsidiariteit en prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanwezigheid van mobiele telefoons en drugs in een justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

The MP Kooiman asks the state secretary about a PowNews broadcast showing a youth in a juvenile detention facility with a mobile phone, hashish and a guard's key, and about sanctions and further controls. The state secretary acknowledges the possession as very serious, explains the key-access system, reports sanctions imposed on the youths, and says existing controls are sufficient with no extra measures needed, though the sector will look into additional systems.

I have expressly asked the sector management of the Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) to remain alert to this and have instructed them to survey the sector as a whole on how the illegal import and use of mobile phones can be further curbed.

Ik heb de sectordirectie JJI van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) nadrukkelijk verzocht hier blijvend alert op te zijn en hen de opdracht gegeven om sectorbreed te inventariseren hoe de illegale invoer en het gebruik van mobiele telefoons nog verder kan worden teruggedrongen.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Oskam (CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over kansspelen op het internet (ingezonden 31 juli 2013).

MPs Kooiman and Oskam asked the State Secretary why online gambling by unlicensed operators remains easy despite the ban, whether the enforcement criteria are too lax, how the parliamentary motion excluding illegal operators from licences and cutting off banks and payment providers is being implemented, and whether a fast-lane for compliant firms is possible. The government answered that it prioritises enforcement against operators clearly targeting the Dutch market, will add stronger enforcement powers including binding instructions to payment and internet service providers, will exclude persisting operators from licences, is studying a fast-lane but sees limited scope, and is working with banks on a blacklist.
I intend to include in the online gambling bill several additional enforcement instruments to further strengthen the gambling authority's enforcement powers against illegal online gambling.

Bovendien ben ik voornemens in het wetsvoorstel kansspelen op afstand enkele aanvullende handhavingsinstrumenten op te nemen om de handhavingsmogelijkheden van de kansspelautoriteit om illegale online kansspelen aan te pakken verder te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er problemen zijn met de site Werk.nl

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the Werk.nl website was unreachable after a July 2013 release, including the cause, prevention measures, client communication and staffing costs. Minister Asscher answered that the site was unstable from 29 July to 8 August due to a release overloading the ICT platform, that a crisis team and evaluation are in place, that alternative paper and telephone channels and deadline extensions were offered, and that external costs are still being invoiced.
An evaluation of the release is taking place.
Er vindt een evaluatie plaats van de release.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over over het bericht dat ambtenaren een 6-daagse cursus krijgen tot jeugdpsychiater

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked whether a six-day course giving civil servants a basic understanding of youth psychiatry is consistent with the transfer of youth care to municipalities, and whether officials deciding on care access could be influenced by municipal budgets. The state secretary replied that the course gives policy staff insight only, that diagnosis remains with qualified professionals, and that municipalities decide their own training and are bound by legal duties to provide adequate care.
It is up to municipalities to determine which training they consider necessary to be properly equipped by January 2015.
Antwoord 2 Het is aan de gemeenten om te bepalen welke opleidingen zij noodzakelijk achten om per januari 2015 goed toegerust te zijn.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gijzelen van mensen bij het niet betalen van (verkeers)boetes (ingezonden 30 juli 2013).

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the Justice minister about rising imprisonment (gijzeling) for unpaid traffic fines, repeated detention for the same fine, effectiveness, personal circumstances, and the case of an elderly man detained for an unpaid damages measure. The minister answered that gijzeling is a last resort, about 40% pay under its threat, a policy of one detention per fine and new criteria for hardship cases by July 2014, and that the elderly man's detention continues because his health was assessed as fit for detention.
The starting point is that imposed (traffic) fines must be paid. There are however heartbreaking cases in which an exception is made to this starting point and some leniency is shown.

Uitgangspunt is dat opgelegde (verkeers)boetes betaald moeten worden. Er zijn echter schrijnende gevallen waarin op dit uitgangspunt een uitzondering wordt gemaakt en dat enige coulance betracht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat steeds meer gezinnen op straat belanden door de crisis

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that more families are ending up on the street due to the crisis, including refused shelter admissions in Groningen, Drenthe and Friesland. The state secretary replied that centre municipalities monitor rising applications, report no signs of families sleeping rough involuntarily, lack reliable national counts of homeless families, and point to prevention measures and the Trimbos-commissioned monitoring.
The Monitor Stedelijk Kompas 2012 shows there is no good picture of how many families in the Netherlands are currently homeless.
Uit de Monitor Stedelijk Kompas 2012 blijkt dat er geen goed beeld is van hoeveel gezinnen in Nederland op dit moment dakloos zijn
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Oskam over het bericht dat een  in afwachting van hoger beroep zijnde veroordeelde zedendelinquent een baan in de gehandicaptenzorg kon krijgen

MPs asked why a convicted sex offender awaiting appeal could take a job in disability care, and how the government will prevent similar cases, including VOG requirements, IGZ reporting of sexual misconduct complaints, and supervision of offenders pending appeal. The state secretary said the pending Wkkgz bill would require providers to vet staff and allow a VOG requirement by decree, IGZ transparency is limited by confidentiality, and immediate enforceability of probation conditions now exists though no figures are kept, with evaluation planned after three years.

With every request for information, a judgement is made about which information can be disclosed without harming those involved, breaching medical confidentiality, or disrupting the treatment process.

Bij elk verzoek om informatie wordt de afweging gemaakt welke informatie naar buiten kan worden gebracht zonder de betrokkenen te beschadigen, het medisch beroepsgeheim te schenden, of het behandelproces te verstoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat verpleeghuizen gebitten laten wegrotten

An SP MP asked the state secretary of health about reports that nursing homes let residents' teeth rot, asking about signals, staffing, the IGZ's role and whether an investigation would follow. The state secretary answered that care providers are primarily responsible, that the IGZ has started a dental-care inspection programme in nursing homes with extension to disability care planned, and that further investigation is not considered useful.
The IGZ supervises whether the quality and therefore the safety of care is not endangered, and thus forms the final safeguard.
De IGZ houdt toezicht of de kwaliteit en daarmee de veiligheid van zorg niet in gevaar komt, en vormt daarmee het sluitstuk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Leijten en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat zorginstelling Aafje uit voorzorg ontslag heeft aangevraagd voor honderden thuiszorgmedewerkers

MPs Kooiman, Leijten and Ulenbelt asked whether care provider Aafje's precautionary dismissal request for hundreds of home-care workers was premature and whether the UWV should grant it, and about municipal tendering practices. The state secretary replied that the dismissal request is not expected to proceed, explained the UWV's approach to dismissal permits tied to tenders, the rules on taking over staff, and that municipalities are responsible for tendering and must follow the law.
I have since understood that the dismissal request will not go ahead, at least for the time being.
Inmiddels heb ik begrepen dat de ontslagaanvraag er – in ieder geval voorlopig – niet gaat komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat zorginstellingen hun eigen vermogens hebben vergroot naar 9 miljard euro

An SP MP asked why care providers grew their own equity to 9 billion euros in 2012 while staff are being dismissed, and whether the government will intervene. The minister answered that the underlying report is not yet available, that equity serves to absorb setbacks and fund investment, and that the government will not intervene or publish a full sector overview.
The report on which the Intrakoop press release is based is not yet available.
Het rapport waarop het persbericht van Intrakoop is gebaseerd, is nog niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het betalen van zorgverzekeringspremie voor Nederlandse gedetineerden in het buitenland

An MP asked why Dutch citizens detained abroad must keep paying health insurance premiums without access to care, and whether suspension was possible, noting debt risks and parents paying for detained children. The minister acknowledged the problem and said a proposed amendment to Article 24 of the Zvw allows suspension of rights and obligations on notification, so exemption from the nominal premium is not needed.
With the proposed amendment to Article 24 of the Zvw, the problem identified has in my view been adequately resolved.
Met het voorstel tot wijziging van artikel 24 van de Zvw is het gesignaleerde probleem naar mijn mening afdoende opgelost.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de reanimatie door agenten in het gedrang komt (ingezonden 19 juli 2013).

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police officers' resuscitation and AED certificates had expired, whether training is offered in only two locations, and whether it was tendered at European level. The minister rejected the picture of a national problem, said training is part of basic police education and offered every two years at 23 IBT locations and elsewhere, and denied any European tender or new internal rules blocking training.
I do not recognise the picture painted in the PZC article and other media.
Ik herken het beeld dat geschetst wordt in het artikel van de PZC en andere media niet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Kooiman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse regering bezwaar heeft aangetekend tegen de herintreding van Bolivia in het Enkelvoudig Verdrag inzake verdovende middelen uit 196

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands objected to Bolivia's re-accession to the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs with a reservation on traditional coca leaf chewing, and why it did not object to Bolivia's earlier amendment proposal. The minister confirmed the objection, said it concerns the procedure of withdrawal and re-accession with a reservation rather than coca use itself, and refused to withdraw it.
The objection lodged by the Dutch government was prompted by concerns about the integrity of the treaty and the proper application of treaty law in general.
Het door de Nederlandse regering aangetekende bezwaar is ingegeven door zorgen omtrent de integriteit van het verdrag en de juiste toepassing van het verdragenrecht in het algemeen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Bashir over de recordopbrengst aan boetes en onduidelijkheid rond 130 km/u-wegen

Two SP MPs asked why the ministry ran an information campaign after confusion about the 130 km/u limit on the A2, whether speeding fines show confusion, which road sections account for most tickets, and whether matrix signs should show limits. The minister said fines data cannot show the cause of speeding, that road signs are clear and flyers were distributed, that the CJIB has no data by road section, and that a Rijkswaterstaat user survey covering signage is due in September 2013 with fixed signs kept for permanent limits.
The CJIB has informed me that its registration system does not distinguish by road section.
Het CJIB heeft mij meegedeeld dat het in zijn registratiesysteem geen onderscheid maakt naar wegvakken.
