Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Ulenbelt ver over het bericht dat thuiszorgmedewerkers massaal ontslagen worden

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked why UWV granted dismissal permits for about 1,100 home-care workers at Thuishulp Sensire and whether the state will intervene. The state secretary answered that the dismissals are the employer's own business decision on economic grounds, that UWV acted within its rules, that most work should remain in 2014 and that he will contact the parties and report on transition plans.
UWV acted in accordance with the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld in overeenstemming met de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de prostitutie in Utrecht aan banden is gelegd (ingezonden d.d. 1 juli 2013).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the closure of window prostitution in Utrecht, the consequences for sex workers, rental prices and police powers. The state secretary answered that the municipality revoked the permits for 115 workspaces for reasons including trafficking signals, that aid remains available, and that police powers are set by law while the APV is a local matter.
This concerns a local matter. I trust that the municipal authorities made a sound weighing of the various options before reaching this decision.
Het betreft een lokale aangelegenheid. Ik vertrouw erop dat het gemeentebestuur een goede afweging heeft gemaakt tussen de verschillende handelingsopties voordat het tot dit besluit is gekomen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de recordopbrengst aan boetes (ingezonden 13 juni 2013).

MP Kooiman asks the minister whether the expected rise in traffic fine revenue will be invested in police, prosecution and prisons, whether automated fines lack educational effect, whether fines arrive too slowly, whether 130 km/h enforcement increased, and whether some fine amounts are disproportionate. The state secretary denies a 30% rise (EUR 912m forecast vs EUR 898m in 2012), promises to decide allocation in the budget cycle, defends automated enforcement and the Tarievenhuis fine framework, and declines to revise the fine system.
I therefore do not intend to revise the fine system or the current traffic fines.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens het boetestelsel of de huidige verkeersboetes te herzien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over illegale doorverkoop van airsoftwapens

MP Kooiman (SP) asked whether airsoft replicas that resemble real firearms can be resold without registration or serial numbers, and how resale is controlled, and whether replicas of real guns sold online are a problem. State Secretary Teeven answered that resale to unauthorised persons is a crime, that the erkenninghouder keeps a dealer register for first sales, and that no measures are needed as long as the exemptions are respected.
I therefore consider the current obligations regarding the sale and resale of airsoft devices sufficient.
Ik acht de huidige verplichtingen rond de verkoop en doorverkoop van airsoft apparaten dan ook afdoende.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Kooiman over de brand bij chemiebedrijf ELD in Oosterhou

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice for a timeline of the June 2013 fire at chemical company ELD in Oosterhout, the GRIP escalation, prior inspections, emergency plans, public communication and the failure to sound sirens. The minister answered in detail, giving a timeline and communication record, but said the investigation into compliance was still ongoing and that communication is a local responsibility.
The investigation is still ongoing, so it is still unclear whether the company complied with all regulations at the time the fire broke out.
Op dit moment loopt het onderzoek nog, waardoor het nog onduidelijk is of het bedrijf op het moment van uitbreken van de brand aan alle voorschriften voldeed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het publiceren van 112-meldingen op internet

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the minister whether P2000 emergency paging traffic will be encrypted from 2014, so that privacy-sensitive 112 messages stop appearing online and journalists lose access. The minister replied that encryption is under study with a decision only after consultation, that the current contract runs to 2017, and that journalists will be informed via a national press-alarm guideline drawn up with the Dutch journalists' association.
In consultation with the National Police and the Security Council, I will examine in the coming months the options for improving citizens' privacy on this point
In overleg met de Nationale Politie en het Veiligheidsberaad onderzoek ik in de komende maanden de mogelijkheden om de privacy van burgers op dit punt te verbeteren
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de meldkamer van de veiligheidsregio Flevoland

MP Kooiman asked whether the Flevoland safety region's emergency control room is fit for a disaster, whether it lacks adequate calamity coordinators, and what the region and the minister are doing about it. Minister Opstelten answered that the inspectorate found no single-head leadership in the room, that the region is working on an interim solution with neighbouring regions without a merger, and that the minister will report on progress.
The safety regions Flevoland, Gooi en Vechtstreek and Utrecht, supported by my ministry, are working to implement the alternative solutions for the identified problems.
De veiligheidsregio's Flevoland, Gooi en Vechtstreek en Utrecht spannen zich, gesteund door mijn ministerie, in om de alternatieve oplossingen voor de geconstateerde problemen uit te voeren.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over een nadere onderbouwing van de gemaakte keuzes met betrekking tot de bezuinigingen in de tbs-sector en een reactie op verzoek van het lid Van Toorenburg om een brief over het voor

MP Kooiman questioned the government's justification for closing FPC Veldzicht and FPC Oldenkotte, including unclear resocialisation figures, how building friction costs were calculated, the regional labour market impact, and the effect of transfers on treatment duration. Secretary Teeven defended the criteria and calculations, said the closures had been justified in writing, and stated that transfer delays would be minimised and measured.

In a letter of 11 June 2013 to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, I provided an explanation of the underlying information, including the weighting of the criteria for closing FPCs in forensic care.

Bij brief van 11 juni 2013 aan de Voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer heb ik een toelichting gegeven op de achterliggende informatie ten aanzien van onder meer de weging van de criteria voor de sluiting van FPC's in de forensische zorg.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de inrichting van de politiedienstencentra

MP Kooiman asks the minister why police service centres are split across three locations, how this fits with commitments on staff and the police collective agreement, and how many support jobs will be lost. The minister replies that the split follows from efficiency and job-retention goals, that a social safety net and job-security guarantee apply, and that roughly 1,500 further FTE will decline through natural attrition without forced dismissals.

The police collective agreement (Arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord 2012–2014) includes a job-security guarantee, under which the employer will ensure that employees threatened by the reorganisation receive a suitable position within or outside the police.

In de politie-cao (Arbeidsvoorwaardenakkoord 2012–2014) is echter een werkzekerheidsgarantie overeengekomen, waarbij met toepassing van het LSS de werkgever ervoor zal zorgdragen dat medewerkers «die bedreigd worden door de reorganisatie» een passende functie zullen krijgen binnen of buiten de politie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over de kritiek van de Nationale ombudsman op de toepassing van het middel preventief fouilleren in de praktijk

MPs De Wit and Kooiman asked the Justice Minister how he responds to the National Ombudsman's criticism of preventive stop-and-search actions on the A2 and at a Maasdriel campsite, and whether misuse of powers will be prevented. The minister rejects the Ombudsman's broader concern, accepts some criticism on the written justification and timely publication of the area designation, and says existing legal safeguards suffice without additional measures.
The written justification for the necessity of the area designation could have been better.
De schriftelijke onderbouwing van de noodzaak van de gebiedsaanwijzing had beter gekund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over opsporing van dopinghandel

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the ministers of Justice and of Health about the investigation of doping trade, including illegal laboratories, online sales, cooperation with Belgium and with police, prosecution, customs and the Dutch Doping Authority, plus the estimated 160,000 doping users and a 2005 internal report. The government referred to earlier answers, said the Doping Authority has no investigative task, confirmed the 2009 prevalence study, and declined to publish the 2005 internal note because it was not a final product.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het uitbreiden van gokhallen en kansspelmogelijkheden

An SP MP asked the state secretary about plans by hospitality firms such as Van der Valk and Hof van Putte to open gambling halls, which municipalities license, and how casino gaming and oversight are organised. The state secretary replied that the halls are slot-machine halls licensed locally, that the Kansspelautoriteit holds a complete sector overview through annual reporting, and that municipalities alone decide on locations and no 'wildgroei' exists.
It is up to individual municipalities to decide whether and for which location they want to grant presence permits for slot-machine halls.
Het is aan individuele gemeenten om te bepalen of en voor welke locatie zij aanwezigheidsvergunningen voor speelautomatenhallen willen verlenen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat straatdealers staan te juichen na politie-invallen bij coffeeshops in Maastricht

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice why police raids on Maastricht coffeeshops were pursued instead of tackling street dealers, how many hours the raids cost, how the government views court rulings against the residence criterion, and whether it will scrap the criterion. The minister answered that both street dealing and the residence criterion are enforced, reported about 840 police hours across seven raids, said the criterion is working and an appeal is planned, and refused to scrap it.
I see no reason to withdraw the residence criterion and change the policy.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het ingezetenencriterium in te trekken en het beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanhouding van 2 demonstranten op de Dam

The SP MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice why two demonstrators were arrested on the Dam in 2013, which laws were broken, why identity documents were doubted, and who ordered the arrests. The minister answered that the arrests were wrongful: one arrest resulted from a mistaken identity with a person the mayor had ordered to leave, the other's circumstances remained unclear, and the police's initial denial was based on incorrect information.
It is established that the arrest took place wrongly.
Vast staat dat de aanhouding onterecht heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het schrappen van de PV-vergoeding

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether he plans to abolish the fee paid to municipalities per issued fine under local bylaws, and what this means for municipal enforcement, public order and the state treasury. The Minister answered that he is still consulting the VNG on the compensation scheme and will inform parliament once more is known.
I am still consulting with the Association of Netherlands Municipalities (VNG) on the compensation scheme for municipalities regarding the administrative penalty order for nuisance.
Ik ben nog in overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) over de vergoedingsregeling voor gemeenten met betrekking tot de bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over de kaalslag in de forensische zorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice whether a 120 million euro cut to forensic care would reduce treatment, leave, recidivism outcomes and staff conditions. The State Secretary answered that the budget falls from 725 to 602 million euro by 2017, that a convenant with sector bodies sets a shorter average tbs treatment duration and protects quality, and that the cuts are unavoidable though he will try to soften staff impacts.
The cuts at DJI, and therefore also those on the forensic care budget, are unavoidable.
De bezuinigingen op DJI, en dus ook die op het budget voor forensische zorg, zijn onvermijdelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het onderzoek ‘Do time restrictions on alcohol advertising reduce youth exposure’

MPs Van der Staaij, Voordewind and Kooiman asked whether a study showing the 6:00–21:00 time slot for alcohol advertising has counterproductive effects for high-risk youth should lead to extending the slot or other measures, and about compliance with the advertising code. The state secretary replied that the time slot is effective for young children, that he will discuss further protection of 12–18 year olds with the education ministry and report back, that code compliance is good, and that no further evaluation is needed beyond the existing one.

As indicated earlier during the debate on the private member's bill raising the alcohol age, I will soon discuss with the education ministry how young people aged 12–18 can be further protected from the influence of alcohol advertising.

Ik zal, zoals eerder aangegeven tijdens het debat over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel verhoging leeftijd alcohol, binnenkort met het ministerie van OCW bespreken op welke manier jongeren tussen de 12–18 jaar verder kunnen worden beschermd tegen de invloed van alcoholreclame.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel en Kooiman over de bedreiging van enkele jongeren uit Arnhem aan het adres van een stadsgenoot

MPs asked whether a Turkish man who publicly condemned antisemitic remarks by young Turks in Arnhem went into hiding after death threats, and whether the victim was supported and the perpetrators identified. The minister answered that the mayor advised him to stay elsewhere temporarily, police found no concrete threats, no complaint was filed, and the prosecutor opened an investigation into one minor for group insult, leading to a educational sanction.
Police research shows there is no question of concrete threats against the Turkish man or his family.
Uit onderzoek van de politie blijkt dat er geen sprake is van concrete bedreigingen tegen de Turkse man of zijn gezin.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over NL-Alert

An SP MP asks the Minister of Safety and Justice about the operation of the NL-Alert emergency warning system, including differing regional protocols, delays in use, message content and public awareness. The Minister replies that NL-Alert is still in its start-up phase, that agreements with the safety regions are in place and will be evaluated, and that a public campaign has been run.
Because NL-Alert is in its start-up phase, I am closely following developments and use in the regions.
Omdat NL-Alert in opstartfase verkeert, volg ik de ontwikkelingen en het gebruik in de regio's op de voet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het categorisch weigeren van mediacontacten van personen werkzaam in het gevangeniswezen

MP Kooiman asked whether prison-service staff are categorically barred from speaking to national media and how many requests were refused, and asked about the rationale given. The state secretary replied that twelve requests were forwarded to the Directorate of Communications since the last answers and all were granted, and that restraint before parliamentary hearings is considered appropriate with contact allowed afterwards.
Since the answering of the previous parliamentary questions, a total of twelve requests have been submitted to the Ministry's Directorate of Communications. All of these have been granted.
Sinds de beantwoording van de vorige Kamervragen zijn in totaal twaalf verzoeken voorgelegd aan de Directie Voorlichting van het Ministerie. Deze zijn alle gehonoreerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het bericht dat het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie slecht samenwerkt met de Nationale ombudsman

SP MPs De Wit, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to respond to press reports that the ministry cooperates poorly with the National Ombudsman, whose criticism described it as immune to criticism and hard to work with. Minister Opstelten answered that he takes the criticism note of, responds to all requests, follows most recommendations, holds consultations where he does not adopt one, and will consult the ombudsman more often and improve deadline monitoring.
I answer all requests from the ombudsman.
Ik geef op alle verzoeken van de ombudsman antwoord.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over agenten die Twitter gebruiken

An SP MP asked whether individual police officers' Twitter accounts were banned from 1 April 2013 and whether they would be replaced by team accounts, and asked about their added value. The minister denied any ban, said individual accounts such as neighbourhood officers' accounts are encouraged, and described the use of Twitter as a valuable complement to traditional police-citizen communication.
No, on the contrary: individual accounts are actually encouraged.
Nee, integendeel: individuele accounts worden juist gestimuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Kooiman over de stijgende kosten van een aansluitovereenkomst brandbeveiligingsinstallaties

Two SP MPs asked why the fee for a fire alarm connection agreement in Noord-Holland Noord rose sharply and whether businesses are unfairly burdened as the regional safety board compensates lost income. The minister replied that the safety board, as the responsible authority, chose the tariff increase and that the matter is a local responsibility, while offering to take no action beyond noting the board's role.
The decision to compensate the shortfall from falling OMS subscriber numbers by raising the OMS tariff from 1 January 2013 was taken by the daily board of the safety region.

Het besluit om het tekort door de daling in de aantallen OMS-abonnees te compenseren door een verhoging van het OMS-tarief per 1 januari 2013 is genomen door het dagelijks bestuur van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam, Kooiman en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat er geen sms wordt verzonden via AMBER Alert na 22 uur

MPs Oskam, Kooiman and Berndsen-Jansen asked whether AMBER Alert SMS messages are withheld between 22:00 and 07:00 and why, and whether differentiated night-time delivery could be arranged. The minister confirmed that night-time SMS alerts were stopped after complaints about disturbed sleep, and promised a website option allowing participants to opt in to night-time SMS within one to one and a half months.
There was a risk that participants would drop out because they were disturbed at night by incoming SMS messages.
Het risico ontstond dat deelnemers zouden afhaken omdat ze ’s nachts gestoord worden door binnenkomende SMS-berichten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Kooiman over illegale lozing door zeeschepen

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked the ministers about illegal night-time oil discharges by sea-going vessels, enforcement and detection chances, fines compared with Belgium and France, and port reception facilities. The minister acknowledged night-time discharges are harder to detect and that enforcement is difficult, promised further study of detection and fines, and said EU-level tightening of waste discharge obligations is preferred.

I of course also have the ambition to further reduce illegal discharges and will examine the report's conclusions and recommendations on increasing the chance of detection for feasibility and effectiveness.

Ik heb uiteraard ook de ambitie om de illegale lozingen verder terug te dringen en ga de conclusies en aanbevelingen uit het rapport inzake het verhogen van de pakkans onderzoeken op uitvoerbaarheid en effectiviteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de alternatieve opvang voor slachtoffers van loverboys

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a private foundation housing loverboy victims in homes without professional training or government oversight, and whether the Inspectorates can intervene. The state secretary said the foundation falls outside the health and youth care framework so the Inspectorates lack powers, that existing tools can address abuse but not ban the initiative, and that a study on supervising privately funded boarding schools is underway.

The Youth Care Inspectorate and the Health Care Inspectorate have no statutory power to supervise the foundation because its activities cannot be classified as care or support falling under the health ministry's legislation.

De Inspectie Jeugdzorg en de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg hebben geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om toezicht te houden omdat de activiteiten van de stichting niet kunnen worden aangemerkt als zorg of ondersteuning die tot het domein van de VWS-wetgeving behoort.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het spreekverbod voor gevangenisdirecteuren en gevangenispersoneel en de verhouding tot de vrijheid van meningsuiting

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether prison directors and staff may speak publicly about the Masterplan DJI 2013-2018 and whether a gag order exists, questioning its compatibility with freedom of expression. The State Secretary answered that staff may speak to local and regional media, that contacts with national press must be coordinated with the ministry's communications directorate, that no gag order was imposed, and that the existing policy will not be changed.
There has been no question of a gag order.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een spreekverbod.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanbesteding van het dienstpistool van de politie

An SP MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about problems in the tender for the new police service pistol, including legal costs, the test ammunition, the PPQ valve-safety failure and the choice of the P99Q. The minister acknowledges the tender did not run smoothly, rejects an independent investigation, and defends the procedure and the safety of the chosen pistol.
I therefore see no reason to have an independent investigation carried out into these tenders.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden voor het laten uitvoeren van een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar deze aanbestedingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en De Wit over verplichte omgang tussen ouder en kind na levensdelicten

Two SP MPs asked the state secretary whether contact between a child and a parent who killed the child's other parent should be allowed, whether the law gives enough grounds to refuse it, and whether the law should change. The state secretary agreed the child's interest must come first, announced a WODC study, said the law already allows refusal if contact is not in the child's interest, and stated he intends to amend the law so that the initiative for contact lies with the child rather than the parent.
I intend to amend the law.
Ik ben voornemens de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Jasper van Dijk over kinderen die noodgedwongen bij hun ouders moeten aankloppen ondanks een ontbrekende band of voogdij

SP MPs asked whether students who cannot ask a parent without custody or a parent who is absent or refuses to pay can qualify for the supplementary grant, and how many are affected. The minister explained the existing 'weigerachtige of onvindbare ouders' rule, saw no need for further research or a new solution, and noted the rule will be abolished under the coalition agreement, with a hardship clause under study.
It is not registered how many students with parents who have been removed or deprived of parental authority do not receive a supplementary grant based on parental income.
Er wordt niet geregistreerd hoeveel studenten met ouders die uit het gezag zijn ontheven of ontzet op basis van het inkomen van de ouders geen aanvullende beurs krijgen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over het bericht dat jongeren geen jeugdzorg meer krijgen vanaf hun 18e levensjaar

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked about reports that young people lose youth care at age 18, with the case of Jabko, an autistic young man with no follow-up placement. The state secretary acknowledged such gaps occur, said he would investigate how often, rejected raising the age limit to 21 for now, and described efforts to develop follow-up care and a working group.
I am willing to investigate how often this happens and to inform the House about it.
Ik ben bereid uit te zoeken hoe vaak dit gebeurt en daarover de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het aantal ondertoezichtstellingen en voogdijmaatregelen

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about the rise in child protection supervision orders (ondertoezichtstellingen) and guardianship placements, the causes of the rise, how municipalities will prevent such measures after decentralisation of youth care, and related budget and caseload questions. The government answered that the rise is likely due to greater attention to child abuse, that numbers have fallen since 2009, that municipalities will be responsible for integrated youth policy and quality requirements under the new law, and that some data (spending by municipalities, caseload averages) cannot be provided or are not planned for research.
Deze vraag is niet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat zeker honderd buurthuizen gesloten zijn en vele tientallen met sluiting worden bedreigd

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that about a hundred neighbourhood centres have closed and many more are threatened, asking whether he would count closures, act against them, and agree measures with municipalities. The state secretary replied that closures are a local responsibility under the Wmo, declined to count closures or investigate, and pointed to existing programmes and transition support while refusing to intervene.
Whether or not to close neighbourhood centres is a local responsibility.
Het al dan niet sluiten van buurthuizen is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over kinderen en jongeren in de maatschappelijke en vrouwenopvang

An SP MP asks the state secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the rising number of children and young people in shelters, the causes, the link to youth care waiting lists and budget cuts, and prevention measures. The state secretary answers that the figures do not show an absolute rise, explains the varied reasons and support available, notes Veerkracht and prevention efforts, and says gemeenten carry primary responsibility while no additional funding is available.
The budget cut in youth care will not be reversed.
De budgettaire korting in de jeugdzorg wordt niet ongedaan gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Kooiman over het onderzoeken en het tijdig voorkomen van pedofilie

MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Kooiman asked about the lack of research on female paedophilia, the availability of help for people with paedophilic feelings, the Stop It Now! helpline and its funding. The minister answered that no separate figures on female offenders or the hidden group exist, that existing bodies do not distinguish offenders by sex, and that funding for Stop It Now! will be reviewed with VWS and reported in April 2013.
Figures on the size of the hidden group of (female) paedophiles do not exist as far as I am aware.
Cijfers over de omvang van de verborgen groep (vrouwelijke) pedofielen bestaan voor zover ik weet niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het publiceren van 112-meldingen op internet

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about websites publishing 112 emergency call details, including addresses of callers or incidents, and how this fits with privacy and the legal basis. The minister said the Police Act 2012 permits sharing incident data where serious privacy intrusion is absent, that a guideline is coming in early 2013, that encrypted P2000 messaging will end scanning, and that he will consult journalists' association on agreements.
I share your concerns about the publication of privacy-sensitive data on the internet.
Ik deel uw zorgen over de publicatie van privacy gevoelige gegevens op internet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het samenplaatsen van (levens)langgestraften

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the status of plans to place life-sentenced and very long-sentenced prisoners together in dedicated wards, including why it was delayed, and whether the inventory and expert advice could be published. The State Secretary said the plan was delayed because not all prisoners cooperated with the required risk assessment, expected it to be realised by 1 July, and declined to publish the inventory and advice citing privacy.
The inventory and the expert advice are not made public for privacy reasons.
De inventarisatie en het deskundigenadvies worden niet openbaar gemaakt vanwege privacy redenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over zijn uitspraken over overheveling van zorgtaken naar gemeenten

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked State Secretary Van Rijn about his remarks that municipalities need not account separately for each decentralised care task, how this relates to the minister's stance, how outcomes will be monitored, and how the VNG's risk warnings, job impacts and continuity of care will be handled. The answers defend integrated budgeting with monitoring at the level of the whole social domain, promise a letter on long-term care, and decline to guarantee that all current AWBZ care will remain equally available.
Requiring financial accountability per component would unnecessarily frustrate this desired integrated approach.
Financiële verantwoording vragen per onderdeel zou deze gewenste integrale benadering onnodig frustreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat werkloze jongeren worden ingezet om de politie administratief te ontlasten

An SP MP asked the Justice minister whether unemployed youths would be deployed to relieve Drenthe police of administrative work from September 2013, and about their selection, duties, training, confidentiality, job prospects, pay, and possible job losses. The minister answered that a pilot in Assen is being evaluated, 10 youths have been placed, they do administrative support under on-the-job training and receive minimum wage, and that the placements do not replace regular police jobs, with no permanent employment prospect.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de aanpak van groepsgewijze jeugd-criminaliteit en de ontwikkeling van sfeerverbalen in het procesdossier

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about intimidation by youth criminal groups, victims' reluctance to report, and whether 'atmosphere reports' (sfeerverbalen) should be added to criminal case files. The Minister answered that prosecution is hard mainly because individual contributions are hard to establish, that such reports are already used in various districts with no legal obstacle, and that the OM will review experiences with them.
Specifically within the national approach to criminal youth groups, the OM will examine what the experiences with atmosphere reports in such cases are at the various prosecutors' offices.
Specifiek in het kader van de landelijke aanpak van criminele jeugdgroepen zal het OM nagaan wat bij de verschillende parketten de ervaringen met sfeerverbalen in dergelijke zaken zijn
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Wit en Kooiman over opsporingsberichtgeving en eventuele afspraken tussen het openbaar Ministerie en de media

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and prosecution filming shared with the media was delayed by agreements with media partners, and whether these agreements involve exclusivity or commercial interests. The minister replied that the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving allows urgent broadcasts, that there are fixed media partnerships but no exclusivity and no commercial role, and declined to explain the balancing in a pending case.
I cannot give details about the OM's considerations in an individual pending case on which the judge still has to rule.
Ik kan geen details geven over afwegingen van het OM in een individuele lopende zaak waarover de rechter nog moet oordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de strijd tegen de drugscriminaliteit en de wens van gemeenten wietteelt te legaliseren

MP Kooiman asks the Justice minister about the rising cannabis cultivation problem, police capacity and costs, insurer claims, and whether municipalities may experiment with regulated cannabis cultivation. The minister says the fight against organised cannabis cultivation remains a top priority and cites an integrated approach, but says police capacity is not earmarked and costs are not broken down, and rejects regulated cultivation as contrary to UN, EU and Dutch law, promising only an inventory and a study to be reported by year-end.
Police capacity is not specifically earmarked.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur, Kooiman, Berndsen-Jansen en Oskam over pedofiele praktijken door vrouwen

MPs from VVD, SP, D66 and CDA asked the Justice Minister about a broadcast on female paedophile practices, including whether the conduct is prosecutable, whether a new network exists, and whether police and prosecutors are aware of female offenders. The minister condemned the conduct, said the OM is cooperating with Greek investigators and will assess Dutch prosecution, and confirmed existing awareness of female offenders while referring to earlier answers.

In light of the findings within the Greek investigation, it will be examined whether the conduct is prosecutable under Dutch law, individually or in association, and whether a criminal investigation in the Netherlands is warranted.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen binnen het Griekse opsporingsonderzoek zal worden bezien of gedragingen individueel dan wel in verenigingsverband naar Nederlands recht vervolgbaar zijn en een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Nederland aangewezen is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bestrijden van recidive en het aan het werk zetten van ex-gedetineerden

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the state secretary how to reduce recidivism by helping ex-prisoners find work, including concerns that the Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) blocks ex-offenders from jobs. The state secretary answered that work is important for reintegration but public safety weighs too; VOG refusals are based on case-by-case assessment, the look-back period for adolescents has been shortened, and prison labour is being reorganised.
I consider it important that people have a paid job as soon as possible after their detention, because having work is one of the important conditions for not reoffending.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat mensen zo snel mogelijk na hun detentie weer een betaalde baan hebben omdat het hebben van werk één van de belangrijke voorwaarden is, om niet te recidiveren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat politieagenten nog steeds vaak betrokken zijn bij ongelukken op de weg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police officers are still often involved in road accidents, and why collisions remain high despite driving training becoming obligatory. The minister answered that police driving skills are a priority, that refresher driving training is an internal police policy rather than a statutory requirement, and that new prevention measures and a 2012 damage report will be used to reduce accidents.
After that, there is no statutory obligation for driving training.
Daarna is er geen sprake van een wettelijk verplichte rijtraining.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat Tristan van der V. een wapencontract tekende met zijn vader en politie

An SP MP asked whether Tristan van der V. and his father signed a written agreement to surrender his weapons upon a new depression, and whether police co-signed it. The minister answered that the document was a note from Tristan to his father, found after April 2011 and unknown to police, and that such police-signed agreements with weapon permit holders are not made.
The "contract" referred to in the interrogation concerns a note from Tristan to his father.
Het «contract» waar in het verhoor naar wordt verwezen betreft een briefje van Tristan aan zijn vader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over signalen van misstanden in justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reported misconduct and contraband in two youth detention centres (Amsterbaken and Teylingereind), including treatment of PIJ detainees, staff assaults and smuggled drugs and phones. The State Secretary answered that investigations found no structural shortcomings, described treatment programmes and incidents handled, and promised heightened vigilance and tighter controls.
I have asked the youth detention sector to monitor this closely.
Ik heb de sector JJI gevraagd hierop scherp toe te zien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over NL-Alert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why millions of phone users did not receive the NL-Alert test message, why iPhones and some Samsung phones are not supported, why the test messages are spaced so far apart, and when networks and phones will be ready. The minister answered that NL-Alert is a supplementary system still in development, that Apple has made no commitments, that test messages twice a year are considered sufficient for now, and promised a report on the survey and evaluation within three months.
I will inform your House within three months about this survey and the evaluation.
Ik zal uw Kamer over uiterlijk drie maanden nader informeren over deze peiling en de evaluatie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en De Wit over de financiële tekorten bij het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Kooiman and De Wit asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of excessive workload at the Public Prosecution Service (OM) in Breda, delayed cases, and whether large budget cuts (up to 23 percent) are planned. The minister confirmed the Breda situation is likely not unique, said cuts are needed under the coalition agreement but declined to pre-empt decisions, and promised to inform the House before the spring memorandum.
I am currently considering options to implement the cuts arising from the coalition agreement. I do not consider it appropriate to anticipate these.
Momenteel bezie ik mogelijkheden om uitvoering te geven aan de uit het regeerakkoord voortvloeiende bezuinigingen. Ik acht het niet dienstig daarop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het opzeggen van het lidmaatschap van de Pompidou Groep

MPs Kooiman (SP) asked why the Netherlands ended its membership of the Council of Europe's Pompidou Group, whether its wider harm-reduction work is lost, and whether Dutch drug policy abroad is abandoned. The government answers that the overlap with EU and UN work and budget efficiency justified the exit, that the Netherlands still pursues its drug policy through other international channels, and that the group's added value had eroded.
The Netherlands indeed ended its membership of the Pompidou Group because the overlap with the tasks and scope of the European Union and also the UN has increased.
Nederland heeft inderdaad het lidmaatschap van de Pompidou Groep opgezegd omdat de overlap met de taken en het werkterrein van de Europese Unie en ook de VN zijn toegenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over het bericht dat er steeds meer kinderen in de crisisopvang komen zonder goede hulp

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about reports that more children are entering crisis shelter without adequate help, and why the number of children in social shelter rose from 7,574 in 2008 to 8,791 in 2010. The state secretary said preventing homelessness is the priority, attributed the rise mainly to the financial crisis and divorces, and committed to adapting the Veerkracht method for social shelter with implementation from early 2014.
It is not known how many families across the Netherlands are on a waiting list at all shelter centres.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel gezinnen in heel Nederland bij alle opvangcentra op een wachtlijst staan.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het gebruik van het pistool door agenten in stresssituaties

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police officers are adequately trained to use firearms under stress, whether the 32-hour annual shooting norm is met, and whether training and instruction will be improved. The minister replied that police firearm decisions are generally adequate, that the 32-hour norm applies with a pass rate above 93%, that the Integrale Beroepsvaardighedentraining is being revised with the Politieacademie and instructors, and that the report on the topic is attached.
I will take the findings of the report 'Shoot or not shoot' into account in the revision of the Integrated Professional Skills Training.
Ik zal de uitkomsten van het rapport Schieten of niet schieten betrekken bij de herziening van de Integrale Beroepsvaardigheids Trainingen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten, Kooiman en Van Gerven over het gebruik van DNA uit ziekenhuizen voor opsporingsdoeleinden in strafzaken

MPs Leijten, Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether draft legislation would let justice examine hospital-held DNA for criminal investigations, and whether this breaches purpose limitation and deters patient participation in research. The minister confirmed that draft texts of a Wet zeggenschap lichaamsmateriaal were circulated for pre-consultation, that they are not government-approved, and that the dilemmas will be for the new cabinet to decide, referring to an earlier letter.
The draft texts have therefore not yet been approved by me or by the cabinet.
De concept-teksten zijn dus nog niet door mij of het kabinet geaccordeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over dekkingspercentage en sluiting posten veiligheidsregio Limburg-Noord

MP Kooiman asks the minister about fire-service coverage below 50% in Limburg-Noord and planned closures of posts such as Swalmen. The minister says the region must show compliance with response times and coverage plans, that the regional board is responsible for closures after regionalisation, and that the inspectorate will re-examine coverage in early 2013.
Furthermore, I have asked the chairs of the safety regions to inform me before the end of the year about the update of the regional coverage plan.
Verder heb ik de voorzitters van de veiligheidsregio's verzocht om mij vóór het einde van het jaar te informeren over de actualisatie van het regionale dekkingsplan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het niet afpakken van misdaadgeld door Justitie

MP Kooiman (SP) asked whether the Breda prosecution service reduces confiscation claims against cannabis growers to clear backlogs, and whether this is acceptable. Minister Opstelten answered that crime must never pay and the aim remains full confiscation, refers to earlier answers on the same questions, and says that capacity is addressed in those answers.
Crime must never pay. The aim is and remains to confiscate the financial benefit from all arrested cannabis growers.
Misdaad mag nooit lonen. Het doel is en blijft om bij alle aangehouden hennepkwekers het genoten financiële voordeel af te pakken.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over handhaving van de Visserijwet 1963

MPs Van Gerven and Kooiman asked whether police and green BOAs can check compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963 and whether the designation decree should be changed, and about staffing for fisheries poaching enforcement. The state secretary answered that existing powers under the Code of Criminal Procedure and Article 55 of the Act are sufficient, so no new designation is needed, and gave staffing figures.
I therefore am of the view that enforcement officers, including BOAs and police officers, have sufficient powers to carry out checks on compliance with the Fisheries Act 1963.
Ik ben derhalve van mening dat opsporingsambtenaren, waaronder BOA's en politieagenten, voldoende bevoegdheden hebben om controle uit te voeren op naleving van de Visserijwet 1963.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het onderzoek naar de gebeurtenissen in Haren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the months-long inquiry into the Haren riots is too slow, given the lessons police need and the need for interim findings, and whether the minister would discuss speeding it up with the inquiry committee. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said the committee is working carefully and will issue recommendations as soon as possible, and said the inquiry will be finished earlier if that is possible without sacrificing thoroughness.
The committee is doing its work carefully and thoroughly and will come with recommendations for the police, municipalities and the Public Prosecution Service as soon as possible.
De commissie doet zorgvuldig en degelijk haar werk en zal zo spoedig mogelijk met aanbevelingen komen voor politie, gemeenten en OM.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over zijn uitspraken over de dood van een inbreker (ingezonden 27 september 2012)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to explain his remarks that the death of a burglar in Diessen was a risk the intruder took, and whether these remarks encourage vigilantism and a spiral of violence. The State Secretary answered that he sympathised with homeowners defending themselves within the legal limits of self-defence, that he gave no judgment on the specific incident which is for the courts, and refused to retract his remarks.
That judgment is also not for me, but for the judge.
Dat oordeel is ook niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de afdeling geboortezorg van ziekenhuis De Sionsberg in Dokkum louter om financiële redenen is gesloten

An SP MP asks the health minister whether the closure of the obstetrics unit at De Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum was purely financial, whether the Inspectorate acted too closely with insurer De Friesland, and whether it should reopen. The minister rejects the claim of undue influence, says the inspectorate acted independently and no inquiry into integrity is warranted, and states that the unit closes in May 2013 for quality reasons tied to the hospital's inability to provide 24/7 acute operating-theatre care.
I do not share this finding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman over slachtoffers van internetoplichting die in de kou blijven staan

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about victims of internet fraud left unprotected, including police capacity, the role of marketplace sites and banks, and reversing payments. The minister says the Meldpunt Internetoplichting and the Fraudehelpdesk have improved the approach, that consumers must act cautiously, and that banks decide on action themselves.
A lot has been invested in improving the approach to fraud via auction and sales sites.
Er is veel geïnvesteerd om de aanpak van oplichting via veiling- en verkoopsites te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over klachten over het politie-uniform

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about shortages and waiting lists for police uniform trousers caused by a supplier's failure, and whether budget cuts played a role. The minister answered that the supplier defaulted and went bankrupt, that the shortage has been resolved by contracting new suppliers and building a stock, and that budget cuts played no role.
In September 2011 the contract with the then supplier was extended.
In september 2011 is het contract met de toenmalige leverancier verlengd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de toegenomen drugsoverlast en straathandel in Breda door de wietpas

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported increases in street drug dealing, nuisance and drug runners in Breda after the national introduction of the cannabis pass, and whether the rollout should be halted pending assessment and a parliamentary debate. The minister answered that police act on street dealing, he is in continuous consultation with regional tripartite bodies, early reporting shows fewer drug tourists, and he will report to parliament in October 2012, while declining to halt the policy and noting temporary extra police capacity is being assessed through regional reports.

I am in continuous and intensive consultation with the tripartite bodies in Limburg, North Brabant and Zeeland in order to draw a complete and detailed picture of their experiences in implementing the tightened coffeeshop policy.

Ik ben in continu en intensief overleg met de driehoeken in Limburg, Noord-Brabant en Zeeland ten einde een compleet en gedetailleerd beeld van hun ervaringen in de uitvoering van het aangescherpte coffeeshopbeleid op tekenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de bestuurderssalarissen bij bloedbank Sanquin weer zijn toegenomen

SP MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister why Sanquin's board salaries rose again, questioning whether they comply with the Balkenende norm and the BBZ code. The minister said the increase mirrored staff CAO raises, that existing contracts are respected under the WNT transitional rules, that Sanquin will be pressed to align contracts with the BBZ, and that the departing chair receives no bonuses.
I will hold Sanquin to account on this.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over onder meer de vermindering van het aantal bedden in de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ)

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the minister of Health about the planned one-third cut in GGZ beds by 2020, reported shortages of beds for domestic violence victims, human trafficking victims and GHB addicts, waiting lists, and the RvZ advice. The minister answered that the bed reduction is an ambition to be refined after a baseline measurement and cost-benefit analysis, that there is no national bed shortage, that GHB detox is exempt from bed reduction, and that the RvZ advice is left to a new cabinet.
At this moment there are still no aggregated national figures on developments in 2011.
Op dit moment zijn er nog geen geaggregeerde landelijke cijfers over de ontwikkelingen in 2011.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven over een fusie tussen de ziekenhuizen in Bergen op Zoom en Roosendaal en de concentratie van afdelingen

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the health minister about a planned merger of the Bergen op Zoom and Roosendaal hospitals, including the concentration of maternity and acute care in Bergen op Zoom, and whether a moratorium on mergers applies. The minister replied that until the pending bill on care-specific merger review takes effect, only the NMa may block mergers, that the internal concentration of departments is for the hospitals themselves, and that the hospitals have consulted their councils and staff and will implement planned measures with conditions to be checked by the IGZ.
Until the bill tightening the rules for care-specific merger review takes effect, only the NMa may decide whether to block mergers.
Totdat het wetsvoorstel, waarmee de regels voor zorgspecifieke fusietoetsing worden aangescherpt, van kracht is, is het uitsluitend aan de NMa om fusies al dan niet tegen te houden.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het uitkleden van de ziekenhuiszorg in Noord-Holland

SP MPs asked the health minister about the downgrading of Gemini Hospital in Den Helder, including loss of maternity care, ambulance response times, and whether mergers should be reversed or subjected to a moratorium pending patient and staff participation. The minister replied that the hospital keeps acute, maternity and planned care, that the merger is legally assessed by the NMa, that no moratorium can be imposed due to EU rules, and that stakeholder involvement is handled by the institutions themselves.
It is the responsibility of healthcare institutions themselves to ensure that stakeholders, including at least clients and staff, are involved in a planned concentration of care.

Het is een verantwoordelijkheid van zorginstellingen zelf om, in geval van een voorgenomen concentratie van zorg, ervoor te zorgen dat de belanghebbenden, waaronder in ieder geval cliënten en personeel, worden betrokken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid  Kooiman over het straffen en behandelen van grafschennisplegers

MP Kooiman asked why desecrating or damaging a grave carries a lower penalty than general property damage, why grave desecration is not listed in the pre-trial detention provision, and how mentally ill offenders could get treatment. Minister Opstelten explained the legal distinction, said detention is usually possible when property damage is also an offence, and pointed to reclassering advice, treatment conditions and compulsory care under existing and proposed law.
Why the legislature did not also add article 149 of the Criminal Code to that list is not known, because it was never considered.
Waarom de wetgever aan bedoelde opsomming van strafbare feiten niet ook artikel 149 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht heeft toegevoegd, is niet bekend omdat dit nooit is overwogen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman over de plannen voor een tv-serie over pleegkinderen die hun pleegouders kiezen

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked whether a planned Talpa TV series in which foster children choose their foster parents, and Jeugdzorg Nederland's involvement, respects children's privacy and welfare. The state secretary answered that the current format offers insufficient safeguards, that talks on an adjusted format are ongoing, that she cannot judge the programme until its format is final, and that recruitment is the responsibility of foster care providers.
The current format – in which a young person publicly chooses a foster parent – offers insufficient safeguards and is therefore not appropriate.
Het huidige format – waarin een jeugdige publiekelijk voor een pleegouder kiest – biedt onvoldoende waarborgen en is daarom niet passend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over gegevensbeheer binnen het KLPD

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether data management on the BVH case system at the KLPD was not properly set up, whether people may wrongly be listed as suspects, and whether the KLPD complies with the Wet politiegegevens. The minister admitted the system was temporarily not up to standard, that a small number of people may wrongly be recorded as suspects, and that improvement measures will be completed by October 2012 with an external audit by the end of 2012.
It cannot be entirely ruled out that in a very limited number of cases, persons are wrongly recorded as suspects in the system.
Het is niet geheel uit te sluiten dat in een zeer beperkt aantal gevallen, personen onterecht als verdachte in het systeem staan vermeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de afhandeling van aangiften in Amsterdam

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about the high share (68%) of Amsterdam reports to police that lead to no investigation, its causes, police staffing, and the effect on reporting willingness and crime statistics. The Minister explains that investigation depends on seriousness and available leads, denies a staffing shortage, notes reporting rates have not significantly fallen, and describes ongoing measures to improve the reporting process.

I am of the view that it is necessary to make a selection from all reports and complaints that come in, and I trust that where it is established that further investigation is not called for, this decision is well founded.

Ik ben van mening dat het noodzakelijk is om een selectie te maken uit alle meldingen en aangiften die binnen komen, en vertrouw erop dat indien wordt vastgesteld dat verder onderzoek niet aan de orde is, dit besluit gegrond is.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het zwarte gat na een melding van kindermishandeling

An SP MP asked the state secretary about gaps in child abuse reporting: lack of feedback to reporters, slow investigation timelines, unclear hulp outcomes, training and the multidisciplinary approach. The state secretary responded that action plans, the mandatory reporting code and evaluations are underway, with feedback obligations reinforced via Jeugdzorg Nederland, though data on help provided is not collected and some proposals await evaluation.
Policy information on youth care does not record which types of help parents receive after child abuse has been established.
In de beleidsinformatie jeugd wordt niet bijgehouden bij welke hulpsoorten ouders terecht komen nadat er kindermishandeling is geconstateerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de toename van ouderen met een alcoholprobleem

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Health about the rise in alcohol problems among older people, including the number affected, the availability of help and treatment places, and whether general information is enough. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, estimated 150,000 to 200,000 problem drinkers aged 55 and over, pointed to existing general information and treatment, and said a quickscan of elderly treatment is under way with results expected in autumn, along with a platform and talks with a clients' council.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten over de sluiting van Klaver 6

SP MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about the planned closure of Klaver 6, a small-scale unit for six severely disabled children run by Philadelphia, and whether care quality and staff stability would be protected. The state secretary answered that care will be reorganised into a different location in small clusters rather than cut, that the inspectorate monitors quality, and that the decision lies with the provider.
I ask the IGZ to be extra alert given the emotions at this time.
Ik vraag de IGZ om extra alert te zijn gezien de emoties op dit moment.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de miljoenenschuld van GGD Zuid-Holland Zuid (ingezonden 1 juni 2012).

An SP MP asked the health minister about GGD Zuid-Holland Zuid's multi-million euro debt, the causes, the number of directors, salaries, a possible €5 per-person levy on citizens, and whether other GGD regions face problems. The minister replied that municipalities own the GGDs and are responsible for their financial policy and oversight by municipal councils, so the national government is only systemically responsible and the questions cannot be answered substantively.
The municipalities are the owners of the GGDs and therefore also responsible for financial policy.
De gemeenten zijn eigenaar van de GGD’en en daarmee ook verantwoordelijk voor het financiële beleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over het (niet) aankondigen van inspectiebezoeken aan jeugdgevangenissen

An SP MP asked whether youth prison inspections are announced in advance and whether staff are coached on what to say to inspectors, after a handout of do's and don'ts was reported. The state secretary said youth prison doorlichtingen are always announced, distanced himself from the handout and ordered it withdrawn, and maintained that inspectors can still obtain a truthful picture.
I have distanced myself from the list of do's and don'ts attached to the pre-inspection protocol.
Ik heb afstand genomen van de lijst met do's en don'ts die als bijlage bij het protocol pre-inspectie is gevoegd.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over vermeend seksueel misbruik bij Commujon in Almelo

An SP MP asked the state secretary about alleged sexual abuse at the youth care institution Commujon in Almelo, including the Inspectorate's measures, the lifting of enhanced supervision after a 2011 re-check, and reporting channels for children and parents. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate took action and found the situation sufficiently improved, that reports can be made to the Inspectorate and complaints committees, and that she would not comment on an individual case.
I am not aware of the facts from the report you mention and do not intervene in individual cases.
Ik ben niet bekend met de feiten uit de door u genoemde melding en treed niet in individuele zaken.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat er weer meer comazuipers zijn

An SP MP asks the health minister how she will respond to reports of rising numbers of youths hospitalised for alcohol poisoning, the spread of alcohol clinics, the causes and regional differences, and additional measures. The minister answers that she will tighten enforcement and the Drank- en Horecawet, expand alcohol clinics through 2013, add prevention funding, and promise proposals before summer, while noting that registration is incomplete.
Before the summer you will receive proposals from me for additional steps to counter this terrible trend.
Voor de zomer krijgt u van mij voorstellen om extra stappen te zetten in het tegengaan van deze vreselijke trend.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de voorgenomen sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in Roosendaal

An MP asks the health minister whether the planned closure of the acute obstetrics unit at Roosendaal hospital is acceptable, given quality, travel time and staffing concerns and a SAZ report on concentration of care. The minister answers that the decision rests with the parties after studies on accessibility and quality, that Roosendaal is not crucial for the 45-minute norm, and that she will not intervene to keep the unit open.
Only after these studies are completed will a decision on concentrating acute obstetrics be taken.
Pas nadat deze onderzoeken zijn afgerond zal een besluit over concentratie van de acute verloskunde worden genomen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over herhaalde opnamestops bij de acute verloskunde in Goes

An SP MP asked the health minister how she views repeated admission stops at the acute obstetrics unit in Goes, the concentration of acute obstetric care since 2009, and whether the concentration policy should be re-evaluated. The minister answered that the hospital must resolve the problems quickly, that the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate will supervise closely, and that the concentration policy's link to the stops is not established.
It is important that the ADRZ resolves its problems with great urgency, and the IGZ will supervise this specifically given the crucial function.
Het is van belang dat het ADRZ haar problemen ter zake met grote spoed oplost en de IGZ zal hierop speciaal toezicht houden gezien de cruciale functie.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het voornemen om de verloskundige zorg in Zuid-Limburg te concentreren op één locatie

An SP MP asked the minister whether hospitals in South Limburg plan to concentrate 24-hour midwifery care at one site, and whether this reduces access, choice and quality, and what volume thresholds apply. The minister replied that the hospitals deny talks on concentration (though a merger of Orbis and Atrium is being explored), that no minimum volume norm for obstetric care exists, and that hospitals and insurers must weigh concentration against the accessibility standard.
There is no minimum volume standard for clinical obstetrics.
Er bestaat geen minimum volumenorm voor de klinische verloskunde.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Van Gerven over het bericht dat alsnog sluiting dreigt van de spoedeisende verloskunde in ziekenhuis De Sionsberg

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the minister whether the closure of the acute obstetrics unit at De Sionsberg hospital would raise maternal and infant mortality and why the Health Inspectorate (IGZ) is cooperating. The minister replied that the IGZ acts in the interest of safe care, that the hospital's care plan is under review against quality and accessibility norms, and that she rejects political interference in the inspectorate's quality judgement.
It is the task of the IGZ to assess the preconditions for providing responsible care for risks to the patient.
Het is de taak van de IGZ om de randvoorwaarden voor het leveren van verantwoorde zorg te beoordelen op risico's voor de patiënt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kooiman en Gesthuizen over het aangiftevolgsysteem bij de politie

SP MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked which police forces use the case-tracking systems (AVS, MVS, BVS), whether they are satisfied, how they relate to the new victims' law, and whether forces developing their own software should stop pending the national police. The minister answered that four forces use AVS, twelve use BVS, MVS is nowhere operational, forces are satisfied, a national AVS is being planned, and he agrees forces should stop developing their own software.
I am not aware of this.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over de sluiting van brandweerposten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported closures of fire stations, the regional sign-off process, the link to response times and the role of municipal councils. The minister said the responsibility lies with regional safety boards, deferred concrete figures and response-time findings until the IOOV inspection report due in May 2012, and declined to suspend closures.
Responsibility for closing fire stations lies with the boards of the regional safety regions.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het sluiten van brandweerposten ligt immers bij het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het dumpen van getraumatiseerde agenten

An SP MP asks the Justice minister why police forces reportedly try to get rid of traumatised officers, whether officers with PTSD are denied help, docked pay, forced to pay medical costs, dismissed with hush money, and whether the Haaglanden force erred after Pijnacker. The minister says he has asked forces to follow the registration guideline, will issue an implementing guideline before summer, and has commissioned research into PTSD cases in the police, with results promised before summer's end.
I have meanwhile commissioned an investigation into the number of PTSD cases in the police and the amount of related labour disputes.
Ik heb inmiddels een onderzoek laten opstarten naar het aantal gevallen van PTSS bij de politie en de hoeveelheid daaraan gerelateerde arbeidsconflicten.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de bezuinigingen op jongerenwerkers

MP Kooiman asked the state secretaries whether cuts to youth work in municipalities, and possible disappearance of youth work, would increase nuisance and crime and raise long-term costs, and whether the government would act. The government replied that municipal authorities decide on youth work, that youth work is one intervention among others, and that it has confidence in local choices and no role in agreements on youth work.
It is up to the local government to decide who fulfils which role and therefore how much is invested in local youth work.
Het is aan het lokaal bestuur om te besluiten wie welke rol vervult en dus ook hoeveel wordt geïnvesteerd in lokaal jongerenwerk.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over een storing in het C2000 communicatiesysteem

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a reported outage of the C2000 emergency communication system in the Haaglanden region. The minister answered that only a technical fault in the status-box function at meldkamer workstations occurred, that C2000 communication itself continued, and that the fault was fixed the same day.
The fault reported by the Telegraaf on 12 April 2012 was not a fault in the C2000 network.
De storing waarvan de Telegraaf melding maakte op d.d. 12 april 2012 betrof geen storing in het C2000 netwerk.

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the state secretaries about a Gezondheidsraad recommendation on multidisciplinary child-abuse diagnostics, a national network of Kinder- en Jeugd Traumacentra, the motion on forensic expertise, and professional training on signalling and reporting child abuse. The state secretary answered that regional multidisciplinary initiatives will be tested, a forensic-expertise report and working group are underway, and training is the responsibility of employing organisations and education institutions.
In June you will receive a response from the cabinet to that report.
In juni ontvangt u een reactie van het kabinet op dat rapport.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de gevolgen van de eigen bijdrage in de GGZ voor kwetsbare zwangere vrouwen

Kooiman (SP) asks the health minister about the effects of the new out-of-pocket charge in specialist mental health care on vulnerable pregnant women, including closures of POP clinics, care avoidance, and maternity care costs. The minister defends the charge as a cost-control measure, says no signals of closures or care avoidance have been received, and promises a monitor with first results in September 2012.
I have started a monitor into the effects of the out-of-pocket charge for vulnerable groups in society in general.
Ik heb een monitor gestart naar de effecten van de eigen bijdrage voor kwetsbare groepen in de samenleving in zijn algemeen.

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether Lyme disease is recognised as an occupational disease under the police legal status decree and whether it therefore qualifies for pain-and-suffering compensation. The minister confirmed both points, answering all three questions in the affirmative.
Yes, Lyme disease is recognised as an occupational disease within the meaning of the General Legal Status of Police Decree.
Ja, De ziekte van Lyme is erkend als een beroepsziekte in de zin van het Besluit algemene rechtspositie politie.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Gesthuizen over de verstoorde 112 dienstverlening

MPs Kooiman and Gesthuizen asked the minister why a back-up system for the 112 emergency line was not used immediately during the KPN outages and whether such a system should always be deployed at once. The minister answered that a back-up network exists, was used during the 31 March outage, and that deploying it immediately is not always necessary, with additional agreements made with KPN.
Additional agreements have now been made with KPN on the accessibility and risk management of the 112 network.
Met KPN zijn inmiddels aanvullende afspraken gemaakt over de bereikbaarheid en het risicomanagement van het 112-netwerk.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat een rechter geen ondertoezichtstelling heeft uitgesproken van een foetus van 17 weken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the court's refusal to place a 17-week foetus under supervision was acceptable, what safety measures were taken for the 18-year-old mother, and whether supervision could be extended or lowered in age limits. The State Secretary said the judiciary decides on supervision, a safety plan was in place (details withheld for privacy and security), a new interim supervision was granted at 24 weeks, and a general age change was neither desirable nor possible.
It is for the judge to assess whether a situation warrants supervision (ots).
Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of een situatie ots-waardig is.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de toerusting en verantwoordelijkheden van gezinsvoogden

MPs Kooiman (SP) asked seven questions about the power and training of child protection guardians (gezinsvoogden), following a Vara Ombudsman broadcast, including the timing of disciplinary law for youth care, mandatory continuing training, caseload and mentoring for new guardians, parents' right to respond to the plan of action, judges' time per case, and complaints handling. The state secretary answered that professionalisation via registration and disciplinary law is being prepared, that parents may already add their views and the bureaus will be reminded of this, and that complaints handling will be unified through provincial policy frameworks, while leaving caseloads and judges' time largely to the sector and the judiciary.
Parents also have the right to add their own opinion to a report or petition.
Ouders hebben ook het recht om hun eigen mening aan een rapport of verzoekschrift toe te voegen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman met betrekking tot de inzet van BOA’s

An SP MP asks the Justice minister whether BOAs (special investigating officers) will take over police tasks, which tasks, training, and whether this weakens police quality and structure. The minister answers that BOAs in shopping areas will be allowed to handle simple shoplifting without violence as a complement to police, with additional training, and that the total enforcement capacity will be used effectively.
These BOAs are only deployed for shoplifting where no violence is used.
De boa’s worden alleen ingezet bij een winkeldiefstal waar geen geweld bij is gebruikt.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over de sluiting van politiebureaus in Amsterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether 15 of Amsterdam's 32 neighbourhood police stations would close under the new national police, and about accessibility, staffing cuts and whether plans were being made to close stations. The Minister denied the 15-station figure, called closure statements premature, said plans would not be adopted before the Senate approved the police bill, and stated that operational strength would remain at 49,500 fte.
Statements about the possible closure of neighbourhood offices are premature.
Uitspraken over het mogelijk sluiten van wijkbureaus zijn prematuur.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bekeuren door particuliere beveiligers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Amsterdam will appoint private security guards as temporary special investigating officers to issue fines, how they are screened and trained, and who is responsible for their conduct. The minister answered that these guards are limited to enforcing local bylaws and parking rules, are screened and examined like other boa's, and that the municipality as employer and the police and Public Prosecution Service supervise them.
The lending company and the borrowing employers take labour-law measures where necessary if the conduct of the boa or supervisor is not acceptable.
Het uitlenende bedrijf en de inlenende werkgevers nemen zo nodig arbeidsrechtelijke stappen als de gedragingen van de boa/toezichthouder niet door de beugel kunnen.
Antwoord van het lid Kooiman over overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet door de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported violations of the Working Hours Act by police forces, including causes, consequences for officers, and whether staffing is adequate. The minister answered that monitoring showed about 180,000 violations in the first half of 2011, that causes and measures are deferred to an Inspectorate SZW report, and that police capacity choices and productivity are the government's focus.

For the causes of the violations and the short- and long-term measures I intend to take, I refer you to the recently conducted Inspectorate SZW investigation and my response to it, which you will receive from me in the coming days.

Voor de oorzaken van de overschrijdingen en de korte en lange termijn maatregelen die ik wil treffen, verwijs ik u naar het recent uitgevoerde onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW en mijn reactie daarop, die u een dezer dagen van mij ontvangt.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over problemen bij de examinering in het politieonderwijs

An SP MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about examination backlogs at the Police Academy, which he links to ending side-job examiners, and asks whether the policy was ill-advised, how large the backlog is and how candidates will be informed. The minister explains the change as a principled shift to on-duty certified examiners, acknowledges a backlog of 264 exams, promises resolution by 1 August 2012 and notification with apologies to affected candidates.
I have agreed with the Police Academy's executive board that the examination problems will be resolved by 1 August 2012 at the latest.
Ik heb met het college van Bestuur van de politieacademie afgesproken dat uiterlijk per 1 augustus 2012 de problemen met de examinering zullen zijn opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kooiman over de financiering van Multi Systeem Therapie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why Multi Systemic Therapy for youths is mostly funded through health insurance rather than justice, and whether budget cuts and a limited number of justice-ordered treatments threaten its availability, including in Overijssel. The State Secretary said MST is promoted where suited to a youth's risk profile, that most MST is funded via health insurance by agreement with the provinces, that the justice-funded GBM placements are limited, and that capacity matters are for the youth probation services, GGZ providers and insurers, with a promised official-level consultation and later update.
I will inform you shortly about the outcomes of this consultation.
Ik zal u binnenkort over de uitkomsten van dit overleg informeren.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het bericht dat Nederland de hoogste boetes heeft van Europa

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security minister whether Dutch traffic fines were raised to fill the state treasury, whether this relates to ending ticket quotas, and what evidence links higher fines to road safety. The minister replied that fines aim to improve compliance and road safety, cited WODC research showing deterrent effects, estimated extra revenue of about €70 million, and reported no clear discretionary shift among officers.
The increase in traffic fines is primarily intended to improve compliance with traffic rules.
De verhoging van de verkeersboetes is primair bedoeld om de naleving van de verkeersregels te verbeteren.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman Identiteitsfraude op sociale media

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether identity theft on social media causes serious harm, what civil and criminal remedies victims have, and whether a new criminal offence of identity theft (proposed by Bénédicte Ficq) is needed. The Minister answered that existing civil remedies, platform abuse procedures and criminal provisions are sufficient, that a new offence would be hard to enforce given online anonymity and foreign-based platforms, and that he does not support the proposal.
