In my expectation, no adequate solution can be expected from the use of criminal law to stop the use of another person's name on social media sites.
Naar mijn verwachting valt van de inzet van het strafrecht kortom geen adequate oplossing te verwachten om het gebruik van andermans naam op sociale mediasites te stoppen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over over het bericht dat kraamverzorgenden nog steeds niet geschoold worden in EHBO vaardigheden

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister why midwifery aides (kraamverzorgenden) still are not trained in first aid and life-saving skills despite an adopted motion, and what would be done about it. Minister Schippers answered that the training is expected to be added via employers and insurers in bij- en nascholing, pointed to a pending NZa tariff review, and said the existing basic training is adequate, with an evaluation underway.
Given the importance of keeping knowledge and skills on first aid up to date, I expect that care providers will include first aid in in-service and refresher training.
Gezien het belang van het up-to-date houden van kennis en vaardigheden op het terrein van EHBO, verwacht ik dat EHBO door de kraamzorgaanbieders wordt meegenomen in de bij- en nascholing.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over opkomsttijden in Petten e.o (ingezonden 1 december 2011).

MP Kooiman asked whether NRG's company fire brigade stopping service outside its site from 1 January 2012 would lengthen response times in Petten to 15-17 minutes, and whether the safety region's compliance with statutory norms and the free smoke detectors were acceptable. The State Secretary answered that the safety region's board imposed the staffing requirements, that response times would rise to 15-17 minutes, that the board will assess Petten against the norm in a review programme, and that he sees no reason to doubt fire safety.

The general board of the Noord-Holland Noord Safety Region will ultimately decide, through the cost-benefit assessment mentioned earlier, whether to take structural improvement measures or to deviate from the statutory norm with reasons.

Het algemeen bestuur van de Veiligheidsregio Noord-Holland Noord zal uiteindelijk door middel van de eerder genoemde kosten-batenafweging besluiten tot het nemen van structurele verbetermaatregelen of het gemotiveerd afwijken van de wettelijke norm.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het recordaantal dakloze jongeren (ingezonden 12

MPs Kooiman and Karabulut asked about a record number of homeless youths in shelters, rising child and youth admissions, debt, benefit levels, the four-week job-search period for young people leaving care or prison, and cooperation between municipalities, youth care and shelters. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said the causes were not yet clear, pointed to municipalities' lead role and listed support programmes and handbooks, while declining to draw up a new action plan.
The cabinet has no intention of drawing up a new action plan.
Het kabinet heeft geen voornemens om een nieuw actieplan op te stellen.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over het gesteggel rond de financiering van de extra ambulance op de Kop van Walcheren en het geboortecentrum in Vlissingen

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister about the dispute over funding an extra ambulance on Walcheren and the Vlissingen birth centre, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister says the NZa has independently raised the Connexxion budget retroactively and that the birth centre stays open, while stressing the NZa's independence and placing responsibility for regional care with insurers and providers.
I am politically responsible for the functioning of the NZa as a whole. However, in its judgement the NZa is independent.
Ik ben politiek verantwoordelijk voor het functioneren van de NZa als geheel. In haar oordeelsvorming is de NZa echter onafhankelijk.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Leijten over de gevolgen van de bezuinigingen op de GGZ voor de politie

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked whether cuts to mental health care (GGZ) and the introduction of patient contributions would increase police workload and crime, and whether such effects will be monitored and registered. The ministers answer that a monitor will track whether patient charges deter care use, that the police and GGZ have agreed new cooperation arrangements, and that registration of GGZ-related nuisance is only partly in place and will be developed regionally.
Whether the introduction of the patient contribution actually leads to avoidance of care will be closely monitored by the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport via a monitor this year.
Of de invoering van de eigen bijdrage daadwerkelijk leidt tot zorgmijding volgt de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport dit jaar nauwlettend via een monitor.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het handelen van een politiechef (ingezonden 5 december 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a police chief acted lawfully in trying to identify a newspaper letter writer (requesting data from the newspaper, a handwriting comparison via the NFI, and related steps) and whether the subsequent suspension and dismissal of the officer were justified. The minister answered that no criminal investigation was needed, that the newspaper voluntarily supplied the name, that the disciplinary process was lawful, and that the dismissal was on 'other grounds' upheld by the Central Council of Appeal, but gave no admission of wrongdoing by the chief.
No authorisation from a public prosecutor is required for such a request.
Voor een dergelijk verzoek is geen machtiging van een officier van justitie nodig.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Jasper Van Dijk over het bericht dat er fors bezuinigd wordt op het schoolmaatschappelijk werk

Two SP MPs asked whether reported large cuts to school social work, which reduce oversight of children with problems at home, would be reversed and whether municipalities cutting prevention conflicts with passend onderwijs and youth care reform. The state secretary answered that school social work is important but that municipalities and schools must decide themselves, that the government does not track cut amounts and will not investigate, and that prevention is a goal of the youth care reform.
I am not aware of how many municipalities are cutting back on school social work.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel gemeenten bezuinigen op het schoolmaatschappelijk werk.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven en Kooiman over de dreigende sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in ziekenhuis de Sionsberg te Dokkum

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the minister whether the acute obstetrics unit at Sionsberg hospital in Dokkum would close and how the 45-minute access norm and maternal safety would be guaranteed. The minister answered that care providers must draw up a regional maternity care plan by 1 May 2012, that regular births continue meanwhile, and that the Inspectorate will review the plan, while leaving much of the responsibility to providers and insurers.
The care providers are responsible for drawing up a coherent plan for maternity care.
De zorgaanbieders zijn aan zet om een samenhangend plan voor de geboortezorg op te stellen.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat middelengebruik in de jeugdzorg en het speciaal onder

MP Kooiman asked the state secretary and minister whether they would respond to reports that youth in youth care and special education use substances more, and start younger, than other young people, and what would be done about prevention, targeted information and staff training. The ministers answered that the findings are concerning but not surprising, pointed to early-detection guidelines, the Gezonde School and Open en Alert programmes, and a new youth-care system, and said they consider current initiatives sufficient while agreeing staff need better tools.
The Healthy School and Substances programme is being extended to special secondary education.
Het programma De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen wordt uitgebreid naar het speciaal voortgezet onderwijs.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het rapport politiekorps Limburg-Zuid (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

SP MP Kooiman asked the minister about a critical visitation report on police force Limburg-Zuid, including whether the report would be shared, the chief's priorities, the force's culture, and her suitability as regional transition manager. The state secretary sent the public report, referred to earlier answers on substance, said the quality of police work is sufficient, noted the appointment procedure for transition managers, and summarised the less critical Limburg-Noord visitation.
The visitation committee's report and the underlying documents are public, in line with the explanatory memorandum to the 24 June 1999 police quality-assurance decree.
Het rapport van de visitatiecommissie en de daaraan ten grondslag liggende documenten zijn – conform de MvT van het besluit kwaliteitszorg politie 24 juni 1999 – openbaar.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie, van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Financiën over het tekort in de ouderenpot bij de politie (ingezonden 16 december 2011).

Kooiman (SP) asked ministers why a 700 million euro shortfall arose in the police early-retirement scheme, who is responsible, and whether officers will bear the cost. The state secretary attributed the shortfall to incorrect population assumptions, said the scheme is being revised in ongoing CAO negotiations, and declined to set a firm timeline beyond an intention to reach agreement in spring.
The parties have expressed the intention to reach an agreement this spring.
Partijen hebben de intentie uitgesproken om dit voorjaar tot een akkoord te komen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over interlandelijke adoptie uit de Verenigde Staten (ingezonden 15 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the Netherlands still upholds the subsidiarity principle in intercountry adoption under the Hague Convention, and how a US practice allowing birth parents to choose adoptive families fits with it, including whether domestic placement must still be shown. The State Secretary answered yes, relying on US counseling, court review and Dutch Central Authority checks, arguing the US procedure satisfies the convention's 'due consideration' requirement.

I am of the view that if the American adoption agency has drawn up a careful adoption plan and the judge reviews whether the subsidiarity principle has been sufficiently satisfied, the Netherlands can agree with that.

Ik ben van mening dat als door het Amerikaanse adoptiebureau een zorgvuldig adoptieplan is gemaakt en de rechter toetst of er in voldoende mate is voldaan aan het subsidiariteitsbeginsel, Nederland daarmee kan instemmen.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman over het tekort aan (crisis)pleeggezinnen

MP Kooiman asked the state secretary about a shortage of crisis foster placements and foster families, including in Amsterdam, and questions on recruitment campaigns and cross-regional placement. The state secretary answered that provinces and regions are responsible for youth care and foster care, that the policy of helping children within nine weeks continues, that national figures on waiting foster parents are unavailable, and that the recruitment campaign was handed over to Pleegzorg Nederland on 1 January 2012.
No figures are available on this at national level.
Op landelijk niveau zijn hierover geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Ulenbelt (beiden SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de crèches leeglopen (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether childcare centres are emptying, why parents cancel care, and how parents on low incomes can keep paying. The minister replied that the Belastingdienst figures still show growth in childcare allowance recipients, that a CPB ex-post analysis is underway, that the FNV survey on parents quitting work is unrepresentative, and that the effects of cuts will be monitored.
The effect of the cuts to childcare allowance in 2012 on the various income groups is being closely monitored; in my view additional research for this is not necessary.
Het effect van de bezuinigingen op de kinderopvangtoeslag in 2012 voor de verschillende inkomensgroepen wordt nauwlettend in de gaten gehouden; extra onderzoek hiervoor is mijns inziens niet nodig.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat De Jutters logeerhuizen moet sluiten (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

Two SP MPs asked why De Jutters must close its respite-care guesthouses for children in the Haaglanden region, whether families are left without alternatives, and how the government will prevent losses. The state secretary answered that the closures followed a financial analysis by the provider amid fewer short-stay indications, pointed to alternative respite forms, and said the government has no role in individual contract negotiations between the care office and providers.
I have no role in the negotiations between the care office and individual institutions.
Ik heb geen rol bij de onderhandelingen tussen het zorgkantoor en individuele instellingen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de instroom van nieuwe aspiranten bij de Politieacademie (ingezonden 9 december 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the intake of new police cadets at the Police Academy for 2011 and 2012, including whether the 1850 target was met, attrition, workload for teachers, and the new curriculum. The minister answered that 1890 cadets were appointed in 2011, that 22 left early, that intake will be spread across six locations with a peak in 2012, and that practical supervision will be standardised under the national police reorganisation.
I will closely monitor the implementation of these agreements.
Ik zal de uitvoering van deze afspraken nauwlettend volgen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de financiering van Multi Systeem Therapie (ingezonden 24 november 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice why Multi Systemic Therapy, an evidence-based youth programme, is funded by justice only in certain criminal-law frameworks, whether this reflects budget cuts, and how the government will promote it. The State Secretary answers that MST is funded via the WMO and Zvw, that justice temporarily funds it for one framework pending evaluation, and that a demand-oriented approach applies, so no single programme will be promoted.
Because this is a severe target group with a high recidivism risk, it was decided at the time to temporarily fund the use of programmes within this measure, including MST, through Justice.
Omdat hier sprake is van een zware doelgroep met een hoog recidiverisico, is destijds besloten de inzet van programma's binnen deze maatregel, waaronder MST, tijdelijk door Justitie te financieren.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat forensisch-medisch onderzoek belangrijk is bij de aanpak van kindermishan

Kooiman (SP) asked two state secretaries about the Forensische Polikliniek Kindermishandeling's funding, its capacity, and whether forensic medical knowledge is used enough by professionals in child abuse cases. The government answered that it is working on a standardised referral chain and a social map, and that the Justice pilot funding is temporary pending evaluation, with a decision promised before summer 2012.
Afterwards the Minister of Security and Justice will decide on possible structural engagement of market parties for forensic research.
Daarna beslist de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over een eventuele structurele inschakeling van marktpartijen voor forensisch onderzoek.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over sluiting van brandweerpost Lage Mierde (ingezonden 2 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about the closure of the Lage Mierde fire station, the dismissal of 16 volunteers, response times exceeding norms, and whether the extended response times were a generic loosening of standards. The minister answered that the regional safety board had found the closure justified, that response-time deviations are permitted per object under the Besluit veiligheidsregio's, and that he would await the IOOV investigation before acting.
In anticipation of the IOOV investigation, I do not wish to go into the coverage plans and discussions of individual municipalities.
Ik wil vooruitlopend op het onderzoek dat de IOOV uitvoert niet ingaan op de dekkingsplannen en discussies van afzonderlijke gemeenten.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over vrijgeven beeldmateriaal (ingezonden 30 november 2011).

The MP asked whether the KLPD has contracts with media companies for releasing police footage, what they contain, whether any fee is charged, and whether released material should be freely usable. The minister answered that there are no contracts, only a standing cooperation with AVRO's Opsporing Verzocht and non-binding letters of intent with some media, with no fee and no exclusivity.
There is no question of contracts.
Er is geen sprake van contracten.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de start van de dierenpolitie (ingezonden 30 november 2011).

MP Kooiman asked the Justice minister whether police chiefs opposed the animal police, whether an internal note will be shared, and how many officers trained and work in it. The minister said the animal police stems from the coalition agreement, declined to share the internal note as it was part of internal preparation, and stated that 131 specially trained officers will be working by end 2011.
No, this concerns an internal note that played a role in preparing the current policy.
Nee, het betreft hier een interne notitie, die een rol heeft gespeeld bij de voorbereiding van het huidige beleid.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat het Landelijk Expertisecentrum Diversiteit (LECD) van de politie dreigt uiteen te vallen door ruzies en machtsmisbruik (inge

The SP MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the police diversity expertise centre LECD risks collapsing due to internal conflicts and abuse of power, including whether it has enough diverse staff and expertise. The minister replied that the Police Academy has commissioned an independent investigation, with results expected by 1 March 2012, and will inform the House of the outcomes and any measures.
The Police Academy is having an independent investigation carried out into the situation reported by the programme Nieuwsuur.
De Politieacademie laat een onafhankelijk onderzoek verrichten naar de situatie waarover het programma Nieuwsuur heeft bericht.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de veiligheid op kinderdagverblijven niet is verbeterd (ingezonden 14 december 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that daycare safety had not improved, including a survey showing most daycare centres do not apply the 'four-eyes principle'. The minister rejected the general conclusion, said the principle is to be specified by industry parties within six months, and said legislation would follow if they fail, with municipalities enforcing once it is codified.
The cabinet has agreed with the covenant parties in childcare that they will come with a proposal for this practice within six months after 11 July.
Het kabinet heeft met de convenantpartijen in de kinderopvang afgesproken dat zij binnen zes maanden na 11 juli jl. met een voorstel voor deze uitvoeringspraktijk zullen komen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het stoppen van seksuele voorlichting op scholen (ingezonden 6 december 2011).

MP Kooiman asks the health minister how the government will ensure municipalities can carry out their legal duty to combat sexually transmitted infections after GGD reports of ending school sex education due to cuts, and whether municipal prevention money should be earmarked. The minister replies that the national government has no plans to cut sex education, that municipalities are responsible for their own budgets within the law, and that earmarking does not fit decentralisation.
I assume that municipalities carry out their statutory tasks, as laid down in the Public Health Act.
Ik ga er vanuit dat gemeenten hun wettelijke taken, zoals vastgelegd in de Wet publieke gezondheid, uitvoeren.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de dreigende sluiting van de afdeling acute verloskunde in Meppel (ingezonden 14 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about the threatened closure of the acute obstetrics unit in Meppel, whether the 45-minute access norm would be breached, and how the unit would be kept open. The minister replied that closure was not currently planned, that a regional hospital vision was pending, that the 45-minute norm would be upheld, and that the IGZ would report on staffing norms in early 2012.
I maintain the 45-minute norm without compromise.
Ik houd onverkort vast aan de 45-minutennorm.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij (SGP), Dijsselbloem (PvdA), Kooiman (SP), Koşer Kaya (D66), Voortman (GroenLinks) en Wiegman-van Meppelen Scheppink (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn e

Six MPs asked the state secretary of Health why the Stichting Adoptievoorzieningen faces an extra structural cut to its aftercare subsidy on top of an earlier 1.5% efficiency cut, and whether this is disproportionate given a further cut from Justice. The state secretary answered that the cuts are justified by falling adoption numbers, that adoption-specific aftercare will largely remain, and that alternatives exist, and left the decision on a pending SGP amendment to the Chamber.
The budget cut obligation has forced me to make choices.
De bezuinigingstaakstelling heeft mij genoodzaakt keuzes te maken.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de ontwikkelingen rond het bijstaan van slachtoffers in een strafproces (ingezonden 9 september 2011).

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked whether stricter application of rules for granting legal aid (toevoeging) to aggrieved parties in criminal proceedings weakens victims' position, notably for those with moderate injuries and domestic violence victims. The state secretary replied that the rules have not changed, that Slachtofferhulp Nederland is the primary support route with exceptions for complex cases, and that victims' position has been strengthened by recent legislation.
The policy on granting the legal aid allowance has been harmonised for all regional offices.
Het beleid omtrent het verstrekken van de toevoeging is voor alle regiokantoren geharmoniseerd.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat tankstations vanaf november alcohol gaan verkopen (ingezonden 20 oktober 2011).

An MP asked whether the government would enforce the ban on alcohol sales at petrol stations after industry plans to resume sales, including threats to restock and sell spirits. The minister said the plan violates the Drank- en Horecawet, committed to enforcement by the nVWA with escalating fines and possible criminal prosecution, and declined to commit to closing stations.
This intention is in violation of Article 22, first paragraph, under a, of the Drink and Catering Act.
Dit voornemen is in strijd met artikel 22, eerste lid, onder a, van de Drank- en Horecawet.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over camping Fort Oranje (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

An SP MP asks the Interior and Infrastructure ministers about the closure of camping Fort Oranje in Zundert, the housing of vulnerable people there, and whether other municipalities enforce against illegal residence on campsites. The ministers answer that a court has suspended the closure, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement and need not report to central government, and that responsibility for rehousing lies mainly with the residents and municipalities of origin.
Municipalities have no obligation to inform central government about this.
Gemeenten hebben geen verplichting het rijk hierover te informeren.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de verloskundige zorg ongelijk verdeeld is in Nederland (ingezonden 5 oktober 2011).

MP Kooiman asks the minister about reports that midwifery care is unevenly distributed across the Netherlands, the norm of 105 births per midwife, the absence of a capacity forecast since 2005, and a 4 million euro cut. Minister Schippers answers that no shortage or access problem is known, the distribution follows midwives' own settlement choices, the cut targets overruns above the already-adjusted norm, and she will ask the College Perinatale Zorg to analyse the findings.
Nevertheless, I will ask the College Perinatale Zorg to analyse the findings further and report to me on them.
Niettemin zal ik het College Perinatale Zorg vragen om de bevindingen nader te analyseren en mij hierover te rapporteren.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Smits (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de Voor- en Vroegschoolse Educatie (VVE) niet werkt (ing

MPs Kooiman and Smits asked ministers about a study reporting that early childhood education (VVE) programmes do not improve children's development, and about related quality, grouping and funding concerns. The government answered that quality of implementation is decisive, pointed to new quality requirements and the Inspectorate's oversight, declined to send the Utrecht study to parliament, and promised a later letter on quality policy.
No, the cabinet will not send the research report of Utrecht University to the House.
Nee, het kabinet gaat het onderzoeksrapport van de Universiteit Utrecht niet aan de Kamer verzenden.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat kinderen die ernstig worden bedreigd in hun ontwikkeling te weinig hulp krijgen (ingezonden 12 augustus 2011).

Deputy MP Kooiman asks the state secretary about reports that children seriously threatened in their development receive too little help at Bureau Jeugdzorg Rotterdam, including whether children placed in a management team (beheerteam) with heavy caseloads is acceptable. The state secretary replies that a beheerteam is undesirable but may be temporary, that children must get care and supervision, that the Deltamethode caseload of 1:15 should be kept, and that a financial audit of Bureau Jeugdzorg Rotterdam will follow, while declining to fund a study of the effects of beheerteams.
Children subject to a child protection measure must immediately receive the necessary care and supervision.
Kinderen waarover een kinderbeschermingsmaatregel is uitgesproken moeten direct de noodzakelijke zorg en toezicht krijgen.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat een pleegkind tegen de wil van de biologische ouder een geloofswijziging

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about a report that a foster child was baptised against the wishes of his biological parent, and whether Bureau Jeugdzorg, as guardian, could consent to such a change of religion. The government declined to assess the individual case, stated that religious background is the guiding principle under the Wet op de jeugdzorg, and said the Inspectie Jeugdzorg oversees this.
We do not judge individual cases.
Wij treden niet in de beoordeling van individuele zaken.
Vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de financiële problemen van Zonnehuizen (ingezonden 23 september 2011).

MPs Leijten and Kooiman asked the state secretary about Stichting Zonnehuizen's financial trouble, complaints ignored for years, the role of the IGZ inspectorate, the missing EUR 20 million, board conduct and the risk of closure. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate visited regularly, that board and supervisory board resigned in 2011, that early-warning rules for financial problems are proposed, and that closure risk is addressed in a separate letter.

Following the results of the supervision carried out, the inspectorate in early April 2011 called the Board of Management and the Supervisory Board to account for care that was deficient in parts and certain unsafe situations.

Naar aanleiding van de resultaten van het uitgevoerde toezicht heeft de inspectie begin april 2011 de Raad van Bestuur en de Raad van Toezicht ter verantwoording geroepen over de op onderdelen tekortschietende zorg en bepaalde onveilige situaties.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de procedures rondom erkenning en gezag over kinderen geboren buiten het huwelijk (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asked why the mother automatically holds custody of a child born outside marriage while the recognising father must go through recognition plus a court custody application, and whether this differentiation should be abolished. The State Secretary defended the current system as serving the child's interest, said the procedure is not more burdensome than in neighbouring countries, and agreed to answer before the committee debate.
Having two legal parents where possible is, in my view, in the child's interest.
Het waar mogelijk hebben van twee juridische ouders, acht ik in het belang van het kind.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat jeugdzorginstellingen signalen van seksueel misbruik onvoldoende oppikken (ingezonden 22 juni 2011).

MP Kooiman asked the state secretary how youth care institutions can better recognise signals of sexual abuse, following the Samson commission's finding and the motion on training professionals for the referral index and reporting code. The state secretary answered that training and reporting-code modules are being rolled out, a sector quality framework addresses open culture, and sexual education programmes exist, while promising to use the Samson final report to assess further improvements.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman, Karabulut en Paulus Jansen (allen SP) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het woningaanbod voor specifieke doelgroepen

SP MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health about housing supply for vulnerable groups, including homeless people, youth leaving youth care, ex-psychiatric patients, ex-prisoners, families living in anti-squat arrangements or campsites, and forced evictions by housing associations. Minister Donner answered that most data are unavailable, cited partial CorpoData figures, rejected stricter reporting requirements for associations, declined further research on campsite living, and said municipalities can use urgency declarations to prioritise these groups.
I am not in favour of an accountability obligation at this detailed level.
Ik ben geen voorstander van verantwoordingsplicht op dit gedetailleerde niveau.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de Landelijke Vereniging van Bloed- en Plasmadonoren (LVB), (aspirant)donoren zal adviseren om

SP MPs asked the health minister how she would respond to a report that the blood donor association LVB would advise donors to stop giving blood over Sanquin board salaries, and whether she would ask board members to cut their pay. The minister called the advice irresponsible, said she has no legal instruments to intervene in existing board contracts, and refused to ask board members to give up salary, while noting new appointees will be paid under the BBZ and WNT norms.
I have no (legal) instruments at my disposal to intervene in existing contracts.
Ik heb geen (juridische) instrumenten tot mijn beschikking om in reeds bestaande contracten in te grijpen.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de beloning van de Raad van Bestuur van bloedbank Sanquin vorig jaar opnieuw fors is toegenome

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister how she views the rise in Sanquin board pay, with individual salaries up to 258,000 euros above the Balkenende norm, what she will do about it, whether it could harm donor willingness, and how she will ensure compliance with the BBZ care pay code. The minister explained the increase by a 2010 board change and indexation, said the two sitting board members' contracts still exceed the BBZ norms, pointed to a pending normeringswet covering Sanquin, and rejected a donor boycott as irresponsible.
The salary of the two sitting Sanquin board members is still under their earlier contracts, and that exceeds the BBZ norms, so in that respect it is too high.
Het salaris van de twee zittende bestuurders van Sanquin is nog steeds volgens hun eerder gesloten contract. En dat ligt boven de normen van de BBZ en in dat opzicht is het te hoog.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Smits (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de gesloten jeugdzorg v

SP MPs asked why the school inside the closed youth care facility Transferium in Heerhugowaard received no national housing funding, whether ministries were coordinating, and whether a one-off payment or cost-based funding would be provided. The ministers answered that municipalities are responsible for school housing via the general Municipal Fund, that no earmarked funding exists, and that they will not provide a one-off payment, cost-based funding, or joint consultation.
Responsibility for school housing is clearly assigned, namely to the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor onderwijshuisvesting is duidelijk belegd, namelijk bij de gemeente.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het Admiraal de Ruyter Ziekenhuis zwangere vrouwen commerciële pretecho’s aanbiedt (ingezonden 8 augustus 2011).

MP Kooiman asked the health minister whether a hospital offering commercial non-medical 'pretecho' scans to pregnant women is acceptable, how much revenue it earns, whether patients are steered toward them, and whether such commercial activity erodes hospital authority. The minister found no objection provided no public money funds the service and the distinction from medical scans is clear, reported about EUR 15,000 a year going to general funds, denied active recruitment, and saw no reason to act.
I therefore see no reason whatsoever to take action against this.
Ik zie dan ook geen enkele aanleiding hiertegen op te treden.
Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de kinderopvang onbetaalbaar wordt door kabinetsbezuinigingen (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare is becoming unaffordable due to cabinet cuts, citing a report of falling demand and whether the Minister will send the report, help parents who withdraw children, and ensure affordable care. The Minister replies that the cuts raise parental costs but remain necessary, that the report's effect is likely overstated, that demand rises in day care and after-school care, and that childcare remains affordable with the childcare allowance.
Due to this cabinet's cuts, childcare indeed becomes more expensive for parents.
Door de bezuinigingen van dit kabinet wordt kinderopvang inderdaad duurder voor ouders.
Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat er een explosieve groei is van te bouwen verloskamers in ziekenhuizen (ingezonden 29 juli 2011).

MP Kooiman asks the health minister about reports of a surge in new delivery rooms, closures of maternity wards such as in Oss and Amsterdam-Noord, travel times and referrals during childbirth, and pain relief options. The minister says there is no evidence of a building surge, insists on the 45-minute ambulance access norm, reports no concrete closure plans for Amsterdam-Noord and that referrals in Utrecht are rare, and promises further data and advice on pain relief.
I have no insight into the number of delivery rooms currently being added.
Ik heb geen inzicht in het aantal verloskamers dat op dit moment wordt bijgebouwd.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over illegale adopties uit China (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports of illegal adoptions from China, including alleged child seizures, payments to social welfare institute directors, and whether adoptions should stop. The State Secretary answered that the abuses date from 2000–2005, that China has started its own investigation, that the Hague Convention framework relies on mutual trust and oversight by the Central Authority, and that adoptions from China will not be halted for now.
For now, I therefore see no reason to halt intercountry adoptions from China.
Vooralsnog zie ik daarom geen aanleiding om interlandelijke adopties uit China stop te zetten.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de zwarte lijst met illegale kansspelaanbieders voor banken (ingezonden 15 juni 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the status of a blacklist of illegal online gambling operators that banks were supposed to block, and why the Dutch banking association said it never received it. The state secretary said the list was sent in 2010 but the banks doubted its legitimacy, a new updated list is being prepared for autumn, and he will not publish the list but may share it confidentially with parliament.
Publication of the list is undesirable in my view, as it contains sensitive information.
Openbaarmaking van de lijst acht ik ongewenst, aangezien deze gevoelige informatie bevat.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat kinderen die ernstig worden bedreigd in hun ontwikkeling op de wachtlijst komen te staan (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary about Bureau Jeugdzorg Amsterdam and Rotterdam creating waiting lists or caseload-management teams for children seriously threatened in their development, including caseload levels, waiting times and budget shortfalls. The secretary called waiting lists undesirable but said the child's safety stays paramount, that municipalities and regions must supervise waiting lists, and that a research into youth-protection tariffs was commissioned, while providing limited current data.
Setting up a waiting list or management team is something I find undesirable.
Het instellen van een wachtlijst of beheerteam vind ik onwenselijk.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat het ziekenhuis Bernhoven in Oss de afdeling klinische verloskunde gaat sluiten (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about Bernhoven hospital's plan to close its obstetrics unit in Oss and concentrate births in Veghel due to a shortage of specialised nurses, and whether this threatens access and quality of care. The minister answered that concentration is acceptable because quality and the 45-minute access norm are not at risk, and that the government sees no reason to intervene, while committing to a joint implementation plan from the NVZ and NVOG by January 2012.
Since the ambulance response time norm in this region is not endangered by this, the accessibility of acute obstetric care is not at stake.
Aangezien de norm aanrijtijden van de ambulance in deze regio hierdoor niet in gevaar komen, komt de bereikbaarheid van de acute verloskundige zorg niet in het geding.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag niet altijd recent is bij inschrijving gastouders (ingezonden 11 mei 2011).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that childminders' certificates of good conduct (VOG) may be years old when they register in the national childcare register, and whether the rules allow this. The minister answered that outdated VOGs are possible only for childminders registered during the 2010 transition year, that GGDs can request a recent VOG when there are doubts, and that he is consulting the Justice Minister on post-registration reporting and will inform the House before the summer.
I am of the view that the purpose of the VOG is sufficiently achieved as regards prior screening.
Ik ben van mening dat het doel van de VOG, voor wat betreft controle vooraf, voldoende wordt bereikt.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP), Recourt (PvdA) en Berndsen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het zwartboek met kritiek van jeugdreclasseerders op het VOG-systeem (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

MPs Kooiman, Recourt and Berndsen asked the state secretary of Security and Justice how he would respond to a black book in which youth probation workers criticised the VOG (certificate of good conduct) system for unfairly excluding young people, and whether he would ease or clarify the system. The state secretary answered that only 54 of about 800 youth probation workers complained, that refusals affect fewer than 1% of applicants, that the assessment framework is sufficient after a Rotterdam pilot, and that he will discuss the matter with Jeugdzorg Nederland before deciding on follow-up steps.
I will discuss with Jeugdzorg Nederland where the needs lie regarding information about the VOG system.
Ik zal met Jeugdzorg Nederland bezien waar de behoeften liggen met betrekking tot voorlichting over de systematiek van de VOG.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de toename van het aantal GHB-verslaafden en het tekort aan behandelplekken (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

MPs Kooiman and Leijten asked the health minister about rising GHB addiction, waiting lists for treatment in Noord-Brabant, and whether the government would act on treatment capacity. Minister Schippers answered that a new detoxification protocol will expand treatment capacity during 2011, that GHB risk assessment is being updated, and that no additional research is considered necessary.
For that reason I am encouraging a project in which addiction care institutions participate in developing, under scientific guidance, a new detoxification protocol for GHB addiction.
Om die reden stimuleer ik een project waarbij de verslavingszorginstellingen participeren in het onder wetenschappelijke begeleiding ontwikkelen van een nieuw ontgiftingsprotocol voor GHB-verslaving.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de hulp aan kinderen van gescheiden ouders (ingezonden 24 maart 2011).

An MP asks ministers how children of divorced parents can receive treatment when one parent refuses consent, and whether the Wgbo leaves enough room, following a TV report. The state secretary answers that existing rules (presumed consent, the judge, the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming) already allow necessary treatment, declines to amend the Wgbo, and commits to a meeting with Jeugdzorg Nederland and an expert.
In my view, the current regulations offer sufficient possibilities to ensure that, even in case of a conflict between both parents, the child receives the necessary treatment.
De huidige regelgeving biedt mijns inziens voldoende mogelijkheden om te zorgen dat, ook bij een conflict tussen beide ouders, het kind de noodzakelijke behandeling krijgt.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Bouwmeester (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het sluiten van de Doggershoek (ingezonden 3 maart 2011).

MPs Kooiman and Bouwmeester asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about closing the Doggershoek youth institution in Den Helder, alternatives, staff consultation, redeployment and remaining regional capacity. The State Secretary confirmed the closure as of 1 March 2011 for capacity reasons, said talks on reuse for LVB youths with Lijn 5 are ongoing with results promised by June 2011, and described staff mobility and redeployment measures.
As promised, I will inform you of the outcomes of that research in June 2011, or sooner if possible.
Zoals toegezegd zal ik u in juni 2011, of zoveel eerder als mogelijk, informeren over de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Financiën en over de kosten van het verwerpen van erfenissen en de omvang van de consignatiekas (ingezonden 28 maart 2

MP Kooiman asked whether it is fair that a woman who was abused by her father must pay court and notary costs to reject an inherited debt, and asked for the size of the consignment fund. The state secretary said rejecting an inheritance can be done at the court registry without a notary, and that a fee exemption exists for low incomes, so he sees no need to pay such costs from the consignment fund; the fund currently holds EUR 24.9 million, of which EUR 4.6 million relates to estates.
No, I see no need for that, because a provision has already been made for those with less financial means.
Nee, daartoe zie ik geen noodzaak, omdat voor minder draagkrachtigen al een voorziening is getroffen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het experiment in de gemeenten Utrecht een legale cannabisclub op te richten (ingezonden 16 maart 2011).

MP Kooiman asks the minister of Security and Justice why he rejected Utrecht's proposal for a legal, regulated cannabis growing experiment before its details were worked out, and whether he will engage with the municipality and monitor the effects. The minister replies that the plans contravene the law, as cannabis cultivation is prohibited even for five plants or fewer, so consultation with Utrecht makes little sense, and he has told the mayor so.
The plans of the municipality of Utrecht, as described in the media, are in violation of the law.
De plannen van de gemeente Utrecht, zoals deze in de media zijn beschreven, zijn in strijd met de wet.
Vragen van de leden Spekman (PvdA), Kooiman en Rik Janssen (beiden SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de opvangomstandigheden voor asielkinderen (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

MPs asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether the government shares the view that little has been done since 2009 to improve conditions for about 7,000 children in asylum centres, and about frequent transfers, homework rooms, a child contact person and the 65 Unicef recommendations. The minister rejected the claim that little was done, pointed to ongoing answers to committee questions, said children now mostly stay at one location, that homework rooms exist, and that families have a contact point, so no separate child representative is needed.
I therefore do not share the view of the director of Vluchtelingenwerk, as reported in Spits.
Ik deel de mening van de directeur van Vluchtelingenwerk, zoals die in het bericht in Spits is weergegeven, dan ook niet.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het gebrek van behandeling van pedofilie (ingezonden 18 januari 2011).

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the ministers of Health and of Justice about the shortcomings in treatment for paedophiles, including the expert view that early help could prevent much harm. Minister Schippers acknowledged that help is hard to reach because of stigma, pointed to existing forensic expertise, and promised to promote early help through campaigns like Stop it now!, e-health and sharing knowledge with regular mental health care.
That means I will ask field parties to, for example, translate the English campaign Stop it now! into Dutch.
Dat betekent dat ik veldpartijen ga vragen om bijvoorbeeld de Engelse campagne Stop it now! naar Nederland te vertalen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de teruggeleiding van een meisje naar Guatemala (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the state secretary how a 9-year-old girl was returned to Guatemala under the Hague Child Abduction Convention, why her whereabouts were unclear, and what safeguards and cooperation with Guatemalan authorities existed. The state secretary answered that courts, not the Central Authority, decided on return, that Dana is now staying with her father pending Guatemalan child protection review, and that Dutch authorities arranged protective measures and cooperation was good.
It is the judge who, on the basis of the criteria in this convention, decides whether a child must be returned to the country from which it was unlawfully removed.
Het is de rechter die aan de hand van de criteria genoemd in dit verdrag, beslist of een kind moet worden teruggeleid naar het land waar vanuit het ongeoorloofd is meegenomen.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat Bureau Jeugdzorg steeds vaker hulpvragen afwijst (ingezonden 31 december 2010).

MP Kooiman asked why Bureau Jeugdzorg rejects a growing share of help requests, whether capacity is the cause, and what happens to rejected applicants, and asked how people with light needs will be directed to Centra voor Jeugd en Gezin. The state secretary answered that rejections often mean information, advice or referral to local services, that no capacity shortage was signalled, that rejected people are not followed up, and that CJG coverage will be complete by end 2011.
No, these people are not followed up further.
Nee, deze mensen worden niet verder gevolgd.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over het oppakken van een asielzoeker bij de geboorteaangifte (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

An SP MP asked the Minister for Immigration and Asylum whether an asylum seeker was arrested at the registry office while registering his child's birth, and how this squares with children's right to registration. The minister confirmed the arrest followed an identity check triggered by a Vreemdelingenpolitie request, that detention was later lifted in favour of a daily reporting duty, and that the family is working toward departure; questions on the child-rights and illegal-residence visie were deferred to a later letter.
I can inform you that the man in question did register the birth in the municipality of Winterswijk.
Ik kan u meedelen dat er door de betrokken man wel aangifte van de geboorte is gedaan in de gemeente Winterswijk.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag voor het individueel begeleiden van minderjarigen vanuit een pers

The MP asks whether individual supervision of minors paid through a personal budget (pgb) requires a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG), and whether a convicted sex offender providing homework support to minors should be barred, and what measures and oversight exist. The government answers that no requirements currently apply to pgb support bureaus, that a VOG is not required, that parents are primarily responsible for checking caregivers, points to a quality mark and the 'In veilige handen' prevention package, and says the Inspectorate for Health Care handles reports of sexual abuse in AWBZ and Zvw care.
I consider it highly undesirable that a person convicted of a sex offence provides one-on-one supervision to minors.
Ik acht het zeer ongewenst dat een persoon die voor een zedendelict is veroordeeld, één op één begeleiding biedt aan minderjarigen.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het voornemen van Zorg Groep Twente om de afdeling klinische kraamzorg in Almelo te verplaatsen naar Hengel

MPs Kooiman and Van Gerven asked the health minister about Zorg Groep Twente's plan to move clinical maternity care from Almelo to Hengelo, including quality, travel times, the relation to hospital budget cuts and consolidation policy. The minister answered that no location decision has been made, that the plan is quality-driven rather than budget-driven, that the 45-minute access norm is not endangered, and that the Inspectorate will oversee a plan of action due in 2011.
With a possible concentration of clinical obstetric care in Hengelo, the 45-minute accessibility norm for acute care is not endangered.
Met een eventuele concentratie van de klinische verloskundige zorg in Hengelo komt de bereikbaarheidsnorm van 45 minuten voor acute zorg niet in gevaar.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Gerven (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de rol van marktsturing in het besluit de afdeling klinische kraamzorg in Almelo te schrappen (ingezonden 1

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether market considerations drove ZGT hospital's plan to concentrate clinical maternity care in Hengelo, and whether accessibility should weigh more heavily. The minister said concentration should not be pursued for its own sake, that hospitals must meet quality standards, and that a feasibility study with regional consultation is underway.
I am not in favour of concentration for the sake of concentration.
Ik ben geen voorstander van concentratie om de concentratie.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de mogelijke sluiting van de afdeling verloskunde van het Diaconessenhuis te Meppel (ingezonden 3 februari 2011).

An SP MP asked the health minister about the possible closure of the obstetrics department at the Diaconessenhuis in Meppel, the reasons, shortages of gynaecologists, the impact on ambulance response times, and a study on infant mortality linked to travel distance. The minister replied that the hospital reports no closure is planned, that the IGZ will require hospital action plans on acute obstetric care, and that the regional acute care body must find solutions for any access gaps.
I am not a proponent of concentration for its own sake.
Ik ben geen voorstander van concentratie om de concentratie.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over het ontslag van 120 jeugdhulpverleners bij Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister about the dismissal of 120 youth care workers at Bureau Jeugdzorg Noord-Brabant, questioning budget cuts, rising caseloads, waiting lists and the impact on about 3,000 children. The state secretary replied that the province is responsible for youth care implementation, that the budget actually rises in 2011, and that the government promises necessary care within acceptable waiting times without committing to prevent the dismissals.
Making agreements with Bureau Jeugdzorg I consider primarily a responsibility of the province.
Het maken van afspraken met bureau jeugdzorg acht ik primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het verhuren van celcapaciteit voor jeugdigen aan België (ingezonden 22 november 2010).

MP Kooiman asked whether the state secretary would explore leasing youth detention capacity to Belgium, given Belgium's prison shortage and Dutch overcapacity. The state secretary answered that Belgian federal and Flemish authorities expressed no concrete need for places in Dutch youth institutions, so no lease is pursued at present.
In the meantime I have understood that there is also no concrete need there for places in Dutch JJIs.
Inmiddels heb ik begrepen dat ook daar geen concrete behoefte bestaat aan plaatsen in Nederlandse JJI's.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over het bericht dat volgens de Inspectie Jeugdzorg particuliere jeugdzorginstellingen nog vaak onveilig zijn (ingezonden 26 augustus 2010)

An MP asked the minister whether private youth care institutions, reportedly often unsafe according to the Inspectorate, will face mandatory registration and quality checks, whether they will fall under the Youth Care Act, and whether parents using a personal budget can judge quality. The state secretary replied that provinces were asked to stop using non-compliant private providers, that further steps are being discussed with the IPO and the Inspectorate with a letter promised early next year, and that personal-budget eligibility for supervised children is under review.
I will inform your House about this further early this year.
Ik zal uw Kamer hier begin dit jaar nader over informeren.
Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat er in de kinderopvang te weinig kinderleiders op de groep staan (ingezonden 24 december 2010).

MP Kooiman (SP) asked the minister about reports that many childcare staff regularly work alone with groups exceeding the permitted child-staff ratio, and what will be done to enforce the rules, including unannounced GGD inspections and pressure on municipalities. The minister called the findings worrying, outlined enforcement measures and planned talks with sector parties, while declining to intervene directly in collective labour conditions or budget effects.
Yes. This is an important aspect of the aforementioned process to simplify supervision and improve enforcement.
Ja. Dit is een belangrijk aspect in bovengenoemd traject om het toezicht te vereenvoudigen en de handhaving te verbeteren.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Leijten (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de alcoholpoli's in Eindhoven en Veldhoven moeten sluiten (ingezonden 16 december 2010).

Two SP MPs asked the health minister whether alcohol clinics in Eindhoven and Veldhoven must close and how insurer CZ funds care for young people admitted with alcohol coma, and whether the clinics will stay open until effectiveness results are known. The minister said talks between parties are ongoing, that CZ does not intend to stop funding, that the pilot has ended with results published, and that a multidisciplinary implementation track will follow.
The parties are still in discussion with each other. I therefore cannot answer this question.
Partijen zijn nog met elkaar in gesprek. Ik kan deze vraag dus niet beantwoorden.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Veiligheid en Justitie over manipulatie door de Europese Commissie van een onderzoek naar adoptie (ingezonden 7 december 2010).

Ms Kooiman (SP) asked whether the European Commission pressured researchers to conclude that a European Adoption Agency was needed, despite weak supporting evidence, and whether the study was initially kept confidential. The state secretary replied that the study was commissioned by the Commission, so it is for the Commission to respond, and that the Netherlands is cautious about new agencies and insists the child's interest come first.
Since this is a study conducted on behalf of the European Commission, it is for the European Commission to respond.
Aangezien het een onderzoek betreft dat namens de Europese Commissie is verricht, is het aan de Europese Commissie om te reageren.
Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister voor Jeugd en Gezin over het bericht dat jeugdhulpverleners geen hulp meer kunnen inschakelen over de provinciegrenzen (ingezonden 7 oktober 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister for Youth and Family whether youth care workers can still call in help across provincial borders after reports that the 10% regulation was abolished. The state secretary answered that the provinces abolished the 10% scheme but agreed that cross-border help remains possible, with free placements for crisis cases and mutual cost settlement otherwise.
Whether or not to maintain the 10% scheme is not within my competence but that of the provinces.
Het wel of niet handhaven van de 10% regeling behoort niet tot mijn bevoegdheid maar die van de provincies.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat huisartsenpost Eudokia in Enschede zelf jeugdzorg gaat aanbieden en niet doorverwijst naar Bureau Jeugdzo

An MP asked the state secretary about a Enschede GP post offering youth care itself instead of referring to Bureau Jeugdzorg, and whether this fragments youth care. The secretary replied that three local pilots test linking GP practices to municipal youth care within the Centrum voor Jeugd en Gezin, with the municipality and insurer monitoring and evaluating them, and that lessons will be drawn in April 2011.
Menzis, the Eudokia medical centre and the municipality of Enschede all monitor this pilot; the first evaluation is at the end of April 2011.
Zowel Menzis, het medisch centrum Eudokia als de gemeente Enschede monitoren deze pilot; eind april 2011 is de eerste evaluatie.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «blowende tiener eerder psychotisch» (ingezonden 19 november 2010).

An MP asks the health and justice ministers how they respond to research linking early cannabis use to psychotic symptoms, and whether they will improve prevention, reconsider budget cuts, regulate coffeeshop quality, or allow regulated cultivation experiments. The minister acknowledges the link, promises strengthened school prevention materials, denies known cuts to addiction care, and rejects quality controls and regulated cultivation as incompatible with the current policy and international treaties.
Nevertheless, the guidance that the Healthy School and Substances programme provides on this will be strengthened.
Niettemin zullen de handvatten die het programma De Gezonde School en Genotmiddelen hiervoor geeft, worden versterkt.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman , Van Gerven en Smits (allen SP) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin, van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat steeds meer kinderen e

Three SP MPs asked ministers about reports that ADHD diagnoses and methylphenidate use have roughly doubled in five years, and whether overdiagnosis, medication without therapy, teacher support, class size and pharmaceutical industry influence are problems. The government confirmed the strong growth in prescriptions, referred to earlier answers on diagnosis, said no signals of medication without therapy exist, and declined to commission studies on pharmaceutical industry influence, citing existing checks.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman, Gesthuizen en Smits (allen SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het weigeren van onderwijs aan asielkinderen (ingezonden 27 september 2010).

SP MPs asked why dozens of children in the Ter Apel asylum facility had gone without secondary education for weeks, and what measures would prevent recurrence. The government answered that unclear funding responsibility between the municipality and COA left education unavailable until mid-October, that education is now available again, and that COA and the municipality agreed on a structural funding solution.
In consultation with COA, a solution to this situation has been reached.
In overleg met het COA is tot een oplossing voor deze situatie gekomen.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Justitie over het steeds vaker opsluiten van alleenstaande minderjarige asielzoekers (ingezonden 20 september 2010).

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister why unaccompanied minor asylum seekers are increasingly detained, whether this violates the Children's Rights Convention, and about its effectiveness and aftercare. The minister answered that about 20 such minors were in immigration detention, that detention is a last resort, that outcomes of detention were tallied, and that the Maasberg regime will be examined for a more open character.
I will inform your House of the outcome once the research has been completed.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomst zodra het onderzoek is afgerond.

Vragen van de leden Leijten en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de gemeente Rotterdam jonge kinderen als hulp in de huishouding beschouwt (ingezonden 18 oktob

The SP MPs asked the minister whether Rotterdam's practice of treating children aged 5-12 as household help, reducing home care, is acceptable and whether measures will be taken. The state secretary defended the municipal application of the protocol gebruikelijke zorg, stated that children may help according to age, and refused to take measures.
I am not prepared to do so.
Ik ben hier niet toe bereid.

Vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de politie het steeds drukker krijgt met de

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Health ministers about reported increases in police work against youth nuisance and street gangs, and why incident figures differ between municipalities. The government attributed rising figures largely to better registration and extra police focus, pointed to existing studies linking nuisance to urbanisation and multiple problems, and described municipal prevention and best-practice sharing.
The exact link between the two has not been studied, but it may be assumed that the extra police focus on youth nuisance leads to an increase in the number of registered incidents.

Het exacte verband tussen het een en het ander is niet onderzocht maar aangenomen mag worden dat de extra inzet van de politie op jeugdoverlast leidt tot een stijging van het aantal registraties met betrekking tot incidenten.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en Smits (beiden SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over uitval op mbo's door bezuinigingen op kinderopvang (ingezonden 28 oktober 2010).

SP MPs asked the education minister about MBO students dropping out because of childcare cuts, citing a broadcast on teen mothers and a Schiedam college that provides childcare. The government disputes the scale of the increase, points to the Plusvoorziening funding and childcare allowance, and does not commit to new measures.
The picture painted in the broadcast, that students in the lowest income bracket will have to pay hundreds of euros more for childcare as a result of the cut from 2011, is not correct.
Het beeld dat in de uitzending wordt geschetst dat leerlingen in de laagste inkomensklasse honderden euro’s meer aan kinderopvang moeten betalen als gevolg van de bezuiniging per 2011, is niet juist.

Vragen van lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat vijf jaar marktwerking de kwaliteit van de kinderopvang heeft verslechterd (ingezonden 5 november 2010).

An SP MP asked the minister for Social Affairs about reports that market forces had worsened childcare quality, including hourly price rises, staffing levels, GGD inspections, concentration among large providers, and the employer contribution. The minister answered that prices had not risen disproportionately according to the NMa, that inspections and enforcement are being tightened, and that the government would write a letter in 2011 but rejected abolishing market provision.
As I indicate in my answer to question 4 from members Koşer-Kaya and Verhoeven, I will send you a letter on this subject during 2011.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 4 van de leden Koşer-Kaya en Verhoeven aangeef, stuur ik u in de loop van 2011 een brief over dit onderwerp.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat ouders de gehele kinderopvangtoeslag terug moeten betalen wanneer het gastouderbureau verdacht wordt van fraude (i

An SP MP asked the minister why parents must repay their full childcare allowance when a childminding agency is suspected of fraud, and what will be done for affected parents and to prevent fraud. The minister answered that repayment only occurs where the parent's entitlement is (partly) absent, that affected parents were informed and can object, and listed new anti-fraud measures for childminding agencies.
So far there are no indications that this is the case. It is unknown whether any agencies are threatening to go bankrupt.
Tot op heden zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat dit het geval is. Onbekend is of er bureaus failliet dreigen te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Kooiman (SP) en Voordewind (ChristenUnie) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het advies aan zwangere vrouwen over alcohol dat te vrijblijvend is (ingezo

MPs Kooiman and Voordewind asked the health minister how he would respond to research showing midwives give non-committal advice on alcohol in pregnancy, and what he would do about midwives' knowledge, consultation practice, training and warning labels. The minister said he finds the advice worrying, commissioned an intervention card and a study of how intermediaries use professional information, left training to the KNOV, and kept the government's position of no warning labels pending evidence.
I find it worrying that non-committal advice on alcohol use is given to pregnant women.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat er vrijblijvend over alcoholgebruik wordt geadviseerd aan zwangere vrouwen.

Vragen van het lid Kooiman (SP) aan de ministers voor Jeugd en Gezin en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het bericht dat de Bureaus Jeugdzorg te laat zijn met indicaties (ingezonden 16 juli 2010).

An SP MP asked the ministers for Youth and Family and for Health about reports that Bureaus Jeugdzorg are slow to issue care indications, including PGB (personal budget) indications, and what would be done about waiting times and children left without care. The minister answered that average processing times have fallen to about 10 weeks, that PGB-specific times are not separately recorded, attributed delays to differences in assessment procedures, and promised monitoring and simplification while stating that children's legal entitlement to youth care is already anchored in law.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en voor Jeugd en Gezin over nieuwbouwplannen voor gesloten jeugdzorg (ingezonden 6 juli 2010).

MPs Gesthuizen and Kooiman (SP) asked whether 122 closed youth care places were planned in Maassluis and Leidschendam, what they would cost, and why the newly built Teylingereind juvenile institution in Sassenheim was left unused. The government answered that the Leidschendam and Maassluis projects are in preparation, that Teylingereind's design does not fit closed youth care and its location is unsuitable, and that the building costs about 5 million euros a year while standing empty.
On 1 July 2010 the Minister of Justice informed the House about developing a future plan for the juvenile justice institutions, which will be completed in the summer and then sent to the House.

Op 1 juli 2010 heeft de Minister van Justitie uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de ontwikkeling van een toekomstplan voor de justitiële jeugdinrichtingen dat in de zomer zal worden afgerond en aansluitend aan de Tweede Kamer zal worden toegezonden.
Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kooiman (beiden SP) aan de ministers van Justitie en voor Jeugd en Gezin over nieuwbouwplannen voor gesloten jeugdzorg (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

The minister rejected the idea of a harsher resolution, said the government works to prevent homelessness of rejected asylum-seeking families, and decided for now not to end reception in regular AZC centres or to put families with minor children out onto the street, pending the Court of Appeal's final ruling.

persons who form or have formed a family with a victim and have a close personal relationship with that victim
