An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that accountants want to stop auditing top incomes under the WNT because oversight has become too complex, and what concrete steps the ministry will take. The minister acknowledged complexity, said he will consult the accountants' professional body to reduce audit burden within the law's framework, and said a legislative change is not expected to be needed for now.
I am indeed willing to consider, together with the professional group among others, whether there are possibilities within the aim and framework of the WNT to reduce the audit burden for accountants.
Ik ben inderdaad graag bereid om samen met onder meer de beroepsgroep te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om binnen het doel en de kaders van de WNT de controlelast voor accountants te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Engelshoven over het bericht dat het NL-alert systeem nog steeds fouten bevat

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported NL-Alert faults, including a message sent up to eleven times, low reach growth, and delays in the system's rollout. The Minister acknowledged the duplicate transmissions, said Amsterdam is evaluating them, denied any delay or extra cost, and promised a pilot-based report in spring 2018.

The municipality of Amsterdam is carrying out an evaluation of this deployment of NL-Alert and, in consultation with my ministry, is examining which aspects played a role in sending the same message four times.

De gemeente Amsterdam voert een evaluatie uit van deze inzet van NL-Alert en beziet in overleg met mijn ministerie welke aspecten een rol hebben gespeeld bij het viermaal verzenden van hetzelfde bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Engelshoven en Raemakers over het publiceren van uitslagen per stembureau

MPs Van Engelshoven and Raemakers asked why the Kiesraad did not collect polling-station-level results after the 2017 election, and whether municipalities published them. The minister explained that digital transfer was banned for security reasons, so only municipal totals were transferred, that municipalities could publish station results, and that inspection rights had lapsed; he will include the issue in the evaluation.
That return (article N11 Kieswet) contains only the totals per party and per candidate for the whole municipality, not per polling station.
In die opgave (artikel N11 Kieswet) staan alleen de totalen per partij en per kandidaat voor de hele gemeente en niet per stembureau.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Laan over het bericht 'Brede welvaart verder onder druk door slechtere gezondheid'

MP Van der Laan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a Rabobank report finding women's broad welfare fell more than men's in the past year, and whether this warrants further research. The minister replied that CBS monitor data show no diverging trend between women and men, that the differences are limited, and that no further research is deemed necessary.
On the basis of these results, it does not seem necessary to me to conduct further research.
Op basis van deze resultaten lijkt het mij daarom niet nodig nader onderzoek uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over bedreigingen van Joodse studenten

MPs Van der Woude and Ellian asked whether lecturers at Leiden University express pro-BDS views, whether funding of a student association promoting BDS is appropriate, and what is being done to protect Jewish students after a letter from them. The minister answered that academic freedom and a safe learning environment apply, described talks held with staff and students, noted the small funding amounts, and said the government uses the IHRA definition of antisemitism and that universities have complaint procedures.
Following the letter from Jewish students to the Executive Board, a meeting was organised between the chair of the board, the diversity officer and the students.
Naar aanleiding van de brief van Joodse studenten aan het College van Bestuur is er een gesprek georganiseerd tussen de voorzitter van het college, de diversiteitsofficier en de studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en El Yassini over het bericht dat het Albeda als eerste mbo in Nederland een studentenrechtbank krijgt

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Justice and Education ministers about the Albeda college's new student court, questioning its legal basis, fair-trial safeguards, victims' reporting to police, and whether it clashes with criminal justice. The ministers answered that it is a voluntary, extrajudicial, preventive restorative process not subject to the Experimentenwet, that police are consulted on suspected crimes, and that the court is complementary and does not change reporting policy.
Parties are entirely free to choose this extrajudicial track.
Het staat partijen volledig vrij om te kiezen voor dit buitengerechtelijk traject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Omstreden software studenten blijkt onveilig: hackers konden meegluren'

MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked the Minister of Education about the Proctorio anti-cheating software, which was found to have a security flaw letting hackers spy on students, and about privacy, use limits and student participation rights. The minister answered that proctoring should be used only when necessary, that the flaw was reportedly fixed within a week, that institutions are responsible for privacy and security, and that no change to the law on works council consent is planned.
There is no intention to change anything in the law on this.
Er is geen voornemen om daar iets aan te wijzigen in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikh over het bericht 'Nibud: mbo'ers lopen honderden euro's mis door financiële onwetendheid'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a Nibud report finding that many mbo students miss out on financial support such as healthcare allowance, study grants and travel-product refunds due to lack of information. The Minister acknowledged the problem, described existing information channels and planned improvements, but gave no firm commitment on automatic grant payments, which depend on a separate pending study.
It is not known exactly how much study finance mbo students at entry and level 2 miss out on.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel studiefinanciering mbo-studenten in de entreeopleiding en niveau 2 precies mislopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat vele tienduizenden Nederlandse studenten maandenlang gemakkelijk te hacken zijn geweest

MP Kwint (SP) asked the Minister of Education whether, and how, students forced to use insecure online proctoring software (Proctorio) could be protected, and what the government would do about privacy and the pending motions. The minister answered that he lacks data on student numbers, that the government does not decide on the software itself, that existing privacy rules suffice, and that proctoring will be scaled back with a vision to follow after the evaluation.
I have no insight into the number of students who used the Proctorio software.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal studenten dat gebruik heeft gemaakt van de software van Proctorio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de berichten dat studenten met coronaklachten toch naar tentamens komen uit angst om een toetskans te missen

An MP asks whether students with corona symptoms or in quarantine are pressured to attend in-person exams for fear of losing a test chance, and whether online exams or extra resits should be offered. The minister answers that institutions must offer tailored solutions and that new service documents set agreements, but declines to commit to a standard online-exam choice, leaving the decision to institutions.
It is up to the institution to shape resit policy in practice and provide tailored solutions in such cases.
Het is aan de instelling om het herkansingsbeleid in de praktijk vorm te geven en in dergelijke gevallen maatwerk te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Kerseboom over het niet informeren van de FVD-fractie over de aankoop van De Vaandeldrager

Two FvD MPs asked why the FVD faction alone was not informed in advance of the planned purchase of Rembrandt's De Vaandeldrager, and questioned the Rothschild family's role, the price and related dealings. The state secretary replied that the faction had the same information as others when the supplementary budget was submitted, that the decision to inform was a personal political judgement, and that the purchase is a commercial transaction with no commitments or conditions attached, while withholding some details such as family member names for privacy and the sale not being finalised.
I see no reason for that at this time.
Ik zie daarvoor nu geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht 'Joodse studenten/docenten in academisch Nederland (vogel)vrij?!'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that Jewish students and staff at Maastricht University face hostility, and whether Jewish student organisations and events can operate freely and whether students are pressed to distance themselves from Israel. The minister answers that the university condemns antisemitic remarks and supports Jewish student organisation efforts, and that she does not recognise demands for Jewish students to distance themselves from Israel while stressing that politically sensitive discussions must remain respectful.

I find it unacceptable if Jewish students were asked to distance themselves from Israel, but I do not recognise the picture that this is the case at universities or at events organised by universities.

Ik vind het onacceptabel als Joodse studenten zou worden gevraagd afstand te nemen van Israël, maar ik herken het beeld niet dat dit het geval is op universiteiten of op door universiteiten georganiseerde evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat met corona besmette studenten toch naar VU gaan door aanwezigheidsplicht

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that COVID-positive students still have to attend VU lectures because of mandatory attendance rules, and what options students have. The minister said institutions should find tailored solutions, that the VU has relaxed attendance requirements and offers consultation routes, and that she is discussing the issue with education bodies and will clarify institutions' responsibility in a service document.
It is up to the institution to discuss a suitable solution with the student(s).
Het is aan de instelling om met de student(en) in gesprek te gaan over een passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude, Kamminga en Becker over het bericht 'French government protests EU Commissioner meeting with 'Islamist' NGO'

MPs Van der Woude, Kamminga and Becker asked ministers about an EU Commissioner's meeting with the FEMYSO network, reported as Islamist, and about whether Dutch student associations linked to FEMYSO received university funding. The government declined to endorse the French criticism, said it supports broad civil-society consultation, reported limited funding details from universities, and said the Taskforce on problematic behaviour and undesirable foreign financing would act only if concrete problematic conduct arose.
The cabinet has confidence that our higher education institutions are well able to critically assess applications for financial support for student organisations
Het kabinet heeft er vertrouwen in dat onze instellingen voor hoger onderwijs uitstekend in staat zijn om aanvragen voor financiële ondersteuning voor studentenorganisaties kritisch te beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tjeerd de Groot over de invoering Richtlijn beroepskwalificaties binnenvaart

MPs asked why the Netherlands has not implemented the EU inland shipping qualifications directive four years after entry into force, and about the impact on small passenger boats and ferries and on Dutch training approvals. The minister answered that the implementation is complex and needs more time, that a transitional arrangement and interim national scheme are planned, and that an adapted certificate for sightseeing boats is under discussion with the sector.
In addition, I am conducting international consultations to reach mutual acceptance of documents by 17 January 2022.
Daarnaast voer ik internationaal overleg om voor 17 januari 2022 tot wederzijdse acceptatie van documenten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de intocht van Sinterklaas

An MP asks ministers whether they will urge mayors to allow QR-code-free Sinterklaas parades and whether they will act against municipalities that refuse Zwarte Piet via subsidy conditions. The government replies that it supports broad access to the parade, that children under 18 are exempt from the coronavirus pass, and that municipalities decide on subsidies and the parade themselves.
The arrival of Sinterklaas is a local matter.
De intocht van Sinterklaas is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Paternotte over de diplomatermijn in combinatie met topsport

Two D66 MPs asked how the ten-year diploma deadline for student finance is extended for elite athletes, including the criteria, definition of top sport, the role of DUO and NOC*NSF, and COVID effects. The minister explained that extensions depend on special circumstances, top sport is narrowly defined as international competition, and DUO will explore broadening the definition, but she gave no data on past extensions and did not answer by the requested deadline.
The reason for granting the extension of the diploma deadline is not registered in DUO's systems.
De reden van de toekenning voor de verlenging van de diplomatermijn wordt niet in de systemen van DUO geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over "Verplichte ideologische indoctrinatie aan de Radboud Universiteit"

An MP asked the education minister whether universities may tailor teaching to ideological views, whether to engage the Radboud University on compulsory sustainability content and a sustainability certificate, and whether activist-style assignments blur science. The minister answered that quality of programmes is for the institution and the NVAO accreditation panels, declined to intervene, and called the sustainability plans not alarming while stressing academic freedom.
The institution is responsible for content and quality. Assessment of the content and quality of a programme lies with the NVAO.
De instelling is verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud en kwaliteit. De beoordeling van de inhoud en kwaliteit van een opleiding ligt bij de NVAO
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Westlandse politiek houdt komst islamitische school opnieuw tegen'

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Education why a Westland municipal council keeps blocking the establishment of an Islamic primary school despite court rulings, and whether the minister will intervene again. The minister says the school legally must be founded, that the council is ignoring the law, and that the school must be able to start on 1 August 2022, but declines to commit to a third replacement decision or to sanctions for now.
The municipality is legally obliged to cooperate and arrange housing.
De gemeente is wettelijk verplicht mee te werken en huisvesting te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over “de aanhoudende kindermarketing en onderwijsbeïnvloeding door de fossiele industrie”

An MP asked the ministers about Shell's 'children's council' outreach to primary schools near its Pernis and Moerdijk sites, alleged ExxonMobil gifts in classrooms, climate responsibility, and how children are protected from fossil-industry marketing in schools. The minister answered that schools and teachers decide on educational materials under school autonomy, that the government is reluctant to steer material choices, that the sponsorship convenant was tightened, and that no new protective measures are planned.
The central government is therefore very restrained in encouraging or discouraging the use of certain materials in education.
De rijksoverheid is daarom zeer terughoudend in het stimuleren of juist ontmoedigen van het gebruik van bepaalde materialen in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over recente NPO-uitzendingen waarin ongevaccineerden bedreigd zouden worden

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether NPO broadcasts threatening or calling for violence against unvaccinated people, and whether the minister would intervene as system responsible for the NPO. The minister answered that public broadcasters are independently responsible for their content under the Mediawet, that prior government review of programme content is constitutionally prohibited, and that courts decide afterwards whether limits were crossed.
Prior supervision of the content of television programmes is, as Article 7, paragraph 2, of the Constitution provides, never permitted.
Toezicht vooraf op de inhoud van tv-programma's is, zoals artikel 7, tweede lid, van de Grondwet bepaalt, nooit geoorloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat TopTicketShop valse kaartjes verkoopt

An SP MP asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister whether TopTicketShop sells fake tickets, what steps follow the adopted Kwint motion on secondary ticket resale, and whether a Dutch law banning resale profiteering is needed. The minister replied that fraud is for criminal investigation or the consumer authority, that a resale ban would not work so a consumer awareness campaign was chosen (postponed due to COVID), that EU rules apply from May 2022, and saw no reason for a new law now.
I see no reason for this at this moment.
Ik zie hiervoor op dit moment geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Peters over het bericht ‘Nederland doet samen met China DNA-onderzoek: 'Fundamenteel fout'’

MPs Van der Woude and Peters asked whether Dutch institutions (Erasmus MC, LUMC, NFI) collaborated on DNA research with Chinese researchers tied to police, using Uyghur samples obtained through consent forms of doubtful voluntariness, and what the government has done on knowledge security. The minister says some details are not yet known, that the institutions were involved only in four broader international studies and not in the three police-linked ones, that a dialogue with institutions and a knowledge-security framework are underway, and promises to report back in early 2022.
At this moment not all details and facts about the research studies that recently emerged in the reporting you refer to are known.
Op dit moment zijn nog niet alle details en feitelijkheden bekend rondom de onderzoeken die recent naar voren zijn gekomen in de berichtgeving waar u naar verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Beertema over het bericht dat Nederland met China DNA-onderzoek doet

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the government knew about Dutch labs developing sensitive DNA techniques with Chinese scientists, and what it would do about it. The answer, given by Minister Slob, mostly addresses truancy (thuiszitters) in the Holland Rijnland region, does not address the DNA or China questions, and only says the government will continue its integrated truancy approach.
Following the report in the Leidsch Dagblad and the questions from MP De Hoop (PvdA), I had contact made with the Regional Truancy Bureau Holland Rijnland.
Naar aanleiding van het bericht in het Leidsch Dagblad en de vragen van het lid De Hoop (PvdA) heb ik contact laten opnemen met het Regionaal Bureau Leerplicht Holland Rijnland
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Kuiken en De Hoop over de samenwerking tussen Nederland en China bij onderzoek naar DNA

MPs Kathmann, Kuiken and De Hoop asked whether Dutch scientists collaborated with Chinese researchers on DNA techniques that could predict appearance and whether results could be misused against Uyghurs and Tibetans, and asked about ethics review and risk screening. The minister said Erasmus MC and LUMC denied involvement in the specific China-linked studies, promised a meeting with institutions and an update in early 2022, and pointed to ongoing knowledge-security measures.
I will inform you in early 2022 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal u begin 2022 informeren over de uitkomsten daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Woude over het bericht dat de bank voortaan je studieschuld kan opzoeken

Two VVD MPs asked whether a plan letting banks look up students' study debt via DUO for mortgage applications breaks the earlier promise that study debt would not be registered for mortgages. The minister replied that the government is not introducing a BKR registration of study debt, that the data stays with citizens who choose whether to share it, and that no talks with DUO are needed.
The cabinet is not proceeding with a BKR registration of study debts.
Het kabinet gaat niet over tot een BKR-registratie voor studieschulden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat de bank voortaan je studieschuld kan opzoeken

An MP asked the education minister about banks being able to retrieve students' study debt from DUO via apps during mortgage applications, including concerns about coercion and comparisons with BKR registration. The minister answered that this only changes how consumers supply data they already must disclose, that no BKR registration is planned, and that study debt keeps its low weighting factor.
This initiative changes nothing in the rights and obligations of (former) students and lenders, but only affects the way in which that obligation can be fulfilled.
Dit initiatief verandert niets aan de rechten en plichten van (oud-) studenten en kredietverstrekkers, maar heeft alleen invloed in de wijze waarop aan die verplichting kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Fort uit Tachtigjarige Oorlog staat op instorten'

Two CDA MPs asked the Education, Culture and Science Minister about reports that Fort Crèvecoeur from the Eighty Years' War is at risk of collapse, including its European heritage nomination, a dispute with 's-Hertogenbosch, the 2010 agreement, steps taken, municipal powers and repair costs. The minister answered that the Ministry of Defence and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are preparing a decision on urgent consolidation measures, that costs are commercially confidential, and that the municipality lacks enforcement powers because the fort is a national security matter under the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management.
The expected costs are for the time being commercially confidential.
De te verwachten kosten zijn vooralsnog commercieel vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat student Peter kanker kreeg, maar beurs volledig moet terugbetalen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Education why a seriously ill student must repay his study grant, whether DUO inspectors and their procedures are proportionate, and how DUO will avoid such hardship in future. The minister expresses sympathy, reports that DUO will waive repayment for the period of illness and moderate the fine, and states that DUO will examine how to ease the procedure for students whose parents are absent, while defending its controls against misuse.
For completeness, I note that the first case is still pending before the court on appeal.
Voor de volledigheid vermeld ik dat de eerstgenoemde zaak nog voor de rechter dient in hoger beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Rajkowski over het bericht 'Psychische problemen HAN-studenten ook op straat na grote hack'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education about a cyberattack on the HAN university, including whether sensitive medical data was stolen, whether the Dutch data protection authority was notified, and whether institutions should do more on cyber security. The minister answered all 12 questions, stating that the HAN was hacked via a web form (not ransomware), that about 3% of exposed data was more personal, that the AP was notified, and that the sector is strengthening its cyber preparedness.
A team of professionals has been on standby since the moment of notification to answer any questions.
Een team van professionals heeft vanaf het moment van informeren klaargestaan om eventuele vragen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en De Hoop over het bericht 'Twentse student Peter kreeg kanker, maar moet beurs volledig terugbetalen: ‘Je wordt als fraudeur gezien’'

MPs Westerveld and De Hoop asked whether DUO demands repayment of student grants from seriously ill students, how often home visits and penalties occur, and what changes are needed for hardship cases. The minister confirmed that DUO reclaimed part of a seriously ill student's grant, that home visits and penalties have declined since 2016, and pointed to existing hardship clauses and case-by-case review without committing to new rules.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the specific case.
Vanwege privacyredenen kan ik niet ingaan op de specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de gedupeerden door de sluiting van een lerarenopleiding aan de Hogeschool Inholland

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Education about students left stranded by the closure of the English teacher-training programme at Hogeschool Inholland, including transfer options, the C2 CPE language requirement, the timing of the retake, and the diploma deadline of 31 August 2021. The Minister answers that all students were offered completion within the programme, transfer to Hogeschool van Amsterdam was arranged with a coulance regime, the C2 level is a sector-wide requirement, and diplomas cannot be issued after the closure date, while noting that some students could appeal.
There has been no question of a take it or leave it proposal.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een take it or leave it -voorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat honderden studenten corona-compensatie mislopen, vaak buiten eigen schuld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education why hundreds of students miss the corona compensation through no fault of their own, including those graduating after 31 August 2021, students who started a master after a pre-master, and whether the scheme should be extended to 31 January 2022. The Minister defended the existing scheme as fair within financial limits, rejected extension and pre-master coverage, and pointed to halved tuition fees for students still studying this year.
The LSVb proposal would mean students receive two allowances in the period up to 31 January 2022, which I find undesirable.
Het voorstel van de LSVb houdt in dat studenten in de periode tot 31 januari 2022 twee tegemoetkomingen zouden ontvangen, dat vind ik onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Honderden studenten lopen coronacompensatie mis, vaak buiten eigen schuld'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether students who graduated after 31 August 2021 after pandemic-related delays, and pre-master students, are excluded from the COVID study-delay compensation. The minister replied that the cutoff stands, that a full list of affected students is unavailable, that extending the scheme would cost about 24 million euro and would give some students two allowances, and that the halved tuition fee is the generic compensation.

There is no national overview of the study progress of individual students, so it is not possible to identify in advance which students will graduate after 31 August 2021 and could have qualified for the allowance.

Er is geen landelijk overzicht van de studievoortgang van individuele studenten, het is dan ook niet mogelijk om op voorhand in kaart te brengen welke studenten na 31 augustus 2021 studeren en in aanmerking hadden kunnen komen voor de tegemoetkoming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat kaartverkoop theaters ver achter blijft bij 2019

MP Kwint (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how to respond to reports that theatre ticket sales lag far behind 2019 levels, and what it means for makers, venues and staff, and the effect of the corona pass and 75% capacity limits. The minister says it is too early to draw conclusions, will monitor developments with the Taskforce, and is setting up a EUR 15 million subsidy scheme via the Fonds Podiumkunsten for venues affected by capacity limits.
To offer venues and festivals affected by the 75% capacity limit a financial contribution, I am currently working on a subsidy scheme to be implemented by the Fonds Podiumkunsten.
Om podia en festivals die te maken hebben met de capaciteitsbeperking van 75% een tegemoetkoming te bieden, werk ik nu aan een subsidieregeling die uitgevoerd zal worden door het Fonds Podiumkunsten.
Antwoord op vragen van van het lid Kwint over signalen die bij de SP zijn binnengekomen over hoge schoolkosten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that a vocational college requires students to bring flowers, vases and other materials costing up to 40 euro a week, and what alternatives exist. The Minister answered that these items fall under the basic equipment the school must provide free of charge, pointed to a collective agreement allowance and a student fund, and said supervision runs through the Inspectorate and the Taskforce schoolkosten.
students at Yuverta mbo Den Bosch are asked to bring their own materials, including flowers, vases and bowls
Yuverta mbo Den Bosch van studenten gevraagd wordt dat zij zelf hun materialen, waaronder bloemen, vazen en schalen, dienen mee te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over de drukte bij de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Van Esch and Teunissen asked the health and education ministers about crowding at the Formula 1 event in Zandvoort, the rules for seated versus unseated events, and whether this was foreseen and would be evaluated. Minister De Jonge answered that the event followed the rules in force, that seated and unseated events differ in risk, that about 90 infections were traced to the event, and that the government aims to lift restrictions when the epidemiological situation allows.
It turned out that this was not possible at all times.
Het is gebleken dat dat niet op alle momenten mogelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en De Hoop over "ongelijke toeslagen voor studenten met een beperking"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and De Hoop asked why students with disabilities still receive less individual study allowance than promised, what steps were taken to get municipalities to pay 300 euro, which municipalities underpay, and whether funding or the Breed Offensief bill should be split to fix this. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the authority and responsibility for setting the allowance, urged them to pay 300 euro from age 21 within current law, said national government lacks municipal-level data, and declined to split the controversial bill or grant extra funds, saying municipalities have sufficient budget.
The national government does not have information on the level of the individual study allowance in individual municipalities.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over informatie over de hoogte van de individuele studietoeslag in afzonderlijke gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht ‘Hoe gelijk zijn man en vrouw voor gemeenten?’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked why women often lack digital access to tax records for property they co-own with men, since municipalities and water boards usually issue tax assessments in one person's name. The minister explained the legal basis and municipal discretion, said there is no legal barrier to addressing all co-owners, and committed to discussing alternatives with municipalities and water boards.
I am willing to discuss with the other tiers of government what the options are for giving all owners of a property insight into the tax records.
Ik ben bereid om met de medeoverheden te bespreken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om alle eigenaren van een eigendom inzicht te geven in de belastinggegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Inge van Dijk en Peters over Europese Missie voor 100 klimaat neutrale steden tegen 2030

MPs from the CDA asked how the Dutch government will engage with the EU Cities Mission (100 climate-neutral cities by 2030), including its role in the City Climate Contract, selection criteria and funding. The State Secretary answers that BZK and EZK coordinate the mission, that the government will decide later whether to co-sign contracts, that selection is up to cities, and that about EUR 300 million is reserved at EU level without geographic earmarking.
Whether the national government should play a major role in this and how that could take shape is not yet clear at this moment.
Of de rijksoverheid hierin een grote rol moet spelen en hoe dat vorm zou kunnen krijgen, is op dit moment nog niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Inge van Dijk over studenten die beleggen met een DUO-lening

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that students borrow student loans to invest, and whether this should be prohibited. The minister disagrees that it is sensible, says the loan is not meant for investing and that a ban is unenforceable, but will improve student information and has asked the Nibud to address it.
It is not prohibited to use the student loan to invest in it.
Het is niet verboden om de studielening te gebruiken om mee te beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Veel laaggeletterden stopten met taal- of rekencursus tijdens corona’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Education about a report showing many low-literate adults stopped language or numeracy courses during the coronavirus pandemic, and whether the government would investigate, provide devices, reach out proactively and coordinate better with municipalities. The Minister answered that the report is sufficient so no new study is planned, gave a delayed interim evaluation timeline (end 2022), pointed to existing device initiatives, campaigns, subsidies and cooperation efforts, and said monitoring of course effectiveness is not yet feasible.
At present it is unfortunately not feasible to monitor nationally the effectiveness of matching, because there is not yet uniformity in recording and monitoring the data.
Het is op dit moment helaas niet haalbaar om de effectiviteit van matching landelijk te monitoren, omdat er (nog) geen eenduidigheid is in het vastleggen en monitoren van gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het testevenement 538 Oranjefeest

Two MPs asked the government about the 538 Oranjefeest test event, including resale of tickets at high prices, subsidies, selection, health-worker staffing and ticket fraud controls. The minister answered that the event was a research pilot, that the ticket auction was not intended and gave a wrong impression, that tests were required before entry and recommended afterwards, and that a national resale ban was not effective, pointing to a pending EU-based consumer law implementation.
The cabinet financed the research carried out at the field tests.
Het kabinet financierde het onderzoek dat wordt gedaan bij de praktijktesten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het bericht 'Wordt politieke correctheid een bedreiging voor de universiteit? 'Het academisch debat moet vrij zijn''

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether political correctness is threatening academic freedom and self-censorship among students and staff, and what concrete steps will be taken. The minister denies seeing signs that students are increasingly afraid to voice opinions, says intimidation of scientists can lead to self-censorship and that she continues talks with VSNU and KNAW, and states diversity includes perspectives but an inclusive culture where views can be expressed is the aim.
I have no signals that students are increasingly not daring to voice their opinions in higher education.
Ik heb geen signalen dat studenten in toenemende mate hun mening niet durven uiten in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over studentenhuisvesting

GroenLinks MPs asked about unhoused international students sleeping in bus shelters, emergency housing, cost of emergency shelter in Groningen, the housing-benefit and cost-sharing rules for hosts, and information given to international students. The minister answers that housing is primarily a local responsibility, lists local emergency measures, explains the rules for taking in students, says the national action plan will be updated with stakeholders while structural solutions await a new cabinet, and admits the answers were not delivered within the requested five days.
It is a local responsibility to ensure there is sufficient housing.
Het is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid om te zorgen voor voldoende huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over het bericht dat de Nederlandse universiteiten weer overspoeld worden door buitenlandse studenten

MPs Kwint and Beckerman (SP) asked the ministers about students sleeping in tents, emergency shelters and on couches because of the student housing shortage, and what will be done for the coming academic year. The government answered that it is working with municipalities and housers through the national student housing action plan, that universities are not primarily responsible for housing, and that it cannot easily quantify homeless students.
It is difficult to establish how many students precisely have housing problems.
Het is moeilijk na te gaan hoeveel studenten precies problemen hebben met huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over vragen over het bericht 'Buitenlandse studenten keren massaal terug, maar fysieke colleges volgen is nog uitdaging'

MP Peters (CDA) asks the Minister of Education about the return of non-EU students, the growth in their numbers, the budget implications, efforts to regain control over student flows, and an Inspectorate investigation. The minister answers that application numbers are back at pre-Covid levels, that the withdrawn WTT bill's tools to steer international intake cannot now be pursued, that non-EU students are unfunded so budget impact is nil, and that the EU has been approached but other countries do not share the imbalance.
The controversially declared bill on Language and Accessibility (WTT) contained several proposals to steer the intake of international students.
In het controversieel verklaarde wetsvoorstel Taal en Toegankelijkheid (WTT), stond een aantal voorstellen om te kunnen sturen op de instroom aan internationale studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Segers over de motie Bikker c.s. inzake hybride onderwijs

MPs Bikker and Segers asked the Minister of Education about follow-up to their motion on hybrid education for students with support needs, carers and chronically ill students, including dialogue with sector bodies, knowledge gaps, unreachable obligations for teachers, reports of studies being postponed, and advice for affected students. The minister answered that the issue was raised with sector councils and will be in service documents, that institutions are responsible for finding individual solutions, that the group-size limit of 75 was lifted, and that students can seek help from student organisations and the support body.
At a next administrative consultation I will ask both sector councils and student organisations what their experiences have been so far.
In een volgend bestuurlijk overleg zal ik, zowel aan sectorraden als aan studentenorganisaties, vragen wat de ervaringen in deze tot nu toe zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de Garantieregeling evenementen

MP Westerveld asks whether event organisers pass on the full government-guaranteed compensation to freelance artists and suppliers, and whether the subsidy conditions should require this. The minister acknowledges signals of underpayment, says it is a private-law matter beyond government's view, explains why pass-through was not made a subsidy condition for administrative reasons, and points to sector outreach and a Taskforce review.
I have no insight into the contractual relationships of individual organisers and their suppliers, including artists and other self-employed workers.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de contractuele verhoudingen van individuele organisatoren en hun toeleveranciers, waaronder ook artiesten en andere zelfstandigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Van der Woude over problemen met ouderverklaringen en DUO

MPs Paul and Van der Woude asked about reported instability of DUO's online system for parental declarations needed to found a new school, and about the deadline. The minister says the reported errors were limited, largely traceable to one outage, DUO is investigating, and the deadline will not be extended.
I am closely following developments around MijnDUO, as well as the contact between DUO and the reporters, and will intervene where necessary.
Ik volg de ontwikkelingen rondom MijnDUO nauwgezet, net als het contact tussen DUO en de melders, en grijp in waar nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over herinschrijvingen en restitutie bij pre-masterprogramma’s

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the minister about re-enrolment and refunds for pre-master programmes, including the absence of a legal definition of re-enrolment, whether institutions may charge fees again for remaining parts, reconciliation with WHW article 7.57i, and the impartiality of student complaints committees appointed by the executive board. The minister answered that pre-master programmes are not degrees, that institutions may charge capped fees and may charge again for a second attempt at remaining parts, and that functional independence of committee members provides sufficient impartiality.
This provides sufficient safeguards for impartial judgement.
Dit biedt voldoende waarborgen voor een onpartijdige oordeelsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat mbo-instellingen ook na corona verder gaan met online onderwijs, tegen de wil van de Kamer

An SP MP asked the Education Minister whether she knew of vice-institutions continuing online education against parliament's wishes, what steps she had taken on the Kwint motion requiring physical education as the norm, and how students who need distance learning would be supported. The minister said she is evaluating the measures before reporting, leaves the choice of distance learning to teaching teams and institutions, and promises case-by-case support and an evaluation to parliament in spring 2022.
I am awaiting this evaluation, and will then inform the House of Representatives about further implementation of the motion.
Ik wacht deze evaluatie af, en zal daarna de Tweede Kamer informeren over het verder uitvoeren van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het coronabeleid

The MP Westerveld asks the ministers about COVID-19 policy, including presymptomatic transmission of the Delta variant, school reopening, vaccination status checks in schools, the use of coronavirus certificates, mask recycling and support for the cultural sector. The minister answers that transmission by asymptomatic people is already taken into account, that the reopening plan was guided by epidemiological data, and that generic support schemes will not be extended after 1 October 2021 while targeted support for night-time hospitality and unseated events is being prepared.
On the elaboration of these support measures, EZK and OCW are in discussion with the sector.
Over de uitwerking van deze steunmaatregelen zijn EZK en OCW in gesprek met de sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Mokumse homohater vaak een allochtoon'

MP Eerdmans asked the ministers whether they acknowledge that anti-gay aggression in Amsterdam is often committed by young men of non-Dutch background, and what policy changes would follow. The government answered that the Amsterdam study is limited in scope, that an updated national study on perpetrators is underway, and that repression, prevention and municipal cooperation are part of the approach.
The cited action research, however, relates only to the Amsterdam situation and moreover has limited scope.
Het aangehaalde Actieonderzoek heeft echter alleen betrekking op de Amsterdamse situatie en het heeft bovendien een beperkte reikwijdte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Ginneken over het bericht dat het ROC Mondriaan in Den Haag is gehackt

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about the hack of ROC Mondriaan in The Hague, its effects on students and staff, timing of recovery and data breach, and whether other ROCs and the sector are protected. The minister answered that systems were shut down as a precaution, teaching largely continued, recovery will take weeks, data including class lists and financial details has been published, and sector-wide security initiatives and a dialogue with the MBO Raad are underway.
That cannot be said at this moment.
Dat is op dit moment niet te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Rajkowski over het bericht ‘Grote hack bij ROC Mondriaan: computers plat en bestanden ontoegankelijk’

MPs El Yassini and Rajkowski asked the Minister of Education about the ransomware hack at ROC Mondriaan, including ransom payments, data leaks, reporting to the data protection authority, and the institution's information-security maturity scores. The minister confirmed ransomware and said no ransom was paid, but declined to disclose individual institutions' benchmark scores as they are confidential, and deferred to the institution on notifications and damage assessment.
The benchmark IBP-E scores of individual institutions are not public, and I therefore cannot make statements about the scores of individual institutions.
De scores van de benchmark IBP-E van de individuele instellingen zijn niet openbaar en ik kan dan ook geen uitspraken doen over de scores van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Wuite over de openbare bibliotheek op Bonaire

MPs Kuiken and Wuite asked the minister whether the public library on Bonaire, which does not meet the Wsob library law, will be improved and rehoused, including reuse of heritage buildings and tailored support. The minister acknowledged the non-compliance, agreed to form a working group and sign an intention agreement with the island government, and offered support while stressing the island's primary responsibility.
It is important for the residents of Bonaire that they can turn to a full-fledged library.
Het is belangrijk voor de inwoners van Bonaire dat zij terecht kunnen bij een volwaardige bibliotheek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en Aukje de Vries over het artikel 'Noodkreet: tandarts gezocht voor Rotterdam, laat meer studenten toe' en de beantwoording van de Minister voor Medische Zorg o

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a newspaper report on a shortage of dentists in the Rotterdam and Zeeland region and whether more dentistry training places would be created. The government answered that funding for 100 extra places (EUR 26.3 million structurally) is not in the budget, so the decision is left to a new cabinet.
Expanding by 100 training places requires a structural amount of EUR 26.3 million. No funding for this amount has been found in the OCW budget.
Voor een uitbreiding met 100 opleidingsplaatsen is een structureel bedrag noodzakelijk van € 26,3 mln. Op de begroting van OCW is geen dekking voor dit bedrag gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over poging verdonkeremanen rapport homodiscriminatie.

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why a report on anti-gay discrimination in Amsterdam was sent to the city council months late, about its perpetrators being often young men of non-Dutch background, and whether a stronger signal should be sent to Amsterdam. The minister answered that anti-LHBTI violence must be tackled, that an action plan and an update of the perpetrator research are underway, and that the timing of the municipal report and the council's business are not for her to judge.
I, as Minister, do not decide on the timing of sending reports from a college of mayor and aldermen and on the interaction between the college and the municipal council.
Ik ga als Minister niet over de timing van het verzenden van rapporten van een college van B&W en de interactie tussen het college en de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de coronamaatregelen in het onderwijs en de start van het nieuwe studiejaar

MP Kwint (SP) asked the ministers how the government prioritises reopening schools and universities for the new school year, and about ventilation, vaccination, self-testing and quarantine rules for children. The ministers answered that in-person education has been a top priority, that the 1.5-metre rule was lifted in higher education, and that additional funding for ventilation and vaccination outreach has been arranged.
The monitoring study into the use of self-tests in education is still ongoing.
Het monitoringsonderzoek naar het gebruik van de zelftesten in het onderwijs loopt op dit moment nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de sluiting van de lerarenopleiding aan de Hogeschool Inholland

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education about three students of Hogeschool INHolland who cannot obtain their teaching diploma after the closure of the teacher-training programme, including whether a C1 English level should suffice and whether a solution could be presented. The Minister replied that the students had until 31 August 2021 to finish, that the C2 CPE requirement follows the national knowledge base, and that no intervention is possible, while acknowledging regret for the students.
I consider that the institution has offered the students sufficient opportunities to complete their studies before 31 August 2021.
Ik vind dat de instelling de studenten voldoende mogelijkheden heeft geboden om de studie vóór 31 augustus 2021 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Werner over het bericht ‘Schaapsherders in de knel: er zijn er nog maar een paar over en subsidie komt niet bij hen terecht’

MPs Boswijk and Werner asked whether only four independent shepherds remain, whether shepherding is on the national intangible heritage list, and how the government will secure their survival given that subsidies flow mainly to nature organisations and provinces. The minister answered that traditional flocks number about fifty, that shepherding is on the national inventory, that subsidies come mainly from provinces and the CAP grazing scheme, and that a national scheme for rare breeds is planned for 2023-2027, without guaranteeing survival of each flock.
The whole set of support for traditionally shepherded sheep flocks, as outlined in my letter of January 2019, contributes to the maintenance of shepherded sheep flocks in the Netherlands.
Het geheel aan ondersteuning van traditioneel gescheperde schaapskuddes, zoals geschetst in mijn brief van januari 2019, draagt bij aan de instandhouding van gescheperde schaapskuddes in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van der Woude over het bericht 'Pride optocht Georgië afgeblazen na bestorming LHBTI-kantoor

MPs Brekelmans and Van der Woude asked the government how it judged the violence against the Tbilisi Pride march, what it had done to protect participants and journalists, and what it would do next. The Minister condemned the violence, said police deployment was insufficient, described diplomatic demarches and joint statements calling for protection and investigation, and promised continued pressure on Georgia.
The Netherlands will continue to press bilaterally and within the EU for an investigation by the Georgian authorities into the violence of 5 July.
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband blijven aandringen op onderzoek door de Georgische autoriteiten naar de gewelddadigheden op 5 juli.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Laan, Ellemeet, Kathmann en Simons over het bericht 'Kabinet biedt excuses aan voor oude transgenderwet'

MPs asked why the compensation scheme for the former transgender sterilisation requirement was not published by 1 July, how the Transgender and Intersex Collective was involved, and why the amount is EUR 5,000. The minister said publication was delayed, the Collective was consulted and its input shaped the scheme, the amount follows an earlier scheme for youth care abuse victims, and the scheme will be published in the Staatscourant with applications from 18 October 2021.
It has become apparent that drafting the scheme and preparing its implementation required more time than originally estimated.
Het is gebleken dat de totstandkoming van de regeling en het voorbereiden van de uitvoering meer tijd vereisten dan op voorhand was ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Peters over het bericht ‘AIVD: hoger onderwijs is zich totaal niet bewust van digitale dreiging'

MPs Van der Woude and Peters asked the Minister of Education whether higher education institutions are sufficiently aware of cyber threats from state actors, after the AIVD said they were not. The minister answered that institutions are aware and taking measures such as SURFsoc monitoring and board-level attention to cyber and knowledge security, while acknowledging that security must be raised further.
I will inform the House again in autumn 2021 about the progress being made on knowledge security.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het najaar van 2021 opnieuw informeren over de voortgang die er op het gebied van kennisveiligheid wordt geboekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de klachtenrapportage 2021 van de Jongeren Organisatie Beroepsonderwijs (JOB)

An MP asked the Education Minister about the JOB 2021 complaints report on premature digital education and sudden unjustified student deregistrations, and about inspectorate enforcement. The minister said the 1.5m distancing rule would be lifted for mbo and ho from 30 August, that deregistration rules will be clarified via the Versterken rechtsbescherming mbo studenten bill, and that the inspectorate considers deregistration policy in its supervision but does not rule on individual cases.
The inspectorate does not rule on individual situations of students.
De inspectie spreekt zich niet uit over individuele situaties van studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister dwingt universiteiten tot monsterplan diversiteit, anders geen subsidie'

An MP asks why the minister did not mention the EU requirement for gender equality plans in the 2020 national diversity action plan, and whether the Chamber was incompletely informed, plus details of the requirements and NWO's role. The minister replies that the requirement was flagged in the action plan and later letters, explains the mandatory versus recommended elements, and states NWO's assessment criteria fall within its own autonomy.
I informed your Chamber in September 2020 through the action plan about the European Commission's intention.
Ik heb uw Kamer in september 2020 via het actieplan geïnformeerd over het voornemen van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het bericht ‘Onderwijsminister dwingt universiteiten tot monsterplan diversiteit, anders geen subsidie’

An MP asks the education minister why a national advisory handreiking for gender equality plans goes beyond the EU minimum requirements for Horizon Europe and whether it risks affecting research funding. The minister answers that the handreiking adds no mandatory requirements beyond the four EU elements, that it is only inspirational, and that excellence remains the criterion for funding.
The handreiking contains no additional mandatory measures or requirements beyond the four elements (public document, budget, data and training) set by the European Commission.
De handreiking bevat geen extra verplichte maatregelen of eisen buiten de vier elementen (publiek document, budget, data en training) gesteld door de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'Onderwijsminister dwingt universiteiten tot monsterplan diversiteit, anders geen subsidie'

An SGP MP asked the Education Minister whether the Horizon Europe gender equality plan requirement turns substantive gender criteria into funding conditions, threatening academic freedom, and why the national handbook uses gender-neutral wording and controls the physical environment. The minister replied that the plan is only an eligibility criterion checked for presence, not substance, that the national handbook goes beyond the EU minimum requirements, and that the handbook prescribes nothing on the physical environment.
The European Commission clarifies in its guidance that the gender equality plan is not assessed on its substance.
De Europese Commissie geeft in voorlichting over de eisen aan dat het gendergelijkheidsplan niet inhoudelijk wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het reorganisatieplan lerarenopleidingen

The MP Pouw-Verweij (JA21) asks Minister Van Engelshoven whether the Bestuursakkoord on flexibilising teacher training is justified, and questions its links to PISA and McKinsey findings, the generalist-versus-expert debate, teacher shortages, and the Dijsselbloem commission's conclusions. The minister responds that the accreditation and final qualifications remain unchanged, that the reform aims to make training more flexible and accessible, and that the programme is carried out with the training institutions themselves.
The final qualifications of the teacher training programmes will not be changed.
De eindkwalificaties van de lerarenopleidingen worden niet veranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Internationaliseer de staf wanneer docenten slecht Engels spreken'

MP Peters asks the Minister of Education whether inconclusive research on Englishtaught higher education affects policy, whether internationalising staff is advisable, and whether this would displace Dutch lecturers. The Minister answers that the NRO study yields recommendations for institutions rather than new research, that her policy is not to stimulate English-taught programmes, and that the study does not recommend hiring international staff as a route in itself.
It is not my policy to encourage more English-taught programmes.
Het is niet mijn beleid om meer Engelstalige opleidingen te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over extra steun voor afgelaste festivals en evenementen

Opposition MPs from the PvdA asked the government about financial support for festivals and events cancelled during COVID-19, including gaps in the guarantee scheme, NOW and TVL, and eligibility for non-EU artists. The state secretary answered that support was being extended and a supplementary allowance introduced, but gave no overview of losses and deferred some questions.
There is no overview of the precise losses you ask about.
Er is geen overzicht over de precieze verliezen waar u naar vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Westerveld, De Neef en Ouwehand over het manifest toegankelijke festivals dat op 8 juni jl. is gelanceerd

MPs from SP, GroenLinks, VVD and PvdD asked ministers whether festivals should be more accessible for people with disabilities under the UN convention, why many are not, and whether the government will engage with the sector and international examples. The minister answered that the Onbeperkt Meedoen programme addresses accessibility, that gemeenten can set accessibility conditions in event permits, and that the government will raise the manifesto with VNG and VNO-NCW but gave no concrete new measures.
I will put this manifesto and the accessibility of festivals and events on the agenda in the talks I hold with the VNG and VNO-NCW.
Ik zal dit manifest en de toegankelijkheid van festivals en evenementen agenderen tijdens de gesprekken die ik voer met de VNG en VNO-NCW.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pouw-Verweij over het artikel in de Telegraaf van 12 juni jl. “Inbreuk op de academische vrijheid door de woke-cultuur en cancel-praktijk op universiteiten en hogescholen”

An MP asked the Minister of Education about alleged woke culture, cancel practices and diversity officers undermining academic freedom at Dutch universities, citing a Telegraaf article. The Minister denied seeing signs of censorship or cancel practices, described diversity policy as institutional responsibility, and said academic freedom must be protected.
I have no signals that this is practice at Dutch universities and universities of applied sciences.
Ik heb geen signalen dat dit op Nederlandse universiteiten en hogescholen gebruik is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Mijn kind wil niet meer Joods zijn’

An MP asked the Minister about reports that Jewish pupils face hostility at school during the Israel-Gaza conflict, including whether the Inspectorate is acting on such signals and how it coordinates with the National Coordinator against Antisemitism. The Minister replied that the Inspectorate received no reports of incidents against Jewish pupils, that it acts on serious signals on a risk basis, that teachers singling out Jewish pupils for Israel's conduct is unacceptable, and that he will consult the National Coordinator and support existing anti-antisemitism organisations.
The Inspectorate has received no reports in recent months of incidents directed at pupils of Jewish schools or Jewish pupils.
De inspectie heeft in de afgelopen maanden geen meldingen ontvangen van incidenten gericht tegen leerlingen van Joodse scholen of Joodse leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er vrees is voor stortvloed aan eigen bijdragen van studenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the regulation on other student contributions in higher education would lead to many extra fees, how 'costs related to the nature of a programme' are defined, how fees are communicated, whether students should pay for a VOG or sports medical advice, and whether the regulation should be withdrawn or fees capped. The minister answered that the regulation clarifies existing practice, that only costs not replaceable by a free alternative may be charged, that VOG and medical advice costs may be borne by students, and that the regulation will not be withdrawn, with caps applying only to certain items.
The regulation will not be withdrawn.
De regeling zal niet worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Amnesty: 1 op 10 Nederlandse studentes slachtoffer seks zonder instemming'

MPs Westerveld asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an Amnesty report finding that 11% of female students had experienced rape during their studies, and about university responsibilities, reporting procedures, confidential advisers and the new ombudsman role. The Minister said she was shocked, pointed to US and Dutch research and existing support structures, and said the report would be discussed with student organisations, while stating that most such violence occurs in private life and that ombudsman roles mainly concern staff.
The Amnesty report will certainly be discussed with the national student organisations.
Het rapport van Amnesty zal zeker besproken worden met de landelijke studentenorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat de hobbyvisserijsector op school reclame maakt

The MP asks whether a primary school lesson filmed with Sportvisserij Nederland, VIS TV and Enzo Knol amounts to hobby-fishing promotion disguised as teaching material, breaching the sponsorship convenant, and whether parents were asked consent. The minister replies that schools have autonomy over teaching materials under the constitutional freedom of education, that content review is the school's and inspectorate's responsibility, and that no further government action is planned.
It is not for the central government to review the content of teaching materials substantively.
Het is niet aan de rijksoverheid om lesmateriaal inhoudelijk te toetsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Laan, De Hoop en Westerveld over het artikel ''Raadsdames' in actie: de titel raadsheer is seksistisch'

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the Ministers whether the judicial title 'raadsheer' is still appropriate given that women hold the office, and whether gender-neutral titles should be adopted. The minister agrees gender-neutral titles fit better, but says a law change is a large operation and defers the decision to the next cabinet, with only a possible WODC study being explored.
It is therefore up to the new cabinet to decide on a legislative change to one or more gender-neutral job titles for raadsheren.
Het is daarom aan het nieuwe kabinet om een beslissing te nemen omtrent een wetswijziging naar een of meer sekseneutrale functietitels voor raadsheren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouchallikht over het bericht 'Stagediscriminatie bij mbo-studenten voor het eerst wetenschappelijk aangetoond'

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Education about a study confirming internship discrimination against Utrecht vocational students, and whether stronger measures such as an anti-discrimination body with practice testing, mandatory anti-discrimination policy, a reporting app and monitoring by school counsellors will be adopted. The Minister acknowledges the problem, points to awareness campaigns, the KIESMIJ campaign, a knowledge centre and a planned review of the work agenda, but does not commit to the specific structural measures, which depend on a pending bill and the next cabinet.
The next cabinet will decide on the new work agenda on internship discrimination and on appointing an advisory committee.
Het volgende kabinet zal een besluit nemen over de nieuwe werkagenda Stagediscriminatie en het aanstellen van een adviescommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Teunissen over het manifest ‘Klimaat in de Klas’

MPs Wassenberg and Teunissen asked the Minister of Education about the 'Klimaat in de Klas' manifesto, including curriculum climate content, student and teacher involvement, objectivity, and corporate influence such as Shell's festival and sponsorship in schools. The Minister answered that the government is open to dialogue, is pursuing stronger sustainability content in curriculum proposals, but says schools are autonomous and the government's ability to restrict corporate materials is limited by freedom of education and expression.
It is not centrally recorded how often and by what means companies or other parties try to influence education.
Er wordt niet landelijk bijgehouden hoe vaak en waarmee bedrijven of andere partijen proberen het onderwijs te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht “Ministerie schatte aantal studenten jarenlang verkeerd in”

An MP asked the Education Minister whether a flaw in the ministry's student forecasting model had caused student numbers to be underestimated since 1995, and how this was discovered and what it means for the budget. The minister acknowledged past over- and underestimates, said emigration and mortality were overstated and that the method has been corrected, and explained the budget impact was absorbed as a shortfall but did not send a separate letter, pointing to the April 2021 reference forecast report instead.
Due to exceptional circumstances (corona and the method change), the publication of the Reference Forecast 2021 was brought forward to promote transparency.
Vanwege bijzondere omstandigheden (corona en de methodewijziging) is de publicatie van Referentieraming 2021 vervroegd om transparantie te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het meerekenen van studieschuld bij een hypotheekaanvraag

An MP asked whether student debt should be counted in mortgage applications, whether the generation without a basic grant should be compensated, and whether students who began before COVID measures should be compensated for lower teaching quality. The minister replied that student debt must be declared and counted at a lower weighting, that compensation choices are for a future cabinet, and listed existing COVID-related tegemoetkomingen and tuition discounts.
Making these choices is for a next cabinet.
Het maken van deze keuzes is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het bericht ‘Bindend studieadvies zorgt voor betere prestaties en minder studievertraging

The MP asks about research showing that students who fall behind struggle to catch up, the scale of COVID-related study delay, how students will be monitored and steered away from unsuitable studies, and how the Wiersma motion and institutional autonomy are being handled. The minister answers that catching up is a challenge that depends on guidance, that study progress is not significantly lower than in other years but is worse in practical programmes, that national data will follow later, and that institutions keep autonomy while binding study advice has been relaxed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over proctoring

MP Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about whether student councils should have consent or advisory rights over online proctoring of exams, citing privacy concerns and student experiences. The Minister answered that fraud-prevention measures are not subject to statutory consent rights, that institutions must respect GDPR and privacy guidance, that programme committees have advisory rights over how exams are taken, and that institutions should inform students better and offer alternatives.
With a possible consent right, students would be given the opportunity to (co-)determine by which methods their own possibly fraudulent conduct can be detected.
Met een eventueel instemmingsrecht zouden studenten immers in de gelegenheid worden gesteld (mede) te bepalen met welke methodes hun eigen mogelijk frauduleuze handelen kan worden opgespoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over studentenuitwisselingen in coronatijd

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Education about universities cancelling student exchanges during COVID-19, whether policy follows travel advice, and how students can recover costs. The Minister said institutions decide on exchanges within the rules, the government lobbies in the EU for flexibility, and students should contact their institution about compensation.
It is up to the education institutions themselves to decide whether mobility projects can go ahead, within the frameworks.
Tot slot is het aan de onderwijsinstellingen zelf om te bepalen of mobiliteitsprojecten, binnen de kaders, doorgang kunnen vinden of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over uitwisseling van studenten tijdens corona

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether student exchanges could go ahead during COVID, including whether universities should decide per region, whether a taskforce is needed, and whether travel advice treats study abroad as essential. The minister gave a substantive answer on participation numbers and travel advice, but stated that institutions decide on exchanges and declined to set up extra support or a taskforce.
The decision on participation in exchange programmes is up to the institutions themselves.
Het besluit over deelname aan uitwisselingsprogramma’s is aan instellingen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Goede relatie met China belangrijker voor Universiteit Groningen dan academische vrijheid’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that Hong Kong students at the University of Groningen feel unsafe due to the Confucius Institute and worry about academic freedom, the government's role in knowledge security, the status of knowledge-security guidelines and dialogues, and the Hogeschool Zuyd contract with a Confucius Institute. The Minister says institutions must guarantee academic freedom, sets out the knowledge-security measures and timelines, and recommends that institutions decouple from the Confucius Institutes.
I therefore consider it sensible that the institutions concerned reconsider this embedding.
Ik vind het dan ook verstandig dat de betrokken instellingen deze inbedding heroverwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht 'Onveilige sfeer op modeschool AMFI: "Een docent vergeleek mijn Arabische model met een seriemoordenaar".

MP Peters asked the Minister of Education about reports of an unsafe climate at the AMFI fashion school, including a teacher comparing a student's model to a serial killer, and whether accreditation (NVAO) and the Inspectorate could act. The minister said the accreditation framework leaves social safety largely to the institution, that the Inspectorate is awaiting the institution's external investigation and is starting a thematic study on social safety in arts education, and that the arts sector and Raad voor Cultuur are being asked to act.
The inspectorate has informed me that it is awaiting the results of the external investigation that the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences is having carried out.
De inspectie heeft mij geïnformeerd dat zij de resultaten van het externe onderzoek dat de Hogeschool van Amsterdam laat uitvoeren afwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over het bericht ‘Beruchte NSB’ers kochten Joodse huizen op in Arnhem’

Two PVV MPs asked ministers about reports that NSB members bought up Jewish houses in Arnhem during the war, asking how much property Arnhem seized, for a full restitution overview, for restitution of looted property, and for investigation of municipal and professional roles. The government answered that Arnhem's own investigation is ongoing, that no federal additional research or restitution is planned, and that post-war restitution was already addressed through the 2000 compensation fund.
This investigation is complex because much administration was lost, partly due to the destruction of Arnhem in the last year of the war.
Dit onderzoek is complex, omdat veel administratie verloren is gegaan, onder meer door de verwoesting van Arnhem in het laatste oorlogsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Bruins over het artikel ‘Zet kinderen niet onder druk met genderkeuze’

MPs Bisschop and Bruins asked whether a Rutgers teaching guide on intersex and sex diversity is scientifically sound, and about the rise in gender care referrals among young people. The ministers answered that schools are free to choose their sources, that Rutgers' subsidised role justifies the guide, and that research into the rise in referrals is being done in the Netherlands and abroad.
Schools have the freedom to choose which information sources they want to use.
Scholen hebben de vrijheid om zelf te kiezen welke informatiebronnen zij willen gebruiken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Paternotte over het artikel ''Dit is oorlog': het internationale netwerk van christelijke fundamentalisten achter het Poolse abortusverbod'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about foreign-funded Christian fundamentalist networks active in Europe and the Netherlands, including Civitas Christiana, and whether this amounts to undesirable foreign influence and how the EU supports feminist movements. The minister confirmed such organisations operate in the Netherlands and that Civitas Christiana receives foreign funding, said this may constitute undesirable influence but with limited societal effect, pointed to a transparency bill, and noted the EU Rights and Values programme may support women's and LGBTI rights organisations.
Regarding Civitas Christiana, there could be a case of undesirable influence.
Omtrent Civitas Christiana zou sprake kunnen zijn van ongewenste beïnvloeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Van der Woude over het opnemen van studieschulden in het BKR-register

MPs Koerhuis and Van der Woude asked whether student debts would be registered with the BKR credit register, as the AFM proposed, and whether the government would keep its promise not to do so. The minister answered that the government will not move to BKR registration of student loans, noting that lenders can already verify loans via Mijn DUO and that student loans have different social repayment terms.
Yes, the cabinet will not proceed with BKR registration for student debts.
Ja, het kabinet gaat niet over tot een BKR-registratie voor studieschulden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Palland over het bericht ’Wijs bruine vloot aan als werelderfgoed’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Palland asked the government whether the Dutch 'bruine vloot' (heritage sailing vessels) could be designated UNESCO World Heritage, whether Dutch vessels receive less subsidy than abroad, and whether the government would engage with provinces and the sector. The minister replied that movable objects like ships cannot be listed under the World Heritage Convention, pointed to intangible heritage routes and existing COVID support schemes, and offered to talk with the sector while info on foreign subsidies was still being gathered.
I asked the RCE to gather information through its international network, but this will take some time.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd via zijn internationale netwerk informatie te verzamelen, maar dit zal enige tijd in beslag nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat bij het onderwijsplan misbruik en willekeur op de loer ligt

An MP asked the education ministers about Algemene Rekenkamer concerns over the Nationaal Programma Onderwijs (8.5 billion euro for catching up after COVID learning delays), including accountability, reporting burden, distribution, timelines and funding. The ministers answered that accountability will use standardized reporting via XBRL and a national monitor, but that the timeline will not be extended and that structural funding is not for this demissionary cabinet to decide.
