Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Kwint over een column van Rosanne Hertzberger in de NRC over de orthodox-Joodse school Cheider in Amsterdam

MPs Van Dijk and Kwint asked about alleged abuse at the Cheider school following a newspaper column, including corporal punishment, sexual abuse and a knife threat, and why the Inspectorate had not intervened. Minister Slob replied that recent inspections found no such incidents, that the school was under intensive supervision with sanctions imposed and suspended by a court, and that a bill to expand the Inspectorate's instruments is expected after the summer.
The inspectorate maintains intensive supervision of the school and has imposed two funding sanctions this school year on my behalf.
De inspectie houdt intensief toezicht op de school en heeft in dit schooljaar (2020/2021) namens mij twee bekostigingssancties opgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over registratie etniciteit universitair personeel

An FvD MP asked the ministers whether ethnicity is registered for university staff, how the CBS Barometer Culturele Diversiteit defines and operationalises it, and what data universities use. The minister answered that the barometer uses only pseudonymised existing records (birth date, sex, postcode, salary scale and similar) to derive migration background in aggregate, that employees are not asked to answer questions, and that employees can opt out by email.
Employees do not have to answer any questions for the Barometer Culturele Diversiteit, in line with the answer to your question 2.
Medewerkers hoeven, in lijn met het antwoord op uw vraag 2, in het kader van de Barometer Culturele Diversiteit geen vragen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het bericht 'TU Eindhoven hervat beleid om vrouwen voor te trekken, maar dan anders'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the revised preferential hiring policy of TU Eindhoven, which the Human Rights Institute had previously ruled against, complies with equal treatment law, how male applicants are treated, and whether the Institute's proportionality concerns are addressed. The Minister answered that the institution itself sets its hiring policy, that the Institute approved the revised programme, and that it is not for the Minister to judge the Institute's proportionality assessment.
It is not for me to pronounce myself on this.
Het is niet aan mij om mij hierover uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over het bericht 'Universiteiten delen zonder toestemming persoonsgegevens met CBS'

MPs Van der Woude and Ellian asked whether universities sharing staff personal data with Statistics Netherlands (CBS) for the Barometer Culturele Diversiteit, which infers migration background from data, complies with the motion on not recording ethnic background and with GDPR rules. The minister answered that universities do not record ethnic or migration background, rely on legitimate interest rather than consent, did no DPIA or prior consultation, and sees no reason to ask universities not to participate.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de voorgenomen maar nooit uitgevoerde fusie tussen Nederlandse Organisatie voor Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek (NWO) en ZonMw

An MP asked whether the abandoned NWO-ZonMw merger could be revived now that NWO has a new chair from medical sciences, and why the agencies should not be formally merged. The minister answered that the transition is largely complete, that no new merger attempt is planned, that the current cooperation agreement works well, and that a statutory merger is not the right instrument.
No, the current way of cooperating is adequate.
Nee, de huidige wijze van samenwerking voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de onderbetaling van artiesten die in de media optreden

MP Kwint asked the ministers whether the adopted motion requiring fair payment of artists appearing on public broadcasting has been implemented, and whether it is true that only about 5 cents per euro of music programme spending reaches artists. The minister replied that public broadcasters set artist fees themselves, that talks with the NPO and broadcasters are ongoing with a report to parliament promised before the summer recess, and that the NPO does not recognise the 5-cent claim.
On 17 February 2021 your House was informed by letter about the progress in implementing the Kwint et al. motion.
Op 17 februari 2021 is uw Kamer per brief 2 geïnformeerd over de voortgang van de uitvoering van de motie Kwint c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Woude over het bericht ‘Raad van State vreest dat uitstel tot afstel leidt bij kwaliteitsafspraken’

An MP asked why the Council of State's August 2020 advice on the quality-funding decree was not shared with Parliament and only published in April 2021, and how quality funds are monitored. The minister said Council of State advice on such decrees is not sent to Parliament, acknowledged publication was wrongly delayed, and described NVAO review of institutions' plans with four institutions still awaiting a decision.
Advice from the Council of State on a general administrative order (amvb) is not sent to the House of Representatives, nor is advice on a so-called pre-consultation amvb.
Adviezen van de Raad van State over een algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) worden niet toegezonden aan de Tweede Kamer, ook adviezen over een zogenoemde voorhang-amvb niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat tientallen Chinese onderzoekers in Delft banden hadden met het Chinese leger

PVV MPs asked whether dozens of Chinese researchers at TU Delft had ties to the Chinese military, whether knowledge flowed to the PLA, whether intelligence services screen Chinese researchers, and whether universities should stop cooperating with the 'Seven Sons' universities. The government answered that the TU Delft figures are limited and that an inventory and binding risk-assessment framework on knowledge security is underway, while it declined to provide nationality data, a blacklist, or confirmation of specific knowledge transfer.

The cabinet is working on a country-neutral package of measures that together offers a course of action for both knowledge institutions and central government to counter undesirable knowledge transfer.

Het kabinet werkt aan een landenneutraal pakket maatregelen dat samengenomen een handelingsperspectief biedt aan zowel de kennisinstellingen als de rijksoverheid om ongewenste kennisoverdracht tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhouach en Agnes Mulder over het bericht 'TT te vroeg voor financiële compensatie, Mulder stelt Kamervragen'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the TT Assen motorcycle race and other events planned before 1 July 2021 can be compensated under the temporary COVID-19 event subsidy scheme, given that the Drenthe safety region bars large events until 1 June. The minister answered that events can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December or receive support if they meet the scheme's conditions, and that the scheme was developed in consultation with the sector and safety regions.
Events planned before 1 July can be moved to a date between 1 July and 31 December, provided it fits the local agenda and a permit is granted.
Evenementen die voor 1 juli staan gepland kunnen worden verplaatst naar een datum binnen de periode 1 juli–31 december, mits dat in de lokale agenda past en er een vergunning verleend wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Palland over het uitblijven van branchespecifieke coronasteun voor de bruine vloot

An MP asked the government about the lack of sector-specific corona support for the traditional sailing ship (bruine vloot) sector, including delays in a promised 15 million euro scheme and wrongly assigned SBI codes forcing repeated objections. The state secretary answered that existing TVL/TOGS support fits these businesses, that the new scheme aims to open in June, and that RVO.nl is speeding up objection handling.
By May at the latest, the Ministers of Finance, Economic Affairs and Climate, and Social Affairs and Employment will come with a proposal on what the support will look like in the third quarter.
Uiterlijk in mei komen de Ministers van Financiën, Economische Zaken en Klimaat en Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid met een voorstel hoe de steun eruit zal zien in het derde kwartaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat het BPRC apen infecteert met het vogelgriepvirus

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about a BPRC study infecting monkeys with H5N1 avian flu, including animal suffering, the risk to the poultry sector, and whether the government will reduce animal testing and the primate breeding colony. The minister answers that the study was reviewed and permitted by the Central Committee on Animal Experiments, defers questions on zoonosis policy to a pending expert review, and states that the 40% reduction target for primate experiments by 2025 remains unchanged.

All animal experiments in the Netherlands are independently and carefully assessed by the Central Committee on Animal Experiments (CCD), which then determines whether the animal experiment may take place from a scientific and ethical standpoint.

Alle dierproeven Nederland worden onafhankelijk en zorgvuldig beoordeeld door de Centrale Commissie Dierproeven (CCD), die vervolgens bepaalt of de dierproef vanuit wetenschappelijk en ethisch oogpunt mag plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat dertien onderwijsbestuurders meer verdienden dan een minister

An SP MP asked the ministers why thirteen education board executives earned more than a minister despite underfunding, and why publicly funded bodies such as Cito and Surf have not complied with the online disclosure duty under the WNT pay cap. The ministers answered that the WNT is strictly applied, that the seven-year transitional regime for existing contracts is legally required to avoid breaching property rights, and that enforcement and falling numbers of above-cap salaries are expected.
In cases where there is a violation of the WNT, we, or the Inspectorate of Education on our behalf, will take enforcement action.
In de gevallen waarin sprake is van een overtreding van de WNT zullen wij, of de Inspectie van het Onderwijs namens ons, handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over artiesten voor de 'field labs' die niet betaald krijgen

An MP asked whether artists at the government-linked 'field labs' pilot events are unpaid and whether this is acceptable given the sector's hardship. The minister confirmed the events were initiated by the sector, performers participate pro bono, ticket proceeds go to the event, and listed general COVID support measures for culture.
The sector itself took the initiative to organise these events and approached the artists and suppliers to participate pro bono in the field labs.
De sector zelf heeft het initiatief genomen om deze events te organiseren en de artiesten en toeleveranciers benaderd om pro bono deel te nemen aan de fieldlabs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Palland over het bericht ‘Werkgevers: creatieve oplossing nodig voor meer stageplekken mbo’ers’

Two CDA MPs asked ministers whether creative solutions such as more trainees per company, variable internship length and retired supervisors could ease the shortage of MBO internship places, and what the SBB action plan has achieved. The minister answers that these options are already possible under the service document, cites about 20,000 students still seeking placements, and promises continued pressure on schools and employers and further action if needed.
If I find that this is not yet sufficient, I will work with SBB and other partners to ensure that the additional room from the service document is used as much as possible.
Als ik merk dat dit nog niet volstaat, zal ik mij samen met SBB en andere partners inspannen om te zorgen dat de extra ruimte uit het servicedocument zoveel mogelijk wordt benut.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat een D66-campagnefoto zes voorpagina’s heeft gehaald

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked about a D66 campaign photo that appeared on six front pages, asking whether photo credits matter for photojournalism, whether political control over journalistic images is desirable, the status of minimum rates for journalists, and the position of freelance photojournalists during COVID-19. The minister answered that source attribution is important, that journalistic independence must be respected, that binding fair practice rules now apply to public broadcasters and talks on a publishing-sector code are ongoing, and that COVID support measures were available to freelancers, without committing to new action.
Journalistic independence is a great good and a strong pillar of our democratic society, in which journalists act as a sound counterweight to politics and government.
Journalistieke onafhankelijkheid is een groot goed en een sterke pijler van onze democratische samenleving, waarin journalisten als een gedegen tegenmacht van politiek en overheid fungeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het artikel ‘Studenten lijden onder politiek-correcte groepsdwang’

An MP from PVV asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she recognises an opinion column claiming students suffer mentally from politically correct group pressure in higher education, and whether she will act against a perceived left-wing monoculture, including by adopting a neutral-conduct code for lecturers. The minister replies that the column is opinion without verifiable evidence, sees no reason for investigation or measures beyond existing complaint routes, and does not adopt the proposed code.
I see no reason in this column for further investigation or for taking measures.
Ik zie in deze column geen aanleiding tot nader onderzoek noch tot het nemen van maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over proctoring

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the use of online proctoring at universities and colleges, including whether student councils and programme committees must be consulted, and the Erasmus University's second-camera requirement. The minister answered that most institutions use proctoring under AVG rules, that programme committees and student councils have advisory or consultation roles but not formal consent rights over proctoring, and that she will keep discussing alternatives and the second camera with the umbrella bodies.
I therefore do not share the view that there is a right of consent over the way institutions combat fraud.
Ik deel de mening dus niet dat er instemmingsrecht bestaat voor de manier waarop instellingen fraude bestrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Geluk-Poortvliet over ‘Promovendi die mantelzorg verlenen hebben vaker mentale gezondheidsklachten, maar ze trekken niet aan de bel’

CDA MPs asked the education minister about carer-PhD candidates who have mental health complaints and do not inform their supervisors, and about their leave rights and support. The minister said universities are the employers and primarily responsible, outlined leave rights by type of PhD candidate, pointed to existing support channels, and noted a sector working group on better data and information.
Universities, as employers, are responsible for adequate information provision.
De universiteiten zijn als werkgevers verantwoordelijk voor toereikende informatievoorziening.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Geluk-Poortvliet over de berichten 'Ronald McDonald Huis en provincie Utrecht in de clinch over nieuwe locatie logeerhuis' en 'Zelfs minister bemoeit zich met discussie over Ro

MPs Terpstra and Geluk-Poortvliet asked why the Minister of OCW intervened in the planned relocation of the Ronald McDonald House on Utrecht Science Park, which falls within the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie heritage zone, and whether the minister could help by adjusting the nomination. The government answered that it asked the province to weigh the World Heritage aspect in its advice, that alternative sites outside the zone exist, and that the nomination boundaries cannot be changed at this stage.
In January 2021 I asked the Provincial Executive of Utrecht to properly take the World Heritage aspect into account in its advice.
In januari 2021 heb ik aan het College van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Utrecht gevraagd om in haar advies het aspect van werelderfgoed goed mee te nemen in de afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Belhaj over eventuele registratie homoseksualiteit bij Defensie

MPs Bergkamp and Belhaj asked about the treatment of LGBTI personnel in the Dutch armed forces, including past S5 unfitness markings for homosexuality and whether restitution is possible. The Secretary of State answered that no current cases of discharge or refusal for sexual orientation have surfaced, that the S5 marking was used only at pre-1974 conscription screening, and that individual cases will be reviewed while awaiting ongoing historical research.
I am always willing to look at individual cases, however there is so far no reason to conduct large-scale research into this.
Ik ben altijd bereid te kijken naar individuele gevallen, echter er blijkt vooralsnog geen aanleiding te zijn om hier grootschalig onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht dat studenten in Nederland China vrezen

MPs Van der Molen and Van Helvert asked whether the Groningen Confucius Institute chair contract, which bars damaging China's image, threatens academic freedom, and what measures the government will take. The minister said the RUG must safeguard academic freedom, the Inspectorate may investigate, the chair agreement will lapse this year, and further measures are under review.
The Inspectorate of Education can itself decide, based on signals including media reports, to launch an investigation.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs kan zelf op basis van signalen, waaronder berichten in de media, besluiten een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Zorg om banden RUG en China: hoogleraar mag imago China niet beschadigen'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a contract between the University of Groningen and Hanban that reportedly bars a China professor from harming China's image, and about academic freedom and foreign influence. The minister says the clause is a termination provision that does not affect the employment contract, that the university will not renew the chair agreement, and that she is in dialogue with the university and will pursue knowledge-security measures.
If such a situation arises, Hanban reserves the right to terminate the agreement.
Als zo'n situatie zich voordoet, behoudt Hanban zich het recht voor de overeenkomst te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Hanzehogeschool tentamens uitstelt vanwege datalek

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the Hanzehogeschool Groningen breached privacy rules by using digital surveillance (proctoring) for exams after a data leak, and what steps will be taken to ensure institutions follow the Dutch DPA guidance and the Futselaar motion. The Minister replied that the data leak was reported to the DPA, that institutions must decide exam-by-exam whether surveillance is necessary, and that agreements on proctoring were made with the sector and an inspection-based review is being explored.
I explicitly point institutions to their responsibility to comply with these guidelines.
Ik wijs instellingen nadrukkelijk op hun verantwoordelijkheid om deze richtlijnen na te leven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat journalisten stiekem konden meekijken bij online tentamens

MPs asked the education minister about reports that journalists could covertly watch online exams at Hanzehogeschool, exposing student names and ID numbers, and what safeguards exist. The minister confirmed the breach, described remedial steps and a notification to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, said no new regulation is needed, and declined to keep a register of online exam incidents, citing institutions' own responsibility.
Higher education institutions bear responsibility under their statutory duties for ensuring the quality of (online) examinations and their components.
Hoger onderwijsinstellingen dragen vanuit hun wettelijke taak de verantwoordelijkheid om de kwaliteit van de (online) examens en de onderdelen daarvan te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Van der Molen over opleidingsplekken voor huisartsen, physican assistants en verpleegkundig specialisten

CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Medical Care and of Education about shortages of GP training places and the funding of physician assistant and nurse specialist training, and whether the Capacity Plan advice could be followed. The government answered that more trainers are needed, that intake is growing more slowly than advised, and that about 22.6 million euros structurally would be needed for the GP advice, with no funds currently available.
At this moment no funds are available in the budgets of OCW and VWS to finance this.
Op dit moment zijn geen middelen beschikbaar op de begroting van OCW en VWS om dit te bekostigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de toename van seksueel geweld tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked ministers whether reported rises in sexual violence during the coronavirus crisis, based on a Rutgers study, are alarming and how they relate to domestic violence, police and prosecution data, and youth sexual health. The government answered that the Rutgers study does not show an increase in sexual violence, that police and prosecution data show fewer reports in 2020, and it pointed to existing campaigns and prevention programmes for youth.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'Proef met sneltesten voor studenten in Groningen op Zernike'

An MP asked the education minister about a COVID-19 rapid-test pilot for students at Groningen's Zernike campus, including test type, daily capacity, false-positive and false-negative rates, consequences for exam participation and safety measures. The minister answered in detail on test type (Abbott PANBIO antigen test, about 450 tests per day), its sensitivity and specificity, expected error counts, referral to GGD and PCR confirmation, and committed to informing the House by the second quarter.
As indicated in the letter of 23 February, all pilot regions are asked to deliver results by 1 May.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 23 februari worden alle pilotregio's gevraagd om op 1 mei resultaten op te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Westerveld over 'De tentamenzaal in ná de sneltest'

MPs Paternotte and Westerveld asked the Minister of Education about the COVID-19 rapid-test pilots that would allow more in-person education and exams, covering participating institutions, start dates, testing numbers, data sharing with the GGD and timelines. The minister answered in detail that eight regional pilots are starting, results are due by 1 May 2021, data sharing with the GGD is limited to positive results, and the cabinet will decide later on expanding in-person education.
The pilot regions have been asked to deliver results by 1 May 2021.
De pilotregio’s is gevraagd om uiterlijk 1 mei 2021 resultaten op te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Paternotte over het bericht 'Ombudsman wil meer aandacht voor obstakels Caribische studenten'

MPs Diertens and Paternotte asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on obstacles faced by Caribbean students in Dutch higher education, including study results, healthcare, BSN numbers and loan repayment. The minister answered that the government is working on improvement measures, has commissioned research and a regional steering group, and promised further letters and investigations on several points.
I have pointed out the Ombudsman's report to my fellow education ministers in the Kingdom.
Ik heb mijn collega-ministers van onderwijs in het Koninkrijk gewezen op het rapport van de Ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat studenten van de Erasmus Universiteit een tweede camera moeten gebruiken bij tentamens

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether the Erasmus University's requirement for a second camera during proctored exams is proportionate and privacy-compliant, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that institutions decide their own measures after a risk analysis with the data protection officer, that she calls on institutions to use second cameras only when strictly necessary, and that alternatives to proctoring should be offered where possible.
I call on educational institutions to be restrained in using a second camera for online examinations and to adopt this measure only where it is deemed strictly necessary.
Ik roep onderwijsinstellingen op om terughoudend te zijn met de inzet van een tweede camera bij online tentaminering en alleen over te gaan op deze maatregel als het strikt noodzakelijk wordt geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar, Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het herleven van een studieschuld na afronding van een WSNP

SP MPs asked why people who exited a debt-restructuring (WSNP) procedure received letters demanding resumption of student loan repayments at amounts unaffordable on a modest income, and whether DUO would soften this. The minister explained repayment is frozen during the procedure, admitted the letters can be unexpected and too high before income-based assessment, and said DUO will now phone debtors first where income is unknown and clarify the letters.
After consultation with DUO, it has therefore been decided no longer to announce the resumption of collection solely by letter.
Na overleg met DUO is dan ook besloten om niet langer uitsluitend per brief aan te kondigen dat de inning wordt herstart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de uitnodiging van de UvA over de start van de selectie voor de opleiding psychologie, de studieweek en de toetsdag

An SP MP asked the minister whether the UvA's 24-hour preparation requirement for its psychology selection test, alongside final exams, is reasonable, and whether other institutions impose similar burdens and whether this causes self-selection. The minister defended proefstuderen as a valid selection method, said preparation times vary (mostly 4 to 8 hours elsewhere), and said the Inspectorate is studying self-selection, with results due before summer.
To gain better insight into self-selection, the Inspectorate of Education is currently conducting research into this.
Om beter zicht te krijgen op zelfselectie, voert de Inspectie van het Onderwijs hier momenteel een onderzoek naar uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over steun aan de culturele en creatieve sector

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an EY report showing a 31% shrinkage of the European cultural sector, and whether large public investment, private investment, a supplementary support package and a European guarantee fund are needed. The minister answered that the Netherlands is investing over 1.7 billion euros in the cultural sector, that a 414 million euro package covers the first half of 2021, and that existing EU guarantee instruments are being used, while stating that a complete picture of the crisis effects is still being mapped.
Following the advice of the Council for Culture 'Onderweg naar overmorgen', I remain in discussion about making the cultural and creative sector more agile and resilient.
Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur «Onderweg naar overmorgen» blijf ik in gesprek over het meer wendbaar en weerbaar maken van de culturele en creatieve sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over het bericht 'Schrikbarend veel misbruik van ADHD-medicatie onder Nederlandse studenten'

CDA MPs asked the ministers whether they were alarmed by reports of widespread non-medical use of ADHD medication by Dutch students to boost academic performance, what the Trimbos/RIVM monitor shows, and what action will be taken, including about illegal online medicine sellers registered abroad. The minister answered that the monitor results arrive in mid-2021, that signals are being taken seriously and that action will follow if the monitor does not reassure, and that IGJ has no formal power over websites hosted abroad, though it takes part in Interpol's Operation PANGEA.
If the outcome does not provide a reassuring picture, I am prepared to take action to curb the undesirable development.
Als de uitkomst geen geruststellend beeld oplevert, ben ik bereid over te gaan tot actie om de ongewenste ontwikkeling af te remmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Wiersma over het artikel 'Soms blijkt een diploma van leerfabriek NCOI bitter weinig waard'

MPs Tielen and Wiersma (VVD) asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about a Trouw article on the limited value of NCOI diplomas, the scarcity of modular adult education, NVAO and inspectorate roles, and corona rules for distance learning. The minister answered that flexibilisation measures are underway, that the inspectorate is investigating NCOI's diploma claims with results expected before summer 2021, and that modular accreditation questions are deferred to a later cabinet.
Supervision of compliance with laws and regulations is after all assigned to the inspectorate.
Het toezicht op naleving van wet- en regelgeving is immers belegd bij de inspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

MPs asked why answers to earlier questions on the brown fleet (historic sailing charter vessels) aid of 15 million euro were delayed and when entrepreneurs would receive funds. The government answered that aid through the existing TVL scheme is being expanded, a separate subsidy scheme is being prepared, and a timeline will follow later, without a firm date.
I will inform the House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht "Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend"

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers why the EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet is complex and slow, and when shipowners will get clarity. The government answered that generic COVID support has been extended and that a separate subsidy for unique maintenance and operating costs of historic ships is being developed, with timing to be set with RVO.nl.
I will inform your House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over het bericht "Geneeskundestudent met migratieachtergrond voelt zich gediscrimineerd door opleiding en patiënt"

MPs Westerveld and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that a medical student with a migration background felt discriminated against by the programme and patients, asking about evidence, broader research, the Diversity Action Plan, assessment subjectivity, binding study advice effects, representation, awareness measures and internship discrimination. The minister cited VU research linking discrimination to fewer credits, said broader research is not necessary now, expressed confidence in the Action Plan, and answered the remaining questions mostly with general references, noting no national research on assessment subjectivity and an unclear effect of binding study advice, while committing to ongoing talks on an internship approach.
For that reason I do not consider broader research, in addition to what is already being done, necessary at this time.
Daarom acht ik een breder onderzoek – in aanvulling op wat er al gedaan wordt – op dit moment niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Op weg naar de juridische fusie’

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers about reported plans for a legal merger of AMC and VUmc, including a Stichting Amsterdam UMC target of 1 January 2022, staff and emergency-department concerns, and the need for WHW amendment. The minister answered that the bestuurlijke fusie was completed in 2018, that the legal merger requires a WHW amendment to be submitted around end-2021, that the Kamer was informed in November 2020, and that staff and patient councils were involved, while the SEH closure timeline is not yet decided.
The bill amending the law so that the desired cooperation can be facilitated is aimed to be submitted to the House by the end of 2021.
Het wetsvoorstel waarmee de wet zodanig wordt gewijzigd dat de gewenste samenwerking kan worden gefaciliteerd, eind 2021 in te dienen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kwint over de hoge BTW-heffing over digitale popevenementen

Two MPs asked why digital pop-event tickets are taxed at the 21% standard VAT rate rather than the 9% reduced rate and whether this should change. The State Secretary confirmed that electronic services fall outside the reduced rate under EU law, rejected a reduced rate for online cultural events, and pointed to subsidy packages and the Geefwet instead.
Under EU law it is not permitted to place online cultural events under the reduced rate.
Het is op grond van het EU-recht niet toegestaan online culturele evenementen onder het verlaagd tarief te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Palland en Bruins over signalen vanuit de Industriecoalitie m.b.t. de regelingen Leven Lang Ontwikkelen (LLO)

MPs Tielen, Palland and Bruins asked whether the government is aware of the Industriecoalitie's signals that LLO schemes are fragmented, favour surplus sectors over shortage sectors, and are hard to scale or combine with modular training. The minister acknowledged the consultations and defended the existing complementary schemes, promising evaluation and sector-led plans without committing to a structural redesign.
The starting point is that people can receive support depending on their position and needs.
Het uitgangspunt is dat mensen, afhankelijk van hun positie en behoefte, ondersteuning kunnen krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over discriminerend beleid binnen studentenorganisaties

An MP asked the education minister about discriminatory membership and officer policies at student organisations and whether they should lose public funding. The minister said no national criteria exist for subsidies or board grants, gave grant figures for Navigators branches, and stated that discrimination on sexual orientation is prohibited, but saw no reason for new measures beyond institutional dialogue.
I therefore see no reason to take further measures at this time.
Ik zie derhalve geen reden nu nadere maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Discriminerend beleid binnen studentenorganisatie: dit soort documenten zijn ontluisterend'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether student association Navigators discriminates against LHBTI members in its leadership criteria and whether such associations receive public funding through student grants. The minister condemned discrimination, explained the General Equal Treatment Act applies, said she is not aware of other such associations, and stated organisations violating that Act should not receive financial support, though she gave no concrete new measure.
I am of the view that organisations acting in breach of the General Equal Treatment Act should not receive financial support.
Ik ben van mening dat organisaties die handelen in strijd met de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling, geen financiële ondersteuning zouden dienen te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat een diploma van leerfabriek NCOI soms bitter weinig waard blijkt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that NCOI diplomas are sometimes of little value, including misleading claims, unexpected student costs, teacher working conditions and private profit margins, and asked for stricter oversight. The Minister said she awaits the Inspectorate's investigation, that the 2017 Wet bescherming namen en graden hoger onderwijs applies, that she has no responsibility for teacher conditions or private fees and profit margins beyond financial continuity, and reported 15.7 million euro paid to private providers via UWV in 2020.
Whether there are abuses depends on the results of the Inspectorate of Education's investigation. That is why I am awaiting the investigation.
Of er sprake is van misstanden hangt af van de resultaten van het onderzoek van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs. Daarom wacht ik het onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van de Molen en Van Toorenburg n.a.v. het bericht ‘Slecht Engels sprekende internationale studenten verdwijnen mogelijk in illegaliteit'

CDA MPs asked whether international students who fail to master English disappear into illegality, how the visa system tracks departures, and whether other EU countries face the same problem. The minister replied that no data exist on students who stay on illegally, that there are few signs of deliberate misuse so no extra action is planned, and that the English-language exemption in the code of conduct is optional for institutions, not a tightening of language requirements.
There is no data available if a student chooses not to return to their country of origin but goes into illegality or applies for residence in another country, whether or not within the EU.

Er zijn geen gegevens voorhanden als een student ervoor kiest om niet terug te keren naar zijn land van herkomst maar de illegaliteit ingaat of verblijf aanvraagt in een ander land, al dan niet binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wiersma over het bericht 'Gemeenten: uitstel nieuwe inburgeringswet teleurstellend'

MPs Becker and Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the postponement of the new civic integration law after municipalities criticised the delay, including the timeline, DUO's implementation assessments, and financial and practical consequences. The minister answered that the postponement was necessary for responsible implementation, that DUO's assessments flagged feasibility risks, that consultation with municipalities and partners is ongoing, and that several questions (financial impact, costs) are still being mapped.
My ministry is currently mapping the total financial consequences of the postponement and I am in discussion about this with the VNG and other chain partners.
Mijn ministerie brengt op dit moment de totale financiële gevolgen van het uitstel in kaart en ik ben hierover in gesprek met VNG en andere ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over wederom seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag op de faculteit Geesteswetenschappen van de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a new sexual misconduct case at the University of Amsterdam's Faculty of Humanities, including why the complaint was handled as it was, why anonymous reporting is not possible in formal complaints, and whether a national independent reporting point should be created. The minister responded that the lecturer has been removed from teaching pending external investigation, that universities are responsible for complaint handling, that a national reporting point is not the answer, and that a KNAW advisory report is expected in December 2021.
For the period during which this investigation runs, the lecturer has been completely removed from teaching.
Voor de periode dat dit onderzoek loopt is de docent volledig uit het onderwijs gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

Three VVD MPs asked why their earlier questions on the EUR 15 million aid scheme for the charter 'brown fleet' shipping operators remain unanswered, why the scheme is delayed, and when operators will receive funds. The item is a notice that the questions were answered during the 26 January 2021 model question hour, with the answers not reproduced in this text.

The written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini (all VVD) on the report 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Bruine vloot op de waakvlam - verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers about a news report that distributing the 15 million euro support scheme for the brown fleet (historic Dutch cargo vessels) is complicated and time-consuming, asking why, how it will be resolved, timing before 1 December, bank cooperation, the effect of the earlier inspection postponement, future options such as field labs, and whether money reaches entrepreneurs rather than administration. The answer, from the State Secretary, is a short referral noting the questions were answered in the 26 January 2021 model question hour and cited in a newspaper report, without substantive answers in this document.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini on the report on the brown fleet and the 15 million euro distribution were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijk vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend» zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over kansen(on)gelijkheid bij de toelating tot excellentieprogramma's in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about research showing students from lower-educated, modest-income families are less likely to be selected for excellence programmes in higher education, and what the government will do to improve equal access. The minister acknowledged the concern, said the programmes were already adapted to include motivation and background criteria, and pointed to inspectorate research, an expertise centre and institutional quality agreements, while leaving selection methods to institutions.
For admission to these programmes, qualitative criteria such as a student's motivation and social engagement are weighed alongside quantitative ones.
Bij de toelating voor deze programma's worden naast kwantitatieve ook kwalitatieve criteria meegewogen zoals de motivatie van een student en zijn of haar maatschappelijke betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Futselaar over coulanceregelingen en maatwerk in toelatingseisen voor mbo-, hbo- en wo-studenten

MPs Van den Berge and Futselaar asked whether newcomers who started higher education without their NT2 diploma will be deregistered, whether institutions can show leniency and offer case-by-case flexibility, and about NT2 exam waiting times. The minister answers that students are not deregistered if they pass before 1 September 2021, that institutions have legal room for hardship exceptions, that she remains in talks with sector bodies, and that waiting times are not known.
It is not known what the average time newcomers must wait before they can take the Staatsexamen NT2 is.
Het is niet bekend wat de gemiddelde tijd is die nieuwkomers moeten wachten voordat zij het Staatsexamen Nt2 kunnen afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Strenger studieadvies leidt tot hogere cijfers’

MP Wiersma asked the Minister of Education about Kickert's research finding that a stricter binding study advice (BSA) raised first-year results at Erasmus University Rotterdam, and whether BSA works, whether testing is the real problem, and whether the BSA should be retained. The Minister replied that the study shows a higher first-year pass rate but cannot show effects on completion, that BSA effectiveness depends on flanking policy, and that talks with the VH and VSNU on the BSA will be reported to the Chamber this spring.
I am in talks with the VH and the VSNU about the binding study advice following the various motions on the BSA that were adopted, and will inform the House more fully about this in the spring.
Ik ben in gesprek met de VH en de VSNU over het bindend studieadvies naar aanleiding van de diverse moties die over het BSA zijn aangenomen en zal de Kamer hierover dit voorjaar nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de verdubbeling van het aantal meldingen van discriminatie op universiteiten

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether she was aware that reports of discrimination at universities had doubled since 2017, and what was being done about it, including whether a national independent reporting point should be reconsidered. The minister said universities attribute the rise to greater awareness and more reporting points, announced talks with student organisations, and said a national reporting point was not appropriate yet because universities should first embed the new ombudsperson function.
A national reporting point is not appropriate at this time, because universities must first be given the chance to embed the ombudsperson function properly.
Een nationaal meldpunt ligt op dit moment niet voor de hand, omdat de universiteiten eerst de kans moeten krijgen om de ombudsfunctie op een goede manier in te bedden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Amsterdam op achterstand in opmars kunstmatige intelligentie'

MPs Van der Molen and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers of Education and Economic Affairs about reports that Amsterdam lags in AI, the number of AI graduates, the need to retrain 800,000 workers, and progress on the AI action plan. The government answered that AI training is broad and hard to count, that Dutch AI leadership remains strong, and that it will keep informing parliament through the digitalisation strategy progress reports.
It is difficult to give a complete figure for the number of people being trained in artificial intelligence.
Het is lastig om een compleet cijfermatig beeld te geven van het aantal mensen dat wordt opgeleid op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Ministerie OCW heeft geen geld voor herkomstonderzoek naziroofkunst’

MPs El Yassini and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the minister why there is no money for provenance research into Nazi-looted art and whether she will fund it, after a report on restitution policy. The minister confirmed there is currently no extra budget for the advised research into the NK collection, said she will address funding and implementation in her policy response in spring 2021, and committed to that response.
It is correct that no extra money is currently reserved for additional research into the NK collection, in addition to the structural expenditure in my budget.
Het klopt dat er momenteel geen extra geld gereserveerd is voor additioneel onderzoek naar de NK-collectie, in aanvulling op de structurele uitgaven op mijn begroting
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp en Özütok over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen transpersonen houdt aan: ‘We moeten dit niet accepteren’’

Three MPs asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how they will tackle violence against transgender people, whether police capacity via Roze in Blauw is adequate, and whether consultation with TNN will produce concrete measures. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited existing measures (equal treatment law, Actieplan Veiligheid LHBTI, a 2021 congress, police diversity networks) and said concrete new measures would be communicated to the House if warranted.
OCW has regular contact with Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) to see how the position of transgender people can be improved in various areas.
Vanuit OCW is er geregeld contact met Transgender Netwerk Nederland (TNN) om te zien hoe de positie van transgender personen op verschillende vlakken verbeterd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over samenwerking Nederlandse universiteiten met China.

Three CDA MPs asked the ministers about Dutch universities' cooperation with China, including whether contracts are tracked centrally, whether guidelines exist, and whether China-specific rules are needed. The government answered that institutions are autonomous and not obliged to register partnerships centrally, that RVO found faculty-level MoUs sometimes escape university board view, and that landen-neutral knowledge-security guidelines are being drafted for the second quarter of 2021.
I will, together with my colleagues, discuss this with the knowledge sector to explore what (administrative) agreements can be made on this.
Ik ga, samen met mijn collega's, hierover in gesprek met de kennissector om te onderzoeken op welke manier we hier (bestuurlijke) afspraken over kunnen maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Zoektocht naar 70 duizend extra stembureau leden: veel meer mensen nodig dan normaal' in de uitzending van WNL op maandag 30 november 2020

MPs Smals and Van Gent asked the ministers how they would address a shortage of about 70,000 polling station workers for the March 2021 elections, including whether vocational (mbo) students could fill roles, as an alternative to internships. The minister confirmed the proposals are being explored with the MBO council, VNG and other partners, and promised a January survey of municipalities and a possible regional or national reserve pool.
To get a good picture of the situation regarding the number of required polling station members, I will hold a survey among municipalities in early January.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de stand van zaken rond het aantal benodigde stembureauleden houd ik begin januari een peiling onder de gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Renkema over het bericht 'Vier op de tien vrouwen op de arbeidsmarkt benadeeld vanwege zwangerschap of pasgeboren kind: zwangerschapsdiscriminatie nog steeds onverminderd groot p

MPs Özütok and Renkema asked about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report finding that 43% of people active on the labour market who had a child in the past four years experienced pregnancy discrimination, and about the government's response, unions, works councils and the Inspectie SZW. The Staatssecretaris agreed the problem is serious, pointed to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, awareness campaigns, a planned stakeholder meeting, and the upcoming wetsvoorstel Toezicht gelijke kansen bij werving en selectie, while stating that the Inspectie SZW has extra capacity and held over 500 inspections this year.
I will work on providing employers with tools.
Ik zal inzetten op het bieden van handvatten aan werkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de restauratie van het Schnitgerorgel in de Grote of St. Michaëlskerk te Zwolle

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about funding for restoring the Schnitgerorgel in Zwolle, including whether the state would cover up to 100% of eligible costs and the status of a 2.5 million euro subsidy scheme for sounding heritage. The minister confirmed the organ's value, denied any commitment to 100% funding, and said the scheme would be published in spring 2021, with the organ potentially eligible.
No commitment has been made to the Grote Kerk in Zwolle to reach 100% subsidy of the eligible costs.
Er is aan de Grote Kerk te Zwolle geen toezegging gedaan om tot 100% subsidiering van de subsidiabele kosten te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de noodgedwongen sluiting van Frascati Producties

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the forced closure of production house Frascati, its effects on young talent and the theatre system, and alternatives to a bridging scheme. The minister pointed to €500,000 per year earmarked for a joint Frascati/Plan Brabant plan, referred to a letter of 7 December 2020 for consequences, and gave no direct answers on substance to most questions.
The aim is to grant this project subsidy in the first quarter of 2021.
Het streven is deze projectsubsidie in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over studiefinanciering

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education about the student loan system, including average debt before and after the 2015 reform, the number of Dutch students without a basic grant, the effect of student debt on maximum mortgage amounts, and the cost of extending free tuition to second degrees. The Minister answered each question with figures and estimates, noting that some recent-year data are not yet available.
No statements can be made about the years 2020–2021 (the current academic year) and 2021–2022 because these numbers are not yet known.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken gedaan worden over de jaren 2020–2021 (het huidige studiejaar) en 2021–2022 omdat deze aantallen nog niet bekend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Van der Molen over het CPB-onderzoek naar het niet-gebruik van de aanvullende beurs door studenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about a CPB study showing a quarter of eligible first-year students do not claim the supplementary grant, many of whom still borrow. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to DUO's proactive mailing experiment and planned website and MijnDUO changes, said automatic payment would need a law change and privacy review, and noted retroactive claims are possible until the start of the study year.
Therefore DUO will next year point all students more emphatically to the supplementary grant in this way.
Daarom gaat DUO volgend jaar alle studenten op deze manier nadrukkelijker op de aanvullende beurs wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het nieuws dat veel eerstejaarsstudenten geen gebruik maken van de aanvullende beurs

An MP asked the education minister about news that a quarter of first-year students entitled to the supplementary grant do not claim it, and whether DUO could grant it automatically or inform eligible students. The minister acknowledged the problem, cited a CPB study and a DUO trial that raised uptake, and said she will investigate automatic granting and application-screen changes, though these would need legislation.
I do indeed intend to investigate whether the supplementary grant can be granted automatically to students who are eligible for it.
Ik ben inderdaad van plan te onderzoeken of de aanvullende beurs automatisch kan worden verstrekt aan studenten die daarvoor in aanmerking komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Studenten laten aanvullende beurs vaak liggen’

An MP asks why a quarter of eligible first-year students did not claim the supplementary grant in 2018 and what will be done to inform them. The minister acknowledges the problem, cites causes such as poor awareness and stigma, and commits to improved information, a DUO mailing experiment and further studies on automatic entitlement checks.
I find it worrying that not all those entitled make use of the supplementary grant.
Ik vind het zorgelijk dat niet alle rechthebbenden gebruik maken van de aanvullende beurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over Iconen van de Rijkshuisstijl

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the gender-normative government icons in the Rijkshuisstijl should be removed and non-gender-normative principles adopted. The minister agreed gender-normative communication should be avoided and said the Voorlichtingsraad will work on a plan for inclusive image communication that could include non-gender-normativity.
Mid-year, the Voorlichtingsraad was tasked with setting up a working group that will develop an action plan for inclusive image communication.
Medio dit jaar heeft de Voorlichtingsraad de opdracht gekregen om een werkgroep in te richten die een plan van aanpak voor inclusieve beeldcommunicatie uit zal werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van Helvert en Paternotte over het bericht ’Internationale steun voor Einstein Telescope groeit; 'Toponderzoeksproject met een wereldwijde impact'

Three MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about international support for the Einstein Telescope, including Italian and German funding, the Recovery Fund, and whether the project can be submitted to the National Growth Fund. The minister confirmed a meeting with North Rhine-Westphalia, declined to comment on Italian budget financing, said the bid process and criteria are still being designed, and that no project announcements will be made before the Growth Fund review.
I am aware that funds are being made available in both locations, in Italy and the Euregio, for research into the suitability of the site.
Het is mij bekend dat op beide locaties, zowel in Italië als de Euregio, middelen ter beschikking worden gesteld voor het onderzoek naar de geschiktheid van de locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'De Jonge Akademie wil maatregelen tegen vliegverslaving'

MP Bisschop asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a report that De Jonge Akademie wants measures against academics' flying, including incomplete emissions data, reducing long-haul trips and funder conditions. The minister answered that data is incomplete and measurement methods vary, that the government prioritises cleaner aviation and offsetting over avoidance, and that she is willing to discuss measures with VSNU and NWO.
I am willing to discuss with the VSNU and NWO the measures they can take to reduce the number of international flights.
Ik ben bereid om met de VSNU en NWO in gesprek te gaan over maatregelen die zij kunnen treffen om het aantal internationale vluchten te doen afnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de Leidse rechtenfaculteit vrijwilligers werft voor het nakijken van scripties

An SP MP asked the minister whether it is acceptable for Leiden law faculty to recruit former colleagues as volunteers to grade bachelor theses during the corona surge, and whether grading is structural work that should be paid. The minister answered that the people involved receive paid temporary teaching appointments rather than volunteer work, that a permanent staff member still co-assesses each thesis, and that the initiative is a creative response to the surge.
The former colleagues and professional peers involved in fact receive a temporary appointment as lecturer and are paid accordingly.
De betrokken oud-collega's en vakgenoten krijgen namelijk een tijdelijke aanstelling als docent en overeenkomstig betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over de berichten 'Docent Rotterdams college bedreigd om spotprent' en 'Docent duikt onder om cartoon in de klas'

Two MPs asked the government about reports that a teacher in Rotterdam was threatened over a cartoon and went into hiding. The minister answered that he contacted the school and teacher, supports them, that police and the Inspectorate acted, a criminal investigation is ongoing, and that the Wet veiligheid op school is being evaluated.
Arrests have since been made in this case and the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Er zijn inmiddels aanhoudingen verricht in deze zaak en het strafrechtelijk onderzoek is gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Bosman over het bericht 'regering Hongarije wil Grondwet aanpassen: ouder zijn altijd een vrouw en een man'

MPs El Yassini and Bosman asked the Dutch government how Hungary's planned constitutional change on parental definitions and adoption rules fits with EU rule-of-law conditionality, what steps it will take at EU level, and how it will promote equal treatment of LGBTI people. The minister answered that the conditionality mechanism is tied to EU budget interests, that Hungary's concerns will be raised in the Article 7 procedure and bilaterally, and that the Netherlands is building coalitions and funding LGBTI NGOs.
The Netherlands will actively point out to the Commission the need to uphold the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.
Nederland zal de Commissie actief wijzen op de noodzaak om het EU Handvest voor de Grondrechten te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht ‘Verhalenboek moet Achterhoeks stimuleren’

MPs El Yassini asked the ministers whether the regional dialect Achterhoeks, a Nedersaksisch variety, is supported, including private initiatives such as a dialect storybook and the 2018 convenant on Nedersaksisch recognition. Minister Ollongren answered that the government values regional languages, describes the convenant, the EUR 25,000 funding in 2019 and provincial support via ECAL, and says regional governments take the lead.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, as coordinating department, is in contact with the local governments involved in the recognised regional languages of the Netherlands.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heeft als coördinerend departement contact met de lokale overheden betrokken bij de erkende streektalen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over de stagetekorten in het mbo

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education about internship shortages in vocational education (mbo), including study delays, costs for students, shortages in public sectors and discrimination. The minister answered that the government is pursuing action plans, alternative forms of practical training, support schemes and a Rijk-wide effort to restore government internship places, while leaving some proposals to SBB, schools and other bodies.
Government-wide efforts are underway to restore the number of internship places within central government to the 2019 level.
Rijksbreed wordt eraan gewerkt om het aantal stageplaatsen binnen de rijksoverheid weer terug te krijgen op het niveau van 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over Omscholing Dansers Nederland

MP Asscher asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the financial crisis of the Dutch dancers' retraining fund ODN, including why dance companies struggle to pay premiums and what the government will do to prevent its disappearance in 2021. The Minister says collective training agreements are the responsibility of employers and employees, acknowledges a budget shortfall, and says she is in talks with the sector about a possible one-off repair but gives no firm commitment.
Agreements on training, however, like agreements on wages or working hours, are not a responsibility of the government but of employers and employees.
Afspraken over scholing zijn echter, net als afspraken over loon of werktijden, geen verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid, maar van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Gratis lenen bij DUO'

MP Van der Molen asked whether DUO promoted borrowing with a social media post titled 'Gratis lenen bij DUO' and what DUO does to make students aware that borrowing costs money. The minister says the post was not as described, that the wording was unfortunate but already corrected, and lists existing information, experiments and plans to raise awareness among students.
I am of the opinion that the original text was unfortunately chosen, but it does not promote borrowing money.
Ik ben van mening dat de originele tekst ongelukkig is gekozen, maar geld lenen niet promoot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over misstanden rondom meldingen van sociale onveiligheid op universiteiten

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report finding that the University of Amsterdam mishandled complaints of sexual misconduct, and whether reporting procedures, ombudsman options and a national reporting point are adequate. The minister said universities are taking steps, asked the KNAW to advise on academic culture, promised to inform parliament about an ombudsman framework, and saw no reason for a national reporting point.
I have therefore asked the KNAW to advise on the prevention and handling of misconduct and intimidation in academia and to set up a committee for this purpose.
Ik heb daarom de KNAW gevraagd om te adviseren over de preventie en aanpak van wangedrag en intimidatie in de academische wereld en daarvoor een commissie in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Minder buitenlandse studenten blijven: dat gaat geld kosten'

MPs Wiersma and Van der Molen asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a report that fewer international students stay in the Netherlands after graduating, its economic costs, selection options, and follow-up on earlier motions. The minister answered that the decline is modest and likely temporary, that selection is mainly the employers' responsibility for retention, that EU-level action on balanced mobility is limited, and that a talent strategy will follow.
I will go further into more targeted recruitment of international talent in the talent strategy.
Ik zal in de talentstrategie verder ingaan op een meer gerichte werving van internationaal talent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat niet alle bijzonder hoogleraren voeding aan de Wageningen University & Research (WUR) transparant zijn over nevenwerkzaamheden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a Foodwatch report that nearly half of WUR's special professors in nutrition did not fully disclose their side activities, and whether this breaches the integrity code and threatens independence of science. The Minister answered that WUR has contacted the professors and demanded quick corrections, that responsibility for enforcement lies with institutional boards, and that universities report much higher disclosure rates but she sees no reason to call the VSNU in or impose sanctions now.
WUR has again contacted all special professors and urgently requested that the shortcomings regarding side activities in the system be corrected in the short term.
WUR heeft alle bijzonder hoogleraren nogmaals benaderd en dringend verzocht de tekortkomingen rond nevenwerkzaamheden in het systeem op korte termijn aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de dreigende sluiting van de bibliotheek in Almelo

An MP asked ministers whether the Almelo public library faced closure due to a municipal subsidy cut and whether they would intervene. The minister acknowledged the importance of library access, said organising it is the municipality's responsibility, and noted the council reduced the cut from 200,000 to 100,000 euros so closure no longer applies.
Given the decentralised character of the library system, the way this is shaped is the responsibility of the municipality.
Gezien het decentrale karakter van het bibliotheekstelsel is de wijze waarop dit wordt vormgegeven de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht 'De beladen bunker van Seyss-Inquart kwijnt weg'

MPs Beckerman and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the deteriorating Seyss-Inquart bunker, a national monument, and how to protect it during its sale, including maintenance duties, heritage protection against unsuitable buyers, and whether stricter conditions can be imposed. The minister answered that maintenance continues, the sale is planned to conclude by end 2021, existing heritage law and zoning rules are sufficient protection, and additional conditions are being considered.
The Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) has carried out the necessary maintenance in recent years and will continue to do so until transfer to a new owner.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (RVB) heeft de afgelopen jaren het nodige instandhoudingsonderhoud gepleegd en zal dit ook tot de overdracht aan een nieuwe eigenaar blijven plegen
Antwoord op van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Hoe een kunstenaar carrière maakt onder aanhoudende beschuldigingen van aanranding en verkrachting’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a NRC report on an artist continuing his career despite repeated allegations of sexual assault and rape, and about reports of misconduct and racism in Dutch art institutions shared on an Instagram account and with the Mores complaints platform. The minister condemned boundary-crossing behaviour, said the artist's case is under criminal investigation, pointed to existing complaint and ombudsperson channels, promised talks with the Vereniging Hogescholen, and said no structural problem has been shown, though the sector should adopt a protocol.
It is important to report the boundary-crossing behaviour to the confidential counsellor or ombudsperson and, if necessary, to file a police report.
Het is belangrijk om bij de vertrouwenspersoon of ombudspersoon melding te maken van het grensoverschrijdende gedrag en zo nodig aangifte te doen bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘studenten die spionagesoftware moeten installeren om tentamens te kunnen doen’.

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether students being forced to install surveillance software (proctoring) for exams is acceptable, given privacy concerns and expert warnings. The Minister says proctoring is sometimes necessary when alternatives are infeasible, that GDPR-compliant safeguards apply, that students may object and request alternatives, but gives no figures on use and no commitment to compensate or to stop its use.
Institutions do not register how many students do or do not install proctoring software.
Instellingen registreren niet hoeveel studenten wel of niet proctoring-software installeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Radboud Universiteit en Radboudumc in Nijmegen mogen zich niet langer 'katholiek' noemen'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Radboud University and Radboudumc losing the 'Catholic' label, the Bishops' Conference's role in appointing supervisory board members, and whether church-based appointment rules are compatible with constitutional and equal-treatment law. The Minister answered that the Bishops' Conference rejected five nominations, that the foundation's governance codes apply, that the institutions' freedom of religion permits such requirements within equal-treatment limits, and that no Inspectorate investigation is planned.
On the basis of this case, but also in general, I see no reason to question the independence and composition of the supervisory boards of universities and colleges.

Ik heb op grond van de onderhavige casus, maar ook in zijn algemeenheid, geen aanleiding om de onafhankelijkheid en samenstelling van de raden van toezicht van universiteiten en hogescholen ter discussie te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kröger en Van den Berge over maatregelen tegen verspreiding COVID-19 op scholen

MPs from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Basic and Secondary Education about poor school ventilation, school closures due to COVID-19 infections, online education for quarantined pupils, mask rules and related guidance. The minister answered that schools are responsible for ventilation improvements supported by €100 million short-term and €260 million long-term funding, and outlined existing monitoring, advice and guidance without committing to new binding measures.
In addition, I call on schools to share the results with staff and parents.
Daarnaast roep ik op de resultaten te delen met het personeel en de ouders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp, Özütok, Bouali en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over aandacht voor de kwetsbare positie van oa. LHBTI’s in de nationale en internationale COVID-19 respons

MPs asked the government about the vulnerable position of LHBTI people during the COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands and internationally, including healthcare access for transgender people and UN recommendations. The Minister answered that impacts are being studied (Movisie survey due in autumn), referred healthcare questions to another minister, said the UN refugee camp reports were not confirmed, and described Dutch advocacy at the UN.
This question falls under the policy area of the Minister for Medical Care and Sport (MZS).
Deze vraag ligt op het beleidsterrein van de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport (MZS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht ‘misleidende kindermarketing door de vee-industrie’

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will act against pig-industry marketing aimed at children, including the 'The Pig Story' lesson pack and the Agractie 'Boer in de klas' programme that receives a start-up subsidy. Minister Schouten answers that schools freely choose their materials, the government does not vet or warn against them, no oversight tightening is planned, and the subsidy conditions are described.
Beyond that, I do not foresee any additional steps.
Verder voorzie ik geen extra stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Emiel van Dijk over het bericht dat de Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) in de jacht op internationale studenten de grenzen opzoekt

MPs Beertema and Emiel van Dijk asked whether the University of Amsterdam enrolls international students in preparatory years for other programmes to obtain residence permits, and whether the government will end this and related agent recruitment. The minister answers that the practice does not fit the national code of conduct, that IND will consult the UvA, and that the code commission's report on preparatory tracks will be discussed with the umbrella organisations.
Enrolling students in a programme other than the one they wish to follow, including the associated preparatory year, is not in line with the intention of the Code of Conduct.

Het inschrijven van studenten voor een andere opleiding, inclusief het bijbehorend voorbereidend jaar, dan de opleiding die de student wenst te volgen, is niet in overeenstemming met de intentie van de Gedragscode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht ‘Uitgaan is nu een avondje zitten’

An MP asked several ministers about illegal parties during COVID restrictions, enforcement numbers, the option of controlled reopening of venues, and support for the sector. The government answered that enforcement data cannot be split by party type, that nightclubs stay closed due to infection risk, that a ventilation pilot is being prepared, and that financial support schemes continue.
Unfortunately, a breakdown by illegal parties and festivals cannot be made.
Een uitsplitsing naar illegale feesten en festivals is helaas niet te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Culturele instellingen in chaos na coronamaatregelen

MPs asked the ministers why COVID-19 exemptions for cultural institutions differ between regions, why safety regions were unprepared, and whether a uniform rule set and RIVM-tested pilots are possible. The government answered that exemptions lapsed after the tougher measures of 13 October, that a uniform 30-visitor cap now applies and a routekaart improves predictability, and that a Fieldlab programme and RIVM advice will inform test events.
With these tougher measures, the possibility for the Safety Regions to grant exemptions has lapsed.
Met deze stevigere maatregelen is de mogelijkheid tot het verlenen van vrijstellingen door de Veiligheidsregio’s komen te vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Brutale roof Congolees beeld als protest in Afrika Museum’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Van Dam asked whether politically motivated thefts and threats against Dutch museums are increasing and how art crime is handled by police, including the Team Kunst- en Antiekcriminaliteit and cooperation with the Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed. The minister answered that sector data are insufficient for a firm conclusion, described the organisation of art crime enforcement and the existing cooperation, but gave no commitments on new action.

There is insufficient data available in the sector to make a concrete statement, based on a sound analysis, about the nature and number of threats to collections in museums and other public institutions in the Netherlands.

Er zijn in de sector onvoldoende gegevens voorhanden om op basis van een gedegen analyse een concrete uitspraak te doen over aard en aantal van de dreigingen richting collecties in musea en andere publieke instellingen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Weverling over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse universiteiten werken samen met omstreden techgigant Huawei’

MPs Wiersma and Weverling asked the ministers why Amsterdam universities are collaborating with Huawei on AI-related research despite security risks, and whether the government had warned the UvA about risks. The government answered that universities are autonomous and responsible for their own risk assessments, that the ministries gave advice on risks without formal approval, and that it is studying additional knowledge-security measures to report on this autumn.
Entering into a collaboration is therefore the responsibility of the institution itself.
Het aangaan van een samenwerking is dan ook de verantwoordelijkheid van een instelling zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Nederlandse digitale veiligheid en de ontmoeting met de Chinese minister van Buitenlandse Zaken

An MP asked the government about the Dutch digital security implications of university research cooperation with Huawei and about the PM's and Foreign Minister Blok's meeting with Chinese FM Wang Yi. The government answered that the research is civilian (multilingual search), results are open access, universities are responsible for their own partner choices, and a neutral framework for telecom suppliers applies.

The cabinet will inform the House this autumn in more detail about the state of affairs in the process toward additional measures to counter unwanted knowledge and technology transfer through education and research.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer dit najaar nader informeren over de stand van zaken bij het proces om te komen tot aanvullende maatregelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Beertema over samenwerking tussen Amsterdamse universiteiten en de Chinese onderneming Huawei
