Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Amsterdam universities' joint AI search-technology project with Huawei Finland risks handing advanced technology to a dictatorship that uses such tools for repression, and whether the project should be stopped. The government answered that export controls apply to dual-use goods, that AI as a field is too broad to fall under them, that the cooperation is for civilian consumer search and the institutions are autonomous, so the cabinet has no formal role in approving or blocking such agreements, while a broader review of knowledge security is ongoing.
The cabinet has no formal role in approving or disapproving cooperation agreements of institutions.
Het kabinet heeft geen formele rol in het goed- of afkeuren van samenwerkingsovereenkomsten van instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van den Berg over het bericht 'Amsterdamse universiteiten gaan samenwerken met Huawei'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg (CDA) asked ministers about reports that Amsterdam universities would collaborate with Huawei on AI research, including the role of security services, dual-use concerns, and the need for national-security frameworks. The government answered that universities are autonomous and responsible for their own partnership decisions, that AIVD and NCTV advised on risks without formal approval power, and that the government is developing additional knowledge-security measures.
The Dutch intelligence and security services have no role in approving or disapproving such collaborations.
De Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen rol in het goed- of afkeuren van dergelijke samenwerkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Asscher over de onduidelijkheid die is ontstaan over het maximum aantal personen dat momenteel is toegestaan in culturele instellingen

Asscher (PvdA) asks the ministers to clarify confusion over whether cultural venues may admit more than 30 visitors after the 13 October tightening, and whether exemptions, criteria, support and quick clear guidelines will be provided. Minister Van Engelshoven answers that the exemption possibility lapsed, a 30-visitor maximum applies to theatres, concert halls and cinemas, she sympathises with the sector, and additional support money is being considered, with the answers mostly referring back to the first answer.
For the answer to this question I refer to my answer to Question 2.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar mijn antwoord op Vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Cultuursector meldt met 62 procent relatief grootste omzetverlies bij UWV’

MPs Van den Berge, Asscher and Kwint asked the ministers whether the culture sector's 62 percent turnover loss at UWV, the delay in support, the adequacy of the second support package, the talent drain, the link with the April motion, sector robustness and events-sector compensation were acceptable. The minister responds that substantial support (about 1.3 billion euros in total) has been provided in stages, that the second package covers January to June 2021, and that further measures are under discussion with the sector and the Raad voor Cultuur.
I regret that institutions and businesses in the cultural and creative sector have to decide to dismiss staff because of this crisis.
Ik betreur het dat instellingen en ondernemingen in de culturele en creatieve sector door deze crisis moeten besluiten tot het ontslaan van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over de loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked the government how it responds to the European Committee of Social Rights finding that the Netherlands falls short on closing the gender pay gap, and what measures are being taken. The state secretary answers that the ECSR found shortcomings on pay transparency and effective measures, that the gap is narrowing only slowly, points to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, the diversity-in-top measures and a forthcoming study on public-sector pay gaps, and says a certification scheme and other transparency measures are still being studied.

The cabinet will come with a position on the private member's bill this autumn, now that the proposal and the response to the Council of State's advice have been submitted to the House of Representatives.
Het kabinet zal dit najaar met een standpunt komen over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel nu het voorstel en de reactie op het advies van de Raad van State is ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Özütok en Bergkamp over het voortbestaan van het Roze in Blauw politieteam

MPs Van den Hul, Özütok and Bergkamp asked whether police agents' workload threatens the Roze in Blauw LHBTI network, and what the government will do to protect it. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the Amsterdam unit is in talks with the network, that the government will monitor developments and stay in consultation with the police leadership, and that the network's expertise is secured through the Netwerk Divers Vakmanschap.
I consider it of great importance that the work of RiB continues in a meaningful way.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat het werk van RiB op een zinvolle wijze wordt voortgezet.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Hoe de UvA in de jacht op de internationale student de grenzen opzoekt'

MPs Van der Molen and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked about reports that the UvA, via the private firm OnCampus, admits non-EEA students with havo-level qualifications through a preparatory year, and whether this breaches the WHW and the Gedragscode. The minister replied that the Landelijke Commissie report is being awaited, that the Inspectie does not supervise these preparatory programmes, that the practice conflicts with the spirit of the law and code, and that further steps and consultations with the sector and Inspectie will follow.
The preparatory education offered to international students does not constitute education as defined in the WHW.
Het voorbereidend onderwijs dat aan internationale studenten wordt aangeboden betreft geen onderwijs zoals gedefinieerd in de WHW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Tielen over het bericht dat de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) de bestuurlijke afspraken over laaggeletterdheid heeft opgezegd

MPs Kwint and Tielen asked why the VNG terminated the administrative agreements on functional illiteracy, whether the budget is adequate, and what this means for quality labels, regional plans and digitalisation. The Minister of Education answers that the budget is supplemented by about €125 million under Tel mee met Taal, that the agreements are too recent to evaluate, that new agreements are being negotiated with municipalities, and that a further letter will follow on quality and the Leesoffensief.
That is why, in implementation of the Tielen-Kwint motion, I am in discussion with municipalities to reach new agreements.
Daarom ben ik, ter uitvoering van de motie Tielen-Kwint, in gesprek met gemeenten om tot nieuwe afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht ‘dat studenten hun diploma kwijtraken na haperend online tentamentoezicht’

MPs Futselaar asked the minister why students lost exams after failing online proctoring, why it took two months to annul them, and how online safety and data protection would be ensured. The minister replied that examination boards and institutions are responsible for remedies, pointed to planned online security audits, and confirmed institutions are responsible for student data under the GDPR.
If incidents occur where quality cannot be guaranteed, for example due to technical problems with an online proctoring system, it is up to the relevant examination board to intervene

Indien zich incidenten voordoen waarbij de kwaliteit niet gewaarborgd kan worden, bijvoorbeeld door technische problemen van een online proctoring systeem, is het aan de betreffende examencommissie om in te grijpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de oproep tot een continuïteitspakket voor jonge wetenschappers in de knel

MP Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she acknowledged the hardship of young researchers during the coronavirus crisis and whether she would fund a €350 million continuity package requested by three organisations. The minister acknowledged the impact, said universities as employers bear primary responsibility, created up to €20 million extra room via a NWO policy rule for affected researchers, and declined the full package while agreeing to continue talks.
I consider it important that universities and research institutes, where possible, offer researchers on temporary contracts room for extension
Ik vind het van belang dat universiteiten en onderzoeksinstituten waar mogelijk onderzoekers op een tijdelijk contract ruimte voor verlenging bieden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Wiersma, Paternotte en Bruins over het bericht 'NWO lijkt haar jonge onderzoekers te zijn vergeten'

Four MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how the government will protect Rubicon fellows researching abroad whose projects were delayed by the COVID-19 crisis and who fall outside Dutch institutions' support measures. The minister answered that a limited earmarked amount of up to 20 million euros will be allocated to NWO via a policy rule for researchers in the final phase of temporary contracts, while declining to commit additional funds from her own budget and noting the number of affected fellows is not yet known.
However, I will give NWO a general directive in the form of a policy rule of up to 20 million euros, to be deducted from the next funding round of the National Science Agenda.
Wel zal ik NWO een [algemene] aanwijzing geven in de vorm van een beleidsregel van maximaal € 20 miljoen, in mindering te brengen op de volgende financieringsronde van de Nationale Wetenschapsagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het artikel ‘Ouders mbo-leerlingen hebben weinig vertrouwen in coronarooster: "Vier uur naar school in de week is veel te weinig"’

MP Kuik (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about a newspaper report on mbo students receiving only about four hours of in-person teaching per week, and about hybrid schedules, the 1.5-metre rule versus practical training, and online teaching quality. The Minister acknowledged parents' concerns, explained that schools decide the blend of in-person and remote teaching within a 1,600-hour study load, said data on hours are not kept, and committed to further steps such as sharing good practices and informing parliament in autumn.
No, these data are not kept.
Nee, deze gegevens worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Smals en Van den Berge over het bericht  “Ik ga waarschijnlijk niet over naar het volgende jaar” op 14 september 2020

MPs Smals and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education about the shortage of internship places for MBO students during the coronavirus crisis, including government and municipal placement numbers, how places will be expanded, and whether diploma requirements can be relaxed. The minister answered that central government internship places fell in 2020, that interdepartmental efforts and an action plan through SBB are underway, and that schools have flexibility on internship hours, while municipal data is not collected.
Inquiries with the VNG, IPO and Union of Water Boards show that no data is collected on the number of internship places at decentralised governments.
Uit navraag bij de VNG, IPO en Unie van Waterschappen blijkt dat er geen gegevens worden verzameld over het aantal stageplekken bij de decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Westerveld en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Minister laat Neerlandistiek zichzelf redden’

MPs Westerveld and Van der Molen asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why no structural funds are provided for Dutch-language studies (Neerlandistiek) and a sector plan, and about teacher shortages, enrolment decline, the KNAW's recommendations and a Stronks pilot. The Minister answers that only limited one-off funds (around 100,000 euros for coordination and a pilot) are available, that faculties must reprioritise within existing lump-sum money, and that no further sector plan funding exists, while noting ongoing cost-adequacy research and Flemish cooperation.
At this moment no funds are available for a languages sector plan.
Op dit moment zijn geen middelen beschikbaar voor een sectorplan talen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Wijngaarden en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Verdachten zaak sushiketen Sumo krijgen geen straf vanwege inbreuk op hun privacy’

MPs asked the government about a court ruling that suspects in the Sumo sushi case received no sentence because their privacy was violated by a KRO-NCRV documentary filmed with the FIOD and the public prosecutor's cooperation, and about the prosecutor's role in the documentary's content and non-disclosure. The Minister of Justice answered that the prosecution has appealed, that the prosecutor had a media contract allowing review of footage, and that the revised prosecution guidelines of September 2020 aim to prevent similar cases.
As long as the case has not become final, I do not wish to anticipate the possible consequences of (part of) the judgment for other criminal cases of the OM.
Zolang de zaak niet onherroepelijk is geworden wil ik niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke gevolgen van (een deel van) het vonnis voor andere strafzaken van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over het bericht 'Studentenorganisaties vrezen hogere studie-uitval door coronamaatregelen'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Education about student organisations' fears that COVID measures would raise dropout, and about support for first-year students, the use of study-deal funds, the ETHO expert group and a joint handbook. The Minister replied that institutions are maintaining student bonding with online and offline programmes, pointed to a welfare handbook and to institution-level quality agreements that allow local adjustments, confirmed the ETHO group will be housed at NRO, and agreed to discuss the handbook with stakeholders.
I appreciate the efforts and contribution of LSVb and ISO to create good bonding for new students with their study, city and fellow students.
Ik waardeer de inzet en bijdrage van LSVb en ISO om een goede binding te creëren voor de nieuwe studenten met de studie, stad en medestudenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het meldpunt voor reiskosten zomerstages en zomerles

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a student-union complaints desk on summer travel costs for internships and summer classes, and about compensation, flexible use of the extra travel entitlement, and travel allowances for vavo adult-education students. The minister answered that she will not compensate students, that flexible use of the three extra months is not feasible in implementation, and that a consultation with the VNG on vavo travel costs is ongoing, with results promised by end 2020.
No, I am not prepared to do that.
Nee, ik ben daar niet toe bereid.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Kwint over diverse berichten aangaande ontslagen bij poppodia en andere culturele instellingen

An MP asked ministers about reports of layoffs at Dutch music venues and cultural institutions during the COVID-19 crisis, and whether support schemes such as NOW, TOZO and TVL would be extended. The minister replied that support measures would be continued for nine months and that a range of additional funding, loan and fieldlab arrangements exist, while stating that not every organisation can be saved.
As I indicated in the debate of 29 June, I want to prevent bankruptcies as much as possible.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in het debat van 29 juni jl. wil ik faillissementen zoveel mogelijk zien te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Van den Berge over het bericht ‘Ook kunstenaars in Oost-Nederland hekelen scheve verdeling kunstsubsidies’

MPs Ellemeet and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the regional imbalance in performing arts subsidies (54% to Amsterdam, almost none to the eastern and northern regions) and what will be done to prevent cultural decline in Oost-Nederland. The Minister replied that extra funding of EUR 15 million per year will go to 71 institutions with positive advice but insufficient budget, and that infrastructure in Flevoland, Friesland, Drenthe, Zeeland, Limburg and Overijssel will be strengthened, with more regional spread than before.
I am adding the province of Overijssel to that.
Daar voeg ik de provincie Overijssel aan toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'China beïnvloedt Nederlands hoger onderwijs en wetenschap' en het rapport 'China’s invloed op onderwijs in Nederland'

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports on Chinese influence on Dutch higher education and research, including academic freedom, self-censorship, Confucius Institutes, Chinese students and the CCP. The Minister answers that the government will inform parliament this autumn, that institutions are responsible for their own partnerships, and that awareness-raising and a checklist are in use, but gives no concrete new measures.
I am considering whether additional tools or frameworks are needed and will inform your House about this in the aforementioned letter.
Ik bekijk of aanvullende hulpmiddelen of kaders nodig zijn en zal uw Kamer hierover informeren in de eerder genoemde brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de VNG de bestuurlijke afspraken over laaggeletterdheid heeft opgezegd

Kwint (SP) asked the Education minister how she views the VNG's unilateral termination of the administrative agreements on functional illiteracy, whether they burdened municipalities, and what happens next. The minister regretted the VNG's decision, said she is in talks with the VNG to address implementation concerns about monitoring and quality labels, and said funding continues and the Kamer will be informed later.
I am in discussion with municipalities about the extent to which they still wish to implement the administrative agreements, specifically regarding monitoring and quality assurance.
Ik ben met gemeenten in gesprek over de vraag in hoeverre zij nog uitvoering willen geven aan de bestuurlijke afspraken, specifiek op het gebied van monitoring en kwaliteitszorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over de naamswijziging van het Confucius instituut en het samenwerkingscontract Stichting Confucius Instituut Groningen

CDA MPs asked whether the renaming of the Confucius Institute headquarters signals stronger Chinese state control, and whether Dutch Confucius contracts, including that of Groningen, should be made more transparent and reviewed. The minister answered that the renaming appears to be a response to backlash and creates distance from Hanban, that Dutch institutions are autonomous and their contracts non-confidential by default, and that no extra measures are needed now, with a fuller update promised this autumn.
As indicated in the cover letter to this report, I will further inform your House this autumn about the position of the Netherlands vis-à-vis China in the field of education and science.
Zoals aangegeven in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit rapport, zal ik uw Kamer dit najaar verder informeren over de positie van Nederland ten opzichte van China op het terrein van onderwijs en wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over de vacature voor ‘Docent-trainees’ op de website van De Haagse Hogeschool

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education whether De Haagse Hogeschool's job posting for teacher-trainees, which explicitly invited candidates with a non-Western migration background to apply, amounts to discrimination against other applicants. The Minister denied that migration background is a selection criterion, said the invitation aims to lower barriers for underrepresented candidates, and affirmed that individual qualities should prevail.
No, I do not share the view that the Haagse Hogeschool is guilty of blatant discrimination here: for this vacancy, having (or not having) a migration background is not a selection criterion.
Nee, de opvatting dat de Haage Hogeschool zich hier schuldig maakt aan flagrante discriminatie deel ik niet: bij deze vacature is het (niet) hebben van een migratieachtergrond geen selectiecriterium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘schrappen eindtoets groep 8 kan ongelijkheid vergroten’

An MP asks the education minister about a CPB report warning that scrapping the basic-school final test (eindtoets) may disadvantage around 14,000 pupils, especially those from lower-income or lower-educated or migrant families, who would miss a higher school recommendation. The minister accepts the CPB conclusions, points to schools' professional judgement, the April 2020 letter urging schools to place pupils generously, and planned monitoring and a new school-advice handbook, but does not adopt mandatory rules.
For this reason I have asked primary and secondary schools to pay attention to pupils who may not enter at a level that suits their abilities in school year 2020/2021.

Om die reden heb ik bij scholen in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs aandacht gevraagd voor leerlingen die in schooljaar 2020/2021 mogelijk niet instromen op een niveau dat past bij hun capaciteiten en mogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Rog en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Haast geboden met ventilatie op scholen’

Three CDA MPs asked ministers whether ventilation rules for schools were known before the school year, how many schools meet current Bouwbesluit ventilation standards, and what measures RIVM, the Belastingdienst and ministries took. The government answered that existing building code rules apply, that school boards are responsible and no data on school ventilation is collected, and that the answers to the questions were delayed.
No data are collected or kept on the ventilation of school buildings.
Er worden geen gegevens verzameld of bijgehouden over de ventilatie van schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Gegevens van alumni, donateurs en relaties Universiteit Utrecht in handen van hackers’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Blackbaud data breach affecting alumni and donor data of Utrecht University and TU Delft, including what was stolen, guarantees of deletion, and who is responsible for protecting such data. The minister answered that institutions bear responsibility for securing their systems, that 100% security does not exist, and that the Inspectorate is examining sector-wide cybersecurity with a promised letter early next year.
It is the responsibility of higher education institutions to ensure the storage and processing of data of students, staff, alumni and other persons who have provided information to the institution.

Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de hoger onderwijsinstellingen zorg te dragen voor de opslag en verwerking van gegevens van studenten, medewerkers, alumni en overige personen die informatie aan de instelling hebben verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van Meenen, Kwint en Rog over de lerarenbeurs

MPs asked why the teacher grant (lerarenbeurs) budget was exhausted in 2020, how many applications were rejected, and why the Chamber was not informed earlier. The ministers answered that 2,416 initial applications were rejected after renewal applications were prioritised, and that budget cuts from parliamentary amendments reduced the budget from 78 to 49.6 million euros, communicated through several channels.
We could not inform you earlier because applications could be submitted until 30 June, and only afterwards was it clear how many renewal applications had been submitted.
Wij konden u niet eerder informeren omdat er tot en met 30 juni aanvragen ingediend konden worden en het pas daarna duidelijk was hoeveel herhaalaanvragen waren ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, El Yassini en Smals over het voorkeursbeleid van de TU Eindhoven

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that TU Eindhoven's temporary preference policy for women in academic appointments (Irène Curie Fellowship) was disproportionate and amounted to near-absolute exclusion of men. The Minister said the College is independent, that the TU/e is responsible for revising its policy, and that she trusts it to act on the ruling, without committing to her own intervention.
It is not for me to redo the assessment the College has made in this case.
Het is niet aan mij om de beoordeling die het College in dit geval heeft gegeven over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het Manifest 'Toplocaties'

An MP asks the Education and Economic Affairs ministers about the 'Toplocaties' manifesto on campus development, its five recommendations, and the role of innovation ecosystems. The government answers that existing national instruments already support campuses, that it will engage with the manifesto authors, and that no separate physical-infrastructure policy is needed now.
There is currently no reason to form national policy specifically focused on the physical aspect of research and innovation ecosystems.
Er is op dit moment geen reden om op nationaal niveau beleid te vormen dat specifiek is gericht op het fysieke aspect van onderzoeks- en innovatie-ecosystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over omscholingstrajecten om leraar te worden

An MP asks how career changers into teaching can find routes, how many drop out and why, whether unmet demand causes waiting lists, and why a second education master costs about 9,000 euro for 25 EC. The ministers answer that a national helpdesk and regional points exist, dropout data is incomplete and being studied, the subsidy must be reported if training stops, and a maximum institutional tuition rate will apply from 2022-2023 via a pending bill.
We share your view that more insight is needed into the course of the career-changer route.
Wij delen met u dat er meer inzicht nodig is in het verloop van de route zij-instroom.

Antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van de leden Markuszower en Wilders over “het bericht dat vier van de vijf gemeenten niet weten of ‘tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog Joods vastgoed is onteigend en doorverkocht terwijl dat

MPs Markuszower and Wilders asked ministers whether the government will map all looted Jewish property during WWII, return unlawfully collected taxes and fees, and open the Nederlands Beheersinstituut archives. The government replied that the Kordes commission and the 2000 settlement already addressed postwar restitution, that no new investigation or restitution is planned, and that most Verkaufsbücher archive material is already digitised and open.
In view of the outcomes of this research and the government's response, there is no reason to conduct new research into looted real estate.
Gezien de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek en de reactie van het kabinet is er geen aanleiding om opnieuw onderzoek te doen naar geroofd onroerend goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Spionnen op de loer: “vooral China aast op vaccinkennis”’

MPs Wiersma and Yesilgoz-Zegerius asked whether signals of Chinese digital espionage against vaccine research institutes were known, what was being done, and whether a broader knowledge-security framework was coming. The government answered that digital espionage by state actors is a persistent threat, that institutions bear primary responsibility for their own security, that a fast-track bill lets the NCSC assist vaccine research centres, and that a broad knowledge-security regulation and new consultations with institutions are in preparation with reports promised in autumn.
However, no concrete statements are made publicly about specific case matters.
In het openbaar worden echter geen concrete uitspraken gedaan over specifieke casuïstiek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Directeur Astron over zijn radiotelescoop versus de windmolens: ‘Lofar zou van beschermd nationaal belang moeten zijn’’

Three MPs (CDA and VVD) asked whether large national research infrastructure such as LOFAR deserves national protection, what the effects of 5G are on the Westerbork radio telescope, and whether ASTRON's measurements can be preserved. The minister replied that LOFAR is of national importance and is protected by regional permitting, that a 10 km protection zone with licence conditions shields Westerbork from 5G interference, and that talks with ASTRON and licensees will be arranged.
The Agentschap Telecom, based on internationally used and Dutch-specific calculation models, determined a 10-km protection zone around the radio telescopes at Westerbork.

Het Agentschap Telecom heeft op basis van internationaal gehanteerde en op de specifieke Nederlandse situatie toegespitste rekenmodellen een beschermingszone bepaald van 10 kilometer rond de radiotelescopen in Westerbork.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het aangekondigde onderzoek naar daders van geweld tegen LHBTI’s

An MP (D66) asked ministers of Justice and of Education about a planned study into perpetrators of violence against LHBTI people, school diversity education, and online hate speech enforcement. The ministers committed to an updated study focused on the G4 municipalities, but declined to judge teaching materials and deferred to schools and the Public Prosecution Service on capacity and enforcement.
Given freedom of education and expression, the school autonomy and the professional space of teachers, the government does not consider it appropriate to judge teaching materials.
Het past de regering, gezien de vrijheid van het onderwijs en meningsuiting, de autonomie van scholen en de professionele ruimte van leraren, niet een oordeel te geven over leermiddelen.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van den Berge over de miljardenkorting op Europese onderzoeksgelden

An MP asks the minister why the European Parliament's proposed EUR 120 billion for Horizon Europe was not adopted, whether this cut harms Dutch researchers, and what compensation is planned. The minister answers that the agreed Horizon Europe budget rises from EUR 66 to EUR 76 billion (plus EUR 5 billion from Next Generation EU), that Dutch researchers are expected to benefit, and that the MFK agreement is not yet final.
The budget for Horizon Europe from the MFF 2021–2027 and the recovery instrument combined therefore rises by 22%.
Het budget voor Horizon Europe uit het MFK 2021–2027 en het herstelinstrument tezamen stijgt dus met 22%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Appen tijdens je tentamen: ook nu frauderen studenten'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that exam fraud is rising in online tests and whether institutions are being supported to prevent it. The Minister answered that no signals of rising fraud were received, that institutions take preventive measures, and that SURF and working groups facilitate knowledge sharing, but declined to centrally monitor best practices.
I am not going to monitor centrally, because I do not want to burden the institutions too much.
Ik ga niet centraal monitoren, omdat ik de instellingen niet teveel wil belasten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Op de universiteit is geen plaats meer voor politieke diversiteit'

MP Wiersma asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an opinion piece claiming universities no longer have room for political diversity, including the role of diversity officers, handling of complaints about pressure to reformulate exam questions or attend diversity lunches, and follow-up on KNAW advice on academic freedom. The minister answered that diversity officer tasks vary by institution and are advisory, that complaints go through existing social safety channels, and that the government will monitor KNAW recommendations, with a national action plan and KNAW position paper announced.
I attach great value to academic freedom. Scientists must be able to share their scientific insights safely.
Ik hecht grote waarde aan academische vrijheid. Wetenschappers moeten veilig hun wetenschappelijke inzichten kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over de impuls regeling praktijkleren

An MP asked the Minister of Education why the impuls regeling praktijkleren excludes agriculture, hospitality and recreation, and whether stage places in those sectors are being monitored and protected. The Minister defends the exclusion by pointing to the separate motion-Heerma funding for those sectors, says SBB monitors placements and will report to parliament in September, and declines for now to extend the scheme.
In September this will be shared with the House.
In september zal dit worden gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Ellemeet en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Minister Van Engelshoven eindigt subsidie op de MBO card’

Three GroenLinks and PvdA MPs asked the education minister why she ended the MBO Card culture subsidy despite the Berenschot evaluation recommending strengthening it, and how this fits her culture policy ambitions. The minister answered that the subsidy goal was not met, so continuing state funding is not appropriate, and she will instead provide 500,000 euro yearly to a general cultural education scheme, while stating she remains committed to integrated culture education.
If the subsidy objectives of the MBO Card have not been achieved, I do not think it makes sense to then continue the MBO Card with government subsidies.
Als de subsidiedoelstellingen van de MBO Card niet zijn behaald, vind ik het niet geheel in de rede liggen om vervolgens met overheidssubsidies het voortbestaan van de MBO Card te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Dam en Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Erdogan wil weer bidden in de Hagia Sophia’

CDA MPs asked whether the government finds it unacceptable that Turkey may convert the Hagia Sophia from museum to mosque, what steps it would take, and whether it will lobby UNESCO. The government replied that the building's function is an internal Turkish matter, that the Netherlands with EU partners has urged respect for its symbolic role and free access, and that UNESCO's assessment focuses on preserving universal value rather than the building's function.
The precise function of the Hagia Sophia is an internal matter for Turkey.
De precieze functie van de Hagia Sophia is een interne aangelegenheid van Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over beperkte ruimte aan het mbo

An MP asked the Education Minister why mbo (vocational) schools were given less room than secondary schools to reopen for minors, and whether minors should get priority for on-site teaching. The minister answered that a 1.5-metre rule applies to all mbo students because age groups are mixed, that schools may prioritise groups such as first-years and practical-training students, and that further easing depends on the virus and a new OMT advice after summer.
In mbo, all students regardless of age must keep a distance of one and a half metres.
In het mbo geldt voor alle studenten, ongeacht de leeftijd, dat zij anderhalve meter afstand dienen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over een wetswijziging in Roemenië waarmee het recht om te zijn wie je bent wordt ondermijnd

Two MPs asked the government about a Romanian amendment banning the teaching of gender as a concept separate from biological sex, and how the EU and the Netherlands would respond. The minister said the amendment awaits presidential approval and a Constitutional Court ruling, and listed EU-level and Dutch efforts to support LHBTI rights, without announcing a concrete sanction.
The ongoing legislative process, as well as the public debate about it in Romanian society, are therefore of concern to the cabinet.
Het nog lopende wetstraject, alsmede de maatschappelijke discussie daarover in de Roemeense samenleving, hebben daarom de aandacht van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over Statement on Black Lives Matter

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a University College Utrecht Black Lives Matter statement by dean James Kennedy, who also chairs the national canon revision, was ideological and should have been avoided; they also asked whether institutions should stop expressing solidarity with the movement. The minister rejected the criticism, saying the statement promotes awareness and that universities may engage on social issues, leaving the approach to institutions.
It is important that an open discussion about social events takes place within education, and it is education's task to promote good citizenship.
Het is belangrijk dat binnen het onderwijs een open discussie gevoerd wordt over maatschappelijke gebeurtenissen en het is de taak van het onderwijs goed burgerschap te bevorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van den Hul over het bericht dat dak- en thuisloze LHBTI-jongeren driedubbel kwetsbaar zijn

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked the State Secretary how the government will respond to calls for safe crisis shelter for homeless LHBTI youth, whose vulnerability was documented by Movisie research. The State Secretary replied that the broad homelessness approach prioritises own housing and short shelter stays, that shelter quality on sexual and gender diversity needs improvement through training and smaller units, and that concrete steps include a national platform and further talks with stakeholders.
I am in further discussion with Valente, VNG and interest organisations to determine what should be organised at regional level for this.
Ik ben met Valente, VNG en belangenorganisaties nader in gesprek om te bepalen wat hiervoor op regionaal niveau georganiseerd dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht 'Theater Markant wil wel showroom voor Nederland worden'

MP Belhaj asked the minister about a theatre's COVID-19 safety protocol using splash screens, whether it should be rolled out nationally, and whether choir singing could resume under strict conditions. The minister said the sector drafts protocols and government only advises, that TNO found indoor splash screens insufficiently safe, and that choirs may rehearse and perform under RIVM guidelines.
Protocols are drawn up by the sector and it is up to the sector to roll out a protocol nationally.
Protocollen worden opgesteld door de sector en het is aan de sector om een protocol landelijk uit te rollen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over de uitvoering van het Unesco Haags Verdrag en het gebruik van het blauw-witte schildje

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about implementation of the 1954 Hague Convention and use of the blue-and-white shield, including whether heritage protection is adequate and whether the register is current. The minister responded that she will study the advisory report and reply in spring 2021, that the RCE handles prevention and the shield register (last updated around 2000), and that cooperation with safety regions and local partners is being pursued, though some activities were postponed due to COVID-19.
I will study the advice of the Dutch UNESCO Commission, its conclusions and recommendations, in more detail and will respond to them in spring 2021.
Ik ga het advies van de Nederlandse Unesco Commissie, de conclusies en aanbevelingen nader bestuderen en zal daar in het voorjaar van 2021 op reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat tienduizenden studenten studievertraging oplopen

MPs asked the education minister how study delays caused by COVID-19 measures are monitored, whether students will get more room for in-person education and public transport, whether students with delays beyond the compensation scheme will be compensated, and how institutions are supported. The minister said monitoring relies on institutions and the annual higher-education monitor, declined to quantify affected students, refused extra compensation for earlier-stage students, and pointed to support instruments such as the Servicedocument and the online teaching acceleration plan.
How many students have actually incurred study delay and how large their delay is cannot be said at this time.
Hoeveel studenten daadwerkelijk studievertraging hebben opgelopen en hoe groot hun studievertraging is, is op dit moment niet te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Groothuizen en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Geef kennismigranten en internationaal talent meer zekerheid tijdens de coronacrisis’

Three D66 MPs asked whether knowledge migrants and international students in the Netherlands should get more legal certainty during the COVID-19 crisis, including relaxed study-progress rules, extended job-search periods, and deadlines. The government answered that it will not impose consequences on temporary salary-criterion breaches under the Wtv scheme, offers flexibility on study progress and language tests, and is only exploring a broader interpretation of job-search rules, with no firm extension of the search period.

When insufficient study progress is caused by the coronavirus crisis, institutions can treat this as an excusable reason for the study delay, and this has no consequences for the student's residence permit.

Wanneer onvoldoende studievoortgang is veroorzaakt door de coronacrisis, kunnen instellingen dit aanmerken als een verschoonbare reden voor de studievertraging en heeft dit geen gevolgen voor de verblijfsvergunning van de student.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Palland en Postma over het bericht 'Indrukwekkend corona-protest met tientallen historische schepen bij eiland Pampus: 'Net Sail Amsterdam’'

CDA MPs asked the ministers about a protest by historic sailing charter vessels near Pampus, the sector's loss of income under COVID measures, subsidies for historic vessels, and how to preserve the sector after the crisis. The government answered that Mondriaan Fund restoration schemes apply, sets out available COVID support measures for the sailing charter sector, and says it is willing to consult municipalities, provinces and the sector, but did not answer within the two-week deadline.
Of course I am willing to consult with the other relevant departments, the mentioned subnational governments and the sector.
Uiteraard ben ik bereid om samen met de andere betrokken departementen in overleg te treden met de genoemde medeoverheden en met de sector
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Wilders over een bericht van Hogeschool InHolland op Facebook

MPs Beertema and Wilders asked the minister whether a Hogeschool InHolland Facebook post on Black Lives Matter and anti-racism was indoctrination and whether diversity officers and university-wide anti-racism framing should be stopped. The minister rejected the characterisations, said institutions have freedom to organise education and that diversity work is a matter for each institution, and refused to intervene.
It is up to the institutions to decide whether or not diversity officers are appointed.
Het is aan de instellingen om te bepalen of er wel of geen diversity officers aangesteld worden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de open brief van de hoogleraren Fries aan de minister en de publicatie van het Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie van Wetenschappen (KNAW) rapport: 'Nederlands verdient me

An MP asked the education minister whether she would address an open letter from Frisian professors and the KNAW report on Dutch-language studies, including protection and funding for Frisian-language university education. The minister answered that she will respond to the letter in her policy reaction, committed to keeping Frisian education at its current scale, and asked faculties to prepare changes for 2022/2023.

I have asked the faculties involved to concretise the preparatory activities for further increasing the attractiveness of the education by summer 2021 so that the first changes can be implemented from academic year 2022/2023.
Ik heb de betrokken faculteiten verzocht om de voorbereidende activiteiten voor het verder vergroten van de aantrekkelijkheid van het onderwijs te concretiseren voor de zomer van 2021
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'lastig leden werven en geen evenementen, corona brengt studentenvereniging in problemen'

An MP asked the education minister about the impact of COVID-19 rules on student associations, including which rules apply to activities, whether bars at associations get the same relaxation as hospitality, where associations can report unclarity, and whether the minister consults on introduction weeks. The minister answered that general emergency-ordinance and RIVM rules apply, that association bar operations follow hospitality rules, that questions go to the institution, municipality or safety region, and that consultations are ongoing but large introduction weeks cannot take place in usual form.
Student and study associations can direct questions about the corona measures to the institution, the municipality or the safety region.
Studenten- en studieverenigingen kunnen zich met vragen omtrent de coronamaatregelen richten tot de instelling, de gemeente of de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Onderzoeksinstituut Wetsus in Leeuwarden gehackt, hacker betaald in bitcoins”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about a ransomware attack on research institute Wetsus, whether minimum cybersecurity requirements apply to publicly funded institutes, and how the government will prevent recurrence, including ransom payment and Chinese knowledge theft. The state secretary answered that cybersecurity is primarily the institutes' own responsibility (defence-related research excepted), that the government is talking with TO2 institutes about improving resilience without new mandatory requirements, that the ransom was paid from own funds, and that Wetsus's funding after 2021 is being explored with an expert group.
Ensuring (cyber)security is primarily the responsibility of the research institutes themselves, subject to the relevant laws and regulations.
Het borgen van de (cyber)veiligheid is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van onderzoeksinstituten zelf, uiteraard met inachtneming van de relevante wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Asscher over anderhalve meter afstand houden in het theater

An MP asked whether household members must keep 1.5 metres distance from each other in theatres, why this differs from rules in hospitality and transport, and whether the sector can be treated like hospitality. The minister answered that household members do not need to keep distance from each other, including in theatres, and referred back to that answer for the other questions.
No, this is not correct. Members of one household do not need to keep 1.5 metres distance from each other, not even in theatres or other cultural institutions.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Leden van één huishouden hoeven onderling geen 1,5 meter afstand te houden, ook niet in theaters of andere culturele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de anderhalve meter in de audiovisuele sector

Labour MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether actors can work within 1.5 metres, whether they should be treated as contact professions, and whether new business models are needed for culture. The minister answered that a sector protocol now allows work under strict conditions, that acting is not a contact profession, and that fieldlab pilots and an advisory request to the Raad voor Cultuur are underway.
I have asked the Raad voor Cultuur for advice on how the sector can become more agile and resilient.
Ik heb de Raad voor Cultuur om advies gevraagd over hoe de sector meer wendbaar en weerbaar gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor vrouwen

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked the ministers of Education, Culture and Science and Social Affairs about the economic and care impacts of the coronavirus crisis on women, including gender-impact checks on support measures. The minister answered that the evidence is mixed, that no specific gender-targeted policy is currently needed, and that the government will monitor and evaluate labour-market measures with attention to gender differences.
The cabinet will monitor and evaluate the effects of labour market measures and inform the House about them.
Het kabinet zal de effecten van arbeidsmarktmaatregelen monitoren en evalueren en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat ROC Nijmegen af wil van een docente, omdat zij een kritisch boek over de gang van zaken op school had gepubliceerd

An MP asked the minister whether ROC Nijmegen's plan to dismiss a teacher who published a critical book about the school restricts staff freedom of expression, and whether the minister would investigate or act. The minister said teachers should be free to criticise their institution within privacy rules, but that the employer is responsible, the dispute concerns a broken working relationship over shared confidential information, and the courts will judge whether the school acted carefully.
Ultimately it is for the court to judge whether ROC Nijmegen acted carefully in this case.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om te oordelen of ROC Nijmegen in dit geval zorgvuldig heeft gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Gemeente verleent vergunning voor Frans Klooster/Walram Site’

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers whether the municipality of Sittard-Geleen's permit for a Confucius Institute annex, and concerns about Chinese influence, warranted stricter policy. The minister answered that the municipality decides autonomously, that government is monitoring Chinese influence via a knowledge network and ongoing research, and that it would discuss arrangements with institutions if the research shows a need.
That is the responsibility and free choice of the municipality.
Dat is de verantwoordelijkheid en de vrije keuze van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Westerveld en Renkema over het openbaar vervoer

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about public transport access during COVID-19, including the OV protocol, student timing, support for people with disabilities, and bicycle policy. The state secretary answered that the protocol protects all users, that Reisassistentie is fully available again from 1 June, and that a further letter on accessibility for people with disabilities will follow.
How accessibility will be further guaranteed for this group is a topic of discussion in the OV protocol working group.
Hoe toegankelijkheid verder wordt gewaarborgd voor deze groep is onderwerp van gesprek in de werkgroep OV-protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Stoffer en Postma over het bericht 'Onzekere toekomst voor gebruik oldtimer openbare weg'

MPs Dijkstra, Stoffer and Postma asked the ministers about the future of historic vehicles (oldtimers) on public roads, including a national register of mobile heritage, definitions, innovative fuels and export of cultural goods. The government says it supports a sector-led register with Mondriaan Fund funding, that heritage is defined under the Heritage Act, and that it will engage on fuels and export protection through a planned commission.
I have asked the RCE to continue supporting this process with knowledge and advice.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd om blijvend dit proces te ondersteunen met kennis en advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten drie maanden collegegeld terugkrijgen bij vertraging afstuderen

An MP asked the education minister whether students delayed by COVID-19 can catch up, why higher education institutions get no compensation in the support package, and about the costs of digital teaching and research delays. The minister answered that institutions get no compensation, pointed to extended study deadlines and coulance measures, said the support package targets vulnerable pupils and students in lower sectors, and promised to monitor costs and research delays with partners.
Education institutions are not compensated for these efforts.
Onderwijsinstellingen worden voor deze inspanningen niet gecompenseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Van den Hul, Westerveld, Van Ojik, Groothuizen en Van Meenen over onderwijs in asielzoekerscentra

Six MPs asked about schooling in asylum reception centres (azc's) during COVID-19, including poor wifi and lack of laptops for online lessons. The State Secretary answered that wifi capacity was expanded at all COA locations, EUR 6.3 million was allocated for devices, and schools must offer distance learning.
It is undesirable that online education is not possible due to limitations in network connections or the availability of tablets, laptops or computers.
Het is onwenselijk dat online onderwijs niet mogelijk is door beperkingen in netwerkverbindingen of de beschikbaarheid van tablets, laptops of computers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over gratis Ster zendtijd voor brancheorganisaties en belangenverenigingen

An MP asked the minister about free Ster airtime for trade and interest organisations during the coronavirus crisis, while charities were excluded, and about the content of some farmer-group ads. The minister answered that airtime allocation is Ster's responsibility, that the Commissariaat voor de Media oversees compliance, and that the broadcaster does not air ads violating the Reclame Code.
Filling the Ster airtime is the responsibility of Ster. I cannot intervene in the choices Ster makes regarding advertising airtime.
Het invullen van de Ster-zendtijd is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Ster. Ik kan niet treden in de keuzes die de Ster maakt ten aanzien van de reclamezendtijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Hul en Moorlag over het bericht “13.000 mbo’ers hebben geen stageplek of leerbaan: ‘Mogelijk voorbode van werkloosheid’”

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked how the government will ensure a sound internship (beroepspraktijkvorming) approach in vocational education given a shortage of 13,000 placements, and whether affected students will avoid study delays and whether the shortage signals future unemployment. The Minister answered that SBB is acquiring new placements with extra funds, that schools may assess learning goals without full placement hours, and that the labour market risk is acknowledged with a progress letter promised before the summer recess.
The shortage of internship places and apprenticeships may indeed be an indication of labour market problems for school leavers.
Het tekort aan stageplaatsen en leerbanen kan inderdaad een indicatie zijn van knelpunten op de arbeidsmarkt voor schoolverlaters.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Bruins over religie en seksualiteit in een online lesmethode voor burgerschapsonderwijs in het mbo

MPs Van den Berge and Bruins asked the Minister of Education about stereotyping questions on religion and sexuality in an online civic education method for MBO, and about oversight and development of such materials. The Minister said civic education should foster critical thinking, that schools choose their own methods within legal requirements, that the Inspectorate checks quality of civic education but not materials in general, and that no ministry role in developing materials is planned.
It is up to the school itself to decide how civic education is shaped and which teaching method is used.
Het is daarnaast aan de school zelf om te beslissen hoe het burgerschapsonderwijs wordt vormgegeven en welke lesmethode hierbij wordt gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Tal van reformatorische scholen hanteren afwijzende verklaringen over LHBTI’s’

MPs Bergkamp and Van Meenen (D66) asked the ministers whether reformed schools' statements rejecting same-sex marriage and LGBTI lifestyles create an unsafe climate and exclude LGBTI pupils, and what the government will do. The ministers answered that schools may state their principles but must respect pupils' rights, must ensure a safe climate, are inspected on civic education and safety standards, and that a curriculum revision is underway, without committing to specific new action against the named schools.
It is up to the inspectorate to establish whether a school complies with these provisions.
Het is aan de inspectie om vast te stellen of een school aan deze bepalingen voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Jasper van Dijk over onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat nog altijd één op de vijf reformatorische scholen het homohuwelijk moreel onacceptabel vindt

MPs Van den Hul and Van Dijk asked whether reformed schools that describe homosexuality as contrary to God's word, and state that sexuality belongs only in a man-woman marriage, will be held to the legal duties on safety and citizenship, and whether the 2009 motion against such staff declarations is respected. The ministers answered that schools' freedom is bounded by fundamental rights, that the Inspectorate monitors safety and will intervene, that the employment exception no longer allows discrimination on sexual orientation, and that the attainment targets on sexual diversity will be sharpened as part of curriculum reform.
It is up to the inspectorate to establish whether a school complies with these provisions and to intervene if it does not.
Het is aan de inspectie om vast te stellen of een school aan deze bepalingen voldoet en om in te grijpen als dat niet het geval is.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Vuurwapens, explosieven en cocaïne: schoolkoepels slaan alarm over criminele leerlingen' en de uitzending van Jinek van 21 februari 2020

MPs Heerema and Van Wijngaarden asked ministers about reports that school federations see rising serious incidents involving weapons and drugs, underreporting to police, and conflicting ministerial statements on filing criminal complaints. The government says there is no national incident registry, points to the Veiligheidsmonitor and existing police and municipal partnerships, stresses the importance of filing complaints for serious offences, and promises to discuss cooperation with partners and to publish the evaluation of the Wet veiligheid op school in summer 2020.
There is no national registration of the number of incidents that have occurred at schools.
Er is geen landelijke registratie van het aantal incidenten dat zich op scholen heeft voorgedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het functioneren van medezeggenschap in tijden van corona

An SP MP asked the education minister about the legal status of the COVID-19 higher-education service document, whether it may allow informing works councils only afterwards, and whether university boards may bypass works-council procedures under the WHW and WOR. The minister answers that the document is administrative agreements that leave WHW and WOR rights intact, that deviations should be limited to what is necessary, and that the inspectorate supervises works-council involvement.
The agreements in the service document on works councils leave unaffected what the WHW and WOR regulate on works council participation.
De afspraken in het servicedocument als het gaat om de medezeggenschap laten onverlet wat in de WHW en in de WOR over de medezeggenschap is geregeld.

Antwoord op van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Leijten, Verhoeven en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen (RUG) en zijn rol in de promotie van de ver

MPs asked about the RUG-commissioned investigation into professor Kochenov's secondary activities and his role in promoting the sale of passports on Malta, and whether he continued such advisory work. The minister reported that the report was released, that no passport-related advisory activities were found after September 2019 apart from attending a Henley & Partners congress, and that she cannot guarantee such cases will not recur.
The research report has today been made public by the RUG, and as promised I have sent you a copy of this report.
Het onderzoeksrapport is heden openbaar gemaakt door de RUG, een afschrift van dit rapport heb ik u – conform mijn toezegging – doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen en Kuiken over de omvang en aanpak van seksuele intimidatie en geweld jegens meisjes en vrouwen in Amsterdam

MPs from the PvdA asked ministers about the scale of sexual harassment and violence against girls and women in Amsterdam, the city's measures, and whether a national gender-sensitive approach and VNG coordination are needed. The government welcomed Amsterdam's measures, pointed to national research, a pending review of the Istanbul Convention recommendations, VNG coordination work and planned extensions of the Veilige Steden programme, and noted new sex offence legislation and extra funding for vice teams.
Together with the other relevant departments, NGOs and experts, I will in the coming period discuss the recommendations in the evaluation report, including this one.
Samen met de andere betrokken departementen, NGO's en experts ga ik de komende tijd in gesprek over aanbevelingen in het evaluatierapport, waaronder deze.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kerstens, Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over gedupeerde studenten van niet-erkende beroepsopleidingen in de zorg

MPs asked why UWV referred students to non-accredited care training run by Quadrant, whether UWV and the government will prevent this and whether they will help affected students. The minister answered that UWV only checked accreditation and that the contract was ended, promised tighter voucher rules and periodic talks with trainers, but said no diploma can be issued outside accredited schools and offered only a conversation with affected students.
UWV is working on an adjustment of the procurement framework that sets out the contractual obligations of a trainer.
UWV werkt aan een aanpassing van het inkoopkader waarin de contractuele verplichtingen van een opleider zijn opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over vrouwenonderdrukking

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about oppression of women in marriages with migrants, including a case where a woman was killed shortly after arriving, and about isolation of partners of knowledge migrants. The government says such practices are unacceptable, points to the action agenda on harmful practices and the Rotterdam pilot, but declines a national study and says it cannot bar sponsors from bringing partners under EU family reunification rules.
Because every case of forced isolation is one too many, it has not been chosen to set up a national study into the extent of forced isolation of marriage migrants.
Omdat elk geval van gedwongen isolement er één te veel is, wordt er niet voor gekozen om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen naar de omvang van gedwongen isolement van huwelijksmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over Friesland als niet-regenboogprovincie

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Friesland is the only non-rainbow province and whether the government would help it become one. The minister confirmed the situation had changed, as the provincial states adopted a motion on 27 May 2020 to become a rainbow province, and said the government welcomes this and will follow developments.
I am pleased that the province of Friesland is joining the cooperating rainbow provinces and in this way gives an extra boost to the social acceptance and safety of LGBTI persons.
Ik ben verheugd dat de provincie Friesland zich aansluit bij de samenwerkende regenboogprovincies en op die wijze een extra impuls geeft aan de sociale acceptatie en – veiligheid van LHBTI-personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘islamitische school hoort erbij’

PVV MPs asked whether an Islamic secondary school in Rotterdam should be denied funding, questioning the government's support for it and calling for all Islamic education to be abolished. The minister replied that the school's application met the statutory conditions under the WVO and that freedom of education is constitutionally protected, so neither revoking the permit nor abolishing Islamic education would be done.
The request from the Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) was assessed against the applicable laws and regulations.
Het verzoek van de Stichting voor Islamitisch Voortgezet Onderwijs Rotterdam (SIVOR) is getoetst aan vigerende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Oplossing voor onderzoekers aan universiteiten hard nodig'

MPs Paternotte and Van der Molen asked the minister about the precarious funding and temporary contracts of university researchers during the COVID-19 crisis, including NWO call delays and extensions. The minister gave data on project funding shares, said NWO is restarting procedures and handling extensions case by case, and said universities can resume on-site research within RIVM rules, without committing to new structural measures.
The aim is to not let any researchers fall between two stools.
Doel is om geen onderzoekers tussen wal en schip te laten vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over onderzoek met apen voor de ontwikkeling van een vaccin tegen COVID-19

An MP asks whether animal testing for COVID-19 vaccines is wasteful, whether non-animal methods should be prioritised and funded, and whether the reduction of primate use at BPRC is being undermined by Java monkey research. The minister says standards require animal tests, that alternatives are being funded through calls and programmes, and that the BPRC reduction stands, with an exception clause not needed so far.
The BPRC indicates that invoking this clause on the basis of the COVID-19 pandemic is not necessary for now.
Het BPRC geeft aan dat een beroep op deze clausule op basis van de COVID-19-pandemie vooralsnog niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over het bericht ‘Belangenverstrengeling zaait twijfels over giftig zaad’

MPs De Groot and Paternotte asked whether industry co-funding of research on bee decline, pesticide approval studies and Wageningen University & Research (WUR) funding compromise independence, and whether pesticide studies should be public. The minister answered that the 2011 bee study was fully publicly funded, that WUR's private co-funding is limited and governed by integrity rules, that pesticide approval relies on company-funded but quality-checked studies with some publication, and that open access is a policy goal.
Underlying studies can be made public on request, within the limits of European and national legislation.
Onderliggende studies kunnen op verzoek openbaar worden gemaakt, binnen de grenzen van Europese en nationale wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over verzekeringen in de culturele sector

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked the ministers of Finance and OCW about insurers refusing payouts to festivals, artists and travel customers during the COVID-19 crisis, and about support for small cultural entrepreneurs and suppliers. The government answered that pandemic losses are often excluded from cover depending on policy terms, that insurers say they will pay event-cancellation claims, and that a support package and talks with insurers are underway, while travel-insurance refusals depend on policy type.
I have no signals that insurers are on a large scale failing to pay out where this is warranted.
Ik heb geen signalen dat verzekeraars op grote schaal niet uitkeren waar dit wel op zijn plaats is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Verhoeven over het bericht 'Studenten protesteren tegen tentamensoftware die beelden van hun huiskamer opslaat'

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Education about student protests against online exam proctoring software that records images of students' homes, asking which institutions use it, whether providers comply with the GDPR, whether students can be excluded for refusing extra personal data, and whether alternatives can be offered. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for GDPR compliance and transparency, that refusing proctoring is allowed but alternatives are limited during the Covid crisis, and that the government is exploring easing measures so on-site examinations can resume.
It is up to the educational institutions to properly inform students about the use and functioning of the proctoring software, for example through a privacy statement.
Het is aan de onderwijsinstellingen om de studenten goed te informeren over het gebruik en de werking van de proctoring software, bijvoorbeeld middels een privacyverklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ''Middelbare scholen: neem het maatwerkdiploma serieus''

MPs Heerema and Wiersma asked the education ministers about reports that pupils with a mixed-level (maatwerk) secondary diploma struggle to gain access to university or higher vocational study, and about related pilots and rules. The ministers answered that current routes exist for such pupils, that a broader review of mixed-level diplomas will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the experiment group and admission rules are being examined.

We are currently working on our policy response to the study on the advantages and disadvantages of diplomas with subjects at different levels in combination with access to further education, as mentioned in the coalition agreement.

Momenteel werken wij aan onze beleidsreactie op het onderzoek naar «voor- en nadelen van diploma’s met vakken op verschillende niveaus i.c.m. toegankelijkheid van het vervolgonderwijs»» uit het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bijgesteld advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan ‘Capaciteitsplan 2011-2024’ en de opleidingscapaciteit van tandartsen

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a revised Capacity Body advice on medical and dental training places, prompted by new CBS population projections, should be adopted, including keeping medical intake at 2900 and raising dental training capacity from 240 to 359. The minister answered that the revised advice will be taken into account in the government's response to the Capacity Plan, to be sent to parliament before summer, and did not commit to specific numbers now.
We will take the revised advice of the Capacity Body into account in our response to the Capacity Plan.
Wij zullen het bijgestelde advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan bij onze reactie op het Capaciteitsplan betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de financiële situatie van studenten

An MP asked the Minister of Education about financial hardship among students during the COVID-19 crisis, including loan trends, parental income distribution, the supplementary grant system and study duration. The minister reported no increase in loan applications or loan amounts, explained that parental income affects grant eligibility, and provided income and loan breakdowns, though the answers were delayed beyond the requested date.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Peters over het bericht ‘MBO Raad waarschuwt: nieuwkomers moeten snelle toegang houden tot mbo’.

MPs Kuik and Peters asked ministers about the COVID-19 impact on language courses and MBO access for newcomers, and whether the government would act. Minister Koolmees answered that remote learning rules were relaxed, the integration deadline extended, MBO schools may admit students without full entry requirements, and no separate budget is planned for now, while monitoring the situation.
I will continue to closely monitor the situation and the effects of the measures taken.
Ik blijf de situatie en de uitwerking van de genomen maatregelen nauwgezet monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Rog en Van Toorenburg over het rapport van het Centrum tegen Kinderhandel en Mensenhandel (CKM) aangaande criminele uitbuiting onder Nederlandse scholieren

MPs Kuik, Rog and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the government about a CKM report on criminal exploitation and drug-related recruitment of Dutch schoolchildren, including school protocols, normalisation of drugs, prosecution statistics, non-punishment protection and the UK approach. The state secretary answered that protocols and prevention programmes exist, that data on drug-related trafficking cases is not registered separately, and that the government will explore closer cooperation and learn from the UK.
The Public Prosecution Service does not register in how many of these cases the exploitation is drug-related, nor whether it occurs among schoolchildren.
Het OM registreert niet in hoeveel van deze gevallen het gaat om drugsgerelateerde uitbuiting, en ook niet of dat gebeurt onder scholieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor de archeologie

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether archaeology firms can access COVID-19 support schemes (TOGS, NOW), late payment rules, and heritage education funding. The minister declined to add the broad SBI code 7220 to TOGS, pointed to other support schemes, and promised to consider extensions to the archaeology quality registration.
I am in consultation with the SIKB, the CCvDA and the IOeE about which leniency measures are needed to keep the archaeology quality system functioning.

Ik ben in overleg met de Stichting Infrastructuur Kwaliteit Bodem (SIKB), het centraal College van Deskundigen in de Archeologie (CCvDA) en de Inspectie voor Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed (IOeE) over welke coulancemaatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Promoveren én mantelzorgen, het valt niet mee’

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about a study showing PhD candidates with informal caregiving duties face high stress and sleep problems, and about support, leave, timeline extensions and training for them. The Minister acknowledged the concern, said universities and the VSNU will raise leave options and balance discussions with PhD candidates, and that no specific schemes exist beyond general care leave, with case-by-case extensions possible.
I have brought this to the attention of the VSNU.
Dit heb ik onder de aandacht van de VSNU gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over streamingsdiensten

An MP asked whether streaming services profit from lockdown-driven demand while creative workers lose income, and whether the minister would push at EU level for a solidarity levy or a moral appeal on streamers. The minister noted Netflix subscriber growth in the Netherlands but said overall streaming revenue is unclear, described voluntary Netflix relief funds, and declined a general moral appeal while expressing concern for the sector.
I therefore do not consider a moral appeal to all streaming services in general desirable.
Ik vind een moreel appèl op alle streamingsdiensten in het algemeen derhalve niet wenselijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor studenten

An MP asked the Minister of Education about unclear COVID-19 rules for students in shared houses, the consequences of study delay for student finance and fees, the support available from student welfare funds, and the protection of young researchers. The minister answered that shared student houses are not treated as one household under the emergency ordinance, that DUO and institutions offer flexibility on loans and fees, and that she is monitoring the effects with education bodies.
I am monitoring this closely and remain in discussion with student and youth organisations about it.
Ik houd dit scherp in de gaten en blijf hierover in gesprek met de studenten- en jongerenorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van den Berge over het bericht 'Transgender eist excuses overheid: ‘Om vrouw te worden, moest ik me laten steriliseren’'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government acknowledges the harm caused by the pre-2014 sterilisation requirement for legal gender change, whether it will apologise, how other countries handled redress, and whether it will meet the complainants. The minister acknowledged the harm and the requirement's damage, said a response to the Transgender Collective's letter requesting apology and compensation talks is still under consideration, described Sweden's compensation and noted no other countries have apologised, and declined to commit to a meeting for now.
I am aware that this condition for sterilisation caused suffering and I also acknowledge this suffering.
Ik ben er mee bekend dat deze voorwaarde tot sterilisatie leed heeft veroorzaakt en erken dit leed ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat universiteiten met surveillance-software studenten thuis in de gaten houden

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether universities using surveillance software to proctor exams at home protect student privacy under the GDPR, what data is collected, and whether student participation rules are respected. The Minister replies that institutions must comply with the GDPR, that proctoring is a pilot-scale tool requiring careful assessment, and that student councils should be involved but may be consulted afterwards when continuity requires it.
Even in such a case, the institution makes efforts to ensure that the student council can fulfil its role, even if afterwards.
Ook in een dergelijk geval spant de instelling zich in om te zorgen dat de medezeggenschap, zij het achteraf, haar rol kan vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'VU blundert er op los met loting opleiding geneeskunde: 'het gaat om onze toekomst''

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the VU's lottery-based selection for medicine, in which about 50 applicants were wrongly informed of a placement rank because two ranking methods were swapped. The Minister explained the error, said the VU would seek to admit the affected students through a one-off capacity increase, and gave permission for it.
The VU then itself decided to switch to a different alternative method without a lottery.
Daarop heeft de VU zelf besloten over te gaan op een andere alternatieve methode zonder loting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Berge over gevolgen van het opschorten van Staatsexamens Nt2 voor statushouders en andere nieuwkomers
