An MP asked whether suspending the Nt2 state exams, due to COVID-19, would block asylum holders and other newcomers from starting education in September, and whether the government would talk with education institutions about solutions. The minister agreed the situation is undesirable and reported agreements with the VH, VSNU and MBO Raad allowing conditional admission for students who cannot yet show the required Dutch language level, subject to proof of level before 1 January.
I have already spoken with VH, VSNU and the MBO Raad.
Ik ben reeds in gesprek gegaan met VH, VSNU en de MBO Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Futselaar en Alkaya over ondersteuning voor zelfstandigen en de culturele sector

MPs Kwint, Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about support for self-employed workers and the cultural sector during the COVID-19 crisis, including eligibility criteria, compensation for cancelled events, and a guarantee fund. The government answered that existing general measures apply, cited extra funding of 300 million euro for culture, and explained why certain sectors were included or excluded from the TOGS scheme.
On Tuesday 7 April the extension to non-food retail and a second extension were communicated to the House.
Op dinsdag 7 april jl. is de uitbreiding met non-food retail en nog een tweede uitbreiding aan uw Kamer gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het uitblijven van ondersteuning voor de culturele sector

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the cultural sector has received no sector-specific support during the COVID-19 crisis, whether a rescue package is coming, and whether the cultural season is lost. The Minister answered that EUR 300 million in additional funds was announced for key cultural infrastructure, alongside general measures, and rejected each premise of the questions with a brief 'no, see answer 1' reply.
The cabinet is adding EUR 300 million in additional funds to the existing instruments to keep the vital parts of the cultural infrastructure intact.
Het kabinet voegt € 300 miljoen additionele middelen toe aan het bestaande instrumentarium om de vitale onderdelen in de culturele infrastructuur in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Futselaar over zwangerschapsdiscriminatie bij studenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about pregnancy discrimination against students, including whether pregnant higher-education students should have maternity leave and individual exam programmes as mbo students now do. The minister acknowledged pregnancy can delay studies, said higher education lacks a statutory attendance duty so institutions handle this case by case, and committed to report after the summer on a parliamentary motion about maternity leave in higher education.
Following this debate, a motion was also adopted requesting the government to map out what is needed to make maternity leave possible in higher education.
Naar aanleiding van dit debat is ook een motie aangenomen die de regering verzoekt in kaart te brengen wat ervoor nodig is om zwangerschapsverlof in het hoger onderwijs mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Van den Berge en Kwint over een noodfonds voor de culturele sector

Three opposition MPs asked whether the government will provide extra funds to compensate the cultural sector for lost income during the COVID-19 crisis and whether they support an emergency fund. The minister answered that an additional 300 million euros is being added for key cultural infrastructure, while pointing to general COVID-19 support measures and repeating the same reply to most follow-up questions.
The cabinet is adding 300 million euros in additional funds to the existing instruments to maintain the vital parts of the cultural infrastructure.
Het kabinet voegt € 300 miljoen additionele middelen toe aan het bestaande instrumentarium om de vitale onderdelen in de culturele infrastructuur in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het bericht dat Shell de Nationale Boomfeestdag van Staatsbosbeheer sponsort

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether Shell's sponsorship of the Nationale Boomfeestdag, its climate record, and related tree-planting and flight-compensation claims amount to greenwashing and misleading children's education material. The government confirmed the sponsorship, said climate responsibility lies with companies and the Klimaatakkoord, declined to assess school learning materials citing school autonomy, and promised a separate letter on the voluntary CO2 compensation market.
The cabinet regularly receives questions about the content of learning materials.
Met enige regelmaat krijgt het kabinet vragen over de inhoud van leermiddelen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Van den Berg en Kuik over de berichten ‘Prestatiedruk in het hoger onderwijs leidt tot misbruik ADHD-medicatie’ en ‘Braindrug modafinil is populair onder studenten, maar ‘je

CDA MPs asked the ministers of Education and Medical Care about reports of ADHD medication and modafinil misuse by students under performance pressure, and about illegal trade, monitoring, prevention and campaigns. The ministers answered that the Amsterdam study is qualitative and not representative, that a RIVM and Trimbos monitor on student mental health and substance use is underway with results expected in 2020 and 2021, that prevention measures will be considered depending on those results, and that the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) is working against illegal online trade within the limits of cross-border enforcement.
The exact scale and extent of trade in ADHD medication and modafinil is insufficiently known.
De exacte schaal en omvang van de handel in ADHD-medicatie en modafinil is onvoldoende bekend.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid El Yassini over het bericht “ondernemer kan diversiteit op werkvloer checken’

An MP asked the government about a report that companies could use employees' citizen service numbers to check workplace cultural diversity, and whether this resembled the abolished Wet Samen. The minister's answers largely shifted to a separate press-sector support fund, avoided the diversity questions, and gave only brief yes/no replies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het collegegeld op de tweede onderwijsstudie

An MP asked the Education Minister about high tuition fees for a second teacher-training degree, including whether the lower statutory rate should apply to graduates who are not working in education or healthcare. The minister said a limited subsidy scheme was created within budget, declined to abolish the institutional rate or to extend the lower rate to non-practising graduates, and rejected binding agreements with institutions.
Making agreements on lowering institutional tuition rates is not something I currently consider desirable or necessary.
Afspraken maken over het verlagen van instellingstarieven acht ik nu niet wenselijk en noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ellemeet over het tekort aan openbare bibliotheken

MPs Asscher and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the shortage of public libraries, including five municipalities with no library and the Council for Culture's advice to legally require each municipality to have one. The minister says every resident should have access to a full library within reasonable distance, will pursue fixes through a convenant with municipalities, provinces and the library sector, and does not rule out amending the Wsob later, but declines to make municipal libraries a legal requirement for now.
I want to follow a phased approach here. My aim is to close gaps in the system via the convenant with the other governments and the library sector.
Ik wil hier een gefaseerde aanpak volgen. Het is mijn inzet via het convenant met de andere overheden en het bibliotheekveld lacunes in het stelsel te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Kwint over het coronavirus en onderwijs

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about school closures and childcare during the coronavirus outbreak, including whether schools should serve as childcare, whether parents may keep children home under the Compulsory Education Act, and the Inspectorate's stance. The minister confirmed that in-person teaching and childcare are suspended until 28 April with online teaching where possible, and set out exam, internship, study-advice and funding adjustments.
Until and including Monday 28 April, no on-site teaching will take place in primary, secondary, vocational and higher education, and regular childcare will be suspended.

Tot en met maandag 28 april wordt er geen les gegeven op locatie in het primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs, en de reguliere kinderopvang wordt gestaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Diertens over de gevolgen van het coronavirus voor de culturele sector

Two D66 MPs asked how the government will cushion the coronavirus fallout for the cultural sector, given many freelancers and self-employed artists, and what support schemes exist. The minister answered that the sector can use general economic relief measures, that rent and subsidy leniency has been agreed with several bodies, that a new self-employed benefit scheme without means test is being set up, and that consultations with the sector are ongoing.
Depending on developments, the cabinet will take necessary and appropriate follow-up measures if the situation calls for them.
Afhankelijk van de ontwikkelingen, zal het kabinet noodzakelijke en passende vervolgmaatregelen treffen indien de situatie daartoe noopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Rog over de berichtgeving rondom het coronavirus COVID-19 via de sociale mediakanalen van de Rijksoverheid

MPs Van den Berg and Rog asked why ministry and inspectorate websites lacked school-specific COVID-19 guidance, whether schools were directly informed, and about contingency planning and school trip cancellations. The minister replied that information is centralised on rijksoverheid.nl with a school FAQ linked from the OCW and inspectorate sites, that a central contact point and daily dialogue with education sector bodies exist, and that schools closed until 6 April with contingency planning in place, while declining to provide figures on cancelled trips and referring travel refunds to schools and carriers.
No, I do not have those figures.
Nee, die cijfers heb ik niet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat een klimaatscepticus meer dan een miljoen gulden ontving van o.a. Nederlandse bedrijven met als expliciet doel om twijfel te zaaien over klimaatverandering en

An MP asks ministers whether they will act on reports that Dutch companies funded a climate sceptic to sow doubt about climate change, and whether those companies should be excluded from climate policy and education. The government answers that it is up to the companies to provide clarity, that it cannot assess the influence of sceptics, that it will not ask schools, media or the cultural sector to change their ties, and that companies funding sceptics may keep their seats at the Climate Agreement table.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sjoerdsma over hulp voor Nederlandse uitwisselingsstudenten, stagiairs en instellingen voor hoger onderwijs met de situatie rond het coronavirus

Two D66 MPs asked the education and foreign affairs ministers how universities and universities of applied sciences help exchange students and interns stranded abroad by COVID-19 travel restrictions, including repatriation, study delay funding and whether countries are expelling students. The minister says institutions are supporting students, gives partial abroad counts and points to existing DUO loan and funding options, and says that contacts with foreign affairs and airlines continue, without new binding commitments.
Because developments keep changing and differ by country, it is difficult to determine at this moment exactly how many students abroad are involved.
Vanwege de steeds veranderende ontwikkelingen die ook nog eens per land verschillen is het lastig om op dit moment precies in kaart te brengen om welke aantallen studenten in het buitenland het gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de ontstane situatie in het hoger onderwijs als gevolg van de uitbraak van het corona-virus

The MP asked how higher education institutions are coping with online teaching during the coronavirus outbreak, whether students who fall behind can be accommodated (including binding study advice, master admission, loans and tuition relief, the hardship fund, and rent flexibility). The Minister answered that she is in talks with sector bodies, that institutions must minimise disadvantage to students, and referred to a separate letter for most specifics, while pointing students to DUO loan options and online Q&As.
For the rest, I refer you to my letter on the COVID-19 approach to higher education that I sent to your House today.
Voor het overige verwijs ik u naar mijn brief over de COVID-19 aanpak hoger onderwijs die ik heden aan uw Kamer heb gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Renkema over maatregelen tegen het Coronavirus in mbo-instellingen

MPs Van den Berge and Renkema asked why mbo vocational schools were not advised to move all non-essential activities online or cancel them, given student work in care settings and the approach taken for higher education. The minister replied that from 15 March until 6 April no on-site teaching occurs in mbo and other schools, that online teaching is used where possible, and that schools were asked to prioritise final-year students and the Cabinet is assessing consequences for individual students.
Currently the cabinet is inventorying the further consequences of COVID-19, including the consequences for individual students.
Momenteel inventariseert het kabinet de verdere gevolgen van COVID-19, waaronder de gevolgen voor individuele studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat gasbedrijven Gronings onderzoek naar duurzame energie domineren

Two SP MPs asked whether gas companies dominating the New Energy Coalition's research on sustainable energy in Groningen is problematic, including its university and subsidy links and the NAM's role. The minister defended the open involvement of fossil-fuel firms in the energy transition, said the NEC's conduct is not a government concern absent evidence of breach, and promised a study of third-party funding of research.
In accordance with this motion, a study will be carried out, with the Ministry of OCW taking the lead.
Conform deze motie zal een onderzoek worden uitgevoerd, waarbij het Ministerie van OCW het voortouw zal nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Lodders over het bericht 'Verkoper van 'tweedehands' e-boeken stopt ermee'

MPs El Yassini and Lodders asked the ministers about a CJEU ruling on resale of second-hand e-books and how it relates to the e-lending convenant for public libraries, plus e-book market size, VAT reduction effects and innovation. The minister answered that the ruling is separate from the convenant, gave market figures, and deferred several questions to forthcoming policy letters or evaluations.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform the House before the summer about the results of this research.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht ‘Vindicat met 900 leden op wintersport naar Italië, ondanks coronavirus’

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports that student association Vindicat sent 900 members on a ski trip to northern Italy despite coronavirus, and asked whether this reflected incoherent policy and what measures would be taken on return. The minister answered that travel advice for the region changed only after the group left, that the advisories of RIVM and foreign affairs serve as the clear rules, and that GGD Groningen will coordinate the group's return with screening on arrival.
At the moment the Vindicat members departed, non-essential travel to this area was not yet being advised against.
Op het moment dat de leden van Vindicat vertrokken werden niet essentiële reizen naar dit gebied nog niet ontraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het bericht "Ruzie met de universiteit over een briljant idee"

An MP asked the Minister of Education about TU Eindhoven's practice of having students sign a declaration waiving intellectual property rights, and about whether universities will follow the VSNU guideline. The minister says the practice goes too far, that the VSNU is preparing a supplementary guideline on student IP with a stakeholder meeting to follow, and that universities will reassess their practices once it is published in spring.
I do find the TU Eindhoven practice with the student declaration in this form to go rather far, given this.
Ik vind de werkwijze van de TU Eindhoven met de studentverklaring in deze vorm gelet hierop wel ver gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over straatgeweld en het toenemend aantal steekincidenten

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Education ministers about rising street violence and knife incidents, including data, reporting by victims, camera technology and a plan of action. The minister answered that knife incidents are not separately registered, that targeted analyses are under way with results expected mid-2020, that police see hardening rather than increase in street violence, and that a broader plan will be sent to parliament in spring 2020.
Knife incidents and street violence are not registered as such in the police systems.
Steekincidenten en straatgeweld worden niet als zodanig geregistreerd in de politiesystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de berichten ‘Rechter krijgt laatste woord’ en ‘Katwijk: Sloop van barakken bij voormalig vliegveld Valkenburg’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the planned demolition of fourteen wartime barracks at former Valkenburg airfield in Katwijk, which were delisted as municipal monuments, and whether the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had been involved. The minister said the heritage value remains largely intact, the RCE has not been involved so far, and she has asked the RCE to talk with the municipality about the area's future.
I have asked the Cultural Heritage Agency to hold consultations with the municipality.
Ik heb de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed gevraagd om overleg te voeren met de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘UT-arts wil stop op instroom buitenlandse studenten: ‘Ze lopen psychisch vast’’

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asks the minister about reports that most international students at the University of Twente have psychological complaints, whether intake should be restricted, funding use, and English as campus language. The minister answers that a RIVM study on student mental health is underway with results expected end 2020, that intake is not a selection criterion, that internationalisation is valued but institutions must provide support, and that language choices are for the university.
I am awaiting the results of the RIVM study before making statements on the extent and severity of stress and mental pressure.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het RIVM-onderzoek af voordat ik uitspraken doe over de omvang en de ernst van stress en mentale druk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het toevoegen van klimaatlessen aan het onderwijscurriculum in Nieuw-Zeeland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will adopt New Zealand's climate-education curriculum and related lessons on climate crisis, activism and eco-anxiety, and asked about the psychological effects of climate change. The ministers answered that sustainability is already part of the Dutch curriculum, that New Zealand's materials are freely available to schools, that Dutch education policy is a national responsibility, and that they do not see a need to copy the Italian or New Zealand models.
The Netherlands therefore does not need to follow the example of Italy and New Zealand, since themes such as sustainability, climate and liveability are already embedded in Dutch education.
Nederland behoeft het voorbeeld van Italië en Nieuw-Zeeland dan ook niet te volgen, aangezien thema's als duurzaamheid, klimaat en leefbaarheid ook nu al ingebed zijn in het Nederlandse onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de noodklok die WO in actie, FNV en AOb luiden over structureel overwerk op universiteiten

MPs asked the minister about reports that university staff work unpaid overtime and whether the labour inspectorate and the government will act on it, and about workload and grant-application pressure. The minister said the labour inspectorate has taken WO in Actie's complaint into its planned inspections of 14 universities, and pointed to a strategic agenda and an action plan on application pressure, promising a response.
The labour inspectorate has taken WO in Actie's complaint into consideration.
De inspectie SZW heeft de melding van WO in Actie in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de leden Westerveld, Renkema en Futselaar over het rapport van WOinActie ‘Inventarisatie omvang en gevolgen van structureel overwerk aan de Nederlandse universiteiten’

Three opposition MPs asked the government about a WOinActie report on structural unpaid overtime at Dutch universities, including whether it is lawful, the government's responsibility, job insecurity and workload causes. The minister answered that the Inspectie SZW will examine the complaints in its planned inspections of the 14 universities, that the Wml, Atw and Arbowet set the legal limits, and that she will press institutions and VSNU on permanent contracts and workload reduction.
It is up to the Inspectie SZW to investigate whether this is indeed the case.
Het is aan de Inspectie SZW om te onderzoeken of dit inderdaad het geval is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht ‘Nieuwe ROC-topman heeft grote plannen: Waarom zou een bakker Engels moeten leren?’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that a new ROC director questioned the need for English for a baker, and whether mbo general subjects are safeguarded. The minister answered that language and arithmetic requirements are built into the qualification structure, that the director does not dispute the triple qualification, and that the Inspectorate monitors compliance.
Individual administrators have no influence on this. The Inspectorate of Education monitors that sufficient attention is paid to language and arithmetic education everywhere.
Individuele bestuurders hebben hierop geen invloed. De Inspectie van het Onderwijs ziet erop toe dat overal voldoende werk wordt gemaakt van taal- en rekenonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over scholen die in de clinch liggen met de Belastingdienst over zonnedaken

GroenLinks MPs asked why schools must charge VAT on electricity fed back to the grid and whether they could be exempted, citing a 2018 motion and the Urgenda ruling. The Secretary of State answered that the new small-business scheme from 2020 lets schools opt out of VAT on feed-in, that a blanket exemption is not possible under EU VAT rules, and that no mandatory rollout of solar panels on school roofs is planned.
An exemption for feed-in to the grid by all schools is not possible.
Een vrijstelling voor de netleveringen door alle scholen is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht ‘Maximaal bedrag dat erkende leerbedrijven ontvangen uit de subsidieregeling Praktijkleren voor iedere bbl-studenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the falling per-student subsidy under the Praktijkleren scheme for BBL vocational students, the SEO cost-benefit study, and whether the scheme should be reformed or funded from the budget. The Minister acknowledged the falling subsidy (from EUR 2,700 to EUR 2,217), defended the scheme and the study, and declined to reform it now, promising only an evaluation in 2022 that will be reported to parliament.
In 2022 the Praktijkleren subsidy will be evaluated.
In 2022 wordt de subsidie Praktijkleren geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Studies niet toegerust op hoogbegaafd talent’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that higher education is not equipped for gifted students, and whether schools may charge parents for gifted-student provision and what action is taken against them. The minister acknowledges uneven provision, points to a subsidy scheme funding 139 partnerships, says there is no overview of gifted students or of costs, and states that voluntary parental contributions are legally allowed with inspectorate oversight and sanctions.
I have no overview of the number of gifted students who do or do not receive appropriate provision.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het aantal hoogbegaafde studenten dat wel of geen passend aanbod krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Medewerkers universiteit Groningen sluisden 1,2 miljoen weg’

An MP asks the Minister of Education about reports that Groningen University staff diverted about 1.2 million euro of NOHA programme funds to a foundation they set up outside the university's controls, and about oversight, consequences and prevention. The Minister answers that the university has filed fraud charges, frozen the foundation's account, started civil proceedings, taken employment measures, and that the Inspectorate is following up with the university.
It does not befit me to make statements about individual employment law measures.
Het past mij niet om over persoonlijke arbeidsrechtelijke maatregelen mededelingen te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Cyberaanval Universiteit Maastricht duurt mogelijk tot na de kerstvakantie’

MPs Wiersma and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the cyberattack on Maastricht University, its impact on students, data protection, the ransom payment, and prevention. The minister answered that systems were restored in January, that the university paid the ransom from proceeds of a holding stake and that the government had advised against it, and that the Inspectorate has opened an investigation and further cyber-security measures are planned.
It was the executive board of Maastricht University's own decision to pay the ransom.
Het is de eigen afweging van het college van bestuur van de Universiteit Maastricht geweest om het losgeld te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Keuzegids mbo 2020: mbo-opleiding met de hoogste baankans trekt weinig studenten’

An MP asks the Minister of Education about a 2020 study guide finding that vocational programmes with the best job prospects attract few students, and about shortages in key sectors like care, construction and technology, and what concrete steps the government will take. The Minister acknowledges the shortages, points to existing measures (labour-market obligation for programmes, career guidance, sector pacts and the care action programme) and promises a broader strategy letter before summer.
Regarding the Kuik/Smals motion, the letter on the broad strategy for opportunity programmes will be sent to your House before the summer.
Voor wat betreft de motie Kuik en Smals, de brief inzake de brede strategie voor de kansopleidingen zal voor de zomer aan uw Kamer worden toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het integraal verwerken van klimaatlessen in het Italiaanse onderwijs

An MP asked the ministers about Italy's plan to integrate climate and sustainability lessons across the curriculum and how this relates to Dutch education, including a parliamentary motion on inspectorate oversight of company-provided education. The ministers replied that the Italian plans are not yet concrete, that climate and sustainability already feature in Dutch curricula, that curriculum.nu addresses sustainability, and that schools have autonomy, so they see no need for intervention.
Moreover, we have no signals that this is the case.
Wij hebben trouwens geen signalen dat hiervan sprake zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de uitzending van BOOS dat de NCOI sjoemelt met overheidsgeld

MP Kwint (SP) asked the Minister of Education about a BOOS broadcast alleging NCOI pockets public voucher money from students who drop out, and about NCOI's quality and fees. The minister denies clear proof of cheating, notes NCOI must repay DUO only in limited cases, reports NCOI's dropout and fee practices, and says NCOI is asked for further accountability that DUO will examine.
Following this additional information from NCOI about the offsetting upon termination of study, NCOI is asked for further accountability, which DUO will examine.
Naar aanleiding van deze aanvullende informatie van NCOI over de verrekening bij stopzetting van de studie wordt NCOI gevraagd om een nadere verantwoording, die door DUO wordt onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de besnijdenis van Nederlandse meisjes in het buitenland

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the cutting of Dutch girls abroad and what measures it takes to prevent and detect it. The minister answers that FGM is strictly prohibited and that prevention, reporting via Veilig Thuis, and an action agenda are being pursued, while noting that outcomes are not known and that Kenya has been raised with its authorities.
I will continue to invest in tackling FGM over the coming years together with my colleague for Legal Protection.
Ik blijf de komende jaren samen met mijn collega voor Rechtsbescherming investeren in de aanpak van VGV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar inzake het bericht dat vanaf 1 januari op de Universiteit Twente alleen Engels wordt gesproken

An SP MP asks the education minister how the University of Twente's decision to use only English from 1 January squares with the Dutch language and accessibility law and the General Administrative Law Act, and whether it is desirable. The minister says the choice is for the university and its participation bodies within legal limits, that formal correspondence with students must remain available in Dutch, and that the university should consider accessibility effects for Dutch-speaking students.
Towards students, the university should therefore, as a main rule, communicate in Dutch in administrative dealings.
Richting studenten dient de universiteit in het bestuurlijk verkeer dan ook – als hoofdregel – in het Nederlands te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat vanaf 1 januari 2020 op de Universiteit Twente alleen Engels wordt gesproken

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the University of Twente's decision to conduct all internal communication in English, and not only teaching, is compatible with the proposed language and accessibility bill and the rule of law. The Minister answered that the bill and the WHW only govern the language of teaching and exams, not internal working language, that the university still offers Dutch-language programmes, and that the Awb's general rule on administrative language allows exceptions.
It is relevant to note that there is no question of Dutch being banned at the University of Twente.
Wel is relevant te noemen dat er geen sprake van is dat het spreken van Nederlands wordt verboden bij de Universiteit Twente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Vanaf 1 januari wordt op de Universiteit Twente alleen Engels gesproken’

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Wiersma asked the Minister of Education whether the University of Twente's decision to use only English as its official language conflicts with ECHR article 14 and Awb article 2:6, and what the government will do. The Minister answered that the decision was taken in 2015, that no discrimination or legal violation has been identified, that language choice is for the institution with its works council, and that she will not intervene but expects the universities to consider accessibility effects.
If it were to turn out that the ECHR is not complied with because an employee or student is discriminated against, the usual legal protection is of course open to that student or employee.

Als zou blijken dat niet aan het EVRM wordt voldaan omdat een medewerker of student wordt gediscrimineerd, dan staat hiertegen uiteraard de gebruikelijke rechtsbescherming open voor de betreffende student of medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het artikel "Ruzie met de universiteit over een briljant idee".

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about disputes between universities and students over intellectual property, including a reported case where a university demanded shares in a student startup. The minister answered that only one lawsuit (TU Delft, won by the university) is known in ten years, that about thirty negotiations occurred, and that a guideline for student IP is being prepared with the VSNU, to be sent to parliament in spring.
The VSNU expects to have the intended supplement to the existing guideline ready in spring. I will inform the House of Representatives about it.
De VSNU verwacht in het voorjaar bedoelde aanvulling op het bestaande richtsnoer gereed te hebben. Ik zal uw Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat een Chinese geneticus van het Erasmus MC werkt voor de Chinese politie

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked the government about reports that a Chinese geneticist at Erasmus MC worked for the Chinese police, and what the government had done in response, including contacts with China, funding, screening of Chinese researchers and university awareness. The minister answered that the disputed face-shape research was separate from the Rotterdam height study, was not funded by Erasmus MC or the EU, that the Chinese embassy was warned about misuse of knowledge, and that the cabinet is examining broader knowledge-security measures.

I cannot give detailed statements on what information is or is not known to the intelligence and security services, because this would reveal the current knowledge level, modus operandi and/or sources of the services.

Ik kan geen gedetailleerde uitspraken doen over welke informatie al dan niet bekend is bij de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten omdat dit inzicht geeft in het actuele kennisniveau, de modus operandi en/of bronnen van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Koopmans over het artikel “NY Times: ‘Rotterdamse geneticus gebruikte mogelijk onder dwang verkregen bloedmonsters van Oeigoeren’”

MPs Wiersma and Koopmans asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a New York Times report that a Rotterdam geneticist may have used blood samples from Uyghurs obtained under coercion, and about Chinese ministry funding of Dutch research, including oversight of such funding and its risks. The minister answered that the government does not monitor foreign funding flows or the use of research results, that institutions must manage risks and be transparent about donations, that the Erasmus MC height study had ethical approval, and that the government is examining broader knowledge-security measures.
My ministry has no insight into funding flows for scientific research originating from foreign governments.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen inzicht in financieringsstromen voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek afkomstig van buitenlandse overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over mogelijke inzet van derdejaars pabo-studenten als zzp’er

The MP asked whether schools using third-year teacher-training (pabo) students as self-employed freelancers, who set their own fees and are cheaper than certified teachers, is acceptable for education quality and cost-effectiveness. The minister answered that third-year pabo students may not teach independently, only as interns, that fourth-year students may be employed as LIO trainee teachers under the law and collective agreement, and that the undesirable practice is already blocked without a new ban.
A third-year pabo student may not yet teach independently.
Een derdejaars pabo-student mag nog niet zelfstandig les geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over achterstandsscholen die zich bevinden in fijnstofgebieden

An MP asks whether schools in air-pollution zones, many of them disadvantaged schools in Amsterdam, were left unprotected and whether parents and school boards are informed, and asks for national funding of filters and green playgrounds. The minister replies that air quality is a shared responsibility of municipalities and schools, that the GGD advises on health effects, that the Schone Lucht Akkoord sets targets, and that national funding for filters and playgrounds does not fit the current system.
It is up to municipalities to inform school boards about air quality and health effects, and to take measures to reduce exposure to local sources.
Het is aan gemeenten om schoolbesturen te informeren over de luchtkwaliteit en gezondheidseffecten, en maatregelen te treffen om blootstelling aan lokale bronnen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Omtzigt, Kuiken en Verhoeven over de paspoorthandel van Malta en de betrokkenheid van een professor van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs asked the government about Malta's citizenship-by-investment scheme, the listed buyers of Maltese passports, the AIVD warning, the Rule of Law situation in Malta, and a Groningen professor's links to a passport firm. The minister answered that the Maltese list covers all naturalisations, that the Commission is monitoring such schemes and the government will seek dialogue, that the Prime Minister raised rule-of-law concerns with his Maltese counterpart, and that the university is examining the professor's activities.
The cabinet considers the sale of passports to non-EU citizens who are suspected of crimes to be undesirable.
Het kabinet acht de verkoop van paspoorten aan niet-EU burgers, die onder verdenking staan van misdrijven, ongewenst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Molen over het onderzoek naar de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Molen asked about the investigation into Professor Kochenov's outside positions, including advisory work for Malta and links to Henley & Partners and the Investment Migration Council, and the Paradise Papers. The minister answered that an external investigation by the University of Groningen is underway, that the Inspectorate has not yet received results, that the report is expected in Q1 2020, and that the university is responsible for publishing it, with a commitment to forward a published version to parliament.
The dissemination and degree of publicity is the responsibility of the RUG.
De verspreiding en mate van openbaarheid is de verantwoordelijkheid van de RUG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Paternotte over de aflevering van Zondag met Lubach «de slacht & NVWA» van 24 november 2019

D66 MPs asked the ministers about shortages of veterinary staff at the NVWA, the training and selection of large-animal vets, and whether slaughter volumes endanger food safety, following a Zondag met Lubach episode. The minister answered that the shortage raises workload but does not directly affect inspections, outlined training figures and recruitment steps, and said capacity gaps do not automatically mean food-safety risk.
The mentioned shortage of veterinarians has no direct consequences for the execution of the inspections carried out on the slaughter process.
Het genoemde tekort aan dierenartsen heeft geen directe consequenties voor de uitvoering van de keuringen die worden uitgevoerd op het slachtproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten aan de TU-Delft zijn opgelicht door nep-verhuurders

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Housing and the Minister of Education about students at TU Delft defrauded by fake landlords, including how many were foreign students, and about platform controls, blacklists, licensing and a quality mark. The minister answered that no standard registration or national figures exist, described information campaigns, the Wet toeristische verhuur, ACM action against intermediary fees, pilots on local landlord licensing, and said fake landlords are a criminal law matter rather than housing policy.
There is no standard registration of this available at TU Delft.
Er is geen standaardregistratie hiervan beschikbaar bij de TU Delft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘De stagiair is vogelvrij’ op AOb.nl op 19 november 2019

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether the position of teacher-trainee (lio) interns should be better safeguarded and why schools do not follow collective agreement rules on interns, after an AOb report that interns are treated as unprotected. The ministers answer that lio trainees may teach under supervision with a temporary contract, that existing collective agreement rules and a 2018 handreiking govern their deployment, and that they will ask the school boards' associations to inform schools and pay trainees.
We will ask the PO-Raad and VO-raad to inform school boards about this issue and urge them to pay a fee for the internship
We zullen de PO-Raad en de VO-raad vragen besturen te informeren over deze kwestie en erop aandringen een vergoeding te betalen bij de stage
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht 'De stagiair is vogelvrij'

An SGP MP asked the education ministers about reports that trainee teachers (stagiairs) are treated unequally and arbitrarily, performing lio-level duties without lio pay. The ministers said lio status and pay are set by the CAO, that stagiairs should not carry lio-level responsibilities, and that they will urge school boards via the PO-Raad and VO-Raad to pay stage allowances and to stop using stagiairs as lio.
We consider a remuneration for trainees desirable.
Daarbij vinden wij een vergoeding voor stagiairs wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het artikel ‘Studentenstress anno 2019: ‘Het is een beetje een hype’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a news article claiming student stress is partly a hype, and about the funding and causes of student wellbeing programmes. The minister replied that existing research is fragmented, that RIVM has been commissioned to measure student mental health (results expected end 2020), and that institutions decide how to spend lump-sum funds and quality-agreement money, with a limited commitment to a plan of action.
I have therefore commissioned RIVM to carry out a large-scale study measuring the mental health of students.
Ik heb daarom het RIVM opdracht gegeven tot een grootschalig onderzoek om een meting te doen naar mentale gezondheid van studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Paternotte en Van den Hul over het manifest van de beurspromovendi

MPs Van den Berge, Paternotte and Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the manifesto of PhD candidates on scholarships, who lack employee rights, face pressure to teach, and receive weaker protections than employed PhD students. The minister largely defended the experiment, saying promotion students have no teaching duty and that the RUG has been urged to better inform supervisors, while promising an independent review and an evaluation in 2021.
In the policy response to the interim evaluation I have therefore already called on the RUG to continue focusing on informing the supervisors.
In de beleidsreactie op de tussenevaluatie heb ik daarom de RUG reeds opgeroepen om onverminderd in te zetten op het informeren van de supervisors.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht 'Huize Ivicke haalt shortlist Europese '7 Most Endangered sites''

MP Geluk-Poortvliet asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the neglected Huize Ivicke estate in Wassenaar and whether owners are holding monuments hostage, and whether small municipalities can enforce the Heritage Act. The minister answered that Wassenaar has started enforcement and the owner began emergency works in January 2020, that Sluis is pursuing the same owner, and that the RCE and Inspectorate provide assistance to municipalities.
For advice on criminal enforcement, one can turn to the Inspectorate for Government Information and Heritage, which also maintains contacts with the police and the Public Prosecution Service.
Voor advies over strafrechtelijke handhaving kan een beroep gedaan worden op de Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed die ook contacten onderhoudt met de Politie en het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Amsterdamse hoger onderwijs moet diverser, desnoods met quota’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a manifesto calling for more diversity in Amsterdam higher education, possibly with quotas, including the role of ministry and institutions, chief diversity officers, measurement of diversity policy, and whether external activist groups should impose admission criteria. The minister said the ministry was not involved, institutions set their own diversity policy and are accountable for spending, and external pressure does not affect accessibility as institutions will weigh it sensibly.
Whether an institution has a diversity officer is institutional policy.
Het is instellingsbeleid of men een diversity officer heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Geweld tegen vrouwen vergt een Nationaal Coördinator’

An MP asked ministers about a report calling for a National Coordinator on violence against women, including prevalence figures, budgets, police stalking detection and coordination between ministries. The minister answered that the figures are known, that responsibility is shared across departments and municipalities with existing programmes and budgets, and that coordination is sufficient, promising a GREVIO-related review and a stalking-training trajectory.
I am of the view that coordination between the ministries is given sufficient shape with this.
Ik ben van mening dat de coördinatie tussen de ministeries hiermee voldoende vorm krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over de actieve promotie van de controversiële paspoortprofessor Kochenov door de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Two SP MPs asked the Education Minister why Groningen University had not yet started its investigation into possible conflicts of interest by professor Kochenov and why it actively promoted his work. The minister answered that the external investigation had begun, that quality takes precedence over speed, that the university's publicity choices are its own responsibility, and that the government is awaiting the report and the Inspectorate's assessment before acting.
I am awaiting the outcomes of the investigation and the Inspectorate's assessment of this investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en het oordeel van de inspectie over dit onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de bescherming van Nederlands cultureel erfgoed

Asscher (PvdA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how Dutch cultural heritage held by private parties is protected, following the Pechtold committee's finding that protection falls short, and how the Rubens drawings sale and the Collectie Nederland register should be addressed. The minister acknowledges the previous policy was too restrained, refers to her policy response on the committee's advice for concrete measures, and agrees to set up an independent expert committee to inventory and update heritage.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Smals en Kuik over het bericht ‘Alarm over vervalste mbo-diploma’s’

MPs Smals and Kuik asked the Minister of Education about reports of rising fraud with vocational (mbo) diplomas, including risks in healthcare and whether forged diplomas can be registered in the BIG register. The minister replied that only a few cases per year are known, that no increase can be established, that employers can verify diplomas via DUO's Diplomaregister, and that fraud should be reported to police, with the issue raised with the Justice Ministry.
I therefore see no reason to investigate how large the group is that is active on the labour market on the basis of a forged diploma.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om te onderzoeken hoe groot de groep is die op basis van een vervalst diploma actief is op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Van Helvert over het bericht 'België houdt grens dicht voor directeur Confucius-instituut'

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government was informed that Chinese professor Xinning Song was barred from Belgium and the Schengen area, and about screening, Chinese intelligence obligations and Confucius Institutes in the Netherlands. The minister replied that Belgium did not actively inform the Netherlands, that no security screening applies to Confucius Institute staff, that Chinese law cannot be ruled out as requiring cooperation with intelligence services, and that knowledge-security measures and a broader study are underway.
When relevant developments arise on this, I will inform the House further.
Bij relevante ontwikkelingen hieromtrent zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over aanbieders van decentrale selectietrainingen geneeskunde

An MP asked whether commercial training providers for the decentralised medicine selection test, and their effect on equal opportunity, should prompt the government to restrict them or rethink selection policy. The Minister replied that such trainings are legal and do not significantly raise admission chances per ResearchNed, that selection cannot rest solely on a knowledge test, and that the government will critically review selection criteria and limit selection where possible.
I do not know how many providers there are or how much money is spent on the demand side.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel aanbieders er zijn en hoeveel geld er aan de vraagkant in omgaat.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Helvert, Diks, Kerstens, Voordewind, Belhaj, Stoffer, Van Haga, Karabulut, Rudmer Heerema, Van den Hul, Rog, Kwint, Bisschop, Bruins, Beertema, Van Meenen, Krol, Wassenberg en

Twenty MPs asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Defence whether schools could be required to give children a day off when a parent returns from a military deployment, a 'family day' as is customary for US troops. The Minister answered that headteachers can already grant up to ten days of leave under the Leerplichtwet for weighty circumstances, that a parent's return from a mission falls under this, and that a letter will be sent to all schools pointing this out.

Because I find it a understandable request, I will send all schools a letter pointing out that the situation mentioned falls under this existing possibility for which a special form of leave is permitted.

Omdat ik het een begrijpelijk verzoek vind, zal ik aan alle scholen een brief sturen waarin ik erop zal wijzen dat de genoemde situatie onder deze bestaande mogelijkheid valt waarvoor een bijzondere vorm van verlof is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over discriminatie op de woningmarkt

Two MPs asked the government about ongoing discrimination against housing seekers on the Utrecht housing market, including licensing for estate agents, fines, and ACM or Public Prosecution action. The minister said the problem is not surprising, outlined an approach of awareness, mystery-guest testing and local pilots, but declined new fines or a licensing law for now.
I have no intention of amending the law on this point.
Ik heb geen voornemen de wet op dit onderdeel aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Wie beschermt onze fragiele Oude Kerk’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about expert concerns that the Oude Kerk monument and its organ suffer damage from dust, heavy installations and improper interventions, and who oversees such risks. The Minister replied that the municipality is the primary permit-granting and supervising authority, that the RCE checked fire safety and found no organ damage, that the RCE advised on the organ restoration which was carried out as permitted, and that the RCE maintains contact with the municipality.
In the first instance it is the municipality, as permit-granting authority and supervisor, that must ensure this.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de gemeente als vergunningverlener en toezichthouder om daarop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over het artikel 'Vraag naar personeel met mbo-opleiding stijgt snel op banensites'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about a news report on rising demand for mbo-trained workers on job sites, including labour market forecasts, shortage sectors, retraining of jobseekers and the flexible-work link. The minister answered that demand for mbo workers has risen with the economy, described forecasting and retraining instruments, and rejected the idea that mbo graduates are mostly trained for unemployment.
It has never been the case that mbo graduates are in many cases trained for unemployment.
Het is nooit zo geweest dat mbo'ers in veel gevallen worden opgeleid voor werkloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de wolk van verontwaardiging om 2 ton voor sterrenkundige die zwart gat wil kieken

An MP asked why the minister granted a one-off 200,000 euro to Professor Falcke's group for science communication after NWO rejected their research proposal, and whether this undermines NWO's independent peer-review process. The minister answered that the funds come from a separate budget for science communication, are not meant to finance the rejected proposal, and that NWO itself sees no problem, with no other such cases.
As stated in my answers to the parliamentary questions from members Paternotte and Futselaar, I do not intervene in NWO's objective assessment.
Zoals aangegeven in mijn antwoorden op de Kamervragen van de leden Paternotte en Futselaar intervenieer ik niet in de objectieve afweging van NWO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het bericht ‘Menstruatiearmoede: geen geld voor maandverband, dan maar wc-papier’

MPs Bergkamp and Raemakers asked the government about reports that some young women in the Netherlands cannot afford menstrual products, and whether the government would investigate price barriers, identify at-risk groups, change VAT or adopt a free-provision policy like Scotland's. The Secretary of State answered that the government supports an integrated poverty approach, points to school sex education, a planned handreiking for schools and municipal support, and declined to commission separate price research.
Are you willing to conduct further research into the extent to which the price of menstrual products hinders access to these products for people living near the poverty line?
Bent u bereid nader onderzoek te doen naar in welke mate de prijs van menstruatieproducten de toegankelijkheid van deze producten belemmert voor mensen die rond de armoedegrens leven?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over “schoolboeken en ander lesmateriaal waarin veel minder vrouwen dan mannen staan en relatief weinig personages met een niet-westerse naam”

An MP asked the ministers whether they would pursue publishers over gender and ethnic underrepresentation and stereotyping found in school textbooks, and whether publishers should act more decisively. The ministers replied that content of teaching materials is for schools to judge given freedom of education, that publishers voluntarily cooperated with the Leiden research and will discuss findings with authors, and that the government will not assess teaching materials.
Given freedom of education and expression, the autonomy of schools and the professional space of teachers, the government does not consider it appropriate to judge teaching materials.
Het past de regering, gezien de vrijheid van het onderwijs en meningsuiting, de autonomie van scholen en de professionele ruimte van leraren, niet een oordeel te geven over leermiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het uitvallen van studenten aan de lerarenopleiding

MP Van den Hul asks the Education Minister about high dropout among teacher-training students, citing a Parool report, and whether this worsens the teacher shortage and what the government will do. The minister confirms higher dropout in second-degree teacher training, lists causes such as extra work in schools and later-life career choices, announces a practice-oriented action research project with the institutions, and says the shortage projections already account for past dropout trends.
Based on the discussions, and with the agreement and cooperation of all institutions, we are now preparing a study together with the second-degree teacher training institutions.
Op grond van de gesprekken, en met instemming en medewerking van alle opleidingen, bereiden we nu samen met de tweedegraads lerarenopleidingen een onderzoek voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht over de peperdure opleiding die het mensen moeilijk maakt om voor de klas te gaan staan (Omroep Brabant, 13 november 2019)

An MP asks the education minister how she views a case where a former healthcare worker starting a second-degree teacher training faces high tuition fees, and whether tailored solutions can be created given the teacher shortage. The minister acknowledges the problem but points to existing routes (zij-instroom, school subsidies) and says tailored arrangements are already possible, without committing to new measures.
As far as can be gathered from the report, the person in question does not seem to have secured an appointment as a teacher/zij-instromer, and is therefore looking for an alternative training option.

Voor zover op te maken uit het bericht, lijkt het echter alsof de betreffende persoon geen aanstelling als leraar/zij-instromer heeft weten te bemachtigen, en daarom een alternatieve opleidingsmogelijkheid zoekt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Den Boer en Verhoeven over paspoorthandel op Malta

Three D66 MPs asked the government about passport sales in Malta, including whether they enable crime, the role of the Maltese state, AIVD warnings, and Dutch positions in the EU. The government answered that Malta conducts due diligence but this is no guarantee, that it sees such sales as undesirable but that citizenship remains national competence, that it will await an EU Commission process before dialogue, and that the Dutch investor residence scheme will be reviewed for added value.
As indicated in the answer to question 6, it is wise to await the outcome of these Commission initiatives and then engage in dialogue, preferably at EU level, on these schemes.

Zoals in de beantwoording van vraag 6 is aangegeven, is het verstandig om de uitkomst van deze initiatieven van de Commissie af te wachten en op basis daarvan de dialoog – bij voorkeur op EU-niveau – over genoemde regelingen aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Futselaar over het bericht dat hypotheekverstrekkers toegang tot studieschuldgegevens bij DUO kunnen vragen

An SP MP asks whether it is desirable that Ockto may give mortgage lenders access to students' study debt data held by DUO, how this fits the Van Meenen motion, and how it can be prevented. The minister answers that the data-sharing is at the student's own initiative with consent, that DUO is not involved, that the government will set rules for data-sharing apps, and that it cannot guarantee commercial parties will never access such data.
The cabinet will therefore develop frameworks that data-sharing applications (such as Ockto) must meet, and will anchor them in the Digital Government Act.
Het kabinet zal daarom kaders ontwikkelen waar toepassingen voor het delen van gegevens (zoals Ockto) aan moeten voldoen, en zal deze verankeren in de Wet digitale overheid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Studieschuld af te kopen’

The MP asks how the minister views a website offering to erase student debts from DUO's systems in exchange for bitcoin, and whether DUO's systems are secure, who can alter records, and what steps will be taken. The minister calls the offer unacceptable, states that debts cannot be removed, that all changes are logged and traceable, found no indications of unlawful changes, and that DUO has filed a criminal complaint while awaiting the justice investigation.
DUO has filed a criminal complaint about what it considers a punishable offence. I am awaiting the outcome of the judicial investigation and will then consider whether follow-up steps are necessary.
DUO heeft aangifte gedaan van dit in haar ogen strafbare feit. Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het justitiële onderzoek af en zal daarna bezien of vervolgstappen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over het bericht dat de SSH& voortaan haar kamers zal verhuren door middel van loting

SP MPs asked whether a housing association's switch to a lottery for student rooms breached the national student housing action plan and whether students were properly consulted. The minister answered that local parties are responsible for the consultation, that the housing association consulted its tenants' organisation as the law requires, and that the government will monitor whether student unions are included.
From central government we will keep a close eye on this.
Vanuit het Rijk zullen we vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Westerveld over het bericht dat sommige jongeren niet kunnen studeren omdat zij dakloos zijn

GroenLinks MPs asked whether homeless young people are excluded from education, how many cannot study or lack a startkwalificatie, where they can get help, and about schuldsanering and student loan barriers. The government replied that lack of a registered address is no bar to enrolment, that no national figures exist on homeless youth without qualifications, that municipalities coordinate support, and pointed to existing action programmes and schuldhulp measures.
DUO does not register who has no fixed residential or residence address.
DUO registreert niet wie er geen vaste woon- of verblijfsplaats heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van den Berge en Buitenweg over het bericht Gedwongen uitgehuwelijkte Fatima: ‘Meisjes zoals ik worden verkocht als golden tickets’ van Hart van Nederland

MPs asked the ministers how forced marriage of young women with a non-Western migrant background is measured, what protection and legal tools exist, and how the vrouwenopvang shortage affects victims. The government answered that reliable figures are lacking, pointed to existing reporting channels, laws and an action agenda due end 2019, and said it would evaluate the Wet tegengaan huwelijksdwang and study the shelter capacity problem.
Precise and reliable figures on the scale of forced marriage in the Netherlands are lacking.
Precieze en betrouwbare cijfers over de omvang van huwelijksdwang in Nederland ontbreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de kwaliteitsafspraken van de TU Delft

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the government approved the TU Delft quality agreement plans despite a negative NVAO advice, and whether this affects the independence of the approval process and the signal sent to institutions. The Minister answered that NVAO advice carries heavy weight, but that TU Delft's response clarified its concrete, measurable goals, which led to a different weighing of the advice, and denied that independence was affected.
NVAO advice plays a weighty role in my decision-making on the quality agreement plans.
Adviezen van de NVAO hebben een zwaarwegende rol in mijn besluitvorming over de plannen voor de kwaliteitsafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over seksuele intimidatie op de werkvloer bij universiteiten

The MP asks whether universities adequately handle sexual and scientific harassment complaints, whether they will engage with university boards, and whether a national independent body or better data is needed. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to VSNU statements, ongoing university measures, an ombudsperson pilot with evaluation in December, and talks with KNAW and LNVH, but declines to commit to a national institute.
I am already in discussion with the VSNU about this.
Ik ben hierover al in gesprek met de VSNU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een racistische uiting bij de Universiteit Leiden

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a racist slogan written at Leiden University, whether the university imposed real consequences, why such incidents recur, and whether she would make a public statement or discuss the issue with the university. The minister said the university held talks, a student apologised, participants were required to take a training programme, and no further talks were needed.
I see no reason to enter into further discussion.
Ik zie geen reden om nader in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Burgemeesters op de bres voor kortebaandraverijen'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the impact of the Wet Kansspelen op afstand and the gambling tax change on short-track harness racing organisations, including possible compensation and whether the sector will survive. The government answered that the wetswijziging will likely lower payouts to the sector, that compensation talks are ongoing with implementation expected 1 January 2021, and that it could not provide a ten-year overview of race numbers.
We do not have the requested overview of developments over the past ten years.
Wij beschikken niet over het gevraagde overzicht van de ontwikkelingen in de afgelopen tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Beckerman over de berichten dat studenten op camping neerstrijken

Two SP MPs asked how many students sleep in tents, hostels or bungalow parks due to housing shortages, how they are supported, and what rent protections exist. The minister said the situation is more nuanced than media reports, described municipal and institutional emergency housing arrangements, pointed to monitoring, the Huurcommissie campaigns and the Goed Verhuurderschap pilots, and promised to continue talks with partners without specifying enforceable consequences.

Regarding your questions on numbers of students in temporary emergency accommodation (campsites, hostels and holiday bungalows) and the costs for students, I made inquiries with various municipalities and educational institutions.

Wat betreft uw vragen over aantallen studenten in tijdelijke noodvoorzieningen (campings, hostels en vakantiebungalows) en de kosten voor de student, heb ik bij verschillende gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen navraag gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Toorenburg en Van der Molen over de verkoop van paspoorten op Malta en de nevenfuncties van professor Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Three CDA MPs asked about Malta's passport-sale programme, its national security risks, and the undisclosed outside roles of a Groningen professor in the investment-migration industry. The minister said the programme is a security concern, that the university must investigate the professor's disclosure and conflicts of interest, and that the Inspectorate will advise on the findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to subsequently assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and possible conflicts of interest and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Leijten over het afkondigde onderzoek naar hoogleraar Kochenov van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen

Two SP MPs asked whether the Groningen university's investigation into professor Kochenov over EU passport-sale advisory work is justified, and why the university had not investigated conflicts of interest earlier. The minister supports the university's independent inquiry, says it will be led by an external chair and checked against the integrity code and secondary-employment rules, and says the Inspectorate will assess its findings.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to assess the findings of the investigation regarding the secondary activities and any conflict of interest, and to advise me on them.

Ik heb de Inspectie van het onderwijs gevraagd om vervolgens de bevindingen van het onderzoek ten aanzien van de nevenwerkzaamheden en eventuele belangenverstrengeling te beoordelen en mij daarover te adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Nederland de geldkraan van beroemd onderzoek naar zwarte gaten dicht draait

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Netherlands was cutting funding for black hole research, and how NWO assesses societal impact. The minister rejected the premise that funding was cut, explained NWO's impact criteria and funding constraints, and gave a one-off 200,000 euro grant for communication about the Event Horizon Telescope result.
I do not share the conclusion that the 'money tap has been turned off'.
Ik deel de conclusie dat de «geldkraan zou zijn dichtgedraaid» niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over de Nederlandse participatie in de Event Horizon Telescope

An MP asked the education minister about the Dutch participation in the Event Horizon Telescope, its scientific importance, and NWO's decision not to fund follow-up research, plus researchers' grant-application workload. The minister said she does not intervene in NWO decisions, granted a one-off 200,000 euro for science communication, noted new funding applications are pending, and promised to speak with the lead professor.
I have great respect for the Dutch scientists who made an important contribution to this and thereby put Dutch science on the map.
Ik heb groot respect voor de Nederlandse wetenschappers die hieraan een belangrijke bijdrage hebben geleverd en daarmee de Nederlandse wetenschap op de kaart hebben gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het stagnerende aantal vrouwen in adviescolleges van het Rijk

An MP asked the ministers why the number of women and people with a migration background in government advisory councils is stagnating, why the statutory goal of balanced representation has not been reached since 1997, and whether a binding quota should be introduced. The State Secretary answered that the government will respond substantively to the Court of Audit report on diversity in advisory councils, taking these questions into account, likely only after the cabinet response to the SER advice on diversity at the top.

As the Minister of the Interior promised your House during the committee meeting of 3 July on the functioning of the civil service, I, as the minister responsible for the Framework Act on advisory councils, will respond substantively on behalf of the cabinet to that report.

Zoals de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tijdens het algemeen overleg van 3 juli jl. over het functioneren van de Rijksdienst aan uw Kamer heeft toegezegd, zal ik, als verantwoordelijke voor de Kaderwet adviescolleges, namens het kabinet inhoudelijk reageren op dat rapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht ‘Eigen  strenge declaratieregels UU weer opzij’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why Utrecht University dropped its own strict rules requiring prior written approval for business-class flights, and whether a college chair's EUR 8,604.94 business-class claims were proportionate. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found the costs compliant with rules and proportionate, that business class is allowed for intercontinental flights under the national scheme, and that a thematic inspection of expense rules will follow at the end of 2019 before deciding whether further regulation is needed.
I sent this report to the House on 12 September.
Ik heb dit rapport op 12 september aan de Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Asscher over inclusiviteit in de podiumkunsten en de overige culturele sector

MPs Ellemeet and Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about inclusiveness in performing arts and culture, including accessibility for disabled concert-goers, the new diversity code, funding, and building accessibility. The minister answered that accessibility is a shared sector effort, outlined a sector meeting and follow-up steps including a 2020 accessibility study, and listed government and sector funding while stating that building accessibility is primarily the owner's responsibility under existing rules.
In addition, I will commission a study in 2020 to map the accessibility of the cultural sector.
Daarnaast zal ik in 2020 een onderzoek laten uitvoeren om de toegankelijkheid van de cultuursector in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en Emiel van Dijk over de kosten van OCW-voorzieningen voor Nederlanders met een (niet-westerse) migratieachtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers of education, culture and media to quantify the costs of education and culture provisions for people with a non-Western migration background and to say how these compare with their returns. The government answered that costs cannot be attributed to origin because funding is lump-sum and not tracked by background, and cited targeted programmes and their amounts.
The share of pupils and students with a non-Western migration background cannot be translated into a share of the costs.
Het aandeel leerlingen en studenten met een niet-westerse migratieachtergrond kan niet worden doorvertaald naar een aandeel in de kosten.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat INEOS via kindermarketing het draagvlak voor schaliegas probeert te vergroten

An MP asked whether INEOS's sponsorship of The Daily Mile, used to build support for shale gas, should be countered, and whether schools should be warned and the programme publicly funded. The minister replied that INEOS is not a sponsor in the Netherlands, that JOGG runs the programme independently, that schools can use the sponsorship convenant, and that the government sees no reason for further action.
INEOS is not a sponsor of The Daily Mile in the Netherlands.
INEOS is in Nederland geen sponsor van The Daily Mile.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma inzake het in de ban doen van de Gouden Eeuw

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why she has not responded to the Amsterdam Museum's decision to stop using the term 'Golden Age' and why she reacts to other controversies. The Minister answers that the government does not steer museum naming or content, that the seventeenth century has both prosperous and dark sides, and that she rejects the premise of the remaining questions.
As I indicated in my answer to the third question, it is not for the government to steer the naming and content of (historical) exhibitions.
Zoals ik aangeef in mijn antwoord op de derde vraag, is het niet aan de regering om te sturen op naamgeving en inhoud van (historische) tentoonstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Meenen over het bericht dat ondanks extra geld mbo-docenten in de laagste salarisschaal terechtkomen

MPs Kwint and Van Meenen asked whether rising numbers of mbo teachers in the lowest salary scale, alongside growing institutional reserves and a critical report on medezeggenschap, reflect misuse of extra funds. The minister answered that the causes are unclear, that the Inspectorate is examining reserves, that she disagrees with the report's analysis, and that she will meet the MBO Raad and unions to review whether the convenant's goals were met.
That is why the Inspectorate of Education is currently conducting further research into this.
Daarom doet de Inspectie van het Onderwijs op dit moment hier nader onderzoek naar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de handel in apen naar Europese proefdiercentra door een Nederlands bedrijf

An MP asked whether a Dutch company trading macaques to European animal testing labs, including a lab in Parma, was implicated in mistreatment shown in undercover footage, and asked for trade volumes, transport welfare and wild-catch safeguards. The minister said Italian authorities should act, that the company meets EU and Dutch rules enforced by the NVWA, and declined to disclose trade volumes and origins for commercial confidentiality reasons.

Although I consider it important to be as transparent as possible on animal testing, I cannot, in line with the earlier answer, provide this information because of the protection of business and manufacturing data.

Hoewel ik het belangrijk vindt om bij dierproeven zo transparant mogelijk te zijn kan ik, in lijn met de eerdere beantwoording, deze Informatie vanwege de bescherming van bedrijfs- en fabricagegegevens niet verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de financiële problemen die Curaçaose oud-studenten ondervinden bij het aflossen van studieschulden

An MP asked whether DUO's repayment and collection practices put former students on Curaçao in financial trouble, and whether repayment schemes reflect local income conditions.
