The minister denied DUO obstructs repayment, explained the income-based draagkracht procedure and the staged collection steps, and promised DUO staff visits to Curaçao and a review of concrete cases.
If the further information from the Minister of OWCS shows that things have gone wrong there, I will certainly take measures.
Als uit de nadere informatie van de Minister van OWCS blijkt dat daar zaken mis zijn gegaan, zal ik zeker maatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dam en Van der Molen over het bericht ‘Oud-studenten op Curaçao in financiële problemen door DUO’

CDA MPs Van Dam and Van der Molen asked the Education Minister about reports that at least a hundred former students on Curaçao got into financial trouble through DUO's communication and collection practices, including a Curaçao minister's claim of a non-integrous approach with a local bailiff. The minister said DUO had not received concrete cases, rejected the claim as unsupported, promised to examine specific cases, and committed to a joint meeting with the Curaçao minister and on-site DUO staff to help debtors.
DUO has asked the Ministry of Education, Science, Culture and Sport for concrete cases in which something would have gone wrong, but has not yet received them.
DUO heeft het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Wetenschap, Cultuur en Sport (OWCS) gevraagd naar concrete zaken waarin iets zou zijn misgegaan, maar deze nog niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar over het bericht ‘Liegen over je studieschuld lastiger: DUO komt met schuldverklaring’

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked why DUO could not adapt its systems for a debt declaration (schuldverklaring) requested by parliament, while a request from another minister could be accommodated. The minister answered that the Blauwe Knop project was small, that work has been stopped following a motion, and that DUO serves several other ministries with maintenance and replacement currently prioritised.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de uitspraken van vicepremier Hugo de Jonge tijdens de jaaropening van Hogeschool Rotterdam

An MP asks whether the deputy prime minister's remarks at a Rotterdam university opening, that students should be steered with a firmer hand toward other study choices to address labour shortages, reflect government policy, and whether numerus fixus or similar measures are planned. The minister replies that students should freely make informed choices, that labour-market prospects are one consideration alongside interest, that the advisory commissions CMMBO and CDHO monitor macro-efficiency, and that no restriction of choice is planned.
It is important that pupils and students have the freedom to make a conscious study choice themselves.
Het is daarbij belangrijk dat leerlingen en studenten de vrijheid hebben zelf een bewuste studiekeuze te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over Shell’s kindermarketingfestival Generation Discover 2019

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether Shell's children's festival Generation Discover, which promotes fossil-fuel-friendly energy views and allegedly misleading teaching materials, is compatible with climate goals, and what government will do to prevent such incidents and avoid officials attending. The ministers answered that the government is not involved in or responsible for the festival, that schools decide for themselves, that no public funds go to it, and that the Shell climate commitment is noted.
The central government is not involved in or responsible for Generation Discover.
De rijksoverheid is niet betrokken of verantwoordelijk voor het Generation Discover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het bericht dat het COC veel Friese scholen niet meer binnenkomt

An MP asked the ministers whether the reduction in COC guest lessons on LHBTI acceptance in Friesland, and the shift of LHBTI policy from province to municipalities, was of concern and what the government would do to keep attention on LHBTI acceptance nationwide. The minister answered that schools are free to choose how to address sexual diversity, that the government supports municipalities through the Regenboogsteden programme, and that the sexuality core objectives are being revised.
I am not aware of agreements on the transfer of LHBTI policy from provinces to municipalities.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van afspraken over de overdracht van lhbti-beleid van provincies naar gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over gastlessen van (voormalig) Shell-personeel

An MP asked the Minister of Education about Shell's guest lessons and lesson materials for schoolchildren, including child marketing, greenwashing concerns and possible climate-denialist influence from a former Shell director. The Minister acknowledged the concerns but said schools are responsible for choosing teaching materials and guest speakers, and refused to request or share Shell's lesson package with Parliament.
I do not see it as my role to request this lesson package and share it with you.
Ik zie het dan ook niet als mijn rol om dit betreffende leerpakket op te vragen en met u te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Haarendael restaureren? Technisch kán alles...maar er moet  ook geld  zijn’

The MPs asked the minister about the fire at the historic Haarendael complex, its consequences for the municipality's enforcement against neglect, measures to secure the surviving structure, and willingness to consult stakeholders. The minister confirmed the monument's historical value, said the enforcement order will be revised, described ongoing safety and conservation measures led by the municipality, and committed to involving the heritage agency in talks on the site's future.
From the municipality, the competent authority in this matter, I have learned that measures are currently being investigated to determine what is possible.
Van de gemeente, het bevoegd gezag in dezen, heb ik vernomen dat er op dit moment onderzocht wordt welke maatregelen mogelijk zijn

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over het bericht van Innovo dat iemand die eerder aan de pabo is begonnen niet voor een zijinstroomtraject in aanmerking komt

Three VVD MPs asked whether someone who started but did not finish the pabo (primary teacher training) is blocked from the zij-instroom (career-changer) teaching route, and whether the rule should be lifted. The minister answered that eligibility requires a completed higher education degree, that the person may be able to start a shortened part-time programme, and that he does not intend to change the degree requirement.
I do not intend to change the condition that a career-changer must have a higher education diploma, which appears to be the problem in this situation.
Aan de voorwaarde dat een zijinstromer een ho-diploma moet hebben, wat in deze situatie het probleem lijkt, wil ik niet tornen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat veel numerus fixus-opleidingen helemaal niet vol zitten

MP Futselaar asked the Education Minister whether numerus fixus programmes are wrongly capped, whether students' choice is restricted, and whether a similar situation exists in higher vocational education. The minister attributes empty places to students not deregistering, announces a provision letting institutions over-enrol and a ministerial prior-approval requirement for numerus fixus, and provides an overview of programmes.
I want to prevent this situation and therefore I give institutions room to counter empty places in numerus fixus programmes.
Ik wil deze situatie voorkomen en daarom bied ik instellingen de ruimte om lege plekken bij numerusfixusopleidingen tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Nijkerken- de Haan over regeldruk bij volkscultuur en het adviesrapport Vermindering regeldruk bij evenementen in Limburg

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about red tape on volkscultuur (folk culture) events, citing a Limburg province report on regulatory burdens for organisers. The minister acknowledged the pressure of regulation on folk culture and immaterieel erfgoed communities, and committed to a round table with the Ministry of Interior and the Limburg province to identify bottlenecks and draft an action plan.
I agree with you that folk culture and intangible cultural heritage inspire.
Ik ben met u eens dat volkscultuur en immaterieel erfgoed inspireren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het declaratiegedrag van de voorzitter van het College van Bestuur van de Universiteit Utrecht

An MP asked the minister about the UU board chair's 2018 domestic travel claims of EUR 124,343, the redacted trip destinations, and whether ceilings and a efficiency test should apply to board travel claims. The minister explained the chauffeur-car arrangement in his contract, said the inspectorate found no irregularities, and said current VSNU rules apply while the inspectorate will review claims in late 2019.
The inspectorate found in its investigation that the company cars and taxi rides were not used for private purposes.
De inspectie heeft in haar onderzoek geconstateerd dat de dienstauto’s en de taxiritten niet voor privédoeleinden zijn ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de kaartverkoop van de Formule-1

An SP MP asked the government about the rapid sale and resale at inflated prices of Formula 1 tickets, public funding of the event, and collusion between artists and ticket resellers. The government answered that it provides no direct financial support, points to earlier answers and to planned consumer-protection measures and a campaign, and says it is in talks about rail capacity without a decision yet.
The organisation managed to raise the necessary budget without financial support from central government.
Het is de organisatie gelukt om het benodigde budget zonder financiële steun vanuit het Rijk bij elkaar te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de faciliteiten van jongerenorganisaties

An MP asked the education, health and interior ministers about whether youth organisations deserve facilities, how youth are consulted on policy, which subsidies exist and how board grants (bestuursbeurzen) are allocated. The government answered that youth participation matters, outlined existing consultation channels and subsidies, and defended the current allocation criteria limited to higher-education-relevant organisations.
No, there is no separate overview of youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Nee, er is geen afzonderlijk overzicht van jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Ronnes over het bericht ‘Graf Jacoba van Beieren hoort op Tholen’

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet and Ronnes asked about reports that Countess Jacoba of Bavaria, buried in the Binnenhof Hofkapel, had wished for burial in Tholen, and about the planned research into historic graves and the plaque at the Binnenhof. The Minister answered that the RCE is studying whether Van Oldenbarnevelt's remains can be identified, that the plaque will not be changed but may receive attention during renovation, and that relocating Jacoba's remains is not a condition for honouring her history.
The research report will be available in September.
Het onderzoeksrapport zal in september beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het onderzoek ‘Het bindend studieadvies in het hoger onderwijs’ en de kabinetsreactie daarop

An MP asks whether the Panteia study on the binding study advice (bsa) in higher education used quantitative findings, what evidence supports claims about bsa norms and wrongly dismissed students, and whether the report is suitable for policy. The minister answers that the study was qualitative by design, that she has asked for a follow-up study with results expected in 2020, and that the report still gives a useful picture of how the bsa works.
That is correct. The study aimed to provide insight into the conditions and criteria under which the binding study advice (bsa) is applied and the factors affecting how the bsa works.

Dat klopt. Het onderzoek had tot doel inzicht te geven in de voorwaarden en criteria waaronder het bindend studieadvies (bsa) wordt uitgevoerd en de factoren die van invloed zijn op de werking van het bsa.

Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Futselaar over de coulanceregeling van de Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam met betrekking tot de in het  verleden te hoge collegegelden voor de Parttime Master Bedrijfskunde van de Rotterdam

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the Erasmus University Rotterdam's limited refund scheme for overcharged Parttime Master tuition fees adequately complies with the minister's call for compensation, and whether the law is clear enough. The minister answered that the law is clear, that the university's interpretation is incorrect, that the inspectorate found a violation, and that students can use administrative appeal routes, while stating the minister cannot force institutions to compensate.
Neither the inspectorate nor I am responsible for the content of the compensation scheme; we cannot enforce anything in that regard.
Noch de inspectie noch ik gaan over de inhoud van de compensatieregeling, we kunnen daarin niets afdwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over de grote klappen voor de werkgelegenheid in Groningen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the ministers about reported job losses in Groningen (about 180 jobs at the RUG) and healthcare access caused by the revised higher-education funding model. The minister answered that there is no forced internal reallocation, that RUG funding changes are small (0.0% in 2020-2021, -1.1% in 2022, -0.9% in 2023), that healthcare access is unaffected, and that the government is committed to Groningen's employment and liveability.
It is the responsibility of the institution's board to allocate the government contribution internally.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het bestuur van de instelling om de rijksbijdrage intern te verdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het overzicht  van de verdeling van het variabele deel van de rijksbijdrage over verschillende studenttypen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the distribution of the variable part of the state funding across student types, including the calculation of per-student amounts and the medical-study workshop budgets. The minister explained the calculation method, the workshop budget structure and accountability by the UMCs, and committed to a cost study while rejecting that medical studies' special status hinders healthcare developments.
I will carry out this cost study and in doing so I also want to pay attention to matters such as the balance between fixed and variable funding
Dit kostenonderzoek ga ik uitvoeren en daarbij wil ik ook aandacht hebben voor zaken als de balans tussen vaste en variabele bekostiging
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het integrale Capaciteitsplan 2016 hoofdrapport van het Capaciteitsorgaan

An MP asked the minister about the 2016 Capacity Plan of the Capaciteitsorgaan, the latest integral advice on medical training capacity, and how intake was set, banded advice was presented, and new developments were incorporated. The minister answered that a new integral advice is due in autumn 2019, that intake was kept at around 2,900 students for political and labour-market reasons, that institutions allocate places among themselves, that the new plan will no longer give a bandwidth, and that the Capaciteitsorgaan is an independent foundation funded by VWS.
In the new capacity plan, the Capaciteitsorgaan will no longer include a bandwidth.
In het nieuwe capaciteitsplan neemt het Capaciteitsorgaan niet langer een bandbreedte op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er woede is over de woekerhandel in kaartjes voor een voetbalwedstrijd

An SP MP asked the government about ticket scalping for the Feyenoord-Ajax match, including enforcement, a national ban, ACM action, EU initiatives, and transparency obligations for ticket resellers. The Staatssecretaris answered that a national ban would be ineffective and unenforceable, that clubs block scalped tickets under KNVB conditions, and that the government will not pursue further national rules given the cross-border nature of the problem.
I do not have the means at my disposal to map the total extent of this problem, since it is a cross-border matter.
Ik heb niet de middelen tot mijn beschikking om de totale omvang van deze problematiek in kaart te brengen, aangezien het hier gaat om een grensoverschrijdende aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat mensen hun servicekosten niet terugkrijgen als een concert wordt geannuleerd

An SP MP asked whether ticketing company Ticketmaster breaks the law by not refunding service fees when a concert is cancelled, and how consumers can enforce their rights. The State Secretary confirmed the ACM considers non-refunding unlawful, pointed to the ACM's enforcement powers, consumer complaint routes, and said ticket prices and fees are not capped by law, only subject to transparency requirements.
It is up to the ACM to judge whether companies comply with the consumer protection rules.
Het is aan de ACM om te oordelen of bedrijven zich houden aan de consumentenbeschermingsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de Groningse universiteit meer grip wil krijgen op het Koninklijk Nederlands Instituut Rome

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that the University of Groningen wants more control over the Royal Netherlands Institute in Rome, questioning its quality, national importance, the criticism of its outgoing director and the funding contributions. The Minister answered that the RUG has been responsible since 1991 under a transfer protocol, that the NWIB board oversees the institute, that quality is safeguarded by existing systems, and that funding is a lump-sum with no detailed budget oversight by the ministry.
I have no insight into the precise budget of the KNIR; its assessment I leave to the NWIB umbrella body.
Ik heb geen inzage in de precieze begroting van het KNIR, de beoordeling daarvan laat ik aan de NWIB-koepel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de Universiteit Groningen niet eerlijk is over het onderzoek naar studentpromovendi

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that the University of Groningen gave incomplete information to its works council on the PhD experiment and about allegedly improper influence on the interim evaluation, and whether the experiment should be stopped or compensation paid. The minister said the university should inform its works council fully and will include the survey in the next self-evaluation, that the interim evaluation's purpose is to detect serious harm, that CHEPS assured scientific integrity, that courts decide on employment status, and that the experiment will not be stopped but a second application round will open.
According to the RUG, the survey referred to in the Trouw article is part of an ongoing study and was therefore not included in the self-evaluation recently sent to the University Council.

Volgens de RUG maakt de enquête, waar in het artikel in Trouw naar verwezen wordt, onderdeel uit van een nog lopend onderzoek en is deze daarom niet meegenomen in de zelfevaluatie die recent naar de Universiteitsraad is gestuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Futselaar over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen naar aanleiding van bericht dat studenten lang in de wacht staan door onderbezetting en nieuw systeem

MPs Van der Molen and Futselaar asked whether extra DUO staff capacity was available for summer phone waiting times, what effect the new student finance system had on waiting times, and what the average waiting time was in 2019 and targeted for summer. The minister answered that extra funds go mainly to maintenance, that waiting times fell with extra capacity and the new system (about 20% fewer calls in early 2019), and that waiting times will likely exceed 10 minutes in weeks 34-37.
But in weeks 34 through 37 the average waiting time will probably exceed 10 minutes.
Maar in de weken 34 tot en met 37 zal de gemiddelde wachttijd waarschijnlijk wel boven de 10 minuten uitkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel schade door ‘bitcoin-advertenties’ met nepuitspraken BN’ers’

MPs from the VVD asked ministers about misleading bitcoin advertisements using fake quotes from well-known Dutch people, the scale of resulting harm, whether police, prosecutors, the AFM and social media platforms can act, and what tools exist to identify advertisers and protect consumers and the persons whose names are misused. The government answered that the advertisers are unknown, reported about 1.7 million euro in reported damage, explained existing criminal, consumer-law and civil remedies, and said crypto-assets generally fall outside AFM supervision and no new national regulation is advised.
It is not known who or which organisations commissioned the placement of these misleading advertisements.
Het is niet bekend wie of welke organisaties opdrachtgever zijn van plaatsing van deze misleidende advertenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de vervreemding van objecten behorende tot het nationaal cultureel erfgoed

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she knew that historically significant Dutch objects were offered for sale on a French antiques website, whether they should have been protected, whether the Pechtold committee would advise on already sold heritage, and what current policy is on selling nationally important heritage in private hands and on state-owned heritage. The minister confirmed awareness of the website, said the current protection policy is restrictive and doubts its adequacy, and referred to the Pechtold committee's advice due in October 2019 without committing to specific measures; she described the existing Erfgoedwet framework and rules for state, provincial and municipal heritage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Tielen en El Yassini over het bericht ‘TU Eindhoven stelt wetenschappelijke vacatures alleen open voor vrouwen’

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether TU Eindhoven opening scientific vacancies only to women is a form of discrimination contrary to the Constitution, and about the underlying figures. The Minister answered that the policy is a permissible form of preferential policy, that vacancies open to men after six months without a suitable candidate, that the Equal Treatment Commission (College voor de Rechten van de Mens) rather than the Minister would judge legality, and that the policy does not affect other forms of diversity.
It is not for me to assess whether this TU/e policy complies with all the strict rules on preferential policy.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen of dit beleid van de TU/e aan alle strenge regels rond voorkeursbeleid voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ellemeet over freelancejournalisten die onder het minimumloon werken

MPs Asscher and Ellemeet asked whether freelance journalists earning below the minimum wage, their falling per-assignment income, and calls for collective bargaining and competition-law exemptions are acceptable. The minister says fair pay is important, announces a planned statutory generic minimum rate for self-employed workers, leaves fair practice to the sector, and points to ongoing work on the Ellemeet/Asscher motion and an ACM guideline.
The cabinet therefore intends to introduce a statutory generic minimum rate so that self-employed persons can earn an income sufficient for a subsistence minimum.
Het kabinet is daarom voornemens om een wettelijk generiek minimumtarief in te voeren om zelfstandigen in staat te stellen een inkomen te verwerven waarmee in een bestaansminimum kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der  Molen  en Van den  Berg over het  bericht 'Universiteiten nemen spionagerisico voor lief'

MPs Van der Molen and Van den Berg asked the ministers whether Dutch universities are exposed to espionage and theft of research findings, whether foreign students should be excluded, and what measures will strengthen security awareness. The government says it is examining broader knowledge-security rules, outlines existing legal tools (Iran and North Korea sanctions screening), declines to give case details or figures, and points to existing platforms and agencies while deferring the outcome of ongoing reviews.
The cabinet does not make public statements about case details that affect the current knowledge level and modus operandi of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over casuïstiek die het actuele kennisniveau en de modus operandi van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Smeulders over de eerlijke betaling van kunstdocenten

MPs Ellemeet and Smeulders asked about fair pay, social security and working conditions for arts teachers, many of whom now work as self-employed freelancers, and about the state's role in arts education. The government answered that it facilitates the sector's labour market agenda and Fair Practice Code, points to planned statutory measures for self-employed workers, gives partial data on freelancers and insurance coverage, and says it will inform parliament about progress in the autumn.
I am aware that workers, and in particular self-employed workers, in the cultural sector often work under unfavourable conditions.
Ik ben me ervan bewust dat werkenden, en met name zelfstandigen, in de culturele sector vaak werken onder ongunstige voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Özdil over het bericht ‘RIVM en CBS: psychische gezondheid jongeren achteruit in afgelopen tien jaar’

MPs Bruins and Özdil asked the ministers about a RIVM/CBS report showing declining mental health among young people, and about student stress, the leenstelsel link, waiting times for student psychologists and prevention. The minister acknowledged the concern, announced a large-scale RIVM follow-up study expected by late 2020, and said the ministries will coordinate, while several questions on causes, waiting times and the leenstelsel link were answered only in outline.
I am aware of the results of the research.
Ik ben bekend met de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de situatie op het Archimedes-instituut van de Hogeschool Utrecht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about financial and governance problems at the Archimedes Institute of Hogeschool Utrecht, including unprofitable teacher training, a flexibilisation pilot, works council disputes and reliance on project subsidies. The Minister answered most questions substantively, stating the government does not fund per programme, that the works council disputes were mediated, and that she is in contact with the Hogeschool board and will address small teacher training costs in a cost study.
Whenever there is cause for it, I am always willing to enter into discussion with Hogeschool Utrecht.
Wanneer daar aanleiding toe is ben ik te allen tijde bereid in gesprek te gaan met de Hogeschool Utrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Becker over het bericht ‘Blauwe Moskee biedt podium aan radicale prediker’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether it could bar a Dutch-national hate preacher from speaking at the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, whether his hateful statements could be prosecuted or sanctioned, and how the Blue Mosque could be sanctioned for hosting him. The Minister of Justice replied that Dutch nationals cannot be excluded from the Netherlands, that the government relies on a three-track approach with municipalities, that the Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution, and that a bill to expand the ban on radical organisations is being prepared.
In general, it is not possible to exclude Dutch citizens from the Netherlands.
In het algemeen geldt dat het niet mogelijk is Nederlandse staatsburgers te weren uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het dreigende faillissement van Utrechts Centrum voor de Kunsten en gevolgen voor diens medewerkers

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the Utrecht municipality is deliberately steering the Utrecht Centre for the Arts toward bankruptcy, leaving about 200 staff without transition pay, and whether the government will act on this. The ministers answered that the municipality has the power to end subsidies, that the courts rather than the government should judge bankruptcy motives and any disguised self-employment, and that they would not intervene in the municipality's decision.

The municipality of Utrecht has the authority to end subsidies. It is not for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Education, Culture and Science to judge practical situations like this.

De gemeente Utrecht heeft de bevoegdheid subsidies te beëindigen. Het is niet aan ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap te oordelen over praktijksituaties als deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ondervoeding bij thuiswonende ouderen

An MP asked the health and education ministers about malnutrition among community-dwelling elderly and whether screening, training and GP guidance should be strengthened. The minister said prevention is shared with carers and professionals, pointed to existing tools and education modules, and declined to mandate structural screening or GP checks.
However, I will raise attention to these education modules in consultations with representatives of relevant training programmes.
Wel zal ik in overleggen met de vertegenwoordigers van relevante opleidingen aandacht vragen voor deze onderwijsmodules.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat wervingsbureaus internationale studenten naar Nederland lokken

SP MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education about reports that recruitment agencies lure international students to Dutch universities, including whether universities should pay such agencies, whether school-bridging programme quality is guaranteed, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate admissions. The Minister said universities are responsible for admissions and quality, that agency costs are not tracked, and that the Inspectorate can investigate if signals arise, without committing to a new inquiry.
The institution remains at all times responsible for admitting students, even if they were recruited by a recruitment agency.
De instelling blijft te allen tijde verantwoordelijk voor de toelating van studenten, ook als deze zijn geworven door een wervingsburau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de financiële gevolgen voor de Rijksbegroting van de ingetrokken wetswijziging van de rentemaatstaf voor de lening hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the budget consequences of withdrawing the interest-rate change for student loans, which would cost the state up to 226 million euro a year by 2060, and whether the cut would worsen education funding. The minister confirmed the lost interest income, said the treatment of the shortfall will be decided in the August budget process and reported to parliament on Budget Day, and declined to anticipate that decision.
How the lost income resulting from not changing the interest-rate benchmark will be handled is being considered in the August budget decision-making.
De wijze waarop wordt omgegaan met de gederfde inkomsten als gevolg van het niet wijzigen van de rentemaatstaf wordt in de augustusbesluitvorming bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht 'Scriptie onvoldoende? Dan ook geen beloning voor docent'

An MP asks whether history lecturers at the RUG received no teaching hours for supervising theses that were graded insufficient or not completed, and whether such schemes exist elsewhere, and calls for compensation and investigation. The minister confirms the RUG allocates hours on expected supervision rather than outcomes, reports no signals of outcome-linked allocation at other institutions, says she sees no reason to investigate further, and states the funding review response will be sent by 21 June 2019.
I see no reason to investigate this further.
Ik zie geen aanleiding dit verder te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de VS een steeds steviger abortusbeleid voert

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about reports that the US is tightening anti-abortion funding rules abroad, asking for the government's reaction, diplomatic steps, and ways to offset the effects. The minister said the government regrets the measures, has raised concerns with US officials, and points to continued SRGR funding and several parliamentary amendments being implemented.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Scholen moeten vijf keer zo hard verduurzamen als ze nu doen’

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked about reports that schools must decarbonise five times faster, the low number of energy-efficiency upgrades, the Schooldakrevolutie motion, new school-building rules, and a 2016 Court of Audit recommendation on clear national school-housing ambitions. The minister replied that climate agreement commitments, the Activiteitenbesluit energy-saving duty, the Green Deal Scholen, pilot programmes and waterside balancing studies are underway, and that a Berenschot-style housing monitor is planned for 2022.
In the draft Climate Agreement, agreements have been made to achieve CO2 reduction in the built environment.
In het ontwerpKlimaatakkoord zijn afspraken gemaakt om tot een CO 2 -reductie in de gebouwde omgeving te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Tielen over de berichten 'Bij hoogleraar B. moesten de vrouwen hakken dragen' en 'Van seksueel wangedrag tot sabotage van je onderzoek'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Education and Justice about press reports of harassment and an unsafe culture at the University of Amsterdam law faculty and academia more broadly. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that the UvA has taken steps such as external investigation, interim management, a review of confidential advisers and a planned ombudsman, while stating that a broader cultural change across academia is needed.
I will examine together with the LNVH and the VSNU which further steps can be taken.
Ik zal samen met het LNVH en de VSNU bekijken welke stappen er verder genomen kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Internationaal podium voor Nederlandse startups tijdens Academic Startup Competition'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the share of academic startups in the Netherlands compared with other countries, whether Dutch universities are competitive, and what measures are taken to promote academic startups and valorisation. The minister answered that academic startups make up about 13% of Dutch startups, cited OECD and Genome rankings, and referred to existing policy letters and funding measures, without committing to a new concrete step beyond planned valorisation meetings.
There are no unambiguous figures available on the number of academic startups and spin-offs in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen eenduidige cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal academische startups en spin-offs in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de te lange wachtlijsten in de transgenderzorg

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about long waiting lists in gender-affirming care, including Amsterdam UMC's waiting times, staffing shortages, a planned Radboud UMC youth service, and a priority scheme for trans youth. The minister acknowledged the waits are undesirable, pointed to a navigator (kwartiermaker) advisory process and capacity expansions, and left prioritisation largely to insurers and providers.
I too find the long waiting lists for gender-affirming care undesirable.
Ook ik vind de lange wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de uitzending 'Xi, Xi wat jij niet ziet' en het bericht 'Confucius Instituten voelen geen druk van Chinese zijde'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Confucius Institutes, including access to confidentiality clauses in HANBAN agreements, the independence of research chairs hosted by such institutes, academic freedom safeguards, and restrictions on Chinese students. The minister answered that the Zuyd agreement can be provided, that the RUG agreement runs to 2021, that academic freedom is safeguard by institutions under the WHW, and that a broader knowledge-security regulation is under study.
Yes. The entire cooperation agreement will be provided in this regard.
Ja. De gehele samenwerkingsovereenkomst gaat hierbij 3 .
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat hogeschool Saxion in verweer komt tegen de nieuwe financieringsplannen voor het hoger onderwijs

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Education whether the government agrees that universities of applied sciences should not be excluded from technical education funding, that Saxion loses about 4 million euros a year to the Randstad, and whether regional institutions should not be held responsible for Randstad switcher problems, and whether the Van Rijn committee's recommendations on switchers will be ignored. The Minister answered only question 1 substantively and said the policy response to the Van Rijn committee advice will be sent to parliament by 21 June 2019.
As I have previously promised, I will send my policy response to the advice of the Van Rijn committee to your House by 21 June 2019 at the latest.
Zoals ik eerder heb toegezegd zal ik uiterlijk 21 juni 2019 mijn beleidsreactie op het advies van de commissie Van Rijn aan uw Kamer sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Lodders over volkscultuur die door de Belastingdienst ongelijk wordt behandeld, als niet cultuur wordt erkend en zodoende geen gebruik kan maken van het gunstige lage btw-tarief

Two VVD MPs asked whether folk culture (parades, carnival associations, shooting guilds) is treated unequally by the Tax Authority, which allegedly does not recognise it as culture and so excludes it from the reduced 9% VAT rate. The State Secretary answers that the VAT rate depends on a closed list in Tabel I of the Wet OB, not on recognition of culture, so there is no unequal treatment and folk culture can qualify where it meets the listed activities.
As the enumeration of these items shows, there is no distinction by type of culture in applying the reduced rate.
Zoals uit de opsomming van deze posten blijkt, bestaat er bij de toepassing van het verlaagde tarief geen onderscheid in het soort cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over instellingen voor hoger onderwijs die tentamens zonder meer door laten gaan op de dag van de openbaar vervoersstaking

MP Van den Hul asks whether students can reach exams held on the public transport strike day and what the minister will do about institutions that keep exams going regardless. The minister says it is up to institutions to decide, expects them to show coulance for students in genuine overmacht, and says she expects institutions to seek individual solutions with affected students.
It is up to universities of applied sciences and universities to decide whether they continue lessons and exams in connection with the public transport strike.
Het is aan hogescholen en universiteiten om te bepalen of zij in verband met de openbaar vervoerstaking lessen en tentamens al dan niet doorgang laten vinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Özdil over het bericht ‘Cafédeur blijft dicht voor expat in Eindhoven: 'Ik ben hier nu vijf maanden en dat is lang genoeg om te weten dat ik nooit hier ga wonen'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about a report of a bar in Eindhoven refusing entry to an expat, and about discriminatory door policy in hospitality generally, including the existing legal framework, enforcement and sanctions. The minister answered that discrimination is unacceptable, cited 2017 and 2018 complaint and police incident figures, and described the legal framework, municipal tools, complaint bodies and sanctions while leaving enforcement largely to municipalities.

It is not compatible with the prohibition of discrimination and the principle of equality as enshrined in our Constitution and as further elaborated in the Criminal Code and the General Equal Treatment Act (Awgb).

Het is niet verenigbaar met het discriminatieverbod en gelijkheidsbeginsel zoals neergelegd in onze Grondwet en zoals onder meer nader uitgewerkt in het wetboek van Strafrecht en de Algemene wet gelijke behandeling (Awgb).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over nieuwe onthullingen rond het Haga Lyceum

SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether reports about a Haga Lyceum linked to radical preachers, gender segregation, and possible terror financing were true, and whether the school should be closed or its board dismissed. The minister declined to comment on substance, citing the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation and the Bibob screening, while stating that intimidation of inspectors is unacceptable and that Article 23 must not block firm intervention.
In the interest of these ongoing investigations, I cannot go into this further.
In het belang van deze lopende onderzoeken kan ik hier verder niet op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Middendorp over de bunker Seyss Inquart

MPs Aartsen and Middendorp asked why the sale and repurposing of the Seyss-Inquart bunker proceeds before the government's promised vision and action plan on WWII heritage, and how this relates to the Beckerman motion. The State Secretary replied that a Nota van Uitgangspunten is not a final sale, that no irreversible steps will be taken before 1 October 2019, and that the sale continues while the motion is implemented in that sense.

No irreversible steps are being taken in the current sale process before the Minister of Education, Culture and Science has presented the promised vision and action plan on Second World War heritage (by 1 October 2019 at the latest).

Er worden geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet in het onderhavige verkoopproces, vóórdat de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) de toegezegde visie met actieplan voor het erfgoed van de Tweede Wereldoorlog heeft gepresenteerd (uiterlijk 1 oktober 2019).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van Dam over het bericht ‘Bunker van nazikopstuk uit foute handen houden’

CDA MPs asked whether the government would halt the sale of Seyss-Inquart's former Nazi command bunker in Wassenaar, which is a rijksmonument, and whether specific conditions should apply given its wartime heritage character. The state secretary confirmed awareness and the rijksmonument status, and said a Nota van Uitgangspunten setting planning conditions and a pre-selection of qualified buyers would govern the sale, without halting it.
The outcome of close cooperation with the municipality of Wassenaar, the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is a Nota van Uitgangspunten to be drawn up.
Uitvloeisel van de nauwe samenwerking met de gemeente Wassenaar, de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed en het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf is een op te stellen Nota van Uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over een breed plan voor technisch onderwijs dat volgens ondernemersorganisatie Techniek Nederland nu nodig is

Two PvdA MPs asked the education and economic affairs ministers how they view Techniek Nederland's call for a broad technical education plan, including hybrid teachers and hybrid programmes. The minister acknowledged the need for technical skills, said youth unemployment is low, welcomed hybrid teaching in principle, referred to existing measures and the Techniekpact, and said the ministry would keep talking with industry without committing to adopt the proposals.
This cabinet therefore considers it important to support schools by improving the transitions between primary education, secondary education, secondary vocational education and higher education.

Dit kabinet vindt het dan ook van belang om scholen te ondersteunen door het verbeteren van de overgangen tussen primair onderwijs, voortgezet onderwijs, middelbaar beroepsonderwijs en hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over het artikel ‘Vrouwen kunnen niet autorijden en dit is waarom’

An MP asked the government about gender data gaps in policy and products, following a column on women and driving, including whether gender effects are assessed in legislation and the Digital Government Act. The minister answered that a new gender-equality effects test was added to the policy framework, that diverse teams are desirable though not a government matter for product design, and that a further gender check on the Digital Government Act is not considered necessary.
To take account of the effects on gender equality in policy and legislation, I have had a new 'gender equality effects' test added to the Integral Policy and Regulation Assessment Framework.

Om bij beleid en wet-of regelgeving rekening te houden met de effecten op gendergelijkheid, heb ik in het Integraal Afwegingskader voor beleid en regelgeving (IAK) een nieuwe toets «effecten op gendergelijkheid» laten opnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Zorgen over Buma State Leeuwarden nemen toe’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the deteriorating former farmhouse Buma State in Leeuwarden, its sale to Van der Valk, unresolved permit applications for renovation and demolition-rebuild, and how monument protection rules interact with ecological checks. The minister answered that the building is a municipal monument so the state has no advisory role, that the municipality handles the permit process which was delayed by ecological requirements under the Nature Protection Act, and that the Omgevingswet is expected to streamline procedures.
This concerns a municipal monument, so the national government has no involvement in the advisory process.
Het betreft hier een gemeentelijk monument, waardoor het rijk geen betrokkenheid heeft in de advisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Kuik en Peters over het bericht 'Schuldhulpverlening lastig voor studenten met schulden'

MPs from the CDA asked the Minister of Education and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the rising number of young people, including students, seeking debt assistance, and about municipal measures, study-stopping rules, DUO paying tuition directly, and a warning banner on DUO's website. The government gave partial answers: it had no exact figures, supported initiatives and dialogue with municipalities, declined the banner and direct tuition payment for now, and pointed to ongoing experiments and measures.
We cannot give you exact numbers and percentages.
We kunnen u geen exacte aantallen en procenten geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de uitzending van BOOS over het feit dat mbo-studenten zakken op keuzedelen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a BOOS broadcast reporting that mbo students were failing elective modules (keuzedelen), whether other institutions had reported similar problems, whether a student can fail on a grade or only be given no grade, how future failures will be prevented, and how rules will be communicated. The Minister said the broadcast underlines the need for clear communication, that results for keuzedelen do not yet count toward diplomas for current students but will from 2020/2021, that schools set the exam format, and that schools are responsible for informing students.
Since the introduction of the keuzedelen, clear communication on this has been pursued.
Vanaf de inwerkingtreding van de keuzedelen is ingezet op duidelijke communicatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht dat kleine gemeenten met erfgoed hulp nodig hebben

MPs Beckerman and Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she shares the Raad voor Cultuur's view that small municipalities need more help protecting their heritage, and whether she will provide more money and options and coordinate with provinces and the Interior Minister. The Minister agreed in principle, describing existing support (Erfgoedacademie, RCE advice, provincial heritage hubs, Erfgoeddeal) and promised a written response to the Raad's advice in May.
I will respond in writing to your House's request regarding the advice of the Raad voor Cultuur, in which I will go further into how I support municipalities.
Ik kom op het verzoek van uw Kamer met een schriftelijke reactie op het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur, waarin ik nader in zal gaan op de wijze waarop ik gemeenten ondersteun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat de maatschappelijke urgentie van de problematiek van laaggeletterdheid is zo hoog dat er geen tijd te verliezen is

An MP asks the Minister of Education about an SER advisory report calling low literacy urgent, and whether the government's extra funding is sufficient, including whether the additional 2 million for digital skills is genuinely new money. The Minister replies that about 7 million per year extra is earmarked for low literacy, that there is no separate digital skills budget, and that she will agree further steps with municipalities this summer while not doubling the budget as the SER recommends.
I therefore do not share the SER's conclusion that there is too little direction at national level.
Ik deel dan ook niet de conclusie van de SER dat er te weinig regie zou zijn op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over de mogelijke selectiviteit van de NOS

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the public broadcaster NOS's reporting on Trump and Russia, and its failure to apologise for it, complies with the Mediawet's quality and impartiality requirements. The minister confirmed the facts but said journalistic content and decisions on corrections or apologies are the broadcaster's own responsibility under sector self-regulation, with supervision left to designated regulators.

The journalistic content and quality of reporting, and the decision whether to issue corrections and/or apologies, is the broadcaster's autonomous responsibility and subject to the journalistic norms the sector has set through self-regulation.

De journalistieke inhoud en kwaliteit van berichtgeving en de afweging om tot correctie en/of het aanbieden van excuses over te gaan, is de autonome verantwoordelijkheid van de omroep en onderworpen aan de journalistieke normen die de sector bij wijze van zelfregulering heeft bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher inzake bibliotheken die met sluiting worden bedreigd

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about around 30 public libraries threatened with closure due to rising care costs, and whether the government would act on the motion on small-community libraries. The minister agreed libraries are a basic facility, said municipalities are responsible for local library provision, described the selection process for the stimulation subsidy, and said the Wsob evaluation will map the network later this year.
In line with the administrative relations under the Wsob, municipalities are responsible for local library provision.
Conform de bestuurlijke verhoudingen uit de Wsob zijn gemeenten verantwoordelijk voor de lokale bibliotheekvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Van Ojik en Diks over het bericht dat Brunei extreme straffen invoert, onder meer de doodstraf voor homoseksuele handelingen

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the foreign and education ministers about Brunei's introduction of harsh Sharia penalties, including the death penalty for same-sex acts, and whether the Netherlands would cut arms trade, summon the ambassador, or take other action. The minister answered that the government strongly opposes the measures, has publicly and diplomatically objected via the EU, the Equal Rights Coalition and the Foreign Affairs Council, and that arms exports are screened for human-rights risk, with no export moratorium deemed necessary at present.
For this reason, the cabinet currently does not consider it necessary to announce a moratorium on the export of strategic goods to Brunei.
Om die reden acht het kabinet het op dit moment niet noodzakelijk om een moratorium af te kondigen op de export van strategische goederen naar Brunei.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog, Omtzigt, Bisschop en Stoffer over extra belastingdruk voor scholen die het lerarentekort proberen op te vangen middels een RTC

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Education whether Dutch VAT rules penalise school boards that match teachers through regional transfer centres (RTCs) and whether the cooperation exemption applies. The government answered that matching is a different service from supplying staff, that the Tax Authority considers RTC matching outside the cooperation exemption, and that it will consult the PO-raad and RTC network on ways to avoid additional VAT burdens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het bericht ‘COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert’

MPs Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked whether the Netherlands can refuse entry to US preacher Steven Anderson and prosecute or prevent his hate speech, and whether the government will act. The State Secretary answered that entry can be refused under Schengen rules and extremist speakers can be barred under existing instruments, that Dutch criminal law cannot prosecute speech made abroad, and that contact with the municipality exists, while declining to comment on other countries' decisions.
I cannot provide information about possible refusals of entry by other countries.
Over eventuele toegangsweigeringen van andere landen kan ik geen informatie geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat COC wil dat Nederland Amerikaanse haatprediker weert

VVD MPs Azmani and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked whether the US preacher Steve Anderson, who has made hateful statements about LGBT people, could be barred from the Netherlands, whether Dutch authorities could prevent his public appearances, and whether the EU could jointly blacklist such preachers. The government referred the core questions to earlier answers, said the EU partner states had been informed at official level, and said it will keep raising the issue in the EU ministers' group on extremist speakers.
I refer you for these questions to the answers to the questions from MPs Van den Hul, Kuiken and Ploumen (PvdA) on refusing a hate preacher entry to the Netherlands.
Ik verwijs u voor deze vragen naar de beantwoording van de vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Kuiken en Ploumen (PvdA) over de toegang weigeren van een haatprediker tot Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Tielen, Beertema en Bisschop inzake het experiment promotieonderwijs

MPs asked why no new application round was opened for the PhD education experiment, whether the experiment is being used improperly, and how it will be evaluated. The minister answered that no new round was opened because no other universities showed interest, that the evaluation is planned for 2021 with an interim review after three years, and that the number of participants and data gaps are acknowledged.
I am not terminating the experiment either in whole or in part.
Ik beëindig het experiment geheel noch gedeeltelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het rapport ‘Mogelijkheden stopzetten studentenreisproduct’ (2017) en het niet automatisch stopzetten van de OV-studentenkaart

An MP asked the education minister why the student OV travel product was not stopped automatically via account based ticketing despite a 2017 report, and why operators earlier claimed this was technically impossible. The minister answered that ABT was rejected mainly because at the time it was technically impossible to stop all student products that way, that blacklist capacity was expanded and new communication measures introduced, and gave boete totals for 2017 and 2018.
The main reason for not choosing ABT as the solution for stopping the student travel product was that at that time it was technically not possible to stop all student travel products via ABT.

De belangrijkste reden om niet voor ABT te kiezen als oplossingsrichting voor het stopzetten van het studentenreisproduct was dat het op dat moment technisch niet mogelijk was om via ABT alle studentenreisproducten stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht 'Opnieuw geschiedvervalsing in Nederlands schoolboek'

PVV MPs asked why a VMBO textbook allegedly omits Jewish history of Jerusalem and the Middle East and wanted the government to ensure historically accurate teaching. The minister replied that the content of teaching materials is for schools to assess under freedom of education, pointing to school complaint and participation routes and criminal law limits.

As I and my predecessors have already indicated to your House in many earlier written questions on this subject, it is not for the cabinet to assess the content of teaching materials, but for schools.

Zoals ik en mijn voorgangers aan uw Kamer in vele eerdere schriftelijke vragen hierover ook al hebben aangegeven, is het niet aan het kabinet om de inhoud van leermiddelen te beoordelen, maar aan scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen inzake ‘Hogescholen stoppen met nationale studentenenquête’

An MP asked the education minister about the Vereniging Hogescholen decision to stop the national student survey (NSE) over privacy-related data problems, and the coding issues. The minister said the NSE is important, that GDPR-related errors make the 2019 data unfit for publication, that she is awaiting an independent CBS study and will inform parliament before summer, and that she is exploring a legal basis for more data delivery.
On the outcomes of the CBS study in relation to the NSE 2019 data, I will inform your House by letter before the summer.
Over de uitkomsten van het CBS-onderzoek in relatie tot de gegevens uit de NSE 2019 zal ik uw Kamer informeren middels een brief voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de werkdruk aan de universiteit nog verder opgelopen is

The SP MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that workload at universities has risen further, with high stress, insecure temporary contracts and the causes of workload. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to planned sector-level measures, a forthcoming advisory report on funding and a review of accountability rules, but rejects calls for an additional investment of 1.15 billion euro.
For additional investments on top of these already substantial investments, I currently see no room.
Voor extra investeringen bovenop deze al forse investeringen zie ik op dit moment geen ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Hogeschool Utrecht het stakingsrecht ondermijnt

An MP asked the ministers whether Hogeschool Utrecht undermines the right to strike by having lessons during strikes covered by other staff, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister confirmed the right to strike is protected under the European Social Charter, said disputes are for the employer, staff and courts to resolve, and that the ministry has only raised the matter with the institution.
I explicitly brought the AOB article to the attention of Hogeschool Utrecht, but I play no role in this conflict.
Ik heb het artikel van de AOB nadrukkelijk onder de aandacht van de Hogeschool Utrecht gebracht, maar ik speel geen rol in dit conflict.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat lokale poppodia dreigen te verdwijnen

MP Kwint asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she recognises that local pop venues are at risk of closing and whether she will map the adequacy of pop infrastructure, talk with municipalities and provinces, and step in to save venues. The minister acknowledged the importance of local venues, pointed to existing investment schemes and a 2017 study, and said cultural policy responsibility is shared with subnational governments and that she has asked the Raad voor Cultuur for advice, with a policy letter to follow.
I am now awaiting the advice of the Raad voor Cultuur.
Ik ben nu in afwachting van het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat 20 procent van de startende docenten in het mbo na één jaar uitstroomt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that 20 percent of new vocational (mbo) teachers leave after one year, and whether this is worrying, what causes it, and what will be done about support for new teachers. The minister called the outflow worrying, pointed to cao agreements on supporting new teachers, said she cannot identify causes from available research but will explore including an analysis of outflow causes in the 2019 career survey.
I will explore whether an analysis of the causes of outflow can also be included in this.
Ik zal verkennen of hierin ook een analyse naar de oorzaken van uitstroom opgenomen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Rudmer Heerema en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘ADO supporters bekladden Amsterdam’

MPs from the VVD asked the government about reports that ADO Den Haag supporters defaced Amsterdam monuments, including the Dokwerker, with anti-Jewish slogans, asking about arrests, club responsibility, and nationwide stadium bans. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that a complaint is under review by the Public Prosecution Service, that the KNVB and clubs can impose stadium bans as a private-law measure, and that he will discuss antisemitism in football with the KNVB.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot make further statements about the investigation.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik verder geen uitspraken doen over het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma en Van Weyenberg over vrouwelijke ondernemers

D66 MPs asked why so few start-ups led by women receive investment, whether women face harder access to credit, and what government will do about it. The ministers answered that the gap is a real underuse of talent, that causes include bias and stereotypes, that no data yet exist on credit applications by women, and that they will commission research, host a roundtable follow-up and seek SER advice on diversity.
We will consider how and within what timeframe such research will take place.
We zullen bezien op welke wijze en welke termijn een dergelijk onderzoek plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht ‘Ritalin is populair op het schoolplein. Kan dat kwaad?’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Education whether non-medical use of Ritalin among pupils and students is problematic, how such use is obtained and combated, and whether more research on effects on school performance is needed. The minister answered that non-medical use is illegal and unacceptable, that enforcement and public information efforts exist, that research on school-performance effects is limited, and that the government will examine further research needs.
I will examine in the coming period whether, and if so what, further scientific knowledge is needed.
Ik zal in de komende periode onderzoeken of en zo ja, aan welke wetenschappelijke kennis er nog meer behoefte is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de verschillen in onderzoekstijd tussen vrouwelijke en mannelijke wetenschappers met kinderen

An MP asked the minister whether small gender gaps in research time and resources for academics with children, and a 3 percent lower chance of a private office for women, are a concern for representativeness in Dutch science and whether further research is needed. The minister shares the concern, points to planned actions such as a national action plan and a new approach to valuing academics, and says the existing LNVH study is sufficient without further research.
I do not consider further research necessary at this time.
Ik acht verder onderzoek op dit moment niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Van der Molen over Confuciusinstituten in Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked whether Confucius Institutes in Dutch higher education, their secret contracts, influence on schools and Chinese-perspective teaching materials conflict with Dutch academic integrity and democratic values. The minister answered that institutions are autonomous, that the Leiden institute will not renew its agreement, that contracts are generally not confidential except where a partner has weighty reasons, and that schools and the inspectorate are responsible for teaching content.
The starting point is that agreements which the institutions conclude with third parties are not confidential.
Uitgangspunt is dat overeenkomsten die de betrokken instellingen sluiten met derden niet vertrouwelijk zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over honderden miljoenen die volgens de SER Overijssel nodig zouden zijn om de klappen van de veranderende arbeidsmarkt voor mbo’ers op te vangen

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the ministers whether SER Overijssel's claims about job losses from digitalisation and the hundreds of millions needed to retrain mbo graduates are accurate. Minister Van Engelshoven answered that jobs both disappear and emerge, cannot confirm the 230 million euro estimate, and pointed to joint government-business efforts and a forthcoming Leven Lang Ontwikkelen letter.
The amount of 230 million euro that is mentioned is an estimate that I cannot confirm.
Het bedrag van 230 miljoen euro dat wordt genoemd is een schatting die ik niet kan bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het overhevelen van 150 miljoen euro van geesteswetenschappen naar technische universiteiten

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Van Rijn committee will advise moving 150 million euro from humanities to technical universities, and about the impact on staff workload and education quality. The minister answers that the committee's advice has not yet been received, a decision will follow by 21 June, the budget must stay neutral under the coalition agreement, and humanities are essential.
After receiving the committee's advice, I will decide which changes to the funding system will be implemented.
Na ontvangst van het advies van de commissie zal ik besluiten welke wijzigingen in de bekostigingssystematiek worden doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat artiesten niet welkom zijn in Nederland

MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked whether artists refused entry to the Netherlands should be allowed to visit more easily, and whether detention of artists on unclear grounds is acceptable. The minister replied that refusals follow EU Schengen rules, that cultural exchange is valued, and that existing facilitation schemes such as Orange Carpet apply, with each visa application still assessed individually.
A decision to refuse entry and place persons in custody is always a decision surrounded by safeguards and reasoned on the basis of national, international and European legal obligations.

Een besluit om de toegang te weigeren en personen in bewaring te plaatsen is altijd op grond van de (inter)nationale en Europese juridische verplichtingen een met waarborgen omkleed en gemotiveerd besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Aantal buitenlandse tandartsen in Nederland neemt fors toe’

An SP MP asked the Health and Education ministers about reports that foreign dentists are increasingly working in the Netherlands, and whether enough Dutch dentists are being trained. The minister answered that about 14% of registered dentists have a non-Dutch nationality, roughly doubling since 2009, that the government does not actively recruit abroad, and that the cost of expanding training places will be reported in the Voorjaarsnota.

The Minister of OCW and I will inform the House with the Voorjaarsnota about the costs of following the advice of the Capacity Body on the required number of training places in Dentistry and Oral Health Sciences.

De Minister van OCW en ik zullen de Kamer bij Voorjaarsnota informeren over wat de kosten zijn van het opvolgen van het advies van het Capaciteitsorgaan over het benodigde aantal opleidingsplaatsen Tandheelkunde en Mondzorgkunde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van der Molen over het bericht dat internationalisering Saxion moet redden voor krimp

MPs Futselaar and Van der Molen asked whether Saxion's shift to English-taught programmes to offset enrolment decline is lawful and justified, and about teacher quality, staff consultation and German-language programmes. The minister said English teaching should not be driven by finance, announced a bill to modernise the WHW language rules, judged Saxion's language code compliant, and reported no signals of insufficient teacher quality.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Becker en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Universiteit Utrecht is te wit'

MPs from the VVD asked whether Utrecht University's diversity policy is compatible with rule-of-law values after reports that men and women were seated separately at a student society lecture, and whether the university has rules to exclude events conflicting with those values. The minister answered that the society said seating was free, that gender equality is a core value, that the university's Code of Conduct prohibits discrimination and forced segregation, and that she sees no reason for further action.
Utrecht University has a Code of Conduct that describes the values guiding work and study at the university.
De Universiteit Utrecht heeft een Code of Conduct die de waarden beschrijft die richting geven aan het werken en studeren aan de universiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over de inmenging van Shell in inhoudelijke exposities van Rijksmuseum Boerhaave

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether Shell's partnership with Rijksmuseum Boerhaave, including a Shell board member's role in an exhibition and Shell's links to the museum's supervisory board, compromises the museum's independence and whether the government will end it. The minister rejected the criticism, stating the partnership targets talent development, that the museum keeps editorial control under the Ethical Code, and that governance rules are followed; she refused to end the partnership.
Article 1.10 of that code requires museums, regardless of their source of income, to at all times retain control over the content and integrity of their programmes, exhibitions and activities.

Artikel 1.10. van die code schrijft voor dat musea, ongeacht de bron van inkomsten, te allen tijde controle houden over de inhoud en integriteit van hun programma's, tentoonstellingen en activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de wetenschapsvisie van de minister ‘Nieuwsgierig en betrokken - de waarde van wetenschap’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why the science vision gave only two sentences to the adopted Özdil motion on safeguarding researchers' academic freedom under the embedding guarantee, whether the motion would be implemented, and whether embedding guarantees should be independently reviewed. The minister answered that NWO is evaluating the embedding guarantee within the ongoing VIDI round, will monitor independence and take measures if needed, and that universities decide who receives a guarantee without mandating independent review.
The scientific freedom and independence of researchers in the VI must remain guaranteed, including with an embedding guarantee.
De wetenschappelijke vrijheid en onafhankelijkheid van onderzoekers in de VI moet gewaarborgd blijven, ook met een inbeddingsgarantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Nederlands diploma te koop op Hogeschool in Qatar’

An MP asked the education minister about reports that Dutch diplomas were being sold at a university of applied sciences in Qatar, including what the government knew, what enhanced supervision after 2012 involved, and whether it had acted on expanding Qatar programmes. The minister answered that the ministry knew of 2012-2014 remedial agreements, that the inspectorate began a new inquiry after a 2018 signal, and that she will await the inspectorate's report before deciding whether to take measures.
I want to await the inspectorate's report and, on that basis, assess whether there is reason to take measures.
Ik wil het rapport van de inspectie afwachten en op basis daarvan beoordelen of er reden is om maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat je op de vestiging in Qatar zo een Nederlands diploma krijgt

An MP asked the Minister of Education about press reports that students at NHL Stenden's Qatar campus receive a Dutch diploma without adequate quality assurance, and about inspection oversight of such foreign branches. The minister said she is awaiting the Inspectorate's ongoing investigation before responding on substance, describes the inspection's past oversight and the accreditation rules for foreign branches, and reports no other known cases.
I am awaiting the outcomes of this investigation before responding substantively to the case.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek af voordat ik inhoudelijk reageer op de casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Özdil over de berichtgeving over de Qatarese vestiging van NHL Stenden

MPs Tielen and Özdil asked the Minister of Education about press reports on NHL Stenden's Qatar campus, including an Inspectorate investigation running since October 2018, and whether foreign branch quality and diploma integrity are adequately safeguarded. The Minister said the Inspectorate's report is expected around June and will be sent to parliament, that existing quality safeguards (NVAO accreditation, examination board decisions) apply, and that she will review rules if the investigation warrants it.
I undertake to send this investigation to your House, including my response.
Ik zeg u toe dit onderzoek naar uw Kamer te zullen sturen inclusief mijn reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat ‘je op een vestiging van NHL Stenden Hogeschool in Qatar zo een Nederlands diploma krijgt’

An MP (PVV) asks whether Dutch public funds may flow to NHL Stenden's Qatar campus, whether such foreign campuses should be banned, and whether accreditation should be withdrawn pending an inspectorate investigation. The minister says public funds should not be used abroad, defends foreign campuses under conditions, and declines to act or comment on the board's conduct until the inspectorate's investigation concludes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over promovendi

An MP asks the Minister of Education about the childcare allowance eligibility and legal status of international fellowship PhD candidates, after a court ruling and reports of large repayment claims. The Minister says fellowship PhDs are generally not employees, eligibility depends on the actual relationship with the university and can be pre-checked with the Tax Authority, and promises to publish extra information and map PhD categories.
Fellowship PhD candidates are likewise not employees.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Aartsen en Laan-Geselschap over het kraken van het Fort bij Velsen in de gemeente Beverwijk door oud-ADM-krakers

VVD MPs asked whether the government will act against squatters who occupied the listed Fort bij Velsen, whether the owner filed a complaint, and whether monumental buildings should get priority for eviction and damage recovery. Minister Grapperhaus said squatting is illegal, the owner filed a report, a court allowed eviction, and no change to prosecutorial priorities for monuments is planned, while withholding details on individual cases.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

MP Ouwehand asked the government whether it would promote the Week without Meat among the public and its staff, whether its ministry was involved in the initiative, and how external costs of meat production should be reflected in prices. The government replied only by referring to earlier answers published in an appendix to the parliamentary proceedings, without addressing the substance of the questions.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03354, on a week without meat, have been answered by way of Appendix to the Proceedings, session 2018–2019, no. 1896.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03354 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat ruim 3.200 Belgische wetenschappers en academici de klimaatstakers groot gelijk geven

Van Raan (PvdD) asked whether Dutch climate policy has caused public concern, whether the government endorses the Scientists4Climate call for stronger climate ambition, and whether it will strengthen its own targets. Minister Wiebes answered that the government shares the concern, meets Youth for Climate, supports the call for structural measures, and sees no need to raise Dutch targets since its own goals already exceed those proposed.
No, that is not necessary, because the Scientists4Climate movement sets lower targets for 2030 and 2050 than the cabinet.
Nee, dat is niet nodig, want de beweging Scientists4Climate hanteert lagere doelen voor 2030 en 2050 dan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Kwint over het bericht ‘Archeologie bij gemeenten ondergeschoven kindje’

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how to respond to a report that municipal archaeological oversight falls short, citing monitor figures on policy currency, staffing, inter-municipal cooperation, finds reporting and enforcement. The minister disputes the report's conclusion, argues the figures do not necessarily mean poor practice, points to ongoing instruments and projects with the heritage agency, and sees no need for an action plan.
I see no reason for an action plan.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een actieplan.
