Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil inzake het bericht ‘Overhaaste studiekeuze in het mbo door numerus fixus’

An MP (Özdil, GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education whether it is undesirable that numerus fixus rules at vocational colleges (mbo) force rushed study choices, whether a national overview and complaint facilities for students are needed, and what is done about unclear enrolment dates. The minister answered that first-come-first-served allocation is lawful under the 2017 mbo admission law, that the first evaluation of the law is due in 2019 and may lead to a national overview, and that schools must communicate enrolment dates better, while pointing to existing complaint committees and an upcoming letter on student legal protection.
Before summer 2019 the first report of the evaluation monitor of the mbo early enrolment date and admission right law will become available.
Voor de zomer van 2019 komt de eerste rapportage beschikbaar van de evaluatiemonitor van de Wet Vroegtijdige aanmelddatum voor en toelatingsrecht tot het mbo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat een te snelle keus voor mbo dreigt

An SP MP asked the Education Minister whether she would inventory mbo programmes with enrolment caps, and whether such caps could force pupils into premature study choices and harm access and equal opportunity. The minister replied that schools may cap places for labour-market or capacity reasons, that early enrolment is not a definitive choice, and that she will monitor and critically examine capped programmes with high labour-market demand, without committing to a full inventory.
Based on the monitoring information, I will critically examine vocational programmes with a numerus fixus and high labour-market demand.
Op basis van de monitoringinformatie zal ik kritisch kijken naar beroepsopleidingen met een fixus en een grote arbeidsmarktbehoefte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik inzake het bericht ‘te snelle keus dreigt door beperkte plekken’

An MP asked the education minister about rising numerus fixus admissions limits in vocational (mbo) courses and the risks of first-come-first-served selection. The minister said the monitor will report before summer 2019, that the government does not yet know which institutions have limits or why, and that no new notification duty is planned until the monitor's results are known.
We currently do not know which institutions have introduced a numerus fixus for which courses, and for what reason.
We weten op dit moment niet welke instellingen voor welke opleidingen met welke reden een fixus hebben ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het EenVandaag-onderzoek: ‘Mbo-studenten willen graag een titel’

An MP asked the education minister why she dismissed an EenVandaag poll showing 63% of MBO students want a title for graduates, and whether she had consulted students. The minister said she had aligned her reaction with the JOB student organisation, acknowledged the new signal, and promised further talks with JOB while cautioning that a title needs recognition by employers.
I will discuss this further with the JOB.
Ik zal hierover met de JOB nader overleg voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Van den Hul, Krol en Özütok over de Nederlandse versie van de Nashville-verklaring

MPs from several parties asked the government about the Dutch version of the Nashville Statement, its signing by a military chaplain and MPs, the Vrije Universiteit's response, effects on LGBTI youth, and biblical passages. The minister distanced the government from the statement, said courts and prosecutors will decide on complaints, and declined to comment on biblical interpretation or engage signatories.
As long as these matters are under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service and/or the court, it is not appropriate for the cabinet to make statements about them.
Zolang deze zaken ter beoordeling liggen bij het OM en/of de rechter ligt het niet in de rede dat het kabinet daarover uitspraken doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het ‘Voorlopig advies Capaciteitsorgaan tandartsen en mondhygiënisten’

An MP asks the ministers how they respond to the Capacity Body's provisional advice to raise annual dentist training intake to 311 students, and whether they will adopt it. The minister replies that the full analysis is still pending later in 2019 and that the costs of implementing the advice will be reported in the spring budget memorandum, without yet committing to the increase.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Egyptische ambassade het Couperushuis in Den Haag in verval laat

MPs Aartsen and Koopmans asked whether foreign embassies in The Hague are letting monumental buildings, including the Egyptian embassy at the Couperushuis, fall into disrepair, and what can be done given diplomatic inviolability. The minister answered that the municipality supervises upkeep, that the ministry escalates via diplomatic channels and recall as a last resort, that the Egyptian embassy has explained its steps and trust in a positive outcome has grown, and that four embassies are still under discussion.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not supervise maintenance, but addresses embassies at the municipality's request.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt geen toezicht op het onderhoud, maar spreekt op verzoek van de gemeente ambassades aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten die geld lenen voor hun studie meer last hebben van psychische problemen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the student loan system contributes to performance pressure and mental health problems among students, and whether the government will act. The minister answers that multiple factors cause mental pressure, that RIVM research is ongoing, that the social repayment conditions protect students, and that DUO will run an experiment on loan behaviour.
I am waiting for the outcomes of the RIVM research now.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van het RIVM-onderzoek nu af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

MPs Belhaj and Sneller asked whether the state bought royal art and heritage objects since the 1980s, whether a list of purchases can be published, and why public access is limited. The minister answered that only palace-bound inventory was bought and placed with the Royal Household, that private owners decide on disclosure and sales, and that some palaces are partly open to the public.
Regarding openness and transparency for art held in private ownership, I note that it is up to the private owner to decide whether and how insight is given.
Wat betreft openbaarheid en transparantie bij kunstbezit in privé eigendom merk ik op dat het aan de particuliere eigenaar is om te bepalen of, en op welke wijze, inzicht wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Je hoopt natuurlijk dat dit in Nederland blijft’ en de bescherming van cultuurgoederen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether privately owned artworks not on the protected cultural goods register can be freely sold, why a Rubens drawing was not registered, and what criteria and motivation apply. The minister confirmed the legal framework, said a cautious designation policy applies, that motivations can be requested from the Erfgoedinspectie, and that a temporary committee will advise on strengthening the instruments of the Erfgoedwet.
In preparation for the general evaluation of the Heritage Act, I intend to establish a temporary committee to advise me
In het kader van de voorbereiding van de algemene evaluatie van de Erfgoedwet ben ik voornemens om een tijdelijke commissie in te stellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het diversiteitsbeleid bij de Universiteit Utrecht

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a reported Utrecht University diversity plan, including prayer rooms with separate entrances and Islamic holiday calendars, and whether such measures serve education quality. The minister answered that diversity and inclusion are the institution's own responsibility, that the university has no plans for separate entrances or a changed calendar, and that equal admission chances matter.
However, it is up to the institutions themselves to determine how they pay attention to this and which measures they take in this area.
Het is echter aan de instellingen zelf om te bepalen hoe zij hier aandacht aan besteden en welke maatregelen zij op dit gebied nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller over het bericht ‘Oranjes verkochten in stilte kunst aan Rijk’

Two D66 MPs asked whether a Rubens drawing and other artworks sold by princess Christina at Sotheby's had ever belonged to a Orange foundation, and if so how they moved to private ownership. The minister answered simply that they had not.
No, that is not the case.
Nee, dat is niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de berichten "Nederland gaat gewetensvol om met roofkunst" en "Twijfel over teruggave is verwerpelijk"

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the restitution of Nazi-looted art and the balancing of emotional interests and museum interests in the Restitutions Committee's advice. The minister answered that the ample reasonableness-and-fairness framework is consistent with the Washington Principles, that victims' interests should come first, and that restitution is advised when rightful ownership and looting are clearly established.
In 2020 the policy will be evaluated again.
In 2020 wordt het beleid weer geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Universiteiten groeien harder dan verwacht’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Education about reports that university and higher vocational enrolment exceeded ministry forecasts, causing budget shortfalls, and about separate forecasting and a reception desk for international students. The Minister confirmed the overruns, said the 2019 budget impact will appear in a supplementary budget, defended the forecasting method as accurate, and promised a separate breakdown of international students in the next reference forecast and talks on a central application desk.
Forecasting international students has our attention and is being discussed with the Advisory Group on Pupil and Student Forecasts (ALS).
Het ramen van internationale studenten heeft onze aandacht en wordt besproken met de Adviesgroep Leerlingen- en Studentenramingen (ALS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Van der Molen over het niet toestaan van een nieuwe aanvraagronde voor het experiment promotieonderwijs

MPs Tielen and Van der Molen asked why the interim evaluation of the PhD education experiment is late and why no new application round was opened. The minister replied that the evaluation started in January 2019 with a report due by April 2019, that no other universities showed interest, and that a new round would not automatically increase PhD numbers.
The report of the research is due by April 2019 at the latest.
Het rapport van het onderzoek uiterlijk april 2019 oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Bruins Slot over het bericht ‘Behoud gebouwen schietbanen Leusderheide’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether it values the former Leusderheide shooting-range buildings as cultural-historical military heritage and what Defence and the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf are doing to preserve them. The minister replied that no specific reuse or demolition plans exist, the buildings are in the maintenance programme, and a final position will follow a broader heritage vision and action plan.

Based on the coherent vision and action plan for management, preservation, research and public presentation of Second World War heritage and archaeology that I promised you, I will determine my position.

Op basis van de samenhangende visie en het actieplan voor beheer, behoud, onderzoek en aan een breed publiek tonen van erfgoed en archeologie uit de Tweede Wereldoorlog dat ik u heb toegezegd, zal ik mijn standpunt bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de effecten van decentrale selectie op de samenstelling van studentenpopulaties bij universitaire opleidingen

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she assesses the ResearchNed findings that decentralised selection in university programmes produces less diverse, more homogeneous student populations that disadvantage students with non-Western backgrounds and from lower socioeconomic groups, and what she will do about it. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says she will review the instrument in the Strategic Agenda due end 2019, consult institutions and students, and keep monitoring its effects.
If decentralised selection leads to a less diverse composition of the student population, then I believe the instrument must be critically examined.
Als decentrale selectie tot een minder diverse samenstelling van de studentenpopulatie leidt, dan vind ik dat het instrument kritisch moet worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok inzake de recente cijfers over de ongelijkheid tussen mannen en vrouwen wereldwijd

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about recent global gender inequality figures, including the WEF Gender Gap Index, labour participation, women in top positions, and the effects of automation. The minister answered that the government is pursuing emancipation measures (parental leave, childcare allowance, IBO on part-time work, quotas enforcement review in spring 2019) but these are policy commitments rather than checks on the executive.
Yes, I attach great importance to that.
Ja, daar hecht ik groot belang aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over veel lhbt-leerlingen die het volgens de Amerikaanse Columbia University nog altijd zwaar hebben op Nederlandse middelbare scholen

An MP asked the education ministers about the Columbia University survey finding that many LGBT pupils in Dutch secondary schools suffer negative remarks and inadequate teacher responses, and whether all schools should mandatorily address LGBT topics in lessons and anti-bullying programmes. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing GSA support and curriculum revisions, and promised to raise the issue with school leaders and teacher training, without committing to new mandatory rules.
That is why I would like to call on school leaders to sit down with teachers to discuss this.
Daarom zou ik schoolleiders op willen roepen om samen met docenten om tafel te gaan om hierover te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Bowi van #SorryJohan doet stap terug: 'Je krijgt veel stront over je heen'

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about threats against the initiator of the #SorryJohan campaign and how to promote LHBT acceptance in sport and football, and asked her to work with the Justice Minister on tracing the threateners. The minister condemned all threats, pointed to the Alliantie Gelijkspelen, Sportakkoord and KNVB cooperation, and declined to comment on individual investigations.
On individual cases of threats and investigations by the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot make any statements.
Over individuele gevallen van bedreiging en onderzoeken door het Openbaar Ministerie, kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het beschikbare lesmateriaal over het conflict tussen Israël en de Palestijnen

An MP asks whether CIDI's Israel-Palestine teaching materials and university course are biased and whether the government should stop their influence in education. The minister answers that education freedom is constitutionally protected, the ministry does not judge the content, schools and parents can raise concerns via participation councils, and CIDI and other organisations may freely offer materials.
Education freedom is enshrined in the Constitution, so it is not the ministry's task to judge the content of the available teaching materials.
In de Grondwet is de vrijheid van onderwijs verankerd en het is dan ook niet de taak van het ministerie om een oordeel te vormen over de inhoud van het beschikbare lesmateriaal
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

MPs Van Raan and Akerboom asked the government whether it bears responsibility for climate policy and how it responds to a speech by Greta Thunberg at COP24, including whether ministers would act to keep warming to 1.5 degrees. The government answered only by referring to a previous answer, Aanhangsel Handelingen 2018-2019 nr. 1305, without addressing the substance.
The written questions from members Van Raan and Akerboom (both PvdD), question number 2018Z24281, have been answered by means of Appendix to the Proceedings, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1305.
Antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Raan en Akerboom (beiden PvdD), vraagnummer 2018Z24281 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor Rammstein binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether her consultations and the Senate's rejection of the earlier ticket-resale bill justify dropping legislation against resale of concert tickets at excessive prices, and whether national law can work given cross-border resale. The minister answered that national legislation is not effective because resale is online and cross-border, that she will pursue an awareness campaign, support industry initiatives and raise the issue at EU level instead of enacting the requested law.
I choose an information campaign to make consumers more aware of resale.
Ik kies voor een voorlichtingscampagne om de consument bewuster te maken van doorverkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over websites die sjoemelen met kaartverkoop

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a secondary ticket seller offering tickets to a Michelle Obama lecture before sales had started, and promising 100% ticket guarantees while its terms allow cancellation of resold tickets. The minister confirmed the facts, said misleading-information rules under the Civil Code apply but that individual judgments are not hers to make, offered to inform the ACM, and pointed to a consumer awareness campaign and European action rather than new legislation.
However, it is not for me to pass judgment on this in individual cases.
Het is echter niet aan mij om daar in individuele gevallen een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet en Van der Molen over een subsidieaanvraag door Stichting De Fryske Mole

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Stichting De Fryske Mole, which owns 42 mills in Fryslân, could be given the 60% subsidy rate that the SIM scheme adopts from 2019, after it applied before the change under the 50% rate. The minister answered that the application is governed by the rules in force at the time, that the foundation could not reasonably expect the higher rate, and that raising it now is not possible because of equal treatment and lack of funds.
That request was rejected, but as far as I am aware, not because a higher subsidy percentage could be obtained under the SIM.
Dat verzoek is afgewezen, maar voor zover mij bekend, niet omdat een hoger subsidiepercentage in de SIM zou worden verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over anti-integratieve uitspraken rector islamitische universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Becker and Tielen asked the government how it would respond to statements by the rector of the Islamic University of Rotterdam that followers of Gülen may receive the death penalty, and whether it would use powers under the Wet bescherming namen en graden. The minister condemned the statements, said an independent advisory commission had been asked for advice under the step-by-step procedure, and said she is willing to use the law's options but will await the commission's advice before deciding.
With the commission's advice I will assess whether there is reason to intervene at the IUASR.
Met het advies van de commissie zal ik beoordelen of er aanleiding is om bij de IUASR in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul op de vragen over de Monitor Vrouwelijke Hoogleraren 2018

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the slow growth in female professors, the decline in the share of female PhD candidates, unequal pay for female professors, and whether the Westerdijk Talent Impuls scheme should continue. The minister calls the 1.6 point rise the largest ever, says the pace is slow but universities are working on their targets, notes the PhD share fell only slightly, will wait for full pay-gap research before acting, and points to the coming science letter for further diversity policy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht «Turkije gaat weekendscholen financieren in Nederland»

MPs De Graaf, Beertema and Wilders asked whether the government would bar Turkish-funded weekend schools in the Netherlands, given concerns about foreign influence on children's education, and whether they should be banned. The minister answered that such informal schools fall outside education law, so the Inspectorate has no powers and they cannot be banned, while the government shares concerns about integration and anti-democratic teaching and has raised them with Turkey, which promised transparency and information sharing.
At present the cabinet does not have full insight into the nature and scale of informal education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen volledig zicht op de aard en omvang van het informeel onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Roon, Bosma en Fritsma over het bericht dat het Chinese leger massaal onderzoekers stuurt naar westerse universiteiten

PVV MPs asked whether Chinese military-linked researchers are entering Dutch universities such as TU Delft to develop dual-use technologies, and how immigration screening and a possible ban would work. The government answered that the intelligence services do not comment on their knowledge, that universities bear primary responsibility for screening students, and that a review of the policy framework is ongoing, with no statutory ban beyond the North Korea rule.
The intelligence and security services make no statements about their current level of knowledge.
De inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doen geen uitspraken over hun actuele kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten weinig gebruik maken van inspraak

MP Futselaar (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how she will respond to research showing few student council elections, low awareness of new powers among programme committee members, and incomplete administrative support, and whether she will press institutions and review the Wet versterking bestuurskracht. The Minister said institutions and students share responsibility, committed to a momentary review of programme committees and a broad evaluation in 2020/2021, and called on institutions to inform and support committees, while rejecting a need to challenge institutions on election practice.
I will fulfil two commitments previously made to the Senate.
Ik zal voldoen aan twee toezeggingen die eerder zijn gedaan aan de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Duitsers willen nieuwe universiteit op grens met Nederland’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that German politicians want a new cross-border university near Venlo, and whether Dutch universities can access EU funding for European university networks. The minister said the idea was only briefly mentioned in talks with North Rhine-Westphalia, sees no added value in a new cross-border university, and says Dutch institutions may apply to the Erasmus+ European university networks pilot, which the Commission assesses without member-state involvement.

I therefore in principle see no added value within the system for a new cross-border university, but possibly for cross-border cooperation between existing universities and universities of applied sciences.

Ik zie dus in beginsel geen toegevoegde waarde binnen het bestel voor een nieuwe grensoverschrijdende universiteit, maar mogelijk wel voor grensoverschrijdende samenwerking tussen bestaande universiteiten en hogescholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Examenlek nieuwkomers via besloten netwerken’

An MP from the PVV asked ministers whether participants in an alleged leak of exam questions via social media should be treated as criminals, deported, and whether asylum-route arrivals should be returned. The government answered that sharing recollections of exam questions is not criminal fraud, that deportation applies only under specific legal criteria after conviction, and that asylum status holders cannot generally be returned via safe countries.
Sharing information about the exam questions based on recollections does not qualify as fraud in the criminal sense.
Dit delen van informatie over de examenopgaven, gebaseerd op herinneringen, kwalificeert zich niet als fraude in de strafrechtelijke betekenis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Özütok over het bericht '53 steden tekenen intentieverklaring Regenboogbeleid'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the report that 53 cities signed the Rainbow policy letter of intent, and whether non-participating municipalities could be encouraged to join. The minister answered that the scope of the 2017 evaluation is limited, that the focus is on the G50 cities, that municipalities may join voluntarily with their own funds, and that Movisie offers guidance and events.
Municipalities must themselves make funds available for this.
Gemeenten dienen daarvoor zelf middelen vrij te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat universiteiten op zoek moeten naar financiers

An SP MP asked the education minister about universities seeking outside financiers for real estate, including whether it makes them dependent on financial markets and whether real estate costs threaten teaching and research. The minister answered that outside financing is a positive development, that borrowing from the treasury is an option, that real estate costs are reported in annual reports and a DUO dashboard, and that institutions decide their own financing policy.
I do not have an overview of the financial risks of individual institutions, as they conduct autonomous financing policy.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de financiële risico’s van afzonderlijke instellingen, aangezien zij een autonoom financieringsbeleid voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Asscher over seksueel overschrijdend gedrag in de cultuursector

MPs Van den Hul and Asscher asked the minister about the Brandpunt+ survey showing widespread sexual misconduct in the cultural sector, including at arts academies, and about complaint handling, action plans and an independent investigation. The minister responded that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to Arbowet obligations and Inspectie SZW enforcement, and announced a meeting with sector parties on 20 December, while declining a separate investigation of the academies or funding an independent study.
I see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Özütok en Renkema over #metoo in de culturele sector

MPs from GroenLinks asked the minister about a survey showing that 45% of respondents in the cultural sector experienced sexual misconduct, low reporting rates, and dissatisfaction with complaint handling, and what the government would do. The minister shared concern, said the sector is primarily responsible, pointed to employer duties under the Arbowet and Inspectie SZW enforcement, and committed to a meeting with stakeholders on 20 December before deciding on any measures.
I will meet with stakeholders on 20 December. Depending on this conversation and any follow-up conversations, I will look into whether I will take measures.
Ik ga op 20 december met betrokkenen in gesprek. Afhankelijk van dit gesprek en eventuele vervolggesprekken zal ik kijken of ik maatregelen ga treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ‘TU wordt voor studenten buiten EU stuk duurder’

An MP asked whether non-EU students at TU Delft facing higher tuition amounts to indirect state subsidy of non-cost-covering programmes, and whether Dutch-language teaching could limit inflows. The minister explained that institutions set institutional tuition within limits, plans to cap it only for EEA students, and will consider requiring institutions to keep language policy under review.
It is up to the institution to decide how this funding is distributed across its statutory tasks, including education for non-EEA students.
Het is aan de instelling om te bepalen hoe deze bekostiging wordt verdeeld over haar wettelijke taken, waaronder ook het onderwijs aan niet-EER-studenten valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van de Hul, Westerveld en Futselaar over de toename van studenten die ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit van universiteiten

MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that rapid student growth at some universities is eroding teaching quality, including overcrowded lectures and shortfalls in facilities and assessment. The minister disputed a general quality decline, pointed to institution-level choices under the quality agreements, and said there are no targets for maximum lecture size.
I do not recognise the picture of a negative quality trend caused by strong growth.
Het beeld van een negatieve kwaliteitstrend door forse groei herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de RUG uit angst voor schadeclaims doorwerkt aan Chinese Branchcampus

MPs Futselaar and Van der Molen asked whether RUG continued planning a Chinese branch campus despite a no, whether the MoU is binding, how damage claims would be handled, and whether the university council was adequately informed. The minister answered that RUG did not apply for the required permission, that the MoU binds only its signatories, that the risk of claims is very low and no public funds may be used, and that council disputes go to the national complaints committee.
The Ministry of OCW was aware of this, but was not a party to those agreements.
Het Ministerie van OCW was hiervan op de hoogte, maar was geen partij in die overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat part time werken voor vrouwen lang niet altijd een vrije keuze is

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether part-time work by women is truly a free choice, given reports that social norms and institutions steer them toward it, and what role men and government policy should play. The minister acknowledged social norms and institutional pressure shape the choice, pointed to parental leave extension, the WerkZorg calculator, tax changes and an interdepartmental policy review (IBO Deeltijdwerk), without committing to a new structural measure.
The cabinet does not want to diminish the possibility of working part-time.
Het kabinet wil niets afdoen aan de mogelijkheid om in deeltijd te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de AOb past voor landelijk overleg over lerarentekort

MPs Kwint asked the minister about the AOb union withdrawing from the national teacher shortage talks and whether the shortage can be solved without structural extra funding. The minister regrets the withdrawal, says the national talks will continue, defends the handreiking and the regional approach, and points to existing structural investments in workload reduction and salaries.
I regret the AOb's departure from the national teacher shortage consultation.
Ik betreur het vertrek van de AOb uit het landelijke overleg lerarentekort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en Beertema over MRI-onderzoek door het Spinoza Centre

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a Spinoza Centre MRI study recruiting people with strong views on refugees, paid 25 euros, was acceptable, whether studying brain activity via political topics was bizarre, what its purpose and subsidy were, and whether such practices should end. The minister defended the recruitment as standard for attitude research, said the study was ethically approved and fundamental rather than medical, and that the equipment is not available for medical use.

The recruitment method, alongside the research methods themselves, was approved by the Standing Committee for Science and Ethics of the Faculty of Behavioural and Movement Sciences of the Vrije Universiteit.

De methode van werving is, naast de onderzoeksmethodes zelf, goedgekeurd door de Vaste Commissie voor Wetenschap en Ethiek van de Faculteit der Gedrags- en Bewegingswetenschappen van de Vrije Universiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Diertens over het bericht 'Voetbal is voor iedereen!'

Two D66 MPs asked the health and education ministers about an open letter from LGBT+ supporters calling for more acceptance in football, and what the government will do to promote inclusion and tackle discriminatory chants. The minister agreed more action is needed, pointed to the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the Sportakkoord, and said the KNVB shares the ambition, while committing only to ongoing consultation with supporters.
Yes. Question 3: In what way are you currently promoting inclusion and acceptance of LGBT+ people in sport and especially in football?
Ja. Vraag 3 Op welke manier stimuleert u op dit moment inclusie en acceptatie van LHBT+ in de sport en bij het voetbal in het bijzonder?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Trump administration wants to remove 'gender' from UN human rights documents’

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bergkamp asked the government about reports that the Trump administration sought to replace the term 'gender' with 'woman' in UN human rights documents, and the implications for transgender and intersex people's legal protection. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes these US amendments as weakening gender equality commitments, that hundreds of UN and EU texts with gender language remain in force, and that Dutch protections for trans and intersex persons are not affected.
The Netherlands is working in international fora to ensure that progress made is not reversed and that agreed language is retained.
Nederland zet zich binnen internationale fora ervoor in te zorgen dat de geboekte vooruitgang niet wordt teruggedraaid en agreed language behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Nieuwe belasting op attracties voor dagjesmensen’

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about Amsterdam's plan for a new levy on attractions aimed at day-trippers, and the limits central government sets on municipal tax autonomy. Minister Ollongren answered that municipalities can set tourist and recreation levies autonomously within legal limits, that the effects on businesses and subsidised institutions are not yet known, and that the Amsterdam alderman will first consult residents.
At this stage there is insufficient knowledge of the measure Amsterdam wishes to introduce to say anything about its potential effects on entrepreneurs or their turnover.
In dit stadium is onvoldoende bekend over de door de gemeente Amsterdam gewenste maatregel om iets te kunnen zeggen over de potentiële effecten ervan op ondernemers of hun omzet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Özdil over de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving dat de studie Nederlands dreigt te verdwijnen en alleen in het buitenland populair

MPs Van der Molen (CDA) and Özdil (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science to clarify earlier answers on the declining Dutch-language degree programmes, including whether the VU plans to close its programme and what actions are planned. The minister denies any contradiction, says no concrete closure plans are known, points to a Deltaplan for the languages due in 2019, a KNAW problem analysis, and a Taalunie study on Dutch abroad, and says further steps will follow in 2019.
However, as far as I am aware, there are no concrete plans by the VU or other higher education institutions to close Dutch programmes.
Echter, voor zover mij bekend is, zijn er geen concrete plannen van de VU of van andere hoger onderwijsinstellingen om opleidingen Nederlands te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse cultuur rond vrouwemancipatie en deeltijdwerken achterhaald is

MPs from D66 asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Education and Finance about a report that Dutch culture on women's emancipation and part-time work is outdated, covering women's access to extra hours, sector shortages, McKinsey's estimate of GDP gains, parental role models, pay gaps and childcare flexibility. The minister answered that the government is studying part-time work through an interdepartmental policy review, cites measures such as tax changes and parental leave, and says concrete outcomes depend on individual employers and employees.
The cabinet has commissioned an interdepartmental policy review on part-time work (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Het kabinet heeft opdracht gegeven tot een interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek deeltijdwerk (IBO Deeltijdwerk).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘Helft van de promovendi is vrouw maar cum laude krijgen ze zelden’

Opposition MP Bergkamp asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that women rarely receive cum laude PhD distinctions, gender bias in committees, gendered PhD regulations and tracking. The minister could not confirm the figures, cited gender bias as a likely cause, and promised talks with universities and the VSNU on bias training and monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over het bericht dat Shell kinderen wurgcontracten zou hebben laten ondertekenen

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked ministers about reports that Shell had children sign contracts with broad rights waivers, English-law jurisdiction and confidentiality clauses for Generation Discover 2018, and about related questions on the Hogeschool Leiden and the festival. The government answered that the forms were sent in error, were replaced, and that affected children were not photographed, declined to answer questions 3 to 25 because Shell will destroy the contracts, and did not consider the other issues reason for action beyond general comments.
Because Shell will destroy the agreements you refer to and will therefore not rely on them, I will not address questions 3 through 25, as you yourself suggest.
Omdat Shell de overeenkomsten waar u naar verwijst, zal vernietigen en daar dus geen beroep op zal doen ga ik, zoals u zelf voorstelt, niet in op de vragen 3 tot en met 25.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de verwijdering van het schilderij Regelrecht uit de rechtbank in Almelo

MP Bergkamp asked ministers about the removal of a nude-breasted painting from the Almelo court building, whether it undermines the court's independence, and whether the samenleving seeks to influence art more. The government answered that the court board is responsible for the building's interior, that the removal was weighed against a complaint from a sex-crime victim, and that artistic freedom remains the starting point, with no general policy on art in public buildings.

In this case it is therefore up to the court board of the Overijssel district court to assess to what extent the complaints received about the painting give cause to move it from the public to the non-public area of the Almelo courthouse.

Het is in dit geval dus aan het gerechtsbestuur van de rechtbank Overijssel om te beoordelen in hoeverre er in de ontvangen klachten over het schilderij een aanleiding moet worden gezien om het schilderij van de publieke naar de niet-publieke ruimte van het gerechtsgebouw in Almelo te verplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor Rammstein binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An MP asked why Rammstein tickets sold out within minutes and resellers offered them at many times face value, and why the government had not enforced the motion to curb ticket profiteering. The minister answered that a national resale ban would be ineffective and unenforceable, so the government chose a consumer awareness campaign and support for existing industry initiatives instead.
Our conclusion is that such legislation is ineffective and hardly enforceable, if at all.
Onze conclusie is dat dergelijke wetgeving ineffectief en niet of nauwelijks handhaafbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “Syriërs sturen kinderen naar weekendscholen”

PVV MPs asked the government about Syrian weekend schools (informal Islamic/Koranic education), whether they should be closed and funded organisations dissolved, and whether all Syrian asylum seekers and status holders should be returned to Syria. The minister answered that this is informal education not covered by education law, that the government lacks structural oversight of it, and that closing it or returning refugees is rejected.
At present the cabinet has no structural insight into the nature and scale of education at, among others, weekend schools.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen structureel zicht op de aard en omvang van het onderwijs op onder andere weekendscholen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een alarmerende daling van studentenaantallen voor Nederlandse Taal en Cultuur

The MP asked whether the reported collapse in student numbers for Dutch language and culture is accurate, what it means for the shortage of Dutch teachers in upper secondary education, and how the minister assesses proposals to reverse the trend. The minister confirmed a roughly 60% fall in intake over ten years that has levelled off but still gives cause for concern, pointed to sector initiatives such as a Delta plan for languages and a KNAW analysis, and said curriculum reform will be examined.
In addition, I have asked the KNAW to produce a problem analysis and possible solutions for the Dutch studies programme.
Daarnaast heb ik de KNAW gevraagd om tot een probleemanalyse en eventuele oplossingsrichtingen te komen voor de studie Nederlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de berichten dat een bedrijf ‘post-master’-opleidingen aanbiedt in combinatie met een arbeidscontract dat uiteindelijk niet tot stand komt

An MP asked the education minister about a company offering 'post-master' courses bundled with a job contract that never materialised, and whether unaccredited providers using such terms should be regulated. The minister confirmed the company is unaccredited, declined to make these titles legally protected or to survey the unaccredited market, and pointed to existing fraud law, Inspectorate checks on the Wet bescherming namen en graden, and public information as sufficient.
I see no reason to do so, given the protection offered by the Wet bescherming namen en graden.
Ik zie hiertoe geen aanleiding, gezien de bescherming die wordt geboden door de Wet bescherming namen en graden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Tielen en Lodders over het bericht ‘Onterecht geld opstrijken; Ouders kunnen zich inschrijven voor studie en, zonder ooit op te dagen, kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen. Wat

MPs from the VVD asked whether a student enrolment certificate alone is enough to receive childcare allowance, how many households receive it for study, and how enrolment is checked. The government answered that enrolment is one eligibility condition checked by the Tax Authority against Dutch education-agency data, that a certificate alone is not sufficient, and that the check is effective.
A certificate of enrolment alone is therefore not sufficient.
Een bewijs van inschrijving alleen is dus niet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over de uit de klauwen lopende bedragen die de publieke omroep jaarlijks aan consultants betaalt

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the high consultancy and temporary staff costs of the Dutch public broadcaster NPO, the use of Boston Consulting Group, and related figures. The minister answered that the NPO itself decides how to spend its budget and that its supervisory board monitors efficiency, and provided the requested cost figures without a full list of past consultancy payments.
It is up to the NPO to decide for itself how to deploy its available budget as wisely as possible and to what extent it uses (external) advice and temporary staff.
Het is aan de NPO om zelf te bepalen hoe hij het beschikbare budget zo verstandig mogelijk inzet en in welke mate hij bijvoorbeeld gebruik maakt van (extern) advies en inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht over nieuwe misstanden bij corpora, in dit geval Minerva

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reported abuses at student corporations (corpora) such as Minerva, including the Groningen decision to suspend Vindicat, and whether a national approach or renewed talks with the LKvV are planned. The minister said the institutions themselves should act, noted that the LKvV condemns such conduct and that many associations have changed their hazing practices, and saw no reason to take a larger role.
As I also indicated in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, I consider it primarily the responsibility of the educational institution to act when these often humiliating incidents occur.
Zoals ik ook in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen heb aangegeven, vind ik het primair aan de onderwijsinstelling om op te treden als er dit soort, vaak vernederende incidenten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Sociale partners belemmeren duurzame inzetbaarheid scholing en training van flexwerkers in de bouw’

MPs Wiersma and El Yassini asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Education about a construction-sector collective agreement clause that allows apprenticeship (bbl) contracts only with direct employees, excluding temp agency workers, and whether this harms flexworkers and bbl places. The ministers answer that sectoral social partners may set such terms, that they expect more bbl places in the tight labour market, and that the government is promoting bbl places but sees no reason to reopen talks with the social partners.
The registration of the SBB cannot show how many bbl students were placed at a training company via a temp agency construction.
Uit de registratie van de Samenwerkingsorganisatie Beroepsonderwijs Bedrijfsleven (SBB) kan niet worden afgeleid hoeveel bbl-ers via een uitzendconstructie bij een leerbedrijf zijn geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over Nederlandse investeerders die amper geld steken in start-ups van vrouwen

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the very low share of venture capital going to women-led start-ups is simply accepted as part of the free market, what levers exist, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that this is not accepted as a given, that institutional investors play a limited role, and that a round-table with stakeholders will be organised before deciding on further measures.
I will consider this after the round-table discussion, where I hope to gain more insight into why female-led start-ups obtain so little capital and the options available to address it.

Dit zal ik na het rondetafelgesprek bezien, waar ik hopelijk meer inzicht zal opdoen over de redenen waarom vrouwelijke start-ups zo weinig kapitaal verkrijgen en de mogelijkheden die er zijn om hier wat aan te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Historie moet wijken voor veiligheid’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about plans to convert a listed villa at Plein 1813 for the Israeli embassy, including the sale by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, a negative heritage advice from the RCE, and the Vienna Convention. The minister answered that the sale was publicly marketed with the monument status disclosed, that the RCE advised negatively, that the municipality's draft permit cites the Vienna Convention, and that the host state must protect the embassy under that treaty.
The Rijksdienst has understanding for taking security measures, but the national monument cannot bear all these measures.
De Rijksdienst heeft begrip voor het treffen van veiligheidsmaatregelen, maar het rijksmonument verdraagt al deze maatregelen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Hoe onafhankelijk is Yvon Jaspers?’

MP Van Raan asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Yvon Jaspers' paid side activities for For Farmers and Farm & Countryfair and possible influence on public broadcasting programming, and whether the Commissariaat voor de Media should investigate. The Minister replied that the Commissariaat is investigating the arrangements with the presenter, that public broadcasters set their own programming and are responsible for transparency on conflicts of interest, and declined to comment further on individual personnel matters.
Following recent media reports on the presenter's side job, the Commissariaat voor de Media is examining the arrangements with this presenter regarding both programmes.

Naar aanleiding van de recente berichten in de media over de nevenfunctie van de betreffende presentatrice onderzoekt het Commissariaat voor de Media (hierna: het Commissariaat) de afspraken met deze presentatrice ten aanzien van beide programma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de brief inzake Flexibilisering uitbetaling collegegeldkrediet voor studies in het buitenland

An MP (Özdil, GroenLinks) asks the Minister of Education why she blocks flexible payment of the tuition credit for study abroad, questioning the fraud risk estimates as assumptions and her distrust of Dutch students. The Minister answers that costs and fraud risks outweigh benefits given budget and DUO capacity limits, that she is not opposed in principle, and points to existing options such as meeneembare studiefinanciering and scholarships.

As I concluded in the letter, I believe the costs – both the structural implementation costs and the one-off costs for process and system adjustments – and the risks of flexible payment of the tuition credit do not outweigh the benefits.

Zoals ik in de brief concludeerde, vind ik dat de kosten – zowel de structurele uitvoeringskosten als de eenmalige kosten voor de proces- en systeemaanpassingen – en de risico’s van de mogelijkheid tot flexibele uitbetaling van het collegegeldkrediet niet opwegen tegen de voordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht ‘Hoe mannen in pakken van het mbo een onderwijsfabriek maakten’

A PVV MP asked the Education Minister about reports of mbo executive pay above the WNT norm, the ROC Amsterdam director's salary, how fines for excess pay are borne, and a list of all over-norm pay in education. The minister defended the WNT and transition rules, called institutional pay an autonomous matter, explained the recovery mechanism, and declined to provide an individual overview, citing reduced WNT reporting since 2017.
One of the changes is that an overview of individual exceedances of the WNT maximum (still under transitional arrangements) is no longer compiled nationwide and provided to your House.

Een van de wijzigingen is dat een overzicht met individuele overschrijdingen van het WNT-maximum (die nog onder het overgangsrecht vallen) niet langer rijksbreed wordt opgesteld en aan uw Kamer wordt verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Berispte ambtenaar blijft actief in vrouwenrechten'

MPs Özütok and Van Ojik asked whether a Foreign Ministry official coordinating a women's rights project, whose complaints of sexual intimidation, financial abuse and bullying were upheld, was moved to an equivalent post still touching women's rights and contact with NGOs. Minister Blok confirmed six complaints were upheld, a disciplinary measure was imposed, the official was moved immediately, and he may continue in ministry work with NGO contact that will be avoided, while outlining reforms to reporting and transparency.
Six of the complaints have been upheld.
Zes van de klachten zijn gegrond verklaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Kooten-Arissen over ongewenste druk van de overheid en het bedrijfsleven op onderzoekers

MPs Van Raan and Van Kooten-Arissen asked about undue pressure from government and business on researchers, including the KNAW code on external funding, the new research integrity code, and Rijksvoorwaarden. The ministers answered that the new Dutch research integrity code covers all researchers, that universities must protect their researchers, and that the government will review the Rijksvoorwaarden and model contract to ensure they fit the integrity code.

I will, together with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the drafting committee that prepared the new code, take another careful look at the Rijksvoorwaarden in combination with the model agreement for (policy-oriented) research.

Daarom ga ik samen met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de schrijfcommissie, die de nieuwe gedragscode heeft opgesteld, nog eens goed naar de Rijksvoorwaarden in combinatie met de modelovereenkomst voor (beleidsgericht) onderzoek kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over verhuurder Camelot

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked the Interior and Education Ministers about the letting company Camelot and its treatment of student tenants at the University of Twente, including deposits, mandatory services, referrals and whether rules need tightening. Minister Ollongren answered that companies may choose their business, that Camelot has reduced its deposit to 1,000 euro after university consultation, that tenants can seek legal advice and rulings, and that the issues feed into the student housing action plan and a 'Goed verhuurderschap' approach, with a follow-up letter promised after a sector meeting.
I will meet the sector on 1 November about the Goed verhuurderschap approach.
Ik spreek op 1 november met de sector over de aanpak Goed verhuurderschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Geef leraar onbeperkt toegang tot onderzoek’

An MP asked the ministers whether teachers should get free access to academic publications and whether the government would provide it quickly, rather than waiting for open access policy. The minister agreed knowledge access matters, pointed to open access goals for 2020 and existing NRO and KB services, and did not commit to free access for all teachers now.
That is why I am working to actually realise that free access.
Daarom span ik me in om die vrije toegang daadwerkelijk te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de berichtgeving dat de studie Nederlands dreigt te verdwijnen en alleen in het buitenland populair is

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about press reports that Dutch-language study programmes face falling enrolment and possible closure, and about what the government will do to raise intake. The minister answered that the government sees no signs of closures, that enrolment in teacher-training programmes is being monitored with concern, that institutions are already taking initiatives, and that a broader study of Dutch-language promotion abroad has been requested.
I have received no signals from universities of applied sciences or universities of concrete plans to close Dutch-language programmes.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen van de hogescholen of universiteiten tot concrete voornemens om opleidingen Nederlands te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de berichten ‘Studie Nederlands dreigt te verdwijnen door studententekort’ en ‘Studie Nederlands is alleen in het buitenland populair’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Education about reports that enrolment in Dutch-language studies has fallen sharply and that the subject may disappear at some universities. The Minister acknowledges the decline, says the causes are not fully known, notes that teacher-training intake is more stable, and points to existing sector initiatives and a planned analysis without committing to new measures.
I want to work with the relevant programmes to determine what may be causing the lagging intake.
Ik wil met de betreffende opleidingen nagaan wat de oorzaak kan zijn van de achterblijvende instroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over verouderde techniekapparatuur in het middelbaar beroepsonderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether vocational colleges using outdated technical equipment hinder labour-market alignment and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that the ministry has no overview of equipment per institution, that schools are responsible for their own investments, and pointed to funding factors, the Regionaal investeringsfonds mbo and the Techniekpact as existing measures.
No, the Ministry of OCW does not have an overview of the equipment present at all individual educational institutions.
Nee, het Ministerie van OCW beschikt niet over een overzicht van de apparatuur die bij alle afzonderlijke onderwijsinstellingen aanwezig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘In de zoveelste onderwijsfraudezaak blijft de inspectie opvallend stil’

MP Bruins asked whether the supervisory board toetsingskader of Hanzehogeschool Groningen, which frames the board's role as a sounding board rather than supervision, adequately guarantees checks and balances, and whether the inspectorate should reopen its review. The minister defends the framework as consistent with the WHW, says the inspectorate now has full information from the reporter and will conclude within weeks, and states that further investigation may follow if warranted.
Should the information give cause for it, the inspectorate may decide to conduct further investigation.
Mocht de informatie daartoe aanleiding geven, dan kan de inspectie besluiten nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het rapport 'Inzicht in en verantwoording van onderwijsgelden'

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether she shares the Onderwijsraad's conclusion that the NVAO lacks the capacity and expertise for sound financial and quality oversight of study-fund spending, and whether this affects the motion requiring NVAO pre-checks of measurable institutional quality agreements. The minister agreed capacity must be expanded, says agreements with the NVAO are already made, and states the NVAO will also assess measurability of quality agreements.
I share this conclusion of the council and have already made agreements with the NVAO on expanding capacity.
Ik deel deze conclusie van de raad en heb reeds met de NVAO afspraken gemaakt over uitbreiding van de capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over undercoverbeelden over apenexperimenten in het BPRC

An MP asked the government about undercover footage showing sedated monkeys at the BPRC primate research centre, including animals left unattended and handlers joking near suffering animals, and whether subsidy should stop. The minister answered that the NVWA inspected, found the sedation adequate and no violations, and committed to a plan from the BPRC by 1 January 2019 to reduce primate experiments by 40 percent, with a letter to parliament in Q1 2019.
Following the undercover footage, the NVWA carried out an extra inspection at the BPRC on 10 September.
Naar aanleiding van de undercoverbeelden heeft de NVWA op 10 september jl. een extra inspectie bij het BPRC uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over plannen van het Bureau Krediet Registratie (BKR) om studieschulden van studenten officieel te gaan registreren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether BKR plans to officially register student loans and whether this would undermine the social character of the student finance system and harm ex-students' mortgage access. The minister replied that the government does not intend to register student debt, since DUO already records it and it is accessible, that lenders must already account for student debt under the Wft, and that BKR cannot register it unilaterally.
The government does not intend to proceed with registration, because study debts are already recorded at DUO and are easily accessible to former students.
De regering is niet voornemens om tot registratie over te gaan, omdat studieschulden al geregistreerd staan bij DUO en hier eenvoudig toegankelijk zijn voor oud-studenten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt en Bisschop over de uitvoering van de motie Geluk-Poortvliet en het behoud van het budget voor de instandhoudingssubsidie woonhuis-rijksmonumenten

MPs Geluk-Poortvliet, Omtzigt and Bisschop asked whether the new subsidy scheme for owner-occupied and rented listed homes, and the transfer of budget from the tax deduction, is consistent with a parliamentary motion and whether budgets will suffice. The minister replied that the scheme is open to natural persons only, the full budget remains available to owners, the budget will be evaluated in 2020, and the 100% loan cannot be combined with the subsidy.
As I indicated in my policy letter Erfgoed Telt, budgetary room arises by subsidising only those costs that contribute to maintaining the monumental parts of the monument.

Zoals ik in mijn beleidsbrief Erfgoed Telt heb aangegeven, ontstaat budgettaire ruimte door alleen de kosten te subsidiëren die bijdragen aan de instandhouding van de monumentale onderdelen van het monument.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht 'Facebook bant foto van twee mannen'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Facebook's removal of a photo from an art exhibition in Dordrecht was painful given the local anti-gay violence, and whether Facebook should bear more responsibility for free expression. The minister confirmed the removal was a Facebook error, the photo was restored, said Facebook's policy allows art depicting nudity, and declined to talk to Facebook because the removal was a mistake.
Since the removal of the photo was an error, I see no reason at this time to enter into discussion with Facebook.
Aangezien het verwijderen van de foto een fout betreft, zie ik geen aanleiding om op dit moment met Facebook het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Remco Dijkstra over het in Nederland houden van het vliegend erfgoed De Catalina

MPs Aartsen and Dijkstra asked whether the government would act to keep the historic Catalina aircraft in the Netherlands before its sale to a US buyer. The minister answered that the aircraft has no protected status, that no other party has yet offered to fund the purchase, and that a request must come from a heritage institution to the Mondriaan Fonds before a decision can be made.
I am willing to take action, but I depend on the willingness of the parties involved to come up with a good proposal and submit it to the Mondriaan Fund.
Ik ben bereid om actie te ondernemen, maar ben daarbij afhankelijk van de bereidheid van de betrokken partijen om met een goed voorstel te komen en dit in te dienen bij het Mondriaan Fonds.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over de uitzending van Zembla getiteld “De Kunstgrasberg”.

MPs Kröger and Westerveld asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast on illegal handling and stockpiling of artificial turf waste, inspection frequency, responsibility for disposal, and sustainable alternatives. The state secretary answered that municipalities and provinces are the competent authorities for licensing and enforcement, that the ILT inspected three firms and issued warnings, and that ownership of the matter remains with local authorities, while committing to follow up with Gelderland and Dongen and to work on sustainability through the sports accord.
I have asked the Province of Gelderland and the municipality of Dongen to keep me informed of the follow-up steps and will actively monitor their implementation.
Ik heb de Provincie Gelderland en gemeente Dongen verzocht mij op de hoogte te houden over de vervolgstappen en zal de uitvoering daarvan actief volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat ex-studenten geen hypotheek krijgen bij een studieschuld

MPs Ronnes and Van der Molen (CDA) asked ministers whether banks wrongly count the original rather than remaining student debt when assessing mortgage applications, and whether DUO should improve information to students. The government answered that annuity repayment makes the monthly burden constant so the original debt is weighted via fixed factors, that the explain exception exists, that information will be improved, and that excluding student debt would raise over-indebtedness risk.

At the next Platform Hypotheken in 2019, where the sector and the supervisor discuss possible bottlenecks in mortgage lending, it will be inventoried how providers use this explain possibility and whether bottlenecks are encountered.

Tijdens het volgende Platform Hypotheken in 2019, waar met de sector en de toezichthouder wordt gesproken over mogelijke knelpunten in de hypotheekverstrekking, zal worden geïnventariseerd op welke wijze aanbieders gebruik maken van deze explain-mogelijkheid en of hier knelpunten worden ondervonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat studenten lang in de wacht staan door onderbezetting en nieuw systeem

An SP MP asked the Education Minister about reports that students face long phone waits at DUO due to understaffing and a new system. The minister says 75 extra FTE were deployed, waits fell to about 5 minutes early 2018 but rose to 15-33 minutes in summer, and a decision on further measures will only come in spring 2019 pending monitoring and budget limits.
I would like to do more to improve telephone accessibility, but I do not currently have the financial room for it.
Ik zou graag meer willen doen om de telefonische bereikbaarheid te verbeteren, maar ik heb daar nu niet de financiële ruimte voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de inventarisatie 'Hypotheek en Studieschuld' van het Interstedelijk Studenten Overleg (ISO)

An MP asked the government why mortgage lenders still use original rather than current student debt when calculating maximum mortgages, despite a motion, and asked about DUO's information duties and the weighting factors. The government defended annuity-based weighting factors (0.45% and 0.75%) as reflecting the social character of student loans, committed to improved DUO information and a Nibud study, and found no signs of misuse of explain options.
Following the Koerhuis motion, Nibud is currently examining whether it is desirable to lower the weighting factors.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Koerhuis onderzoekt Nibud momenteel of het wenselijk is om de wegingsfactoren te verlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over de culturele invulling van handelsmissies

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how culture is incorporated into trade missions, including how cultural institutions are selected, whether innovative firms can join, and whether art can be promoted as an export product. The minister answered that culture is not a standard part of trade missions, there are no formal selection criteria, creative-sector firms are routinely invited, and the government supports promotion of Dutch culture mainly through facilitation.
Cultural programmes are not a standard part of trade missions.
Culturele programma's maken geen standaard deel uit van handelsmissies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over de stellage in Enschede waar je als slachtoffer van een ISIS beul gefotografeerd kunt worden

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a provocative art installation at the Gogbot festival in Enschede, where visitors could pose as ISIS execution victims, was inappropriate and whether the minister would ask the mayor to remove it. The minister answered that the artist's freedom of expression is protected, that the installation was co-funded by several public and private bodies, and that the mayor saw no reason to remove it.
No. The mayor already stated on 8 September, while the festival was still taking place, that he saw no reason to remove the artwork.
Nee. De burgemeester heeft al op 8 september, toen het festival nog plaatsvond, laten weten dat hij geen reden zag om het kunstwerk weg te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over studenten met een hiv-besmetting die niet worden behandeld

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they knew of international students with untreated HIV, how large the problem was, and whether they would help find a solution with insurers and universities. The minister said there is no registration of the group, that he will commission research into its size and nature, that private insurers' exclusions are their and the universities' responsibility, and that he will participate in talks if that helps.
I will therefore have research carried out into the scope and nature of the problem in order to gain insight into the risk to public health.
Ik zal daarom onderzoek laten doen naar de omvang en aard van de problematiek om zicht te krijgen op het risico voor de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Schreeuwende tekorten, maar scholing van flexwerkers is voor bedrijven geen prioriteit.’

An MP asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about ROA research showing flex workers receive far less work-related training than permanent staff, and about the planned individual learning account. The minister acknowledges the gap, says employers and employees bear primary responsibility, and promises a letter to parliament before the October committee meeting on lifelong learning.

On the policy to achieve a breakthrough in strengthening the Dutch learning culture, including the design of the individual learning account, parliament will be informed by letter before the October committee meeting.

Over het beleid om te komen tot een doorbraak bij de verdere versterking van de Nederlandse leercultuur, waaronder de vormgeving van de individuele leerrekening, wordt uw Kamer voorafgaand het algemeen overleg in oktober per brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over de berichten ‘Promoveren op een studentenbeurs’ en ‘Universiteit Groningen kleedt het promoveren verder uit’

An MP asked the education minister about the RUG and EUR experiment with promotiestudenten who receive a stipend instead of employment, raising concerns about lower pay, missing benefits, savings for universities, and whether the experiment should be capped or stopped. The minister answered that the positions differ legally, that a minimum stipend is not set but universities aim for a netto starting salary level, that an independent interim evaluation is underway, and that no new applications will be honoured.
I refer to the answer to question 9.
Ik verwijs naar het antwoord op vraag 9.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘In de zoveelste onderwijsfraudezaak blijft de inspectie opvallend stil’

MP Bruins asked the Minister of Education about press reports that the inspectorate stayed silent on a fraud case at Hanzehogeschool Groningen, including whether the supervisory board treated its role as advisory rather than supervisory, and how a whistleblower report was handled and protected. The Minister answered that the board analysed the report and found insufficient grounds for investigation, the inspectorate agreed, a whistleblower's submission was misplaced internally and is being examined, and the inspectorate keeps whistleblower identities confidential.
The inspectorate is currently examining what went wrong when the whistleblower's submission was received and will take measures if necessary to prevent this from happening again.

De inspectie onderzoekt momenteel wat er verkeerd is gegaan bij de ontvangst van de zending van de melder en zal zo nodig maatregelen nemen om te voorkomen dat dit in de toekomst nogmaals verkeerd gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Futselaar over de alarmerende omvang van het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Futselaar asked the ministers about the teacher shortage, including the lack of vacancy data, spending on temp agencies, overtime, and higher tuition for second degrees in education and care. The ministers acknowledged the shortage, said they do not hold current vacancy figures, pointed to schools' own choices and the work-pressure accord, and referred to a recent letter on the shortage.
The ministry does not have a current vacancy overview.
Het ministerie heeft geen actueel vacatureoverzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar inzake psychische gezondheid en prestatiedruk van studenten

MP Futselaar asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that students are psychologically breaking down under performance pressure, and whether the introduction of the student loan system causes debt-related psychological problems. The minister acknowledges the risks, denies that debt is a main cause (pointing to a combination of self-imposed demands, social media and study pressure), and promises a student-wellbeing approach and a letter, but declines new large-scale national research for now pending consultation with the health ministry.
I will of course continue to monitor this.
Ik zal dit uiteraard blijven monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Özdil over het bericht ‘Gemiddelde prijs studentenkamer voor het eerst boven de 400 euro’

GroenLinks MPs asked ministers about rising student rents, the causes of the housing shortage, and whether the woningwaarderingsstelsel should be mandatory for student housing. The government said it lacks exact shortage figures per city, pointed to the Landelijke monitor and a new action plan, and considered existing rent-control and Huurcommissie routes sufficient consumer protection.

As I indicated earlier in answers to parliamentary questions from MPs Van Meenen and Van Eijs (D66) and MPs Voortman and Özdil (GroenLinks), no exact figures per city can be given on student housing demand and supply.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven in antwoorden de Kamervragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs (D66) (kenmerk 2017Z12177 ) en de leden Voortman en Özdil (GroenLinks) (kenmerk 2017Z15653 ) zijn er geen exacte standen per stad te geven als het gaat om de vraag naar en het aanbod van studentenhuisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het tekort aan studentenkamers

Two CDA MPs asked about the shortage of student rooms, rising rents, housing options for starters, arrangements for international students, and whether the housing situation affects study choices. The minister disputed the figure of 40,000 unhoused students, pointed to monitor data and the rent-check route via the Huurcommissie, and said no trend yet shows housing affecting study choice.
I have not yet observed a trend showing that the housing market situation influences students' study choices.
Ik heb nog geen trend waargenomen waaruit blijkt dat de situatie op de woningmarkt de studiekeuze van studenten beïnvloedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Van Meenen over (buitenlandse) studenten die geen onderdak hebben

MPs Van Eijs and Van Meenen (D66) asked whether foreign students lacking housing at the start of their studies could be quantified, whether a permanent solution is foreseen, how universities consider housing capacity in recruitment, and about tent accommodation in Groningen and municipal-university coordination. The minister replied that no exact figures per city exist, pointed to the national student housing monitor and a new action plan with local production agreements, and said she will inventory local cooperation and concrete housing actions with the monitor.
No data are available on the number of students who cannot find accommodation before the start of their studies.
Over het aantal studenten dat voor de start van hun studie geen woning kan vinden zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Tielen en De Lange over het bericht 'Húsdokter yn oplieding wol graach nei Fryslân, mar mei net'('Huisarts in opleiding wil graag naar Fryslân, maar mag niet')

Three VVD MPs asked why medical faculties restrict GP trainees to stages within their own university region, despite shortages in regions like Friesland, and asked about criteria, overviews and possible talks with HON. Minister Bruins replied that the uniform national allocation procedure already considers shortage regions, that HON is evaluating allowing transfers to shortage areas by Q3 2018, that no study delays were found, and that a LHV-linked study on GP location motives is being set up.
One of the recommendations from that evaluation is to allow transfers to shortage areas under conditions.
Een van de aanbevelingen uit die evaluatie is om overplaatsing naar krimpgebieden onder voorwaarden toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht dat honderden Nederlandse wetenschappers publiceerden in neptijdschriften

MP Van Meenen (D66) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that hundreds of Dutch academics published in predatory journals that skip peer review. The minister called the practice fraud by malicious publishers, saw no consequences for the scientists involved, pointed to library checklists and repositories, and acknowledged that publication pressure may contribute.
I do not assume that the scientists involved acted in bad faith, and I see no reason to attach consequences to publishing in the journals concerned for the scientists or their institutions.

Ik ga er niet vanuit dat de betrokken wetenschappers te kwader trouw zijn geweest en zie geen aanleiding om aan het publiceren in de betrokken tijdschriften consequenties te verbinden voor de betrokken wetenschappers of hun instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de capaciteit in de mondzorg
