An MP asked why the Capacity Body is being asked to study dental-care capacity again, when earlier reports already showed training capacity must rise, and whether the delay is a stalling tactic. The minister answered that the new study addresses quality doubts and the need to model task reallocation, starts in September 2018, and that the ministers will decide afterward, while declining to raise training places now.
There is no question of a 'delaying tactic' in the further study by the Capacity Body.
Er is bij het nader onderzoek door het Capaciteitsorgaan geen sprake van «vertragingstechniek».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over het verwijderen van een boek uit een bibliotheek omdat het negatieve emoties oproept en aanstoot geeft

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether removing a children's book from the Amsterdam public library (OBA) because it caused offence and negative emotions harms culture and freedom to read. The minister replied that library collection policy is the library's independent responsibility under the Wsob, that the OBA lawfully weighed complaints against public values and withdrew the book from lending while keeping two copies in a museum collection, and declined to meet the Amsterdam mayor.
The Wsob sets out the responsibilities of the various parties in the library system. Collection policy is the responsibility of the library and not of the government.
De Wsob legt de verantwoordelijkheden van de verschillende partijen in het bibliotheekstelsel vast. Het collectiebeleid behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de bibliotheek en niet van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht ’Studenten lenen steeds meer en vaker’

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education about reports that students borrow more, and that first-generation students and MBO students are advancing less to higher education, including effects of leenaversie (aversion to borrowing) and migration background. The Minister confirms concern about declining MBO-to-HBO progression, explains the definition and trends of first-generation students, notes that leenaversie does not clearly affect progression, and promises a letter on access and equal opportunities.
In my letter on accessibility and equal opportunities, which I will send you before the budget debate, I will go into detail on the progression of MBO students to higher education.
In mijn brief over toegankelijkheid en gelijke kansen, die ik u voor de begrotingsbehandeling toezend, ga ik uitvoerig in op de doorstroom van mbo-studenten naar het hoger onderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat de gemeente Utrecht voornemens is een vorderingsbesluit in te zetten om basisschool de Klimroos te verplichten klaslokalen beschikbaar te

Three PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether he shares their view that an Islamic school threatens Dutch values and whether he will support a public primary school resisting Utrecht's plan to requisition classrooms for a new Islamic school. The minister rejected the premise, noted that schools commonly share buildings and that the municipality is responsible for housing, and said the municipality will keep talking with both school boards.
The municipality is responsible for housing schools.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor de huisvesting van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat het leenstelsel en bindend studieadvies zorgen voor psychische klachten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the loan system and binding study advice cause psychological complaints among students, and whether she would investigate student mental health and the financial effects of abolishing the basic grant. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to a working group on student welfare and ongoing monitoring, but rejected a direct causal link between the abolition of the basic grant and psychological problems.
Prevention and timely intervention in case of excessive or prolonged study pressure are therefore of great importance to me.
Preventie en tijdige interventie bij een te hoge of langdurige studiedruk acht ik daarom van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van der Molen over het bericht dat meer dan 100 Nederlandse studenten hun kamer moeten verlaten voor internationale studenten

Two CDA MPs asked ministers about reports that over 100 Dutch students must leave their rooms in the former Bijlmerbajes to make way for international students, and whether this is undesirable and what will be done. The ministers answered that the temporary housing is additional capacity once converted, that the affected students were told their stay was temporary, that they will be asked to help find alternatives, and that they know of no other similar cases.
Only once this location has been made suitable for international students do the rooms count as extra capacity on top of the existing supply.
Pas op het moment dat deze locatie geschikt is gemaakt voor internationale studenten, tellen de kamers als extra capaciteit op het bestaande aanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat zwangere vrouwen achtergesteld worden bij de aanvraag van NWO beurzen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether pregnant women applying for NWO research grants are disadvantaged, and whether regulation and data on this exist. The Minister said NWO does not intend to disadvantage pregnant applicants, offers case-by-case flexibility and will clarify this on its website, declined a separate study as unnecessary, and committed to reporting NWO's outcomes on gender balance to parliament.
NWO works towards this by pursuing gender diversity policy. NWO does not want to disadvantage women because of their pregnancy when applying for research funding.
NWO zet zich hiervoor in door het voeren van genderdiversiteitsbeleid. NWO wil geen vrouwen benadelen vanwege hun zwangerschap bij een aanvraag voor onderzoeksfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de voortdurende onduidelijkheid voor examenleerlingen van het VMBO Maastricht

An MP asked the Minister of Education about ongoing confusion for exam pupils at a Maastricht VMBO school over catch-up tests and communication with parents. The minister replied that the school has set up a helpdesk, answered about 70 questions that week, and that responsibility for individual questions lies with the school; a Frans summer-school lesson was missed once due to a teacher's sudden unavailability.
Because these are specific questions from individual pupils, responsibility for answering them lies with the school.
Omdat dit specifieke vragen van individuele leerlingen betreft ligt de verantwoordelijkheid voor de beantwoording hiervan bij de school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Minder efficiënt onderwijs is beter onderwijs’

MP Van Raan asked the education ministers about an article arguing that less efficient education is better education, touching on technology, globalisation, the purpose of schooling, and cost comparisons with other sectors. Minister Slob answered that the article has interesting analyses, that the curriculum review addresses broad social purposes, and that Baumol's cost-disease argument justifies deliberate budget choices.
The article contains some interesting analyses of the role of sociology and economics in thinking about education.
Het artikel bevat enkele interessante analyses over de rol van sociologie en economie in het denken over onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht explosie aantal eerstejaars economie en bedrijfskunde door buitenlandse studenten

An MP from the PVV asked whether the minister shares concern about a surge of foreign first-year students in economics and business studies crowding out Dutch students, and whether universities should be directed to prioritise Dutch applicants for numerus fixus programmes. The minister acknowledged the report, said she wants to avoid displacement of Dutch students, but noted equal-treatment law makes nationality-based distinctions legally difficult and that options are still being explored.
Under the right to equal treatment, it is for example not self-evidently possible to distinguish between Dutch or EEA students and students of another nationality.
Op grond van het recht op gelijke behandeling is het bijvoorbeeld niet vanzelfsprekend mogelijk onderscheid te maken tussen Nederlandse of EER-studenten en studenten met een andere nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Yesilgöz-Zegerius  over het bericht 'Wijkagent: 'Haal dat bord met Joodse huizen weg''

MPs Rutte and Yesilgöz asked whether a neighbourhood police officer in Amsterdam asked a business to remove a sign reading 'Open Joodse huizen', how police advise on Jewish and other religious symbols, and how they tackle antisemitism. The minister says police discussed security scenarios with the business, including removal of the sign as one option, outlines existing anti-discrimination screening and networks, and sees no current growth in antisemitism.
In this case the police considered security with the business, discussing various scenarios openly.
In onderhavige casus heeft de politie meegedacht met de ondernemer over de veiligheid, waarbij verschillende scenario's in openheid zijn besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rog en Slootweg over een weeffout in de wet aangaande de financiering van het Passend Onderwijs (herdruk)

Two CDA MPs asked the education minister about a funding flaw in the special education financing law that makes the Gelderse Vallei partnership bear disproportionate costs for youths released from the Deelen closed youth institution. The minister answered that the problem stems only partly from the residence-principle, that the Variawet amendment only partly helps, that the Inspectorate is studying the issue, and that she is willing to explore improvements to the funding system.
I am willing to explore what options there are for refining and improving the funding system for education at a school attached to a residential institution.

Ik ben bereid te verkennen welke mogelijkheden er zijn om te komen tot een verfijning en verbetering van de systematiek van bekostiging van onderwijs op een school die verbonden is aan een residentiële instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht het noodlijdende HAS in Den Bosch onder financieel toezicht staat

MP Futselaar (SP) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that HAS Hogeschool in Den Bosch is under financial supervision, questioning plans for new locations, student protection, the board's claim of no real financial crisis, and whether growth targets or budget cuts were responsible. The Minister confirmed the supervision, deferred the Inspectorate's assessment, declined to pre-empt consequences for students, attributed growth decisions to the institution under a lump-sum system, and promised to wait for an Inspectorate study of green higher education before considering action.
At the end of July 2018 I will receive the Inspectorate of Education's assessment of HAS Hogeschool's improvement plan.
Eind juli 2018 ontvang ik het oordeel van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs over het verbeterplan van HAS Hogeschool.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Tielen over het bericht 'Nieuwe imamopleiding, nu van Milli Görüs'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the planned private imam training by Milli Görüs in Amsterdam will start in September 2018, how it relates to the VU programme, whether Dutch-rooted imams are preferred, and whether civic values and inspection oversight apply to it. The minister replies that the private training falls outside recognised higher education, so the government has no view on its start or content and the Inspectorate has no oversight, while the VU exploration proceeds and the government supports Dutch-rooted imams.
I cannot impose obligations on institutions outside the recognised higher education system.
Ik kan geen verplichtingen opleggen aan instellingen buiten het bestel van erkend hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht dat één op de acht universitaire opleidingen hbo-studenten weert

An MP asked whether bridging programmes (schakelprogramma's) for HBO students entering university masters should be publicly funded, given reports that one in eight university programmes excludes HBO students. The minister agreed bridging is important, said these pathways are funded from institutions' lumpsum and will be considered in the funding review, and rejected the claim that this creates a wrong incentive.
As agreed in the sector agreement with the VSNU, I am including bridging programmes in my consideration of the funding review for higher education.
Zoals ik in het sectorakkoord met de VSNU heb afgesproken neem ik de schakeltrajecten mee in het nadenken over de bekostigingsherziening in het hoger onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özütok over de uitspraak van de rechtbank Limburg waarin staat dat ook ‘geslacht is niet kunnen worden vastgesteld’ in de geboorteakte mag komen te staan?

An MP asked the ministers whether, following a Limburg court ruling, a birth record may state that a child's sex could not be determined, and whether people should be able to register as gender-neutral. The minister said the question is on the agenda of the advisory commission on civil status, will consider next steps after the commission's findings and legal, financial and ICT implications, and gave no commitment to a legislative change yet.
The findings of the Commission will be taken into account when considering, together with my fellow ministers, possible further steps.
De bevindingen van de Commissie zullen worden betrokken bij het bezien, samen met mijn collega bewindspersonen, van mogelijke nader te zetten stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat één op de acht universitaire masteropleidingen hbo-studenten weert

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that one in eight university master's programmes effectively bars HBO graduates, including through limited bridging (schakel) programmes. The minister said bridging tracks are a legal duty of institutions, cited research showing about 16 percent of university master's intake followed one, and agreed to clarify communication and ask the Inspectorate to look into it.
I will also ask the Inspectorate to look into this.
Ik zal de Inspectie ook vragen hiernaar te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het te vroeg intreden van de zomerperiode voor het OV-studentenreisproduct van studenten in de regio Noord

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the summer period for the student public transport product, in which only discounted travel is allowed, should start later for students in the Noord region whose summer holiday begins later, and whether students should be compensated for extra travel costs. The Minister acknowledged the mismatch and that some students face extra costs, but declined to change the summer period or offer compensation, citing the generic nature of the product, administrative burden and contract changes needed with transport operators.

Providing financial compensation to students who still have to travel to their educational institution or internship address in the week of 16 to 20 July 2018 requires great implementation effort and entails administrative burdens.

Het verstrekken van een financiële compensatie aan studenten die in de week van 16 tot en met 20 juli 2018 nog naar hun onderwijsinstelling of stageadres moeten reizen, vergt uitvoeringstechnisch grote inspanningen en brengt administratieve lasten met zich mee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag op de werkvloer van artsen

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked how the government views a Medisch Contact survey finding that many doctors and medical students experienced sexual boundary-crossing behaviour at work, and why it persists, and what consequences it draws. The minister replied that such behaviour is unacceptable, that employers must have policies and complaint procedures, that few victims take further steps, and that the government will work with the sector on additional measures.
I will discuss with the sector further steps to address and prevent unwanted behaviour.
Ik ga met de sector nader in gesprek over aanvullende stappen om ongewenst gedrag tegen te gaan en te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht '#MeToo: artsen gaan niet vrijuit'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that many doctors and junior doctors have experienced sexual intimidation and that few victims report it, and about the lack of change since 2006. The government acknowledges the problem, points to employer responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, existing tools and the Werken in de zorg programme, and promises to talk with the sector about additional measures.
I, like the State Secretary of SZW, am working to ensure that employers in healthcare have an eye for this and act on it, as explained in the answer to questions 4 and 5.
Ik draag er, net als de Staatssecretaris van SZW, zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op vragen 4 en 5, aan bij dat werkgevers in de zorg hier oog voor hebben en werk van maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind en Özdil over de hogeschool Saxion, die een stuk over de Aramese genocide niet plaatst omdat er ophef en discussie over is in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt, Van der Molen, Voordewind and Özdil asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Saxion's decision not to publish a student interview on the Aramean genocide due to public controversy, questioning whether such concerns justify withholding publication and whether the institution should be told so. The Minister replied that controversy alone should not be a reason to withhold publication, that the editorial decision was made independently for safety reasons, that the article was later published internally and on Saxion's website, and that she sees no need for further action or a joint statement.
I am of the view that controversy and debate should not be reasons to avoid speaking or writing about a subject.
Ik ben van mening dat ophef en discussie geen redenen mogen zijn om over een onderwerp niet te spreken of te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Hogeschool censureert uit angst voor boze Turken’

An MP asks the Minister of Education whether a Saxion university of applied sciences self-censored an article on the Armenian genocide out of fear of Turkish reactions, and whether such censorship occurs at other institutions. The minister replies that the decision was made by the independent magazine's editor-in-chief, not the college board, that no structural self-censorship has been found, and that a new code of conduct addressing self-censorship takes effect on 1 October 2018.
I see no reason for this.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht 'Studenten de pineut: OV-kaart te vroeg ongeldig'

An MP asked why the student public transport card is invalid during the regular study week of 16-20 July 2018 in the north of the Netherlands, and whether the period could be aligned with regional study weeks, costed, or compensated. The minister answered that the summer period is a long-standing cost-control measure, that regional alignment would reduce efficiency and require costly system changes, that the contract with carriers sets the payment basis, and that compensating students is administratively burdensome, so no changes were planned.

Precisely because I know there is also a wish in your House to save on the student travel product, I see insufficient reason, given the above, to make changes to the summer period of the student travel product.

Juist omdat ik weet dat er vanuit uw Kamer ook een wens leeft om op het studentenreisproduct te besparen, zie ik als gevolg van het bovenstaande onvoldoende aanleiding om aanpassingen te maken in de zomerperiode van het studentenreisproduct.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de open brief aan de Minister over bestuurders die alles maar vertrouwelijke maken

An MP asked the Education Minister how she would respond to an open letter complaining that university boards classify documents and meetings as confidential, whether access to such documents matters for oversight of boards, and whether she would set rules on transparency. The minister said transparency is important under the open-unless-closed principle, that existing law (Wet Openbaarheid Bestuur) applies, that she sees no need for extra rules, and that the debate belongs within institutions.
I consider it very important that institutions of higher education operate transparently.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat instellingen voor hoger onderwijs transparant opereren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de helft van de mbo’ers spullen moet kopen die ze vervolgens niet gebruiken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that about half of mbo students must buy books and materials they never use, raising costs and asking about controls, the scale per institution, and a forthcoming guidance document on school costs. The minister agreed unused books are undesirable, announced a handreiking (guidance) on school costs with the MBO Raad and JOB, said no checks on necessity are carried out, and noted the Inspectorate will supervise school costs under the guidance.
I believe it should be regularly evaluated whether prescribed books are actually used and the book lists adjusted accordingly.
Ik vind dat regelmatig dient te worden geëvalueerd of voorgeschreven boeken daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt en de boekenlijsten daarop worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de verantwoording over het profileringsfonds door hogescholen en universiteiten

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the education minister whether combining funds for students with disabilities and student board members in one profileringsfonds is unclear, whether institutions should better communicate the fund, and why institutions do not publish required fund data. The minister defended the single fund, agreed to raise awareness and consult institutions, acknowledged non-compliant reporting, and promised to address it in a forthcoming monitor.
I find it undesirable that institutions do not publish profileringsfonds data in accordance with the Rjo.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat instellingen niet conform de Rjo gegevens rondom het profileringsfonds publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over grote problemen bij ROC Top

An MP asked the education minister about reported serious problems at ROC TOP, a small vocational college in Amsterdam, and whether competition with ROC van Amsterdam and a planned reorganisation served students or the institution. The minister answered by relaying the college's denial of the press reports, stating that finances are secure and that the reorganisation aims to better prepare students, while calling for cooperation between colleges.
I have contacted the Executive Board of ROC TOP about this.
Ik heb hiervoor contact opgenomen met het College van Bestuur van ROC TOP.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat bijna de helft van alle mbo-scholieren zegt dat ze boeken en materiaal moeten kopen voor hun opleiding die ze daarna nooit meer gebruiken

An MP asks the minister about a survey showing that nearly half of mbo students must buy books and materials they never use, and whether the government will act on school costs. The minister points to a joint handreiking on school costs with the MBO Raad and JOB, Inspectorate oversight, and student council consent rights, agrees the practice is undesirable, and says institutions must be frugal, but offers no new binding measures.
I share that view. It is undesirable for an institution to prescribe books that remain unused.
Ik deel die mening. Het is ongewenst als een instelling boeken voorschrijft die ongebruikt blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens en Van den Hul over de studentenstop bij zorgopleidingen terwijl er een personeelstekort is in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van den Hul asked why nursing schools impose an intake cap (studentenstop) while the care sector faces staff shortages, whether the vicious circle of shortages and too few placements is recognised, whether stipends for placement supervision are being negotiated, and whether trainees are used as full-time staff. The minister replied that hogescholen are dropping the numerus fixus for nursing from 2019/2020, that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds are the instruments used, that no negotiation on supervision fees is taking place, and that using trainees as full staff is undesirable and left to schools and care institutions to resolve.
I financially support this programme with the SectorplanPlus.
Dit programma ondersteun ik financieel met het SectorplanPlus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht ‘Vicieuze cirkel: groot tekort aan verpleegkundigen, maar de opleidingen hanteren studentenstops omdat er geen stageplaatsen zijn’

GroenLinks MPs asked the health and education ministers why the nursing shortage persists despite student admission stops caused by insufficient internship places, and about internship funding, student deployment as staff, and the numerus fixus. The minister answered that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds address the shortage, that most universities of applied sciences are dropping the numerus fixus from 2019/2020, and that the admission budget for the current year cannot be increased.
Compensating staff shortages with the full deployment of interns is not desirable.
Het compenseren van personeelstekorten met de volwaardige inzet van stagiairs is niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Groothuizen over de uitvoering van het Besluit zorgvuldig onderzoek verweesde werken

Two MPs from D66 asked the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Justice and Security how Dutch archives may reproduce and publish copyrighted works, including online, and how the orphan works decree applies, in response to reports of municipal archives taking photos offline after a court ruling. The minister answers by setting out the copyright exceptions for archives and the orphan works diligence procedure, notes that no estimate exists for Dutch archives, and points to the EU EnDOW project and a pending EU proposal for extended collective licences as ways to reduce the administrative burden.
For the online publication of copyrighted standalone photographs, archives must in principle obtain permission from the relevant rightsholders.
Voor de online beschikbaarstelling van auteursrechtelijk beschermde losse foto's dienen archieven dus in beginsel toestemming van de desbetreffende rechthebbenden te verkrijgen.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht: ‘Basisschool wil geen homorol in eindmusical vanwege geloof leerling’

MPs Heerema and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (VVD) asked whether a Hengelo primary school's ban on same-sex roles in the final musical, reportedly due to a Jehovah's Witness pupil's faith, was consistent with the attainment targets on sexual diversity. The minister answered that schools have discretion within the attainment targets, that she would not assess this individual case, and that the school is itself holding a dialogue on the issue.
It is not for me to assess the school principal's conduct in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om de handelwijze van de schoolleider in deze individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over een basisschool die homorollen schrapt uit de musical vanwege het geloof van een leerling

An MP asks the ministers how they judge a Hengelo primary school director who removed same-sex roles from a graduation musical because of a pupil's Jehovah's Witness background, and whether children must be prepared for the Dutch society's acceptance of homosexuality. The minister answers that school leaders have discretion within the kerndoelen on sexual diversity, does not assess this individual case, and considers the matter a debate for the school to resolve.
It is not for me to assess the conduct of the school leader in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om de handelwijze van de schoolleider in deze individuele casus te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haersma Buma en Pechtold over het bericht ‘Veel trots, weinig kennis’

MPs Van Haersma Buma and Pechtold asked about a Historisch Nieuwsblad survey showing weak Dutch historical knowledge and its implications for national identity and the curriculum. The minister answered that no comparable ministry research exists, lists regeerakkoord measures on historical awareness and curriculum review, and reports the minister's own quiz results.
Question 8: Are you willing to take the history test yourself as well and publish the results?
Vraag 8 Bent u bereid de geschiedenistest zelf ook te maken en de resultaten ervan te openbaren?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het artikel 'Populariteit Psychologie en Kunstmatige Intelligentie leidt tot studentenstop'

An MP asked the minister whether a numerus fixus at Utrecht's psychology programme, linked to popularity of English-taught programmes, harms accessibility and whether action is needed. The minister denied a link to English-taught programmes, rejected the 'weak students' framing, and defended a temporary numerus fixus for quality reasons while declining further action.
I am not a supporter of numerus fixus, because it leads to a restriction of accessibility.
Ik ben geen voorstander van numeri fixi, omdat het leidt tot een beperking van de toegankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat hbo’ers opnieuw niet warm lopen voor verkiezingen

Futselaar (SP) asked the Education Minister how to respond to low turnout in higher-vocational (hbo) student council elections and whether time constraints, the sector agreement minimum hours, and attendance under WHW article 10.39 are adequate. The minister said facilitation was already strengthened by law and sector agreements, that further talks were not needed beyond a national help desk, and that institutions and councils must agree attendance arrangements.

So I see no reason to enter into talks. However, I am facilitating that for specific questions from participation bodies within the quality agreements, through a national help desk set up by ISO, LSVb, the Vereniging Hogescholen and VSNU.

Ik zie dus geen aanleiding om in gesprek te gaan. Wel faciliteer ik dat voor specifieke vragen van medezeggenschapsorganen in het kader van de kwaliteitsafspraken door ISO, LSVb, de Vereniging Hogescholen en VSNU een landelijk loket wordt ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Wie koopt bunker van nazi-topman Seyss-Inquart?'

An MP asked whether the Julianabunker (Seyss-Inquart's command bunker, a rijksmonument) and its cultural-historical value will be protected when the state sells it, and why it is not maintained to standard. The government says the monument's heritage value is protected under the Erfgoedwet and the Nota van Uitgangspunten, that sale goes by open tender with heritage-respecting plans, and that storm damage repair is delayed by a power-supply split.
The repair of this damage will take place soon, after connection to the regular power network.
Het herstel van deze schade zal binnenkort plaatsvinden, na aansluiting op het reguliere stroomnetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht dat ‘Toelatingstoetsen niet zorgen voor betere leraren’

MP Van den Hul asked the Minister of Education whether research showing that admission tests for teacher training did not improve intake quality, and the teacher shortage, should change the government's stance on admission requirements. The minister called the research conclusions premature, said evaluation is due in 2019 and that she will decide on changes only after it, citing positive early signals.
Following the Trouw article, I committed to critically studying the underlying research and responding with a reaction.
Ik heb naar aanleiding van het artikel in Trouw toegezegd dat ik het onderliggende onderzoek kritisch zou bestuderen en met een reactie zou komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik- Faber over de museumtramlijn te Amsterdam

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the future of Amsterdam's heritage museum tram line, which depends on volunteers and may be displaced by housing development, and whether the municipality and transport operators bear responsibility and should support it. The minister said the loss would be regrettable, that the municipality should support the foundation without excessive demands, and that she would facilitate expert support and funding options while noting the municipality awaits the Raad van State appeal outcome.
The municipality can indeed be expected to support the EMA in this and not to impose unnecessarily heavy requirements.
Van de gemeente mag wel verwacht worden dat zij de EMA daarbij ondersteunt en geen onnodig zware eisen stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht 'Kunstmarkt schrikt van EU-regel tegen witwassen'

An MP asked the government about the EU anti-money-laundering directive lowering the cash-and-bank threshold for art and antiques dealers' customer due diligence to EUR 10,000, the reasons, implementation room, and burden. The Finance Minister answered that the threshold lowering and extension to buyers and freeports will be implemented within 18 months with limited national room, that regulatory burden will be assessed, and that the art trade will be involved, without a quantified impact assessment.
The room for national discretion in implementing the provisions concerning the art trade is therefore limited.
De ruimte voor een eigen invulling bij het implementeren van de bepalingen die betrekking hebben op de kunsthandel is daardoor beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en El Yassini over de berichten dat in hbo en mbo de ICT-opleidingen verouderd en ondermaats zijn

MPs Tielen and El Yassini asked the minister about press reports that ICT programmes in hbo and mbo are outdated and underperforming, and about the consequences for the labour market. The minister acknowledged the signal, pointed to curriculum renewal via SBB, Dcypher, regional funds and accreditation standards, and said a shortage of ICT workers is a real challenge without a single easy fix.
As I already indicated in my answers to written questions from member Van der Molen (submitted 2 May 2018), I take this signal very seriously.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van der Molen (ingezonden op 2 mei 2018) al aangaf, neem ik dit signaal zeer serieus.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat voor het eerst in haar geschiedenis de Universiteit van Amsterdam meer aanmeldingen heeft van studenten met een buitenlandse vooropleiding dan m

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked whether the University of Amsterdam receiving more applications from foreign-educated than Dutch-educated students raises student housing shortages, and asked about housing policy, corporation finances and a planned cap on international student housing. The minister answered that applications are not enrolments, that a joint action plan on student housing is being prepared, and that the government will not limit international student intake or housing, though the answers are largely general.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht 'Britse universiteiten zoeken samenwerking'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the Northumbria University satellite campus at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences and about how British universities can establish branches in the Netherlands. The minister said the campus is a pilot with about 50 students, that the government has little involvement, and promised further study of barriers to foreign institutions, pending Brexit outcomes.
As I already indicated in the General Consultation on Competitiveness on 23 May, I find it interesting that campuses of British universities are coming to the continent.
Zoals ik al aangaf in het Algemeen Overleg Concurrentievermogen op 23 mei jl., vind ik het interessant dat er campussen van Britse universiteiten naar het vasteland komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Özütok en Van den Hul over de verkiezingsprocedure voor leden van het United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW)

Three MPs asked why the Netherlands did not nominate a candidate for the UN CEDAW committee and whether it would do so in future. The minister replied that suitable candidates were unavailable or did not meet the independence and expertise requirements, and that the government will reconsider a nomination in a future round.
On the basis of the criteria mentioned earlier, the cabinet will again consider nominating a candidate in a next round.
Op basis van eerdergenoemde criteria zal het kabinet een volgende ronde opnieuw overwegen een kandidaat te nomineren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat een openbare school in Rijswijk de lesinhoud aanpast aan de ramadan en docenten vertellen welke islamitische gebeden verplicht zijn

Three PVV MPs asked whether the minister knows that a Rijswijk public school adjusts lessons to Ramadan and tells teachers which Islamic prayers are obligatory, how many schools do so, and whether the minister will act to keep Islamic influence out of public education. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report, said he does not know how many schools adjust programmes, and rejected intervention, stating that schools must meet attainment targets and may schedule parts of their programme themselves while taking pupil background into account.
Schools are obliged to provide education in line with the core objectives and the attainment targets.
Scholen zijn gehouden onderwijs te verzorgen in overeenstemming met de kerndoelen en de eindtermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over de voorgenomen sluiting van HOVO in Limburg per 1 mei 2018

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Hogeschool Zuyd's decision to end HOVO (higher education for older people) in Limburg from 1 May 2018, covering its funding, causes, comparisons with other provinces and the government's levers. The minister answered that HOVO is a non-subsidised activity that must be cost-covering, that the decision followed failed attempts to make Limburg's programme self-financing, and that the government has no direct responsibility for non-formal courses, pointing to a forthcoming letter on lifelong learning.
I am not responsible for the course offerings or for ensuring a regionally comprehensive course supply for older people or other target groups.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor het cursorisch aanbod en de zorg voor een regionaal dekkend cursusaanbod voor ouderen of andere doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Wilders en De Graaf over het bericht dat de burgemeester van Heerenveen heeft gepleit voor verplicht moskeebezoek voor scholieren

PVV MPs asked the education minister whether it is appropriate that the mayor of Heerenveen proposed compulsory mosque visits for pupils, whether schools may require them, and whether the minister would issue guidance or ask VNG to tell mayors to stay out of curriculum matters. The minister replied that excursions in the regular curriculum are in principle compulsory, parents may request exemption from the school board, schools have freedom of education, and no circular or VNG request is needed.
Question 3: Are you aware how many primary schools require pupils to attend a mosque visit? Answer 3: No.
Vraag 3 Is het u bekend hoeveel scholen binnen het primair onderwijs scholieren verplichten om aanwezig te zijn bij een bezoek aan een moskee? Antwoord 3 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht ‘Rekenkamer: OCW controleert slecht op cultuursubsidies’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why OCW failed to enforce four performance requirements on cultural subsidies, as the Court of Audit found, and whether subsidies would be reclaimed and the policy changed. The minister said the requirements were only partly applicable, that subsidies were budget-based and not tied to specific performance, that the Court of Audit did not find subsidies wrongly granted, and that the specific requirements are no longer separately included in decisions, while promising to answer before the 2017 closing budget law debate.

By including only a few specific performance ambitions as performance requirements in the grant decision, the impression can be created that those performances are more important than the other performances the institution itself intended.

Door in de verleningsbeschikking slechts enkele specifieke prestatie-ambities op te nemen als prestatie-eis, kan de indruk worden gewekt dat die prestaties belangrijker zijn dan de overige door de instelling zelf voorgenomen prestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het beschermingsprogramma wederopbouw 1959-1965

A VVD MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why many post-war (wederopbouw) buildings outside the 1959-1965 protection programme remain unprotected, why iconic buildings like the St. Petrus Bandenkerk and Fatimahuis are not safeguarded, whether municipalities should be able to nominate municipal monuments for national status, and whether consultation with heritage actors was adequate. The Minister replied that the government uses a deliberately selective, programme-based designation policy, that consultation was extensive, that she sees no reason for renewed talks, and that municipalities are involved whenever national monuments are designated in their area.

For the 1959–1965 protection programme, a great deal of time was in fact set aside for consultation with the heritage sector, municipalities, provinces and heritage organisations such as Heemschut and the Cuypers Genootschap.
Bij het beschermingsprogramma 1959–1965 is juist veel tijd ingeruimd voor overleg met het erfgoedveld, gemeenten, provincies en erfgoedinstellingen zoals Heemschut en het Cuypers Genootschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Kröger over het bericht 'Ryanair reveals worst gender pay gap in airline industry'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about reports that Ryanair has a very large gender pay gap and whether KLM and Transavia, in which the state is a shareholder, have similar gaps. The minister said the Ryanair situation cannot be addressed specifically, offered to suggest a quick scan to KLM and Transavia, and said the government has no legal means to force gender balance across functions.
We do not have specific information about a gender pay gap at KLM and Transavia.
Wij beschikken niet over specifieke informatie over een loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen bij KLM en Transavia.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht dat mbo- en hbo-studenten onvoldoende cybersecurity kennis en vaardigheden aanleren

An MP asked the education minister whether ICT and cybersecurity curricula in mbo and hbo are outdated, how accreditation and inspection address this, and whether teacher shortages and industry cooperation are being addressed. The minister acknowledges the concern, points to accreditation standards, inspection practice, Dcypher mapping of cybersecurity programmes and the need for closer industry ties, without committing to a specific new step.
I take this signal very seriously and find it very unpleasant that these students feel they are learning knowledge and skills that are outdated.
Ik neem dit signaal zeer serieus en vind het erg vervelend dat deze studenten het gevoel hebben dat ze kennis en vaardigheden leren die verouderd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gezellig. Cursussen koran voorlezen op de Vrije Universiteit gescheiden voor mannen en vrouwen’

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that Koran reading courses at the VU were segregated by sex and whether the government would pressure the university to stop such segregation. The minister replied that equality of men and women applies, that the VU's rules forbid segregation, that the student association moved the courses to an external location after the university intervened, and that he sees no reason for further talks with the VU.
As soon as the VU received signals about this, they entered into discussion with the student association and indicated that such segregation is not permitted at the VU.
Zodra de VU hier signalen over ontving, zijn ze in gesprek gegaan met de studentenvereniging en is aangegeven dat dergelijke segregatie op de VU niet is toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Omtzigt over het onderzoek naar paasvuren

MPs Von Martels and Omtzigt asked why RIVM is studying Easter bonfire emissions, who commissioned it, its cost, and whether Easter fires are intangible heritage. The government answered that RIVM is updating the national emissions register under international obligations, estimated Easter fire PM10 emissions at about 10% of stove emissions, and budgeted 6,800 euro for a sizing study before any decision on inclusion.
Therefore it was decided to further determine the size of the source in 2018.
Daarom is besloten om in 2018 de grootte van de bron nader te gaan bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij-instromers die binnen een jaar hun lesbevoegdheid halen

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked how a one-year pabo teacher training run by LOI Hogeschool for career changers fits with the regular four-year route and the accreditation and suitability requirements, and how its quality is ensured. The ministers answered that the programme is NVAO-accredited (valid to 2021), is the only such one-year route found, and that the training includes all required outcomes, so teaching requirements are not being compromised.
It is a 240-credit programme. No exemptions are granted.
Het is een opleiding van 240 studiepunten. Er worden geen vrijstellingen verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over alweer een ernstige mishandeling bij het Groningse studentencorps Vindicat atque polit

An MP asked the education minister about a serious assault at the Groningen student corps Vindicat atque Polit, which failed to report it under the conduct code, and whether the university should cut ties with the corps. The minister said the corps breached its own code, that the university and hogeschool withdrew bestuursbeurzen, and that accreditation conditions and possible sanctions remain under review.
Vindicat atque Polit has therefore not adhered to the conduct code it signed itself.
Vindicat atque Polit heeft zich hiermee niet aan de, door hen zelf ondertekende, gedragscode gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over de continuïteit van onderwijs van asielkinderen door de sluiting van het AZC Goes

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the State Secretary and Minister whether the closure of the Goes asylum reception centre, and the forced relocation of families with school-age children, was communicated in time and whether education continuity is protected. The State Secretary answered that the closure is a justified capacity decision, that schools and parents were informed promptly, and that COA plans relocations during school holidays to protect continuity, without committing to a new meeting with COA.
However, I do not consider this to outweigh the (societal) costs of maintaining too many reception places.
Ik vind dit echter niet opwegen tegen de (maatschappelijke) kosten die gepaard gaan met het in stand houden van teveel opvangplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over verkiezingen voor opleidingscommissies

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is a concern that elected programme committees are still the exception rather than the norm at many institutions, and whether she will engage institutions to make elections the standard. The Minister answered that the law requires elections unless another method is agreed with the works council, noted that fewer than half of surveyed universities chose an alternative, and said she would act only if she received signals that consultation is not taking place.
The legal norm is that composition takes place through elections, unless after consultation with the works council a different method of composition than election has been determined.
De wettelijke norm die hiervoor geldt is dat de samenstelling door verkiezingen plaatsvindt, tenzij na overleg met de medezeggenschap een andere wijze van samenstelling dan verkiezing is bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geluk-Poortvliet over het bericht ‘Heemschut is verbijsterd over veiling stoelen Vredespaleis’

MP Geluk-Poortvliet (CDA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Heemschut's objection to the auction of furnishings from the Peace Palace and whether heritage protection or agreed documentation applied. The minister confirmed the palace is on a showcase list of interior ensembles but said this gives no legal protection to movable items, that the RCE gave advice rather than a binding agreement, and that the owner has postponed the auction to seek a solution with the RCE.
I have asked the RCE to again consult with the owner/manager to see what is possible to do justice as much as possible to the valuable interior ensemble.
Ik heb de RCE gevraagd opnieuw in overleg te gaan met de eigenaar/beheerder om te bezien wat er mogelijk is om zoveel mogelijk recht tew doen aan het waardevolle interieurensemble.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de publicatie "Risicomanagement voor collecties" van de Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed

An MP asked the ministers about the RCE publication on collection risk management, incident registration in DICE, the end of the Mondriaan Fund security grant, and the tracing of stolen art and antiques. The minister answered that collection holders are primarily responsible for security, that DICE registration is voluntary so incident numbers are likely undercounted, and that the Erfgoedinspectie oversees security in state collections.
Registration of incidents in DICE is not mandatory and not all collection managers are connected.
Registratie van incidenten in DICE is niet verplicht en niet alle collectiebeheerders zijn aangesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de ongelijke kansen voor kinderen met een migratieachtergrond in het Nederlandse onderwijssysteem

An MP asked the minister whether the OECD report showing unequal educational opportunities for students with an immigrant background is recognised, what causes it, and how the government will respond, including to proposals for broad first-year classes and the redistribution of disadvantage funding. The minister answered that the report shows Dutch immigrant-background students perform above OECD averages on resilience, cites the Gelijke Kansen programme, DUO mapping of broad brugklassen, and a new CBS indicator for redistributing disadvantage funds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Betalen per studiepunt houdt studenten binnenboord’

MP Tielen asked the Minister of Education whether early Windesheim findings on the flexstuderen pay-per-credit experiment are encouraging, whether other institutions can join, and whether an extra intake moment can be created. The Minister called the findings relevant, said more institutions could join if interest is confirmed, but that the experiment is bound by its legal maximum duration.
I will ask the Vereniging Hogescholen (VH) and the Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU) about the potential interest of institutions.
Ik zal bij de Vereniging Hogescholen (VH) en de Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU) navraag doen naar de potentiële interesse van instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema en Fritsma over het bericht dat ambassades in Nigeria en India zoveel mogelijk studenten naar Nederland willen halen

PVV MPs Beertema and Fritsma asked the Minister of Education about reports that Dutch embassies in Nigeria and India were recruiting students for Dutch universities, and whether this worsens capacity pressure and amounts to a brain drain. The minister confirmed the reports, said capacity problems are not widespread but that she is examining how institutions can gain more influence over student inflow, and defended international student recruitment as beneficial while promising a forthcoming internationalisation policy letter.
I am currently examining what options exist to ensure that institutions – where needed – can exert more influence over the inflow of students.
Ik onderzoek momenteel welke mogelijkheden er zijn om te zorgen dat instellingen – daar waar dat nodig is – meer invloed kunnen uitoefenen op de instroom van studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over onbetaalde banen in de culturele sector

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the high share of unpaid positions and volunteers in the cultural sector, and whether budget cuts displace paid workers. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the labour market agenda, Fair Practice Code and model regulations for volunteers, but mostly declined to take direct action and left arrangements to the autonomous institutions and social partners.
Cultural institutions are autonomous enterprises with decentralised collective labour agreements.
Culturele instellingen zijn autonome ondernemingen met decentrale cao's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Kuik over sugardating

MPs Van der Staaij and Kuik asked whether sugardating platforms that connect young women with wealthy men for sex amount to illegal prostitution or trafficking, whether they should be regulated or investigated, and whether municipalities can act against their advertising. The state secretary answered that no specific permit is needed, existing criminal law (art. 273f) suffices against exploitation, consultations with site operators are constructive, no indications of exploitation are known to the prosecution service, and no further investigation or new municipal powers are planned.
I currently see no reason to conduct further research into this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om hier verder onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Futselaar over onrecht als gevolg van de invoering van het leenstelsel voor studenten

MPs Bisschop and Futselaar asked the Minister of Education about the financial effects on 17-year-old students and their parents of the student loan system, comparing cases before and after the coalition agreement, and about how the government handled the overlap between child benefits and student finance for minors. The minister answered with tables showing that after the agreement a two-parent household loses about 1,389 euro per year (50 euro less than before) and a single-parent household about 2,280 euro (945 euro less than before), and said that 17- and 18-year-old students receive identical support and that the issue was discussed during the legislative process, while agreeing to answer before the plenary debate.
Yes, I am willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat hbo-medezeggenschap meer tijd en geld eist

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that higher-education works council members are underpaid and under-resourced, and whether students should get at least twelve paid hours per week. The Minister said the matter is for boards and councils to settle, pointed to the April 2018 quality-agreement minimums of 8 hours per week for large institutions and 4 for smaller ones, and cited reporting and NVAO review mechanisms.
It is up to the institution's board and the works council together to take the necessary measures for this.
Het is aan het bestuur van de instelling en de medezeggenschap samen om hier de benodigde maatregelen voor te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over zij instromers

Two MPs asked the ministers about career-entrant teachers who obtain their teaching qualification within a year, after a TV programme showed trainees teaching alone after five weeks. The ministers replied that career-entrants must qualify within two years under individual support, that the TV programme's one-year course is a separate intensive pabo track where trainees are not fully alone in the classroom, and that they will not weaken teaching standards.
We have no plans to tamper with the requirements of the teaching profession.
Wij hebben geen plannen om te tornen aan de eisen van het leraarschap.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste 100 dagen van het kabinet

An MP asked the government about measures to give teachers and other public-sector professionals more recognition, funding, burn-out figures and a plan against workload and staff shortages. The ministers answered by listing a €720 million structural package, a €237 million workload deal, a guidance brochure and a teacher-shortage action plan, but gave limited detail on other sectors.
For recognition, support and room for professionals in primary education, a structural amount of €720 million has been included in the coalition agreement.
Voor waardering, ondersteuning en ruimte is ten behoeve van de vakmensen in het primair onderwijs een bedrag van structureel € 720 miljoen in het Regeerakkoord opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de invloed van de fossiele industrie op de inhoud van het onderwijs

An MP asked whether fossil fuel industry involvement, such as Shell teacher training and industry-supplied teaching materials, risks influencing the content of education, and whether industry representatives shape the technology curriculum. The minister answered that schools are responsible for their own sponsorship and material choices under a sponsorship covenant, that curriculum consultation is open to all, and that the government will remind schools of the covenant rules.
The school is responsible for the quality and content of education. This also includes the school's sponsorship policy.
De school is verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en inhoud van het onderwijs. Daaronder valt ook het sponsorbeleid van de school.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Vertrouwenspersonen #metoo-slachtoffers gedwarsboomd door werkgevers'

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked about reports that employers obstruct workplace confidential advisers (vertrouwenspersonen) supporting #metoo victims, and how the government will strengthen their position. The State Secretary called the figures worrying, stressed adviser independence under the Arbowet, and pointed to a forthcoming study and policy response before summer.
A confidential adviser must indeed be sufficiently independent to be able to support victims of unwanted behaviour in confidence.
Een vertrouwenspersoon moet immers in voldoende mate onafhankelijk zijn om in vertrouwen slachtoffers van ongewenst gedrag bij te kunnen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht ‘Departementen blokkeren fusie van ZonMW en NWO’

MP Bruins asks why the planned merger of ZonMW into NWO was reportedly blocked by the ministries, and whether cultural differences justify stopping it. The ministers answer that the statutory integration was dropped as the wrong instrument, that the aims remain via an updated cooperation agreement from 2019, and that the transition has cost about EUR 6 million to 2017.
During the transition process we concluded that a change of law is not the right instrument to achieve this objective.
Gedurende het transitieproces zijn wij tot de conclusie gekomen dat een wetswijziging niet het juiste instrument is om deze doelstelling te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de KNAW waarschuwt dat ‘ongewenst’ onderzoek ook nodig is

An SP MP asked the minister whether the KNAW's warning about research independence, its proposal for a joint independence declaration, and the risk of funding constraints on innovative research warranted government action. The minister declined new measures, relying on self-regulation and the existing code of conduct, while noting extra research funding in the coalition agreement.
I see no reason to take steps.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om stappen te gaan ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de WUR een video wist na druk van een vastgoedbedrijf

An SP MP asked whether Wageningen University removing a lecture video after pressure from a property developer undermines academic freedom and what measures will stop firms influencing course content. The minister answered that the video was restored, that curriculum is the university's responsibility, and that she sees no reason for further measures.
It is the responsibility of Wageningen University to determine the content of education and to set the curriculum
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van Wageningen Universiteit om de inhoud van het onderwijs vast te stellen en om het curriculum te bepalen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over diversiteit in de theatersector

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Council for Culture's suggestion of a diversity quota in theatre and whether talent should outweigh skin colour. The minister said the quota is only being studied for effectiveness within the wider cultural policy advice, that diversity should be promoted, and that considering team composition in hiring is not positive discrimination.
The Council advises examining the effectiveness of a quota for cultural diversity at theatre organisations in its theatre sector advice.
De Raad adviseert in het sectoradvies theater de effectiviteit te onderzoeken van een quotum voor culturele diversiteit bij theaterorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Arno Rutte over het bericht ‘Cybersecurity hoogleraren vrezen dat Nederland digitaal onder water komt te staan’ en het bijbehorende position paper

MPs Tielen and Rutte asked why the Netherlands invests little in cybersecurity research compared with German centres, whether talent is leaving, and how a knowledge fund and chairs would fit government priorities. The minister replied that cybersecurity is a priority in the coalition agreement and national agenda, that Dutch research is of high quality, and that talks with ministries and stakeholders on a research impulse and a possible institute are ongoing, with a joint letter promised in spring.
I will inform the House about this in the spring through a joint letter with these departments.
Ik zal hierover de Kamer in het voorjaar informeren via een gezamenlijke brief met deze departementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat de kaarten voor U2 binnen enkele minuten waren uitverkocht

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew concert tickets for U2 sold out within minutes while hundreds were offered on resale site Seatwave, and what they would do about resale practices and a motion on ticket profiteering. The ministers said resale is under study with the sector, cannot guarantee LiveNation does not sell directly to resale sites, point to the consumer authority ACM, and refer to a separate letter on implementing the motion.
I cannot guarantee that LiveNation does not sell tickets directly to secondary ticket websites.
Ik kan niet garanderen dat LiveNation kaarten niet direct verkoopt aan secundaire ticketwebsites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de carrière van postdocs van toeval aan elkaar hangt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the career of postdocs depends on chance, citing internationalisation, output-based funding and temporary contracts, and asked what steps would strengthen postdoc positions and whether flexible contracts should disappear. The minister answered that working conditions are the employer's responsibility, that the cao target of reducing variable and temporary contracts from 30% to 22% is welcome, that she has no data on postdocs leaving science, and that she sees no reason to doubt postdocs' work ethic, without committing to new measures.
How the environmental factors affect working conditions is the responsibility of the employer.
Hoe de omgevingsfactoren uitwerken op de arbeidsvoorwaarden is de verantwoordelijkheid van de werkgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de verengelsing in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the push to make English the language of instruction and governance at Dutch universities, including TU/e, and how student and staff co-determination bodies are involved in language decisions. The minister reaffirmed that there are few compelling reasons for English-only governance, said co-determination bodies have instemmingsrecht over the OER and the university has sought consent for its language code, and promised to urge university umbrella organisations to take responsibility.
When foreign students and teachers feel co-responsible for governance and co-determination, I greatly appreciate that.
Wanneer buitenlandse studenten en docenten zich mede verantwoordelijk voelen voor bestuur en medezeggenschap, heb ik daar grote waardering voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bergkamp over het behoud van het religieus erfgoed

MPs Dik-Faber and Bergkamp asked the minister about preserving religious heritage, including church vacancy, restoration priorities, long-term funding for large monuments and sustainability measures. The minister agreed that local church visions are important, earmarked 13.5 million euro for them, promised a new multi-year instrument for large monuments to be presented this autumn, and described existing sustainability initiatives.
I therefore endorse the Ecorys recommendation on large monuments and will work with the sector to develop a new instrument, which I will present to your House this autumn.
Ik onderschrijf dus de aanbeveling van Ecorys over grote monumenten en zal met het veld een nieuw instrument uitwerken en dit najaar aan uw Kamer presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Kwint over het subsidiëren van privaat onderwijs door gemeenten

MPs Alkaya and Kwint asked whether municipal and national subsidies for international schools, aimed at attracting foreign investors and expats, are a responsible use of public money compared with regular schools. The minister replied that foreign investment mostly creates jobs for Dutch workers, that the subsidies were a one-off measure to reduce international school waiting lists, and that funds were not given directly to a private school group.
The central government did not provide any funds to the Amity Education Group. That was a decision of the municipality of Amsterdam.
Het Rijk heeft geen middelen beschikbaar gesteld aan de Amity Education Group. Dat betreft een besluit van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht in het Dagblad van het Noorden van 6 februari jl. “Het Noorden laat veel subsidie voor Rijksmonumenten liggen”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why Rijksmonument loans from the Nationaal Restauratiefonds are used less in the periphery than in the Randstad, and requested data on loans and average amounts. The minister explained the regional differences by weaker economic demand for non-residential monuments outside urban zones, provided loan figures, and committed to asking the fund to raise awareness where large restorations stall.
The Ministry of OCW will ask the Restauratiefonds to bring this message more to attention when large-scale restorations and repurposings struggle to get off the ground.
Het Ministerie van OCW zal het Restauratiefonds verzoeken om deze boodschap nog meer onder de aandacht te brengen, wanneer grootschalige restauraties en herbestemmingen moeizaam van de grond komen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Beckerman over kwaliteit van en toezicht op de archeologie nav advertentie Volkskrant d.d. 26 januari ´Creatief met archeologie, tips voor projectontwikkelaars´

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an advertisement advising developers how to avoid archaeological obligations, and about oversight of archaeology by municipalities and inspectorates. The minister denied that unlawful excavation is widespread, said no structural oversight gap exists, but acknowledged definitional confusion and some quality and backlog issues, and promised further case study and monitoring.
I have no reason to think that this system does not meet its requirements.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om te denken dat dit stelsel niet voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht op de website nos.nl van 28 januari jl. “Zorgen over Joods cultureel erfgoed buiten grote steden”

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about concerns that Jewish cultural heritage outside the big cities is hard to maintain and repurpose, and whether continuity of protection is at risk. The minister acknowledges the difficulty for religious heritage, points to existing monument status and subsidies, and says Jewish heritage will be included in a forthcoming policy letter and a heritage exploration.
I will therefore also pay specific attention to Jewish heritage in my policy letter 'Erfgoed Telt', which I will send to your House in the spring.
Ik zal daarom ook specifieke aandacht besteden aan het Joods erfgoed in mijn beleidsbrief «Erfgoed Telt», die ik in het voorjaar naar uw Kamer stuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen inzake het bericht 'Verplicht op eigen kosten naar New York voor een paar studiepunten'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that university students must pay extra costs for excursions, materials and exams, which may breach the rules on charging such fees. The minister replied that the rules apply, that the Inspectorate found eight complaints justified and that institutions have promised better information, with no sanctions so far and a commitment to raise the issue with the universities' associations.
If it turns out that institutions do not comply with the law, the inspectorate will address them and, where necessary, take enforcement action.
Als blijkt dat instellingen zich niet aan de wet houden, zal de inspectie hen hierop aanspreken en zo nodig handhavend optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Van den Hul over piratenzenders

MPs Nijboer and Van den Hul asked about unlicensed pirate radio stations, rising fines, and whether the hobby could be tolerated or recognised as cultural heritage. The government defended enforcement by Agentschap Telecom on grounds of spectrum scarcity, safety and environmental harm, pointed to legal alternatives, and declined to endorse the heritage call.
The fining policy is aimed at stopping illegal activities or sharply reducing them.
Het boetebeleid is erop gericht om illegale activiteiten te doen stoppen dan wel sterk te doen verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de daling van het aantal leerlingen op het vmbo en mbo

An MP asks the education ministers about the decline in vmbo and mbo pupil numbers, the monitoring of havisten entering mbo, implementation of the regeerakkoord measures for vmbo teachers, the status of vmbo-mbo pathway experiments, and ways to improve the esteem of practical education. The ministers answer that the decline is mainly demographic, that havist inflows show no clear increase, that the teacher measures are not in the coalition agreement but teacher training is underway, and that pathway experiments are progressing with a bill planned.
The measures you mention are not in the coalition agreement.
De door u benoemde maatregelen staan niet in het regeerakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat Engels de voertaal wordt op de TU Eindhoven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether the TU Eindhoven's switch to English as the language of instruction and communication is justified, and how it affects staff and students and fits the Higher Education Act. The Minister answered that the choice is the university's, that language policy should be decided per programme, that Dutch-language programmes remain, and that she will reflect on better oversight of language decisions in her internationalisation letter.
I want to consider ways to make more generally transparent how language policy choices are made and whether those choices are indeed well considered and fit the legal framework.

Ik wil nadenken over manieren om, in algemene zin, beter inzichtelijk te maken op welke manier keuzes over taalbeleid tot stand komen en of die keuzes inderdaad weloverwogen zijn en passen in het wettelijk kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat de vergoeding aan gehandicapte studenten fors verschilt per gemeente

Futselaar (SP) asked whether the individual study allowance for disabled students, which differs strongly between municipalities, is unjust, whether application procedures are too complex, and whether this inequality conflicts with the UN Disability Convention. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are legally required to set the allowance by local ordinance, that local variation is an intended consequence of decentralisation, that a motion asks for an evaluation by 1 September 2018 and better publicity, and that this variation does not breach the UN Convention.
Centrally prescribing the amount of the individual study allowance does not fit with this.
Het centraal voorschrijven van de hoogte van de individuele studietoeslag past hier niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de subsidieregeling werkdrukvermindering

An SGP MP asked the education minister why schools that applied early for the work-pressure subsidy were rejected after the funding ceiling was reached, and whether applications submitted before the website notice should be honoured. The minister replied that applications were granted in order of receipt up to the ceiling, that schools had advance notice, and pointed to the new Werkdrukakkoord providing extra funds to all primary schools.
I will not grant more applications for the subsidy scheme than the subsidy ceiling allows.
Ik zal daarbij voor de subsidieregeling niet meer aanvragen toekennen dan het subsidieplafond mij toelaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht in het Brabants Dagblad van 24 januari jl. "Toezicht op erfgoed kan beter"

An MP asked the education, culture and science minister about a newspaper report that some Brabant municipalities have weak or abolished heritage advisory commissions, and whether this is widespread. The minister answered that the province supervises these commissions, the situation has improved, a fuller monitoring report is expected, and a joint cabinet response on the supervision law will follow.
Within the framework of inter-governmental supervision, the province of Noord-Brabant supervises heritage care in the Brabant municipalities.
In het kader van het interbestuurlijk toezicht houdt de provincie Noord-Brabant toezicht op de monumentenzorg bij de Brabantse gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat je alle controle over je werk kwijt bent als je Turnitin gebruikt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reports that students lose control over their work when submitted through Turnitin, including the broad licence granted to iParadigms and its affiliates, and how universities protect copyright. The minister answers that institutions choose their own tools, that about eighteen institutions hold licences via SURF, that the broad end-user licence does not apply to those institutions, and that the licence is being reassessed under the GDPR before 25 May 2018.
This reassessment will be completed before 25 May.
Deze herbeoordeling zal voor 25 mei aanstaande worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de berichten ‘Steeds minder doorstroom van mbo naar hbo’ en ‘Minder mbo’ers naar hbo in afgelopen decennium’

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Education about reports that the share of MBO graduates moving on to HBO has fallen since 2005, and whether this relates to the student loan system and to lower uptake among students from middle-income families. The Minister replied that the monitor shows no clear effect of the study grant reform yet, that the decline predates it and seems to be stabilising, and that the motives behind the decline will be examined in the next monitor, with a full policy response to be sent before summer.
I will send you the monitor on policy measures, with my response, before the summer.
Ik zal u de monitor beleidsmaatregelen, voorzien van mijn reactie, voor de zomer toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het rapport inzake Voorinvesteringen en medezeggenschap in het hoger onderwijs

An MP asks the Minister of Education about the Court of Audit report on pre-investments and works council involvement in higher education, including whether only 280 of 600 million euros was demonstrably spent on stated goals and whether students should be compensated. The Minister answers that the report shows unclear definitions rather than wrongdoing, promises clearer agreements in the quality agreements, and commits to sending a letter to parliament after talks with sector bodies.
As I also indicated in my written response to the Court of Audit report, we can learn from the report for future policy.
Zoals ik ook in mijn schriftelijke reactie 2 op het Algemene Rekenkamer rapport heb aangegeven, kunnen we van het rapport leren voor toekomstig beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Veldman en Weverling over het bericht ‘Maakbedrijven trekken naar India wegens groeiend gebrek aan Nederlandse ingenieurs’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Education about a newspaper report that manufacturing firms are moving to India due to a shortage of Dutch engineers, including expected shortages, number of firms leaving, and how other countries respond. The state secretary and minister answered that a shortage of technical talent is a growing constraint, that no integrated data exist on firms leaving or on the number of jobs lost, and that the government's Techniekpact is a model cited by other countries.
Statistics Netherlands does not keep data on the number of firms leaving the Netherlands.
Er worden (door het CBS) geen gegevens bijgehouden over aantallen bedrijven die uit Nederland vertrekken.
