Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Belhaj over fraude met oorlogswrakken in de Java-zee

Two MPs (Van Haga and Belhaj) asked ministers of Defence and Education, Culture and Science about reports of illegal salvage of Dutch WWII wrecks in the Java Sea, including permits and possible mass burial of remains. The ministers answered that Indonesia denies issuing permits, that the coordinates do not match the wrecks, that further joint on-site investigation is being arranged, and that next of kin are being informed.
The Netherlands is therefore currently in close consultation with the Indonesian authorities about the possibility of follow-up on-site investigation.
Nederland voert daarom op dit ogenblik nauw overleg met de Indonesische autoriteiten over de mogelijkheid van vervolgonderzoek ter plaatse.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laan-Geselschap over het bericht dat de buste van Johan Maurits is weggehaald uit de foyer van het Mauritshuis

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the Mauritshuis moving a bust of Johan Maurits out of its foyer amid debate over slavery's legacy, and whether such removals of historical figures' statues and names should be stopped. The minister answered that the museum decides how to present its history, that the figure has been presented in a revised context since 2017, and that museums and municipalities may join the debate with added context.
I leave it to the Mauritshuis to decide how it wants to present and integrate art and history in its public activities.
Ik laat aan het Mauritshuis over op welke wijze zij de kunst en de geschiedenis willen presenteren en integreren in hun publieksactiviteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bindend studieadvies

MP Özdil asks the Minister of Education about the binding study advice (bindend studieadvies), citing a dissertation on student success, alternatives such as mentoring and grants, and the legal basis allowing a rejection to end enrolment. The Minister acknowledges the research, promises further study of the binding advice including input from student bodies and the CBHO ruling, but declines to make the advice non-binding or to widen the aanvullende beurs.
Therefore I will have further research conducted into the current functioning of the binding study advice.
Daarom zal ik verder onderzoek laten doen naar de huidige werking van het bindend studieadvies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over mogelijke mijnbouwactiviteiten aan de grens met België bij Zuid-Limburg voor de winning van onder andere zink en mogelijke effecten voor de Nederlandse bie

CDA MPs asked whether Belgian mining exploration for zinc near the Dutch border, and the Einstein Telescope bid in South Limburg, threaten each other. The minister answered that the Belgian authorities did not notify the Netherlands, that a transboundary environmental assessment would be required, and that the Belgian mining could affect the telescope's noise environment, but that it is too early to judge and the matter will be investigated with the province and the Belgian authorities.
I was not informed by the Belgian authorities.
Ik ben door de Belgische autoriteiten niet op de hoogte gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kwint, Van den Hul en Van Raan over het bericht 'Steeds meer kinderen in 'plofklassen''

MPs from GroenLinks, SP, PvdA and PvdA-adjacent PvdD asked the ministers about reports that more children are in large classes, with questions on class size trends, staffing ratios, teacher workload and passend onderwijs. The minister answered that large-class shares fell in 2017, gave statistics across primary and secondary education, and said no binding class-size targets or sector-wide agreements would be made.
The share of large classes has fallen over the past year.
Het aandeel grote klassen is het afgelopen jaar gedaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over de berichten dat begrotingen aan universiteitsraden worden voorgelegd zonder goede verantwoording van besteding studievoorschotsmiddelen

An SP MP asked the minister whether universities are presenting budgets to university councils without proper accounting for spending of study-fee (studievoorschot) funds, and whether the minister will hold institutions to account and inform councils of their co-determination right. The minister acknowledged the reports, confirmed the councils' consent right over budget outlines, pointed to institutional sector agreements and future monitoring, but committed to no direct enforcement step against institutions.
With the Study Fee Act for higher education, the co-determination bodies have been given a right of consent over the main lines of the budget.
Met de Wet studievoorschot hoger onderwijs heeft de medezeggenschap instemmingsrecht op de hoofdlijnen van de begroting gekregen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over incidenten tijdens de ontgroening bij het studentencorps in Rotterdam

An MP asked the education minister how she assesses abuses during hazing at the Rotterdam student corps RSC/RVSV, shown in a TV broadcast, and why the rector had not yet acted. The minister condemned all violence and noted that the Erasmus University suspended its relationship with the association, ending subsidies and its presence at official events, while stating that physical boundaries must never be crossed.
The rector magnificus of the Erasmus University decided, immediately after viewing the footage, to suspend the relationship with student association RSC/RVSV with immediate effect.
De rector magnificus van de Erasmus Universiteit heeft namelijk besloten om, direct na het zien van de beelden, de relatie met studentenvereniging RSC/RVSV met onmiddellijke ingang op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over incidenten tijdens de ontgroening bij het studentencorps voor vrouwen in Utrecht, UVSV

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether she supports the suspension of university and college funding to the women's student corps UVSV after hazing incidents, whether incidents were reported to the independent advisory committee, whether criminal offences occurred, and whether she will act against the UVSV or the institutions. The minister answered that she supports the suspension, that the events shown were not reported to the advisory committee, that criminality is unknown and left to investigation and courts, and that she considers the institutions acted correctly and that restoring trust is primarily the association's task.

I am of the view that the University of Utrecht and the University of Applied Sciences Utrecht have acted appropriately here, and I consider it up to the educational institution to act when unacceptable, humiliating incidents have occurred.

Ik ben van mening dat de Universiteit Utrecht en Hogeschool Utrecht hier op een juiste wijze hebben gehandeld en ik vind het aan de onderwijsinstelling om op te treden als er ontoelaatbare, vernederende incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Futselaar over het bericht dat middelbare scholen, universiteiten en bedrijven de handen ineens slaan voor het aanpakken van het lerarentekort

MPs Kwint and Futselaar asked about a plan in which secondary schools, universities and Shell jointly retrain surplus Shell staff as teachers, raising questions about funding ties, teacher independence, loyalty and pay. The ministers welcomed the initiative as a way to expand career-changer entry, said Shell only points staff to the option and funds some training costs, and stated that schools set contracts and pay while relying on existing checks.
We rely on the checks and balances built into education regulation, among other things.
Wij vertrouwen op de checks and balances die onder meer door regelgeving in het onderwijs zijn ingebouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat selectie aan de poort niet leidt tot betere studieresultaten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education whether research showing that selection at the gate for medicine does not improve study results means selection should be abandoned. The Minister acknowledged the research, said decentralised selection aims at fit rather than study success, committed to extra monitoring and knowledge sharing, and refused to abolish selection.
No. Programmes with student demand exceeding their teaching capacity and limited labour-market prospects must be able to introduce a numerus fixus.

Nee. Opleidingen met een belangstelling van studiekiezers die groter is dan de onderwijscapaciteit van de opleiding en waarvan het arbeidsmarktperspectief beperkt is, moeten een numerus fixus kunnen instellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de woekerhandel in concertkaarten kan voortduren

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked whether the government would tackle large-scale secondary resale of concert tickets, including by Live Nation's platforms, and whether it would act against professional resale. The Staatssecretaris answered that resale is nuanced, that the ACM already has tools and has acted in specific cases, that talks with the sector will follow, and that any EU-level measures are preferable, without committing to new legislation yet.
As indicated in the answers to questions 3, 5 and 7, I first want to enter into discussion with the sector and then consider what may need to be done.
Zoals aangegeven in de antwoorden op de vragen 3, 5 en 7 wil ik nu eerst het gesprek met de sector aangaan en daarna bezien wat er eventueel moet gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Duitsers binnenkort kunnen kiezen om ‘interseksueel’ te zijn

MP Sjoerdsma asked whether the German Constitutional Court's ruling allowing an intersex or diverse registration option is noted, and whether the Netherlands should follow and limit sex registration. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said the Netherlands has no ethics committee on this, is having the advisory commission consider it, and committed to further consultation and to exploring limiting unnecessary sex registration.
The Cabinet will inform the House of Representatives in the usual way.
Het Kabinet zal uw Kamer op de gebruikelijke wijze informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint inzake de Muur van Mussert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Muur van Mussert, a historic wall in Ede, should be protected as a national monument given reports it may be demolished for a campsite expansion. The minister said a review on remembering wartime heritage will conclude next year, the wall is currently protected by a municipal heritage ordinance, and a rijksmonument designation will be decided after talks with the municipality and owner.
Based on talks with the municipality and the owner and on the mentioned review, I will decide whether protection of the Wall as a national monument is the most suitable instrument.
Op basis van gesprekken met de gemeente en de eigenaar en op basis van de genoemde verkenning zal ik besluiten of bescherming van de Muur als rijksmonument het meest geschikte instrument is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over het bericht ‘De muur van Mussert maakt deel uit van onze geschiedenis’

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a planned demolition notice for the 'Mussert wall' and whether it could be protected as a monument, and about the timing of a review of military and memorial heritage. The minister replied that a demolition notice was filed when no protection existed, that interim protection requests at municipal level are said to halt the demolition threat, and that the review will be ready by end 2018.
The reviews will be completed by the end of 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Sjoerdsma over homofobie in de voetbalwereld

MPs Diertens and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers about a news report on homophobia in football, whether homosexuality remains a taboo among professional players, and how acceptance of LHBTI athletes in sport will be promoted. The minister condemned intolerance, cited a 2014 survey of players, and pointed to KNVB workshops, the Alliantie Gelijkspelen and the sports agreement as measures.
To further promote diversity in sport and the acceptance of LHBTI athletes, I will include this theme as a focus area in future sports policy.
Om diversiteit in de sport en de acceptatie van LHBTI-sporters verder te bevorderen, zal ik dit thema meenemen als aandachtsgebied in het toekomstig sportbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema, Wilders over het bericht 'Videos. Universitaire kindbruidjes over de zegeningen van islam'

PVV MPs asked the Education Minister whether a university Islam academy's programme undermines critical thinking, and whether Oman-funded chairs should be banned. The minister denied any duty to suppress critical thinking, said the academy responds to partner requests, and rejected a ban since Oman has no influence over the chair, which the university controls.
No. It is precisely a task of Dutch education to stimulate critical thinking.
Nee. Het is juist een taak van het Nederlands onderwijs kritisch vermogen te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sjoerdsma over bureaucratie bij het aanvragen van een genderneutrale ov-chipkaart

Two D66 MPs asked why applying for a gender-neutral OV-chipkaart involved bureaucracy, and whether such a card should be offered. The state secretary answered that the sector committed to dropping the m/v gender marker on all new cards from 1 January 2017, with NS cards following by 20 December 2017, and that she welcomes this and supports gender-neutral cards.
That is why I am glad that very soon, without bureaucratic obstacles, no m/v marking will be visible on any new OV-chipkaarts.
Daarom ben ik blij dat er zeer binnenkort zonder bureaucratische drempels op alle nieuwe OV-chipkaarten geen m/v vermelding meer zichtbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Özütok over de afhandeling van de zaak Artez

Two MPs asked the ministers about the costs and lessons of the ArtEZ top-salary (WNT) case, the first enforcement of its kind, which involved a penalty order by the Education Inspectorate. The government estimates about €350,000 in public costs, says lessons are shared among WNT supervisors, promises evaluation of supervision and enforcement in 2019, and points to the annual WNT report for other cases.
In the next evaluation of the WNT, planned for 2019, supervision and enforcement will be specifically evaluated, among other things.
In de volgende evaluatie van de WNT, voorzien in 2019, zullen onder meer het toezicht en de handhaving gericht worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Futselaar over het bericht dat er een studentenstop is aan de verpleegkunde opleidingen

MPs Marijnissen and Futselaar asked about a reported student admission stop for nursing programmes amid a severe nurse shortage, the adequacy of internship places, use of trainees to fill staff gaps, and demands from nurses' organisations. Minister De Jonge answered that growth in places is managed regionally, that no hard data exist on students stopping for lack of internships, that the Stagefonds and regional action plans are being used, and that a planned action day was supported.
According to the Landelijk Overleg Opleiding Verpleegkunde, there is no hard data on students who had to stop their studies due to a shortage of internship places.
Volgens het Landelijk Overleg Opleiding Verpleegkunde zijn er geen harde gegevens over studenten die hun studie hebben moeten stoppen vanwege een tekort aan stageplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en Van der Linde over het bericht dat er een studentenstop is aan de verpleegkunde opleidingen

MPs Hermans and Van der Linde asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports of a student intake cap (numerus fixus) for nursing programmes despite a nursing shortage, including its causes, internship availability and the Utrecht case. The minister answered that fixus programmes fell from 56 to 33, that caps protect quality and internship places, that internship capacity has grown, and that the Utrecht university of applied sciences is moving to a cap of 400 full-time students.
The main reason for a programme to introduce a numerus fixus is to maintain the quality of the programme and to offer students sufficient and good-quality internship places.

De voornaamste reden voor een opleiding om een numerus fixus in te stellen is om de kwaliteit van de opleiding te behouden en om voor de studenten voldoende en kwalitatief goede stageplekken te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat 62% van de studenten in het dagelijks leven prestatiedruk ervaart

An SP MP asks the education minister how she views the finding that 62% of students experience performance pressure, and what causes and measures follow, including links to finances, study pressure, selection and a national study. The minister acknowledges student pressure as a multi-causal issue, cites ongoing talks under the Bruins/Asante motion and an NRO research call, but gives no direct link to financial causes or a large national study beyond that call.
I expect to be able to inform your House in spring 2018 about the implementation of the motion.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2018 over de uitwerking van de motie te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Linde over het bericht dat 62% van de studenten in het dagelijks leven prestatiedruk ervaart

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a report that 62% of students often experience performance pressure, questioning the methodology and whether high performance pressure is a problem. The Minister defended both surveys as methodologically sound, rejected the inference that 38% experience little pressure, and said she is consulting institutions on a motion and will inform parliament in spring 2018.
I expect to be able to inform your House in spring 2018 about the implementation of the motion.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2018 over de uitwerking van de motie te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over het bericht “Waar blijven die extra uni-docenten”

MP Van der Molen (CDA) asked the Minister of Education whether universities, despite hiring about 900 of the promised 1400 extra lecturers, are falling behind student growth, and why university hiring lags behind hogeschool hiring. The Minister replied that institutions have discretion over how to spend study-advance funds, that she cannot confirm fewer lecturers work than in 2012, and that quality agreements on the funds will be made from 2018.
I assume that hiring additional lecturers has priority in the spending of the study-advance funds.
Ik ga ervan uit dat het aanstellen van extra docenten prioriteit heeft in de besteding van de studievoorschotmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Ellemeet over de numerus fixus in (tand)artsenopleidingen

MPs Özdil and Ellemeet asked whether the numerus fixus in dentist and doctor training causes the dentist shortage, raises specialist salaries and collective care costs, and whether more training places should be funded. The minister answered that the latest capacity study is under way with results expected end 2017 or early 2018, that the numerus fixus is considered sufficiently generous, and that integrated tariffs were introduced in 2015 to address costs, without committing to a new estimate of places.
I would prefer to await the results of this study before making statements about the number of training places needed.
Graag wacht ik de resultaten van dit onderzoek af alvorens uitspraken te doen over het aantal benodigde opleidingsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kwint over het bericht 'Groot deel leerlingen locatie Zadkine Rotterdam volgt lessen niet'

MPs Van den Hul and Kwint asked the Minister of Education about reports that many logistics students at ROC Zadkine Rotterdam rarely attend lessons, and how the institution, inspectorate and municipality respond. The Minister calls the attendance findings serious, says Zadkine must fix its absence policy with the municipality's help, notes a follow-up inspection check in January, and outlines the municipal truancy-supervision legal gap and planned legislation.
The management of the five examined courses can, however, as the Inspectorate report showed, do more to reduce absenteeism and dropout.
Het management van de vijf onderzochte opleidingen kan er echter, zo is uit het Inspectierapport gebleken, nog meer aan doen om verzuim en uitval terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over misbruik bij toneelopleidingen

MP Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reported sexual misconduct by teachers at drama schools and whether these schools are safe learning environments. The minister acknowledged the power imbalance, reported few signals of abuse, said institutions must have complaint procedures and support systems, and described a proactive investigation at one school.
Institutions must ensure a safe environment in which students and teachers feel encouraged to report any form of unwanted behaviour.
Instellingen moeten zorgdragen voor een veilige omgeving, waarbinnen student en docent bij elke vorm van ongewenst gedrag zich aangemoedigd voelen om tot melding over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Westerveld over het massaal delen van verhalen over grensoverschrijdend seksueel gedrag

MPs Voortman and Westerveld asked the ministers of Education and of Health about the mass sharing of #MeToo stories on sexual boundary violations, whether the percentage affected is unacceptable, and how schools, coaches, employers and teacher training will address boundaries, consent and harassment. The minister answered that such conduct is unacceptable, that schools already cover sexual boundaries under the existing core objectives, that teacher training and sport programmes address these topics, and that a sport-sector study is expected in December 2017.
Yes, this is already a task of education.
Ja, dit is al een taak van het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beertema over het bericht dat Nederlandse wapenkennis en -technologieën in handen zijn gekomen van Iran, Syrië en Pakistan

An MP asked the education minister whether Dutch weapons knowledge reached Iran, Syria and Pakistan, which universities were involved, and whether students from OIC countries are screened. The minister answered that no involvement of universities or departments is known, that all students in listed programmes undergo risk analysis under the North Korea sanctions regulation, and that fewer than 10 OIC-country students applied for exemption in 2016.
It is not known that universities or departments are involved in this.
Het is niet bekend dat hier universiteiten/vakgroepen bij zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over zorgen bij ouders over de studievoortgang van kinderen door problemen met toegang tot digitaal lesmateriaal

MP Kwint asked the minister whether it is acceptable that vocational students waited weeks for digital course material from distributor Studers, how many lack access, whether there are problems at other distributors, and how students will be protected from learning delays and cost. The minister answers that the matter is a private contractual issue between suppliers, schools and students, that most problems are now solved, that an independent investigation will follow, and that the government has no formal role in the refund or assessment questions.
Agreements between suppliers of course material and schools are agreements between two private parties. I have no direct involvement in them.
Afspraken tussen leveranciers van lesmateriaal en scholen zijn afspraken tussen twee private partijen. Ik heb daar geen directe bemoeienis mee.

m: Amendement van het lid Mooiman over het uitsluiten van urgentie voor statushouders
Amendment to exclude holders of residence permits from the housing-applicant definition, so municipalities cannot give statushouders a priority urgency category.
Housing applicants referred to in the first paragraph do not include foreigners who have been granted a residence permit under the Aliens Act 2000.
Tot de woningzoekenden, bedoeld in het eerste lid, behoren niet vreemdelingen aan wie een verblijfsvergunning als bedoeld in de Vreemdelingenwet 2000 is verleend.
Amendement van de leden Tony van Dijck en Mooiman over middelen voor het verhogen van de huurtoeslag in 2026
Amendment shifts 806 million euro of released housing-corporation funds to raise the rent allowance in 2026.
the released funds intended for housing corporations to compensate lost rental income from the rent freeze are used to increase the rent allowance
worden de vrijgevallen middelen die bestemd waren voor woningcorporaties ter compensatie van de gederfde huurinkomsten als gevolg van de huurbevriezing aangewend om de huurtoeslag te verhogen
Motie van het lid Mooiman c.s. over een blijvende actieve inzet om woningbouw op de locatie Bleizo-West op korte termijn mogelijk te maken
Asks the government to keep actively pursuing housing construction at Bleizo-West in Lansingerland in the short term, using instruments where needed.
requests the government to keep actively working to make housing construction at the Bleizo-West location in Lansingerland possible in the short term
verzoekt de regering zich actief in te blijven zetten om woningbouw op de locatie Bleizo-West in Lansingerland op korte termijn mogelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Mooiman over een oproep aan gemeenten om geen bovenwettenlijke eisen op te leggen aan nieuwbouwwoningen
Asks the government to urge municipalities not to impose beyond-statutory requirements on new homes and to monitor compliance.
requests the government to urge municipalities not to impose beyond-statutory requirements on new homes
verzoekt de regering gemeenten op te roepen om geen bovenwettelijke eisen op te leggen aan nieuwbouwwoningen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Mooiman over recente artikelen ’Zonnepanelen ontploffen en zorgen voor problemen' en 'Expert: Stop met brandbare isolatie'

Two MPs asked the minister about fires involving external insulation and solar panels in Arnhem and Didam, and about fire safety rules for renovation and sustainability projects. The minister answered that existing Bbl fire rules apply, that monitoring and follow-up research (TNO, NIPV, Royal Haskoning DHV, NEN) are underway, and that no new national rules, action plan or structural programme is considered necessary.
Banning combustible insulation materials in the building envelope of homes is not appropriate.
Het verbieden van brandbare isolatiematerialen in de gebouwschil van woningen ligt niet in de rede.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Omtzigt, Mooiman en Wilders over het bericht ‘Maximale huurverhoging vanaf 1 januari 2025: 4,1% voor vrije sector en 7,7% voor middenhuur’

MPs asked the Minister of Housing whether the 7.7% maximum rent increase for mid-segment rentals in 2025 is acceptable for households, and whether additional measures, a transitional arrangement, or a structural change to the mid-rent increase system are planned. The minister answered that the increase follows from the Wet betaalbare huur tied to collective wage growth, that the actual increase will often be lower, and that no legislative change is planned before the 2027 evaluation, while declining to calculate household income effects.
I therefore cannot make a calculation of the effects on the purchasing power figures.
Ik kan dan ook geen doorrekening maken van de effecten in de koopkrachtplaatjes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mooiman en Emiel van Dijk over het opgeven van soevereiniteit voor de interne markt

PVV MPs Mooiman and Emiel van Dijk asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch sovereignty would be surrendered to complete the EU capital markets union and how this would affect autonomy, alternatives, and protection against liability for other member states. The minister answered that the goals can be pursued within existing EU powers via harmonisation and stronger ESA supervision, that any new EU powers require Dutch consent, and that parliament will be involved through BNC fiches, while giving only general answers and no concrete commitment to new scrutiny steps.

The cabinet will involve your House, in line with the regular arrangements, in the Dutch assessment of and position on new white or green papers, communications (action plans) and/or legislative proposals from the European Commission.

Het kabinet zal uw Kamer conform de reguliere afspraken betrekken bij de Nederlandse appreciatie van en inzet bij nieuwe wit-of groenboeken, mededelingen (actieplannen) en/of wetgevende voorstellen van de Europese Commissie.
